articles.title: Grizzlies could thrive in California — so why aren’t we reintroducing them?
articles.author: Peter S. Alagona

paras.en: Computer models are widely used in ecological research and conservation, providing scientists with tools to predict how a given species might respond to a stressor or shift in conditions. These models can then be refined and built upon with real world data to get a better understanding of what's going on within a population and what the biggest risks are.
paras.zh: 计算机模型广泛应用于生态研究和保护，为科学家提供了预测特定物种如何应对压力源或条件变化的工具。然后可以利用现实世界的数据来完善和建立这些模型，以更好地了解人群中正在发生的事情以及最大的风险是什么。

paras.en: But models aren't perfect. In this excerpt from "Start With a Bear: Humans, Grizzlies, and the Power of Stories on a Crowded Planet" (HarperOne, 2026), author Peter S. Alagona highlights how these models are built on the presumptions of their creators. Alagona examines the model of grizzly bear (Ursus arctos horribilis) habitats used by the Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) to inform its recovery plan for the species — and why California, despite its apparent suitability, was left out.
paras.zh: 但模型并不完美。在《从一只熊开始：人类、灰熊和拥挤星球上故事的力量》（HarperOne，2026 年）的摘录中，作者 Peter S. Aragona 强调了这些模型是如何建立在其创建者的假设之上的。阿拉戈纳检查了鱼类和野生动物管理局 (FWS) 使用的灰熊 (Ursus arctos horribilis) 栖息地模型，以告知其该物种的恢复计划 - 以及为什么加州尽管表面上适合，但被排除在外。

paras.en: Most of the grizzly habitat models that were introduced in the 1990s and 2000s, and then improved in the 2010s and 2020s, make two key assumptions. They assume that conservation efforts should focus on the best remaining grizzly habitats, and that we can best understand those habitats by studying bears in the places where they still live.
paras.zh: 大多数灰熊栖息地模型在 2010 年代和 2020 年代引入，并在 2010 年代和 2020 年代进行了改进，做出了两个关键假设。他们认为保护工作应该集中在现存最好的灰熊栖息地，并且我们可以通过研究熊仍然生活的地方来最好地了解这些栖息地。

paras.en: The result has, indeed, been a far better understanding of grizzly habitat use. But this approach has also produced a circular logic with a structural bias toward the status quo. In most grizzly habitat models, past realities and future possibilities fade. With each new study, it seems more and more like the only possible places for grizzlies are the exact kinds of places where they currently live.
paras.zh: 事实上，其结果是对灰熊栖息地的利用有了更好的了解。但这种做法也产生了一种循环逻辑，对现状存在结构性偏见。在大多数灰熊栖息地模型中，过去的现实和未来的可能性都消失了。每一项新的研究都表明，灰熊唯一可能居住的地方似乎就是它们目前居住的地方。

paras.en: The six recovery areas identified in the 1993 Recovery Plan were all places where grizzlies still lived or had recently lived when they were listed as threatened in 1975. The plan argued that these areas "had the potential to provide adequate space and habitat to maintain the grizzly bear as a viable and self-sustaining species." But it also acknowledged the risks and uncertainties facing the bears, and it pledged to assess other areas in their historical range.
paras.zh: 1993 年恢复计划中确定的六个恢复区域都是灰熊在 1975 年被列为受威胁物种时仍然居住或最近居住的地方。该计划认为，这些区域“有潜力提供足够的空间和栖息地，以维持灰熊作为一个可生存和自我维持的物种”。但它也承认空头面临的风险和不确定性，并承诺评估其历史范围内的其他领域。

paras.en: This process was expected to take five years. Twenty-eight years later, in 2019, the FWS settled a federal lawsuit in which it agreed to finally conduct this long-delayed analysis. It built a simple model based mainly on secure habitat, and then applied it to both the San Juan Mountains of Colorado and the Sierra Nevada of California. Other potential recovery areas — such as the North Rim of the Grand Canyon in Arizona, the Gila Wilderness in New Mexico, and the Northwest Forest of Northern California — were, for unexplained reasons, not included.
paras.zh: 这一过程预计需要五年时间。 28 年后的 2019 年，FWS 就一项联邦诉讼达成和解，同意最终进行这项拖延已久的分析。它建立了一个主要基于安全栖息地的简单模型，然后将其应用于科罗拉多州的圣胡安山脉和加利福尼亚州的内华达山脉。其他潜在的恢复区域——例如亚利桑那州大峡谷北缘、新墨西哥州吉拉荒野和北加州西北森林——由于不明原因未被包括在内。

paras.en: The model did its job. According to the FWS, neither the San Juans nor the Sierra Nevada contained enough secure habitat to support a viable grizzly population. Instead of subjecting the study to peer review, the FWS published it in an appendix on page 286 of a species status report. Having pioneered the idea of secure habitat, David Mattson now set out to explain why the FWS was abusing it. In his view, the service's models focused on artificially small areas, failed to consider several key factors described in the scientific literature, and neglected to conduct essential supporting analyses to explain its conclusions.
paras.zh: 该模型完成了它的工作。根据森林气象局的说法，圣胡安和内华达山脉都没有足够安全的栖息地来支持灰熊的生存。 FWS 没有将该研究进行同行评审，而是将其发布在物种状态报告第 286 页的附录中。戴维·马特森 (David Mattson) 率先提出了安全栖息地的理念，现在他开始解释 FWS 滥用这一理念的原因。在他看来，该服务的模型侧重于人为的小区域，没有考虑科学文献中描述的几个关键因素，并且忽略了进行必要的支持分析来解释其结论。

paras.en: The FWS had dragged its heels for almost three decades, and then, after pledging in court to conduct a good-faith analysis, produced a study that seemed designed to reach a predetermined result: The only places capable of supporting grizzlies were the places where the FWS was already trying to recover them. When Mattson and his colleague Troy Merrill ran a more detailed model for the southwestern states, they found that Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico, and Utah contained seven potential recovery areas with more than 45,000 square kilometers of suitable habitat that could probably support more than 1,000 bears.
paras.zh: FWS已经拖延了近三十年，然后，在法庭上承诺进行善意分析后，进行了一项研究，似乎旨在达到预定的结果：唯一能够支持灰熊的地方是FWS已经试图恢复灰熊的地方。当马特森和他的同事特洛伊·梅里尔为西南部各州运行更详细的模型时，他们发现亚利桑那州、科罗拉多州、新墨西哥州和犹他州包含七个潜在的恢复区域，拥有超过 45,000 平方公里的合适栖息地，可能可以容纳 1,000 多只熊。

paras.en: For more than a century, the prevailing narrative in California has been that the grizzly's extinction there was inevitable and its recovery is impossible. But Mattson's results for the southwest, combined with California's unique geography, cast doubt on this story.
paras.zh: 一个多世纪以来，加利福尼亚州盛行的说法是，灰熊的灭绝是不可避免的，而且不可能恢复。但马特森对西南部的研究结果，加上加州独特的地理位置，让人们对这个故事产生了怀疑。

paras.en: California is home to nearly 40 million people, and it has more miles of roads than any state except Texas. But its population is extraordinarily concentrated. California is the most urban state, with 95% of its residents packed into cities and 75% living on only around 2% of its land area. Much of California has a human population density lower than that of the Northern Rockies. Unlike in the Northern Rockies, the majority of California's farms are concentrated in broad valleys dozens of miles from core wilderness habitats.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州拥有近 4000 万人口，其道路里程数超过除德克萨斯州以外的任何州。但其人口却异常集中。加利福尼亚州是城市化程度最高的州，95% 的居民都居住在城市，而 75% 的居民仅生活在约 2% 的土地面积上。加利福尼亚州大部分地区的人口密度低于北落基山脉。与北落基山脉不同，加州的大部分农场都集中在距核心荒野栖息地数十英里的宽阔山谷中。

paras.en: Outside urban and agricultural areas, California has more protected land than any state except Alaska, including the largest areas of potential grizzly habitat outside the six current recovery zones. Some of these protected areas are in desert ecosystems not suitable for grizzly bears, but others are in mountain ecosystems with potential grizzly habitat.
paras.zh: 在城市和农业区之外，加利福尼亚州拥有的受保护土地比除阿拉斯加州以外的任何州都多，其中包括目前六个恢复区之外最大的潜在灰熊栖息地区域。其中一些保护区位于不适合灰熊生存的沙漠生态系统中，但其他保护区位于具有潜在灰熊栖息地的山区生态系统中。

paras.en: California's national parks and wilderness areas sometimes strain under heavy visitation, but the numbers paint a complex picture. Consider the southern High Sierra. In 2024, Sequoia Kings Canyon National Park, which is around 865,000 acres and 97% wilderness, topped 2 million visitors for the first time, whereas Yellowstone, which is around 2.2 million acres and 90% wilderness, received almost 5 million visitors, meaning that both parks had about 2.3 visitors per acre. Yellowstone has more than double the total land area in wilderness, but both parks border large U.S. Forest Service wilderness areas and other public lands, and the High Sierra has fewer roads cutting across its protected areas.
paras.zh: 加州的国家公园和荒野地区有时会因为大量游客而造成压力，但这些数字描绘了一幅复杂的景象。以南部高山脉为例。 2024 年，占地约 865,000 英亩、97% 为荒野的红杉国王峡谷国家公园接待游客量首次突破 200 万，而占地约 220 万英亩、90% 为荒野的黄石公园接待了近 500 万名游客，这意味着两个公园每英亩约有 2.3 名游客。黄石公园的荒野总面积是黄石公园总面积的两倍多，但这两个公园都与美国林务局的大片荒野地区和其他公共土地接壤，而高山脉穿过其保护区的道路较少。

paras.en: In 2024, I coauthored a study, almost eight years in the making, looking at potential grizzly habitat in California. This project, led by Alex McInturff from the University of Washington, ran four computer models, and then compared them to assess the results each produced. One of these models focused on historical sightings of grizzlies in California, two used approaches developed in other regions where brown bears currently live, and one looked at the habitat use preferences of one of California's other large carnivores, the puma.
paras.zh: 2024 年，我与他人合着了一项研究，花了近八年的时间，研究了加利福尼亚州潜在的灰熊栖息地。该项目由华盛顿大学的 Alex McInturff 领导，运行了四个计算机模型，然后对它们进行比较以评估每个模型产生的结果。其中一个模型侧重于加利福尼亚州灰熊的历史目击事件，两个模型使用了在棕熊目前居住的其他地区开发的方法，还有一个模型着眼于加利福尼亚州其他大型食肉动物之一美洲狮的栖息地使用偏好。

paras.en: Each of these approaches has its own strengths and weaknesses. None of them fully account for the distribution or abundance of food on the landscape or for possible conflicts with people. Together, however, they provide a first assessment of the amount, quality, and locations of potential grizzly habitats. Amazingly, about a third of California appeared as suitable habitat in all four models.
paras.zh: 这些方法中的每一种都有其自身的优点和缺点。它们都没有充分解释景观中食物的分布或丰富程度，或与人类可能发生的冲突。然而，它们共同对潜在灰熊栖息地的数量、质量和位置进行了初步评估。令人惊讶的是，在所有四个模型中，大约三分之一的加利福尼亚州似乎都是合适的栖息地。

paras.en: The biggest areas of high-quality habitat were in the southern Sierra Nevada, around Sequoia-Kings Canyon National Park, where some of the last California grizzly sightings occurred in the 1920s. The Northwest Forest, along the Pacific Coast near the Oregon border, also scored highly owing to its low human population density and rich forest habitats. The Transverse Ranges, in the state's southwestern corner, scored highly because of their rich chaparral habitats and density of historical sightings, but ranked somewhat lower than the other two because more people live, work, and grow crops, including extensive vineyards and avocado orchards, around its borders.
paras.zh: 最大的优质栖息地位于内华达山脉南部，红杉国王峡谷国家公园周围，加州最后的灰熊目击事件发生在 1920 年代。靠近俄勒冈州边境的太平洋海岸的西北森林也因其人口密度低和森林栖息地丰富而得分很高。位于该州西南角的横向山脉因其丰富的丛林栖息地和历史景点的密度而得分很高，但排名略低于其他两个，因为更多的人在其边界周围生活、工作和种植农作物，包括大面积的葡萄园和鳄梨果园。

paras.en: - 'We're looking at how a bear sees the world': From forest trails to 'Sims for Bears,' researchers are learning how grizzlies navigate a fragmented wilderness
paras.zh: - “我们正在研究熊如何看待世界”：从森林小径到“熊的模拟人生”，研究人员正在了解灰熊如何在支离破碎的荒野中航行

paras.en: - Bear hair and fish weirs: Meet the Indigenous people combining modern science with ancestral principles to protect the land
paras.zh: - 熊毛和鱼堰：了解土著人民将现代科学与祖先原则相结合以保护土地

paras.en: - Photojournalist Steve Winter on his iconic Hollywood puma image, the illegal tiger trade and having a black panther knock on his door
paras.zh: - 摄影记者史蒂夫·温特谈他标志性的好莱坞美洲狮形象、非法老虎贸易以及黑豹来敲门

paras.en: These results made intuitive sense, given the state's robust historical grizzly population, large areas of protected habitat, and healthy black bear populations. But they represented a departure from the conventional wisdom that dominated the circular logic of most habitat models. For the first time, it was clear how much potential habitat could be available in California for a grizzly recovery. But our approach still clung to the conservative assumption that the grizzly is a wilderness species. We had shown, with some important caveats, that California probably had enough wilderness to support one or more viable grizzly populations.
paras.zh: 考虑到该州历史悠久的灰熊种群、大面积的受保护栖息地以及健康的黑熊种群，这些结果具有直观意义。但它们代表了对主导大多数栖息地模型循环逻辑的传统智慧的背离。第一次明确了加州有多少潜在栖息地可供灰熊恢复。但我们的方法仍然坚持保守的假设，即灰熊是一种荒野物种。我们已经表明，尽管有一些重要的警告，加利福尼亚州可能有足够的荒野来支持一个或多个可行的灰熊种群。

paras.en: What we hadn't shown was whether Californians were willing to coexist with grizzlies that might, someday, wander outside the state's wilderness boundaries.
paras.zh: 我们没有展示的是加州人是否愿意与灰熊共存，这些灰熊有一天可能会游荡到该州的荒野边界之外。

paras.en: Help us improve Live Science Pro: We're always trying to make our content better. Leave us feedback about Pro here.
paras.zh: 帮助我们改进 Live Science Pro：我们一直在努力让我们的内容变得更好。 Leave us feedback about Pro here.

paras.en: A century ago, prevailing wisdom cast large carnivores as adversaries—pests and threats to be removed for human safety and prosperity. In North America, among the most targeted of these animals were brown bears, or grizzlies, whose population decimation has made them emblematic of this fear-driven approach to wildlife management.
paras.zh: 一个世纪前，普遍的观点将大型食肉动物视为敌人——为了人类的安全和繁荣，需要消除害虫和威胁。在北美，这些动物中最受攻击的目标之一是棕熊或灰熊，它们的数量锐减使它们成为这种由恐惧驱动的野生动物管理方法的象征。

paras.en: In California, where they once roamed the land in the tens of thousands, grizzlys have not been seen in more than 100 years. Modern conservation has evolved, yet it often remains rooted in a separation from nature, a systemic opposition that keeps the wild at arm's length.
paras.zh: 在加利福尼亚州，曾经有数以万计的灰熊在这片土地上漫步，但现在已经有一百多年没有见到灰熊了。现代保护已经发展，但它往往仍然植根于与自然的分离，这是一种与野生动物保持一定距离的系统性对立。

paras.en: In Start with a Bear, historian, ecologist, and bear expert Peter Alagona suggests we must reimagine the very heart of conservation, inviting a new framework for sustainable, reciprocal relations with the wild creatures that remain.
paras.zh: 在《从一只熊开始》一书中，历史学家、生态学家和熊类专家彼得·阿拉戈纳建议我们必须重新构想保护的核心，引入一个新的框架，与现存的野生动物建立可持续、互惠的关系。

paras.en: Peter S. Alagona is an environmental historian, conservation scientist, and nature-culture geographer. His work explores what happens when people share space and resources (their habitats) with other species: how we interact with non-human creatures, how we make sense of these interactions, why we fight so much about them, what we can learn from them, and how we might use these lessons to foster a more just, peaceful, humane, and sustainable society. He is a professor of environmental studies at the University of California, Santa Barbara. He is the author of "After the Grizzly" and "The Accidental Ecosystem."
paras.zh: Peter S. Aragona 是一位环境历史学家、保护科学家和自然文化地理学家。他的作品探讨了当人们与其他物种共享空间和资源（栖息地）时会发生什么：我们如何与非人类生物互动，我们如何理解这些互动，为什么我们对它们如此争论，我们可以从它们身上学到什么，以及我们如何利用这些经验来培育一个更加公正、和平、人道和可持续的社会。他是加州大学圣巴巴拉分校环境研究教授。他是《灰熊之后》和《意外的生态系统》的作者。

articles.title: CERN physicists measure the universe at the smallest scale ever: enter the 'zeptoverse'
articles.author: Charles Q. Choi

paras.en: Using the Large Hadron Collider (LHC), the world's largest particle accelerator, scientists have gotten the first glimpse of the "zeptoverse" — the universe as it behaves within less than a hundred-trillionth of a wavelength of visible light, the smallest scale that researchers have explored to date.
paras.zh: 借助世界上最大的粒子加速器大型强子对撞机 (LHC)，科学家们首次看到了“zeptoverse”——宇宙在可见光波长不到万亿分之一的范围内运行，这是研究人员迄今为止探索的最小尺度。

paras.en: The new findings may one day help to answer long-standing cosmic mysteries, such as why there is far more matter than antimatter seen in the universe, and what makes up the dark matter that constitutes about 85% of all matter in the universe, the researchers announced Nov. 3 at a seminar at CERN (the European Organization for Nuclear Research), the organization that operates the LHC. The study, available as a preprint, has not yet been peer reviewed.
paras.zh: 11 月 3 日，研究人员在运行大型强子对撞机的组织 CERN（欧洲核研究组织）的一次研讨会上宣布，这些新发现有一天可能有助于解答长期存在的宇宙谜团，例如为什么宇宙中所见的物质远多于反物质，以及暗物质是由什么构成的，暗物质约占宇宙所有物质的 85%。该研究以预印本形式提供，尚未经过同行评审。

paras.en: At the LHC, located near Geneva at the border of France and Switzerland, researchers were investigating elusive particles called beauty quarks. These subatomic particles are cousins of the standard "up" and "down" quarks that make up the cores of all atoms in the universe.
paras.zh: 在位于法国和瑞士边境日内瓦附近的大型强子对撞机中，研究人员正在研究一种难以捉摸的粒子，称为美夸克。这些亚原子粒子是构成宇宙中所有原子核心的标准“上”和“下”夸克的近亲。

paras.en: When beauty quarks are created — in this case, when the LHC smashes atoms together at incredibly high speeds — they live for just one and a half trillionths of a second before they decay. There are a number of ways beauty quarks can break down; researchers hope that analyzing rare forms of these decays might reveal that they might not unfold as expected.
paras.zh: 当美夸克产生时——在这种情况下，当大型强子对撞机以令人难以置信的高速将原子粉碎在一起时——它们在衰变之前只存在万亿分之一秒。美夸克分解的方式有很多种：研究人员希望，分析这些衰变的罕见形式可能会揭示它们可能不会按预期展开。

paras.en: Such outcomes could then shed light on new kinds of physics found only at very tiny scales of zeptometers, or trillionths of a nanometer. (For comparison, a wavelength of visible light ranges from about 380 to 750 nanometers.)
paras.zh: 这样的结果可以揭示仅在非常小的泽米（即万亿分之一纳米）尺度上发现的新型物理学。 （作为比较，可见光的波长范围约为 380 至 750 纳米。）

paras.en: By exploring this zeptoverse, scientists hope to discover new particles that have escaped detection until now.
paras.zh: 通过探索这个 zeptoverse，科学家们希望发现迄今为止尚未被发现的新粒子。

paras.en: "We're confident there must be new particles to discover, and these could help explain mysteries like dark matter and the existence of matter in the universe," study co-author Harry Cliff, a particle physicist at the University of Cambridge, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、剑桥大学粒子物理学家哈里·克里夫（Harry Cliff）告诉《生活科学》杂志：“我们相信一定有新的粒子有待发现，这些粒子可以帮助解释暗物质和宇宙中物质的存在等谜团。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "Why haven't we seen these particles yet? One answer, and perhaps the most likely answer, is these new particles only become manifest at very, very short-distance scales. So by probing into the zepto scale, we give ourselves the best chance possible of finding these new particles that could explain these mysteries."
paras.zh: “为什么我们还没有看到这些粒子？一个答案，也许是最有可能的答案是，这些新粒子只会在非常非常短距离的尺度上显现出来。因此，通过探索 zepto 尺度，我们给自己提供了最好的机会，找到这些可以解释这些奥秘的新粒子。”

paras.en: Now, after hunting for more than four decades, physicists have found the first evidence of the rarest kind of beauty-quark decay seen yet. "Only one in 10 billion beauty particles decay this way," Cliff said.
paras.zh: 现在，经过四十多年的探索，物理学家找到了迄今为​​止最罕见的美夸克衰变的第一个证据。 “只有百亿分之一的美丽粒子会以这种方式衰变，”克里夫说。

paras.en: In this form of decay, technically known as the B0 to mu+ mu− decay, a beauty quark collides with an oppositely charged beauty antiquark. They annihilate each other, generating a pair of smaller particles — a muon and an antimuon. Previous research suggested that this requires a complicated set of interactions, making this kind of decay extraordinarily rare.
paras.zh: 在这种形式的衰变中，技术上称为 B0 到 mu+ mu− 衰变，美夸克与带相反电荷的美夸克碰撞。它们互相湮灭，产生一对更小的粒子——一个μ子和一个反μ子。先前的研究表明，这需要一系列复杂的相互作用，使得这种衰变极其罕见。

paras.en: An experiment at the LHC called LHCb was specifically designed to study beauty quarks. In 2024, a major upgrade to LHCb made it possible to distinguish different types of particles. Using machine learning techniques, the researchers suppressed huge amounts of background noise, which helped them detect the first evidence of the B0 to mu+ mu− decay.
paras.zh: LHCb 的大型强子对撞机实验是专门为研究美夸克而设计的。 2024 年，LHCb 进行了重大升级，使得区分不同类型的粒子成为可能。研究人员利用机器学习技术抑制了大量的背景噪声，这帮助他们检测到 B0 到 mu+ mu− 衰变的第一个证据。

paras.en: "We're now recording in a single year what took 10 years to record in the past," Cliff said. "And so we have this massive sample of beauty decays, and that is ultimately what allowed us to see this decay for the first time."
paras.zh: 克里夫说：“我们现在仅用一年的时间就能录制过去需要 10 年才能录制的内容。” “所以我们有大量美丽衰变的样本，这最终让我们第一次看到了这种衰变。”

paras.en: The new results suggest that the way this rare decay happens matches the predictions of the Standard Model of particle physics, the current best description of how the basic building blocks of the universe behave. As such, the researchers have not yet discovered signs of new particles or new physics beyond the Standard Model.
paras.zh: 新的结果表明，这种罕见的衰变发生的方式与粒子物理标准模型的预测相符，粒子物理标准模型是目前对宇宙基本构件行为的最佳描述。因此，研究人员尚未发现标准模型之外的新粒子或新物理学的迹象。

paras.en: "For me, I think the most exciting thing about this result is the fact that we are probing these unimaginably short distance scales," Cliff said. "Seeing the evidence for this decay begins a new area of research where we can start to make precision measurements that will give us the best chance of finding new physics in the future."
paras.zh: “对我来说，我认为这个结果最令人兴奋的事情是我们正在探索这些难以想象的短距离尺度，”克里夫说。 “看到这种衰变的证据开启了一个新的研究领域，我们可以开始进行精确测量，这将为我们提供未来发现新物理学的最佳机会。”

paras.en: The researchers would now like to upgrade LHCb to fully exploit the improvements to the LHC's luminosity that are currently planned for the 2030s.
paras.zh: 研究人员现在希望升级 LHCb，以充分利用目前计划在 2030 年代对 LHCb 亮度进行的改进。

paras.en: "However, there is some doubt over that now because the U.K. recently withdrew funding from the project," Cliff said. "So we are really trying to figure out if we'll be able to continue this type of research."
paras.zh: “然而，现在对此存在一些疑问，因为英国最近撤回了该项目的资金，”克里夫说。 “所以我们真的想弄清楚我们是否能够继续这种类型的研究。”

paras.en: In an ideal world, "we'll collect many hundreds of these decays in the future, make precise measurements and probe deep into the zeptoverse," Cliff said.
paras.zh: 在理想的世界中，“我们将在未来收集数百个这样的衰变，进行精确的测量并深入探索 zeptoverse，”克里夫说。

articles.title: For Almost 600 Years, This Enigmatic Jan van Eyck Painting Has Entranced Viewers. Could It Actually Be a Self-Portrait in Disguise?

paras.en: Ahead of a new exhibition celebrating the portraiture of famed Netherlandish painter Jan van Eyck, a new theory has emerged about one of the artist’s most famous—and deeply puzzling—canvases.
paras.zh: 在一场纪念荷兰著名画家扬·凡·艾克肖像画的新展览之前，关于这位艺术家最著名且令人深感困惑的画布之一的新理论出现了。

paras.en: At first glance, the scene in van Eyck’s 1434 Arnolfini Portrait seems straightforward: A man, dressed in black, and woman, clad in green, stand at the center of a lavish room where every detail—furniture, a dog, jewelry, oranges—is placed as though to purposefully highlight their wealth. But a closer look at the space’s geometry offers more uncanny observations. There is no fireplace, as would have been expected, and the ceiling is too low to realistically accommodate the chandelier that nonetheless dangles above their heads. Meanwhile, a convex mirror on the far back wall reveals that the pair are not alone; two figures are entering the room. The man in black lifts his hand, apparently in silent greeting, while a large inscription beside his head reads, in Latin: “Jan van Eyck was here 1434.”
paras.zh: 乍一看，范·艾克 1434 年创作的《阿诺菲尼肖像》中的场景似乎很简单：一个身穿黑衣的男人和一个穿着绿衣的女人站在豪华房间的中央，每一个细节——家具、狗、珠宝、橘子——都被放置在一起，仿佛是为了突出他们的财富。但仔细观察这个空间的几何形状可以得到更多不可思议的观察结果。正如预期的那样，这里没有壁炉，而且天花板太低，无法实际容纳悬挂在他们头顶上的枝形吊灯。与此同时，远处后墙上的一面凸面镜表明，这对情侣并不孤单。两个人影正在进入房间。黑衣男子举起手，显然是在无声地打招呼，而他的头旁有一个巨大的拉丁文铭文：“扬·凡·艾克于 1434 年在此。”

paras.en: Of all the details in the piece, which borders on the surreal, the identity of the man has been speculated upon the most. The leading theory derives from the 16th century, when inventory records labeling the painting as “hernoul le fin” were interpreted to be the French spelling of “Arnoul fin,” or “Arnolfini,” the surname of a wealthy Italian merchant clan who lived and worked in Bruges, Belgium, where van Eyck kept his studio.
paras.zh: 在这部近乎超现实的作品的所有细节中，该男子的身份被猜测得最多。主要理论源自 16 世纪，当时库存记录将这幅画标记为“hernoul le fin”，被解释为“Arnoul fin”或“Arnolfini”的法语拼写，这是一个富裕的意大利商人家族的姓氏，他在比利时布鲁日生活和工作，凡·艾克在那里设有他的工作室。

paras.en: For centuries, many art historians have supported this understanding, considering the piece to be a portrait of some members of that family. Some scholars identify the man as Giovanni di Arrigo Arnolfini, while others think it depicts his cousin, Giovanni di Nicolao Arnolfini. But now, as London’s National Gallery prepares to open “Van Eyck: The Portraits,” an exhibition, a new theory put forth about the canvas potentially turns its meaning on its head.
paras.zh: 几个世纪以来，许多艺术史学家都支持这种理解，认为这件作品是该家族某些成员的肖像。一些学者认为这个人是乔瓦尼·迪·阿里戈·阿尔诺菲尼，而另一些学者则认为这是他的表弟乔瓦尼·迪·尼古拉·阿尔诺菲尼。但现在，随着伦敦国家美术馆准备举办“范·艾克：肖像”展览，一种关于画布的新理论可能会彻底改变它的意义。

paras.en: Writing in the exhibition catalogue, Stephan Kemperdick, a curator at the Berlin Gemäldegalerie, posits that the painting is actually a self-portrait of van Eyck and his wife. His evidence is multi-faceted. He points to the Latin inscription as a clear self-reference and suggests that “hernoul le fin” actually translates to mean something like “a deceived cheat.” He argues that the painting, in the early modern period, would have been received as more of a lewd genre piece than a portrait. And he fixates on a statue in bedframe, which has been identified as St. Margaret, to hint that the woman is van Eyck’s wife, whose name was also Margaret.
paras.zh: 柏林美术馆策展人史蒂芬·肯珀迪克 (Stephan Kemperdick) 在展览图录中写道，这幅画实际上是凡·艾克和他妻子的自画像。他的证据是多方面的。他指出拉丁铭文是一个明显的自我指涉，并表示“hernoul le fin”实际上翻译过来的意思是“一个被欺骗的骗子”。他认为，在现代早期，这幅画更多地被认为是一幅淫荡的流派作品，而不是一幅肖像画。他注视着床架上的一尊雕像，该雕像已被确认为圣玛格丽特，暗示该女子是范艾克的妻子，她的名字也叫玛格丽特。

paras.en: The reception of this interpretation has thus far been mixed. Maximiliaan Martens, an art historian at the University of Ghent, tells the Art Newspaper’s J.S. Marcus that he “doesn’t see any reason to doubt” that “hernoul le fin” isn’t a reference to the Arnolfini family. Nicholas Flory, the exhibition’s co-curator, tells the outlet that the theory is “interesting” though “speculative.”
paras.zh: 迄今为止，人们对这一解释的接受褒贬不一。根特大学艺术史学家马克西米利安·马滕斯 (Maximiliaan Martens) 告诉《艺术报》的 J.S.马库斯表示，他“没有任何理由怀疑”“hernoul le fin”并不是指阿诺菲尼家族。展览的联合策展人尼古拉斯·弗洛里（Nicholas Flory）告诉媒体，这个理论虽然“具有推测性”，但“很有趣”。

paras.en: “It’s such a rewarding painting, and also a frustrating one at the same time. Even [after] many years of looking at it, it still allows you to see different things, to see surprising things, and it always sort of keeps you coming back,” Flory tells the “Collector” podcast’s Emily Snow. “There’s something very tantalizing about it that makes you want to look more carefully and harder … I hope that one day we solve all the questions that remain about it.”
paras.zh: “这是一幅非常有价值的画，同时也是一幅令人沮丧的画。即使在看了很多年之后，它仍然能让你看到不同的东西，看到令人惊讶的东西，而且它总是让你流连忘返，”弗洛里告诉“收藏家”播客的艾米丽·斯诺。 “它有一些非常诱人的东西，让你想要更仔细、更努力地观察……我希望有一天我们能解决所有关于它的问题。”

paras.en: The exhibition, which opens later this month and runs through early April, is the first time ever that all 10 of van Eyck’s known portraits have been gathered in the same space. By placing them all together, the show’s curators hope that the artist’s pioneering style, which often included mysterious and misleading details, can be appreciated in full.
paras.zh: 该展览将于本月晚些时候开幕，一直持续到四月初，这是有史以来第一次将凡·艾克所有 10 幅已知肖像画集中在同一个空间。通过将它们放在一起，展览的策展人希望能够充分欣赏艺术家的先锋风格，其中经常包含神秘和误导性的细节。

paras.en: Also on view at the National Gallery exhibition is Portrait of an Elderly Man, van Eyck’s only surviving drawing. Created around 1438, it is the earliest existing record of a formal portrait sitting in European art history.
paras.zh: 国家美术馆展览中还展出了范艾克唯一幸存的画作《老人肖像》。它创作于 1438 年左右，是欧洲艺术史上现存最早的正式肖像画记录。

paras.en: “Some stories do not have a beginning. Portraiture is one of them. It bursts onto the scene fully formed in the 1430s under the brush of Jan van Eyck,” Emma Capron, the exhibition’s co-curator, says in a statement. “These portraits’ ability to baffle by their precision and liveliness is intact today. Yet, just as van Eyck defined the fledgling genre of portraiture, he also subverted it with his cryptic inscriptions and the play of materials of his frames and reverses. These images do not divulge their meaning easily, and they are all the more rewarding for it.”
paras.zh: “有些故事没有开始。肖像画就是其中之一。它在 1430 年代在扬·凡·艾克的画笔下完全成型，突然出现在场景中，”展览联合策展人艾玛·卡普伦 (Emma Capron) 在一份声明中说道。 “这些肖像画以其精确性和生动性而令人困惑的能力在今天仍然完好无损。然而，正如凡·艾克定义了新兴的肖像画流派一样，他也用他神秘的铭文以及他的框架和反面材料的发挥颠覆了它。这些图像不会轻易泄露它们的意义，而且它们因此而更加有价值。”

paras.en: “Van Eyck: The Portraits” is on view at the National Gallery in London from November 21, 2026, through April 11, 2027.
paras.zh: “凡·艾克：肖像”将于2026年11月21日至2027年4月11日在伦敦国家美术馆展出。

articles.title: How Did Ancient Egypt's Sacred Cats Live? More Than 100 Unwrapped Mummies Reveal Poor Living Conditions, Infections and Violence Before Death

paras.en: Across ancient Egypt, millions of cats were once mummified and laid to rest in sprawling animal necropolises to honor the gods. Now, a closer look at more than a hundred preserved skulls reveals that these sacred animals endured surprisingly brutal lives.
paras.zh: 在古埃及，数以百万计的猫曾被制成木乃伊并埋葬在广阔的动物墓地中以纪念众神。现在，仔细观察一百多个保存完好的头骨就会发现，这些神圣的动物经历了令人惊讶的残酷生活。

paras.en: Researchers analyzed 131 well-preserved cat skulls housed at the Natural History Museum in Vienna that originally came from Beni Hassan, an ancient animal funerary site in Egypt’s Nile Valley, some 155 miles south of Cairo. The majority of skulls belonged to adult cats, mostly domestic and some wild. They were largely dated between 380 B.C.E. and 40 B.C.E Osteological and chemical examinations revealed widespread signs of gum disease, infections, healed wounds and fatal skull fractures, according to a study recently published in the Journal of Archaeological Science.
paras.zh: 研究人员分析了维也纳自然历史博物馆收藏的 131 个保存完好的猫头骨，这些头骨最初来自贝尼哈桑 (Beni Hassan)，贝尼哈桑是埃及尼罗河谷的一处古代动物墓地，距离开罗以南约 155 英里。大多数头骨属于成年猫，其中大部分是家猫，也有一些野生猫。它们的年代大多在公元前 380 年之间。根据《考古科学杂志》最近发表的一项研究，公元前 40 年，骨学和化学检查显示出广泛的牙龈疾病、感染、伤口愈合和致命颅骨骨折的迹象。

paras.en: “What struck us most was the high proportion of injuries and evidence of disease, suggesting that these cats lived in poor conditions,” Bea De Cupere, study co-author and archaeozoologist at the Royal Belgian Institute of Natural Sciences, tells Phys.org’s Sandee Oster. “This is not what one would expect for animals destined to become votive mummies.”
paras.zh: 研究合著者、比利时皇家自然科学研究所的考古动物学家 Bea De Cupere 告诉 Phys.org 的 Sandee Oster：“最让我们印象深刻的是受伤和疾病证据的比例很高，这表明这些猫的生活条件很差。” “对于注定成为木乃伊的动物来说，这不是人们所期望的。”

paras.en: In ancient Egypt, cats were revered as earthly embodiments of the goddess Bastet and frequently appeared on tomb walls and artifacts. Eventually, devotees began mummifying felines as sacred offerings across at least 20 animal cemeteries in Egypt, according to the study.
paras.zh: 在古埃及，猫被尊为女神巴斯蒂特在世的化身，经常出现在墓墙和文物上。研究显示，最终，埃及至少 20 个动物墓地的信徒开始将猫制成木乃伊作为神圣的祭品。

paras.en: In the 19th and early 20th centuries C.E., however, excavators were mostly interested in human mummies and used ancient animal remains as ship ballast, fuel, fertilizer or powdered medicine. The Beni Hassan skulls—the largest known museum collection of ancient Egyptian cat skulls with documented origin—survived only because British biologist William A. Herdman salvaged a small portion of roughly 200,000 animal mummies set out for a fertilizer auction in Liverpool in 1890, according to Gizmodo’s Gayoung Lee. Since 19th-century scientists were mainly interested in skulls, the cats’ torsos were likely discarded after unwrapping.
paras.zh: 然而，在公元 19 世纪和 20 世纪初，挖掘机主要对人类木乃伊感兴趣，并使用古代动物遗骸作为船舶压舱物、燃料、肥料或粉状药物。据 Gizmodo 的 Gayoung Lee 介绍，贝尼·哈桑头骨是已知最大的有记录来源的古埃及猫头骨博物馆藏品，之所以能幸存下来，是因为英国生物学家威廉·A·赫德曼 (William A. Herdman) 抢救了 1890 年在利物浦进行化肥拍卖的大约 200,000 具动物木乃伊中的一小部分。由于 19 世纪的科学家主要对头骨感兴趣，因此猫的躯干在打开后很可能被丢弃。

paras.en: To reconstruct the cats’ lives, lead author Wim Van Neer, also an archaeozoologist at the Royal Belgian Institute of Natural Sciences, and his team conducted X-ray and chemical isotope analyses alongside radiocarbon dating on nine of the skulls. Eight dated to between 380 B.C.E and 40 B.C.E., spanning the end of the Late Period into Ptolemaic rule. A single outlier dated to the Third Intermediate Period, around the 10th century B.C.E., hinting either that Beni Hassan was used earlier than other records indicate or that the specimen came from Bubastis, Egypt’s oldest known cat cemetery. Unlike previous studies of cat mummy deposits, where roughly 20 percent of individuals were adults, 86 percent of the Beni Hassan specimens were fully grown. Most were domestic cats, alongside at least seven jungle cats, African wild cats and possible hybrids.
paras.zh: 为了重建猫的生活，主要作者、比利时皇家自然科学研究所的考古动物学家 Wim Van Neer 和他的团队对九个头骨进行了 X 射线和化学同位素分析以及放射性碳测年。八件可追溯到公元前 380 年至公元前 40 年之间，跨越晚期托勒密统治时期。一个异常值可以追溯到第三中间时期，大约公元前 10 世纪，暗示贝尼·哈桑的使用时间比其他记录显示的要早，或者该标本来自埃及已知最古老的猫墓地布巴斯提斯。与之前对猫木乃伊沉积物的研究（其中大约 20% 的个体是成年猫）不同，贝尼·哈桑标本中 86% 已经完全长大。大多数是家猫，还有至少七只丛林猫、非洲野猫和可能的杂交猫。

paras.en: More than half of the skulls bore evidence of disease or physical trauma, including missing teeth, gum disease, metabolic disorders and pitted bone possibly linked to infections. Isotope analysis revealed that while domestic cats were raised around people, the jungle cats had a markedly different diet, indicating they were captured young and later kept alongside domestic felines. Six of the seven jungle cats suffered from similar ailments as their domestic counterparts, and in one case, a jungle cat’s canine teeth lined up directly with healed bite marks on a domestic cat’s forehead.
paras.zh: 超过一半的头骨有疾病或身体创伤的证据，包括牙齿缺失、牙龈疾病、代谢紊乱和可能与感染有关的凹陷骨。同位素分析显示，虽然家猫是在人类周围饲养的，但丛林猫的饮食却明显不同，这表明它们是在幼年时被捕获的，后来与家猫一起饲养。七只丛林猫中有六只患有与家猫相似的疾病，其中一只丛林猫的犬齿与家猫额头上愈合的咬痕直接对齐。

paras.en: “The high density of animals would inevitably have led to stress and aggression among them, resulting in injuries, while diseases could spread easily,” Van Neer tells Phys.org.
paras.zh: 范尼尔告诉 Phys.org：“动物的高密度不可避免地会导致它们之间产生压力和攻击性，从而导致受伤，同时疾病也很容易传播。”

paras.en: Fourteen of the skulls also showed signs of trauma, including human-inflicted wounds, revealing how the cats started their journey towards mummification. While some cats were strangled, most died from blows to the head inflicted with a heavy wooden stick or a sharp metal blade. “Skull fractures were the most common cause of death, whereas evidence of strangulation occurred less frequently,” the researchers write in the study.
paras.zh: 其中十四个头骨还显示出创伤迹象，包括人类造成的伤口，揭示了这些猫是如何开始木乃伊化之旅的。虽然有些猫被勒死，但大多数是死于用沉重的木棍或锋利的金属刀片击打头部。研究人员在研究中写道：“颅骨骨折是最常见的死亡原因，而勒死的证据则较少发生。”

paras.en: Not every blow was immediately fatal. Several skulls displayed healed lesions, which the team noted in the paper could reflect human “disciplinary measures” or failed attempts to dispatch the animals, per the study. “Catching the cats and killing them for the preparation of mummies may also not always have gone as intended,” Van Neer tells Phys.org, noting that some felines may have escaped after sustaining severe injuries.
paras.zh: 并非每一次打击都会立即致命。根据研究，几个头骨显示出已愈合的损伤，研究小组在论文中指出，这可能反映了人类的“纪律措施”或未能成功派遣动物。范尼尔告诉 Phys.org：“捕捉猫并杀死它们来制作木乃伊也可能并不总是按预期进行。”他指出，一些猫科动物可能在遭受严重伤害后逃脱了。

paras.en: In absence of whole skeletons, the researchers caution that diagnosing systemic health problems is not so straightforward. Just how these sacred animals were housed before their deaths also remains an open question.
paras.zh: 研究人员警告说，在没有完整骨骼的情况下，诊断系统性健康问题并不是那么简单。这些神圣动物在死前是如何被安置的仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

paras.en: The authors write: “Although the precise conditions under which cats intended for votive mummification were kept remain unknown, the evidence from the Beni Hassan collection suggests that they lived in a stressful environment, probably in confined spaces rather than being allowed to roam freely.”
paras.zh: 作者写道：“虽然用于还愿木乃伊的猫被饲养的确切条件仍然未知，但贝尼·哈桑收藏的证据表明，它们生活在一个充满压力的环境中，可能是在密闭的空间里，而不是被允许自由漫步。”

articles.title: This Tiny, Unassuming Fungus Is a 'Dark Magic Mushroom'—the First Found to Contain Both Psychedelic Compounds and Deadly Toxins

paras.en: A little brown mushroom that grows in the swamps of Florida offers a lethal two-for-one deal: It can get you high and kill you.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州沼泽地里生长的一种棕色小蘑菇提供了一种致命的二合一交易：它可以让你兴奋，也可以杀死你。

paras.en: The fungus Galerina indica, dubbed the “dark magic mushroom,” produces both the mind-altering chemicals psilocybin and psilocin, as well as deadly amatoxins, making it the first species of mushroom known to contain both types of compounds. The findings, published in the journal Current Biology on November 11, offer new understanding of the evolution and diversity of fungi.
paras.zh: 被称为“黑魔法蘑菇”的真菌 Galerina indica 会产生改变思维的化学物质裸盖菇素和裸盖菇素，以及致命的鹅膏毒素，使其成为已知第一种含有这两种化合物的蘑菇。该研究结果发表在 11 月 11 日的《当代生物学》杂志上，为真菌的进化和多样性提供了新的认识。

paras.en: “Humanity’s cultural infatuation with mushrooms has long been bookended by two categories: mushrooms that induce psychedelic experiences and mushrooms that are deadly toxic,” says study co-author Andrew Kunik, a fungal biologist who conducted the research at the University of Florida, to Ed Cara at Gizmodo. “Our discovery of the ‘dark magic mushroom’ represents an unusual convergence of worlds, where we now know of this rare and unusual species that produces the chemistry responsible for both properties.”
paras.zh: “人类对蘑菇的文化迷恋长期以来分为两类：引起迷幻体验的蘑菇和致命的有毒蘑菇，”该研究的合著者、佛罗里达大学真菌生物学家安德鲁·库尼克 (Andrew Kunik) 向 Gizmodo 的埃德·卡拉 (Ed Cara) 说道。 “我们对‘黑魔法蘑菇’的发现代表了世界的不同寻常的融合，我们现在知道这种稀有且不寻常的物种能够产生负责这两种特性的化学物质。”

paras.en: Some mushrooms are known to contain either psilocybin or amatoxins, and the latter is well-documented in certain Galerina fungi. G. indica, however, is a less-studied variety. Kunik spotted the unassuming species on a moss-covered palm trunk while studying fungi in the wetland of central Florida in 2025. Surprisingly, the specimen turned blue when handled—a sign that it might produce psilocybin.
paras.zh: 已知一些蘑菇含有裸盖菇素或鹅膏毒素，而后者在某些 Galerina 真菌中已有充分记录。然而，G. indica 是一个研究较少的品种。 2025 年，库尼克在佛罗里达州中部湿地研究真菌时，在长满青苔的棕榈树干上发现了这种不起眼的物种。令人惊讶的是，该标本在处理时变成了蓝色，这表明它可能会产生裸盖菇素。

paras.en: So, Kunik and colleagues conducted chemical analyses of the mushroom, along with specimens of two unnamed Galerina species collected in the southeastern United States between January 2024 and September 2025. The work revealed that G. indica contained psilocybin, psilocin and two amatoxins, including a toxin that had never been documented in mushrooms. One of the other Galerina species they studied had only the psychedelic substances, while the other made neither type of compound.
paras.zh: 因此，Kunik 及其同事对这种蘑菇以及 2024 年 1 月至 2025 年 9 月期间在美国东南部收集的两种未命名的 Galerina 物种的标本进行了化学分析。研究结果表明，G. indica 含有裸盖菇素、裸盖菇素和两种鹅膏毒素，其中包括一种从未在蘑菇中记录过的毒素。他们研究的另一种 Galerina 物种只含有迷幻物质，而另一种则不产生任何类型的化合物。

paras.en: “This finding shows that there’s a lot more diversity in [fungal] chemistry and the ways that they’re combined than we had really thought about,” says Anne Pringle, a mycologist at the University of Wisconsin-Madison who was not involved in the work, to Tina Hesman Saey at Science News.
paras.zh: “这一发现表明，[真菌]化学及其组合方式的多样性比我们真正想象的要多得多，”未参与这项工作的威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校真菌学家安妮·普林格尔 (Anne Pringle) 对科学新闻的蒂娜·赫斯曼·赛伊 (Tina Hesman Saey) 说道。

paras.en: The largest G. indica mushrooms found stood around 0.2 inches tall and had caps up to roughly 0.1 inches wide, according to Live Science.
paras.zh: 据《Live Science》报道，发现的最大的 G. indica 蘑菇高约 0.2 英寸，菌盖宽约 0.1 英寸。

paras.en: The team then examined G. indica’s DNA and compared it with that of other psilocybin-producing mushrooms. Genetic analyses revealed that the mushroom’s ancestors likely picked up the genes to make psychedelics through a process called horizontal gene transfer. That means the species did not inherit the genetic material from a parent but received it from another organism, probably an unrelated mushroom.
paras.zh: 研究小组随后检查了 G. indica 的 DNA，并将其与其他产生裸盖菇素的蘑菇的 DNA 进行了比较。遗传分析表明，蘑菇的祖先很可能通过一种称为水平基因转移的过程获得了制造迷幻药的基因。这意味着该物种并未从父母那里继承遗传物质，而是从另一种生物体（可能是不相关的蘑菇）那里获得了遗传物质。

paras.en: The researchers suspect the G. indica lineage could already produce amatoxins before it acquired the five-gene Psi cluster, responsible for psilocybin production. Two hypotheses might explain what happened: The dark magic mushroom and the other psilocybin-producing Galerina species may have independently acquired the psychedelic genes from other fungi, or they could have both inherited them from a common ancestor that previously acquired them through horizontal gene transfer. The first scenario is more likely, the scientists say, though they’re careful to note they still don’t have a clear understanding of the genus’s family tree and would need to identify the donor mushrooms for more definitive answers.
paras.zh: 研究人员怀疑，在获得负责产生裸盖菇素的五基因 Psi 簇之前，G. indica 谱系就已经能够产生鹅膏毒素。有两个假设可以解释所发生的事情：黑魔法蘑菇和其他产生裸盖菇素的 Galerina 物种可能独立地从其他真菌获得了迷幻基因，或者它们都可能从一个共同的祖先那里继承了这些基因，而该祖先之前通过水平基因转移获得了这些基因。科学家们表示，第一种情况更有可能发生，不过他们小心翼翼地指出，他们仍然对该属的家谱没有清楚的了解，需要确定捐赠蘑菇以获得更明确的答案。

paras.en: It was interesting to see “both of these [compounds] present, seeing that this gene cluster jumped in, got rearranged, maybe came in twice—it’s very cool,” says Hannah Reynolds, a fungal ecologist at Western Connecticut State University who wasn’t involved with the study, to Olivia Ferrari at Live Science.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，“这两种[化合物]都存在，看到这个基因簇跳入，重新排列，可能出现了两次——这非常酷，”未参与这项研究的西康涅狄格州立大学真菌生态学家汉娜·雷诺兹 (Hannah Reynolds) 对 Live Science 的奥利维亚·法拉利 (Olivia Ferrari) 说道。

paras.en: The findings open the door to further research on how mushrooms benefit from producing amatoxins or psilocybin. Many scientists speculate the compounds help fungi ward off predators, Pringle tells Science News, but they don’t have enough evidence to prove it.
paras.zh: 这些发现为进一步研究蘑菇如何从产生鹅膏毒素或裸盖菇素中获益打开了大门。普林格尔告诉《科学新闻》，许多科学家推测这些化合物有助于真菌抵御捕食者，但他们没有足够的证据来证明这一点。

paras.en: “What’s exciting is that there are small, seemingly uninteresting fungi that can conceal extraordinary chemistry that we’re only beginning to understand,” Kunik says in a statement.
paras.zh: 库尼克在一份声明中说：“令人兴奋的是，有一些看似无趣的小真菌可以隐藏我们才刚刚开始了解的非凡化学作用。”

articles.title: The Nvidia Scandal Could Upend Chip Sales to China. Trump Wants to Keep Them Going
articles.author: Hugo Lowell

paras.en: After days of political fallout from former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, President Donald Trump is defending commerce secretary Howard Lutnick.
paras.zh: 英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋与一名疑似中国情报人员的恋情引发数日政治影响后，唐纳德·特朗普总统开始为商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克辩护。

paras.en: Last week, Lutnick came under fire from treasury secretary Scott Bessent for not aggressively imposing export restrictions on advanced AI chips to China.
paras.zh: 上周，卢特尼克因没有积极对向中国的先进人工智能芯片实施出口限制而受到财政部长斯科特·贝森特的批评。

paras.en: But Trump’s defense of Lutnick, sources tell WIRED, reflects the president's own view that allowing the sale of some advanced AI chips to China can keep China reliant on US technology and simultaneously boost US tech stocks.
paras.zh: 但消息人士告诉《连线》杂志，特朗普对卢特尼克的辩护反映了总统自己的观点，即允许向中国出售一些先进的人工智能芯片可以让中国继续依赖美国技术，同时提振美国科技股。

paras.en: Lutnick “was doing that because if you didn’t delay it, if you didn’t do something, you could have a blowup with China. We’re having a very good relationship with China right now,” Trump said ahead of a multiday trip to Asia and a meeting on Thursday with Chinese leader Xi Jinping.
paras.zh: 卢特尼克之所以这样做，是因为如果你不拖延，如果你不采取行动，你可能会与中国发生冲突。我们现在与中国有着非常好的关系，”特朗普在为期数日的亚洲之行以及周四与中国领导人习近平会晤之前表示。

paras.en: Trump convened an Oval Office meeting on November 5 to discuss the political fallout from Huang’s affair with Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed executive whom some in the US government believe was recruited to spy for China, according to two sources briefed on the discussion.
paras.zh: 据两名知情人士透露，特朗普于 11 月 5 日召开了一次椭圆形办公室会议，讨论黄与前 Megaspeed 高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 恋情的政治影响，美国政府中的一些人认为黄爱丽是被招募来为中国从事间谍活动的。

paras.en: Megaspeed received advanced AI chips manufactured by Nvidia through several layers of companies that started with a subsidiary of a blacklisted Chinese server conglomerate called Inspur, The New York Times has reported.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，Megaspeed 通过几层公司获得了 Nvidia 制造的先进人工智能芯片，这些公司最初是被列入黑名单的中国服务器集团浪潮的子公司。

paras.en: In the meeting, the sources say, Bessent confronted Lutnick, asking why Megaspeed was not added to the entity list faster, given that secretary of state Marco Rubio and US trade representative Jamieson Greer, among others, had already agreed it was the correct move.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，在会议上，贝森特与卢特尼克对峙，询问为什么没有更快地将 Megaspeed 添加到实体名单中，因为国务卿马可·卢比奥和美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔等人已经同意这是正确的举动。

paras.en: Lutnick responded that he would defer to Trump and would add Megaspeed to the entity list if that was what the president wanted, the sources say.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，卢特尼克回应称，他会听从特朗普的意见，如果总统想要的话，他会将 Megaspeed 添加到实体名单中。

paras.en: But Trump settled on a third approach: for Lutnick to work on introducing a new interim trade rule to stop Chinese AI labs from using advanced AI chips remotely by leasing their compute power from data centers in Southeast Asia.
paras.zh: 但特朗普选择了第三种方法：让卢特尼克致力于引入一项新的临时贸易规则，以阻止中国人工智能实验室通过从东南亚数据中心租赁计算能力来远程使用先进的人工智能芯片。

paras.en: In a statement to WIRED, a White House spokesperson said the new rule would “crack down on the smuggling of advanced US SI chips” and “help ensure that America’s most advanced chips go first to US SI innovators, not Chinese shell companies.” (Superintelligence, or SI, is the administration’s term for artificial intelligence.)
paras.zh: 白宫发言人在向《连线》杂志发表的一份声明中表示，新规定将“打击走私美国先进的 SI 芯片”，并“有助于确保美国最先进的芯片首先流向美国 SI 创新者，而不是中国的空壳公司。” （超级智能，或 SI，是政府对人工智能的术语。）

paras.en: A senior White House official added that Trump has been adamant that Chinese firms cannot acquire the most advanced Nvidia chips, known as Blackwells and Rubins. Those are different from the H200-type chips, built on previous-generation Hopper architecture, that Megaspeed was acquiring.
paras.zh: 一位白宫高级官员补充说，特朗普一直坚持认为中国公司无法获得最先进的 Nvidia 芯片，即 Blackwells 和 Rubins。这些与 Megaspeed 正在收购的基于上一代 Hopper 架构构建的 H200 型芯片不同。

paras.en: Lutnick’s position appears to have been based on a series of considerations, the sources say. For one, Megaspeed has already had the chips for months, and blacklisting the company would be akin to playing whack-a-mole unless the administration dealt with the underlying issue of Chinese firms getting remote access to US chips.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，卢特尼克的立场似乎是基于一系列考虑。首先，Megaspeed 已经拥有这些芯片几个月了，将该公司列入黑名单就像打地鼠游戏，除非政府解决中国公司远程访问美国芯片的根本问题。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Lutnick has moved cautiously on any new export restrictions—essentially waiting to get explicit approval from Trump—after he faced heavy criticism in 2025 for expanding restrictions against firms with Chinese ties, the sources said.
paras.zh: 与此同时，消息人士称，卢特尼克在 2025 年因扩大对与中国有联系的企业的限制而受到严厉批评后，对任何新的出口限制都采取了谨慎的态度，基本上是在等待特朗普的明确批准。

paras.en: In September 2025, the Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security started aggressively using the so-called affiliates rule, which automatically extends trade restrictions to any company that is 50 percent owned by a company already on the US entity list or the military end-user list.
paras.zh: 2025 年 9 月，商务部工业与安全局开始积极使用所谓的附属公司规则，该规则自动将贸易限制扩大到任何已在美国实体名单或军事最终用户名单上的公司拥有 50% 股权的公司。

paras.en: But the move prompted immediate retaliation by China, which suspended exports of critical rare earth metals to the US and, the sources said, prompted a wave of internal criticism accusing the Commerce Department of having sparked a trade war.
paras.zh: 但消息人士称，此举立即引发了中国的报复，中国暂停了向美国出口关键稀土金属，并引发了一波内部批评，指责商务部引发了贸易战。

paras.en: After the Busan summit at the end of October 2025, where Trump and Chinese president Xi Jinping agreed to a trade truce, the White House instructed Commerce to halt the use of the affiliates rule and clear new export controls in advance, the sources said.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，特朗普和中国国家主席习近平在 2025 年 10 月底举行的釜山峰会同意贸易休战后，白宫指示商务部停止使用附属规则，并提前清除新的出口管制。

paras.en: The suspension of the affiliates rule—which came almost as soon as it was implemented—may have had a knock-on effect on companies like Megaspeed, one person familiar with deliberations said.
paras.zh: 一位知情人士表示，关联公司规则几乎在实施后就被暂停，可能对 Megaspeed 等公司产生了连锁反应。

paras.en: Inspur, the Chinese server conglomerate connected to Megaspeed, operated a subsidiary called Aivres, which, as a California-based company, could legally buy restricted Nvidia chips without triggering direct export bans and ship them internationally to Southeast Asia.
paras.zh: 与 Megaspeed 连接的中国服务器集团浪潮运营着一家名为 Aivres 的子公司，这家总部位于加州的公司可以合法购买受限制的 Nvidia 芯片，而不会触发直接出口禁令，并将其运往东南亚。

paras.en: In total, Aivres transferred billions of dollars’ worth of restricted Nvidia chips, including the powerful H200 chips, to Megaspeed’s subsidiaries.
paras.zh: Aivres 总共将价值数十亿美元的受限制的 Nvidia 芯片（包括功能强大的 H200 芯片）转移给了 Megaspeed 的子公司。

paras.en: Instead of shipping the physical chips into China, Megaspeed hosted servers at data centers in Malaysia and Indonesia—then rented out compute power to major Chinese companies. A spokesperson for Aivres said in a statement that the company complies with all US export controls.
paras.zh: Megaspeed 没有将物理芯片运送到中国，而是在马来西亚和印度尼西亚的数据中心托管服务器，然后将计算能力出租给中国主要公司。艾夫雷斯发言人在一份声明中表示，该公司遵守美国的所有出口管制。

articles.title: Waymo Pauses All Highway Rides After California Safety Ban
articles.author: Aarian Marshall

paras.en: Waymo self-driving taxis are no longer driving on highways after the California Department of Motor Vehicles banned its vehicles from state freeway operations. The ban, which the DMV says began on November 11, comes after the department determined that Waymo’s freeway driving poses “an imminent hazard to public safety.”
paras.zh: 在加州机动车辆管理局禁止其车辆在州高速公路上运营后，Waymo 自动驾驶出租车不再在高速公路上行驶。 DMV 称该禁令于 11 月 11 日开始实施，此前该部门确定 Waymo 的高速公路驾驶对“公共安全构成迫在眉睫的危险”。

paras.en: In response, Waymo says it has stopped highway driving in all of its markets. The company may continue testing its vehicles on non-California highways with safety operators behind the wheels.
paras.zh: 作为回应，Waymo 表示已停止在所有市场的高速公路行驶。该公司可能会继续在非加州高速公路上测试其车辆，并由安全操作员负责。

paras.en: The ban follows two recent concerning incidents, California DMV spokesperson Jonathan Groveman wrote in a statement. In one, three Waymos entered an active highway construction closure on Route 101 on the San Francisco Peninsula. The other was captured in a viral video showing a Waymo vehicle interfering with California Highway Patrol cars on a San Francisco highway as they tried to enforce a “traffic break” as workers cleared debris from the crash.
paras.zh: 加州DMV发言人乔纳森·格罗夫曼(Jonathan Groveman)在一份声明中写道，该禁令是在最近发生的两起相关事件之后发布的。其中，三台 Waymos 进入了旧金山半岛 101 号公路的高速公路施工封闭阶段。另一起视频是在一段广为流传的视频中拍摄的，视频中一辆 Waymo 车辆在旧金山高速公路上干扰了加州高速公路巡逻队的车辆，当时加州高速公路巡逻队的车辆试图在工人们清理车祸残骸时实施“交通中断”。

paras.en: Groveman said the California ban will remain in place until Waymo has proved that it has “taken effective corrective actions to address the deficiencies" that led to the incidents. It’s unclear how long that process will take.
paras.zh: 格罗夫曼表示，加州的禁令将继续有效，直到 Waymo 证明其已“采取有效的纠正措施来解决导致事件的缺陷”。目前还不清楚这个过程需要多长时间。

paras.en: In a written statement to WIRED, Waymo spokesperson Dana Gallagher said the company is “working with the California DMV and other state officials diligently and responsibly to resume freeway operations." Waymo vehicles will continue to operate on surface streets in the 15 metros where it offers taxi service, including portions of Los Angeles, San Diego, and the San Francisco Bay Area.
paras.zh: Waymo 发言人达纳·加拉格尔 (Dana Gallagher) 在给《连线》的一份书面声明中表示，该公司正在“与加州 DMV 和其他州官员勤奋、负责任地合作，恢复高速公路运营”。 Waymo 车辆将继续在其提供出租车服务的 15 个都会区的地面街道上运营，其中包括洛杉矶、圣地亚哥和旧金山湾区的部分地区。

paras.en: This is the second time Waymo has publicly restricted its freeway operations after beginning to transport passengers on them last year. In June, the company recalled its software after federal regulators found that its system failed to recognize highway construction zones. Regulators with the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) cited several incidents in April and May in which Waymo cars drove past ramp closure signs and into active lane closures. The events did not lead to collisions or injuries.
paras.zh: 这是 Waymo 自去年开始在高速公路上运送乘客后第二次公开限制其高速公路运营。六月，在联邦监管机构发现该公司的系统无法识别高速公路施工区域后，该公司召回了其软件。美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 的监管机构列举了 4 月和 5 月发生的几起事件，其中 Waymo 汽车驶过匝道关闭标志并进入主动封闭车道。这些事件没有导致碰撞或受伤。

paras.en: The NHTSA did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 美国国家公路交通安全管理局没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: Last week, the agency said it was examining whether another Waymo recall software fix had actually solved its robotaxis’ safety issues. This recall, which occurred last December, was tied to incidents in which Waymo cars repeatedly drove by stopped school buses with their lights on and/or stop arms extended.
paras.zh: 上周，该机构表示正在检查另一项 Waymo 召回软件修复程序是否确实解决了其机器人出租车的安全问题。这次召回发生在去年 12 月，与 Waymo 汽车多次驶过停着的校车、车灯亮着和/或停车臂伸出的事件有关。

paras.en: Self-driving cars have struggled with construction zones for at least a decade. The zones can look and be arranged differently based on what sort of construction is being done, and where. While humans can easily understand bollards, placards, and blinking arrows, the lack of hard-and-fast rules has proven difficult to reliably program into driving software. The issue is especially hazardous at high freeway speeds, where workers exist alongside fast-moving car traffic.
paras.zh: 至少十年来，自动驾驶汽车一直在建筑工地中挣扎。根据正在进行的施工类型和地点，这些区域的外观和布置可能会有所不同。虽然人类可以轻松理解护柱、标语牌和闪烁箭头，但事实证明，由于缺乏硬性规定，很难将其可靠地编程到驾驶软件中。这个问题在高速公路高速行驶时尤其危险，因为工人与快速行驶的汽车交通并排存在。

articles.title: How to Tell If It’s a Cyberattack or Just an Outage
articles.author: Andy Greenberg, Lily Hay Newman

paras.en: Over the past week, anyone could be forgiven for wondering whether a Diehard IV–style cyberwar had finally arrived in the US.
paras.zh: 在过去的一周里，任何人都可能会怀疑“顽固分子四世”式的网络战争是否终于来到了美国。

paras.en: Across just four consecutive business days, a mass Microsoft exchange outage broke IT services for thousands of companies, a Federal Aviation Administration tech screwup grounded airplanes across the country, a software problem affecting JPMorgan Chase caused another round of disruption, a United Airlines system glitch delayed flights yet again, and an NSA classified network’s downtime left the agency’s staff sitting at home waiting to return to their office at Fort Meade. In the midst of a US war with Iran and rising fears of AI-enabled hacking, this still-unfolding comedy of IT errors colliding across American infrastructure felt to plenty of observers like more than a coincidence.
paras.zh: 在连续四个工作日内，微软交易所的大规模宕机导致数千家公司的 IT 服务中断，美国联邦航空管理局的技术故障导致全国各地的飞机停飞，影响摩根大通的软件问题造成了另一轮中断，联合航空的系统故障再次延误了航班，国家安全局机密网络的宕机导致该机构的工作人员坐在家里等待返回米德堡的办公室。在美国与伊朗的战争以及对人工智能黑客攻击的担忧日益加剧之际，这一仍在上演的美国基础设施发生 IT 错误冲突的喜剧让许多观察家觉得这不仅仅是巧合。

paras.en: Yet there’s still no evidence that any one of these clustered technological failures were related, much less caused by hackers. Their improbable, sequential timing left Americans anxiously doomscrolling for signs of foul play. But in cases like these, it’s the job of cybersecurity analysts (and reporters at WIRED) to determine—vibes aside—whether the latest tech outage was actually an accident or the result of a cyberattack.
paras.zh: 然而，仍然没有证据表明这些集群技术故障中的任何一项都是相关的，更不用说是由黑客造成的了。他们不可思议的连续时间让美国人焦急地寻找不法行为的迹象。但在此类情况下，网络安全分析师（以及《连线》记者）的工作就是确定（抛开舆论）最新的技术中断究竟是意外还是网络攻击的结果。

paras.en: The baseline for that fact-finding, as anyone tasked with investigating these incidents will tell you, is that the vast majority of these digital breakdowns are not the result of malicious intent but rather casualties of IT admins’ constant war to keep computer systems from collapsing under the weight of their own complexity.
paras.zh: 正如任何负责调查这些事件的人都会告诉您的那样，事实调查的基线是，绝大多数数字故障不是恶意意图的结果，而是 IT 管理员为防止计算机系统在自身复杂性的重压下崩溃而不断进行的斗争的结果。

paras.en: “I’ve just seen enough times where we thought maybe it’s a cyberattack and it turns out it’s not. Sometimes it will be, but typically not,” says Matthew Prince, CEO of the internet infrastructure company Cloudflare. “Right now, most of what we’re seeing is the standard background noise. Stuff breaks, and that’s just the nature of complex systems.”
paras.zh: 互联网基础设施公司 Cloudflare 的首席执行官马修·普林斯 (Matthew Prince) 表示：“我已经见过很多次了，我们认为这可能是网络攻击，但事实证明并非如此。有时会，但通常不会。” “现在，我们看到的大部分都是标准的背景噪音。东西会损坏，这就是复杂系统的本质。”

paras.en: So in the interest of soothing the country’s rattled nerves and helping us all find ground truth amid seemingly endless tech catastrophes, we at WIRED present our general guide to determining whether a tech outage is the result of a cyberattack. So take a breath—maybe open the bunker door to let in some fresh air—and read on.
paras.zh: 因此，为了安抚这个国家紧张的神经，并帮助我们所有人在看似无休无止的技术灾难中找到真相，我们在《连线》杂志上提出了确定技术中断是否是网络攻击造成的一般指南。因此，深吸一口气——也许打开掩体门让新鲜空气进来——然后继续阅读。

paras.en: 1. Start With a Presumption of Innocence–or Negligence
paras.zh: 1. 从无罪推定或疏忽开始

paras.en: The process of determining the cause of an IT service outage should begin with the assumption that it was an accident, says cybersecurity researcher Doug Madory.
paras.zh: 网络安全研究员 Doug Madory 表示，确定 IT 服务中断原因的过程应该首先假设这是一次事故。

paras.en: As the head of internet analysis at the network security firm Infoblox, Madory says he monitors as many as a dozen network outages a day. Only around “one in a thousand,” he says, turns out to have been caused by hackers. “One's default position should be that it isn't a cyberattack,” he says, “unless there is some concrete evidence to the contrary.”
paras.zh: 作为网络安全公司 Infoblox 的互联网分析主管，马多里表示，他每天监控多达十几起网络中断事件。他说，只有大约“千分之一”是由黑客造成的。 “人们的默认立场应该是这不是网络攻击，”他说，“除非有一些具体的证据表明相反的情况。”

paras.en: Given the rarity of cyberattacks compared to outages as a whole, it’s wise to look at other potential causes first. “Most big outages that look like attacks are self-inflicted,” says João Tomé, the internet research editor at network data company IPinfo. (In response to WIRED’s questions, Tomé also wrote his own guide for distinguishing outages from cyberattacks.) The usual suspects, he says, include “a bad update, a configuration change, a cable cut, or a power failure.”
paras.zh: 考虑到网络攻击与整体中断相比很少见，明智的做法是首先考虑其他潜在原因。网络数据公司 IPinfo 的互联网研究编辑若昂·托梅 (João Tomé) 表示：“大多数看起来像是攻击的大型中断都是人为造成的。” （在回答《连线》杂志的问题时，Tomé 还编写了自己的指南，用于区分网络中断和网络攻击。）他说，通常的嫌疑包括“错误的更新、配置更改、电缆切断或电源故障”。

paras.en: 2. Look at Status Updates From Organizations That Might Be Involved
paras.zh: 2. 查看可能涉及的组织的状态更新

paras.en: In the scramble to understand what’s really happening with a given outage, it can sometimes be difficult to tell which sites and services are actually down. And there can be a few reasons for this muddled picture. Sometimes, an outage occurs within a foundational service like a big cloud provider. Major downtime within Amazon Web Services, for example, can cause a cascade of other failures among the company’s customers, who are all dependent on that infrastructure.
paras.zh: 在争先恐后地了解给定中断的实际情况时，有时很难判断哪些站点和服务实际上已关闭。造成这种混乱局面的原因可能有几个。有时，像大型云提供商这样的基础服务会发生中断。例如，亚马逊网络服务内的重大停机可能会导致该公司的客户出现一系列其他故障，而这些客户都依赖于该基础设施。

paras.en: In other cases, multiple services can seem to be having outages and producing errors but are functioning normally and only having problems when they interact with an entity that’s down. This appears to have been the case in this week’s bank outage: Multiple banks appeared to be having issues, but they all seem to have been linked to certain inter-institutional transactions that involved JPMorgan Chase. Another good example of this scenario is situations where it may appear that multiple wireless carriers are struggling, but all of the failed calls actually involve one network that’s having an outage.
paras.zh: 在其他情况下，多个服务可能看似出现中断并产生错误，但实际上运行正常，并且仅在与发生故障的实体交互时才会出现问题。本周的银行停电事件似乎就是这种情况：多家银行似乎都出现了问题，但它们似乎都与涉及摩根大通的某些机构间交易有关。这种情况的另一个很好的例子是，看起来多个无线运营商都在苦苦挣扎，但所有失败的呼叫实际上都涉及一个发生中断的网络。

paras.en: On top of these, there are also scenarios where one or more large services are down, and false (typically accidental or anecdotal) reports of additional outages create further confusion and opacity.
paras.zh: 除此之外，还存在一种或多种大型服务停机的情况，并且关于额外中断的虚假（通常是意外或轶事）报告会造成进一步的混乱和不透明。

paras.en: It can all feel overwhelming, even impossible, to attempt to parse these situations yourself—but there is a concrete place to start. If you think a website or service from a major tech company may be down, look for acknowledgment of the situation on their verified social media accounts or in the “newsroom” press release section of their websites. And keep in mind that you can find these pages and social media accounts through search engines, so you definitely don’t need to be familiar with every company’s communications strategy. Use this same approach for government agencies and other institutions.
paras.zh: 尝试自己解析这些情况可能会让人感到不知所措，甚至不可能——但有一个具体的起点。如果您认为大型科技公司的网站或服务可能出现故障，请在其经过验证的社交媒体帐户或网站的“新闻编辑室”新闻稿部分中查找有关情况的确认信息。请记住，您可以通过搜索引擎找到这些页面和社交媒体帐户，因此您绝对不需要熟悉每个公司的传播策略。对政府机构和其他机构使用相同的方法。

paras.en: Another concrete and vital source of information that you can find through search engines is what’s often known as “status dashboard” pages. Large digital platforms specifically offer these informational pages to provide transparency into whether different components of their service are functioning normally or dealing with issues. In a major incident, companies often thread incremental updates about system restoration on the status dashboard. AWS, Google Cloud Platform, and Microsoft Azure all offer these landing pages, and there are similar ones for other services like Meta business products, Google Workspace, telecom companies, AI companies, and so on.
paras.zh: 您可以通过搜索引擎找到的另一个具体且重要的信息来源是通常所说的“状态仪表板”页面。大型数字平台专门提供这些信息页面，以透明地了解其服务的不同组件是否正常运行或处理问题。在重大事件中，公司通常会在状态仪表板上发布有关系统恢复的增量更新。 AWS、Google Cloud Platform 和 Microsoft Azure 都提供这些登陆页面，其他服务（如元业务产品、Google Workspace、电信公司、AI 公司等）也有类似的登陆页面。

paras.en: 3. Check Trusted Sources of Network Data
paras.zh: 3. 检查网络数据的可信来源

paras.en: When a cascading tech failure causes outages across many services at once, and the point of failure isn’t clear, sources of network data that monitor the internet at a broad scale can also help determine the underlying issue. Amanda Meng, a research scientist at Georgia Tech who helps run its Internet Outage Detection and Analysis service, or IODA, points to not only IODA’s own data—and its social media accounts on BlueSky and Mastodon—but also tools like Cloudflare Radar and Watch the Net. Infoblox’s Madory also posts his own findings about network outages on his social media accounts.
paras.zh: 当级联技术故障同时导致许多服务中断，并且故障点尚不清楚时，大规模监控互联网的网络数据源也可以帮助确定根本问题。佐治亚理工学院的研究科学家阿曼达·孟帮助运行其互联网中断检测和分析服务（IODA），她不仅指出了 IODA 自己的数据及其在 BlueSky 和 ​​Mastodon 上的社交媒体帐户，还指出了 Cloudflare Radar 和 Watch the Net 等工具。 Infoblox 的 Madory 还在他的社交媒体帐户上发布了他自己关于网络中断的发现。

paras.en: When IODA sees evidence of a network disruption, “we’ll look at the timing of it, the start, the end, the network affected, anything we can find out about it, and then try and connect it with what we see from reporting,” Meng says. That scope, location, and timing of an outage can help determine a suspected cause, whether it’s a single network that might be the victim of a buggy update, a region cut off by damage to a fiber optic cable or, in rarer instances, a cyberattack or even a government purposefully cutting off internet access to its citizens to stifle protests.
paras.zh: 当 IODA 看到网络中断的证据时，“我们将查看它的时间、开始、结束、受影响的网络以及我们能找到的任何信息，然后尝试将其与我们从报告中看到的内容联系起来，”孟说。中断的范围、位置和时间可以帮助确定可疑的原因，无论是可能是有问题的更新的受害者的单个网络，还是因光纤电缆损坏而被切断的区域，或者在极少数情况下，是网络攻击，甚至是政府故意切断其公民的互联网访问以镇压抗议活动。

paras.en: Even with those network clues, however, Meng advises returning to step two: Once an affected service is identified, its actual owners are often the best source to monitor for updates. “Usually the operators have the most information about what's actually going on,” she says.
paras.zh: 然而，即使有了这些网络线索，孟建议回到第二步：一旦确定受影响的服务，其实际所有者通常是监控更新的最佳来源。 “通常操作员拥有最多的实际情况信息，”她说。

paras.en: Most often, mea culpa updates from companies or government agencies confirm an outage is caused by a tech mishap. In the rarer cases when that downtime results from an actual cyberattack or hacker breach, however, the hackers responsible often claim responsibility in some form.
paras.zh: 大多数情况下，公司或政府机构的道歉更新确认中断是由技术事故引起的。然而，在极少数情况下，当停机是由于实际的网络攻击或黑客入侵造成的时，负责的黑客通常会以某种形式声称承担责任。

paras.en: Ransomware gangs, perhaps the most common source of serious malicious internet disruption, publicize their breaches on dark web pages that list their targets for the purposes of extortion, sometimes with a countdown timer designed to pressure victims to pay before they leak stolen information. In other cases, like the NotPetya or WannaCry worms—two of the worst cyberattacks in history—the hackers’ self-perpetuating code left behind ransom messages on machines that quickly spread on social media as the attacks unfolded. Ideological “hacktivist” groups—or state-sponsored hackers working for military or intelligence agencies but posing as hacktivists—also often take credit for their cyberattacks on platforms like X, Telegram, or their own websites. These messages then quickly spread to social media and through news reports.
paras.zh: 勒索软件团伙可能是严重恶意互联网中断的最常见来源，他们在暗网页上公布他们的违规行为，列出他们的勒索目标，有时还会设置倒计时器，迫使受害者在泄露被盗信息之前付费。在其他情况下，例如 NotPetya 或 WannaCry 蠕虫（历史上最严重的两种网络攻击），黑客的自我延续代码在计算机上留下勒索信息，随着攻击的展开，这些信息迅速在社交媒体上传播。意识形态的“黑客行动主义”团体——或者是国家资助的为军事或情报机构工作但冒充黑客行动主义者的黑客——也经常将他们在 X、Telegram 等平台或他们自己的网站上进行的网络攻击归功于自己。这些消息随后迅速传播到社交媒体和新闻报道。

paras.en: Even these statements, however, should be taken as just another significant data point: Hacker groups exaggerate, misdirect, or lie when it serves their purposes. And some significant mass hacking incidents—such as the Mirai attack on the internet infrastructure company Dyn in 2016 that took down thousands of websites—have been accompanied by no public message at all from the hackers responsible.
paras.zh: 然而，即使这些陈述也应该被视为另一个重要的数据点：黑客团体在达到其目的时会夸大、误导或撒谎。一些重大的大规模黑客事件——例如 2016 年对互联网基础设施公司 Dyn 的 Mirai 攻击导致数千个网站瘫痪——肇事黑客根本没有公开任何信息。

paras.en: In cases where neither the perpetrator of a hacking incident nor its target has confirmed the attack, confirmation can sometimes come first from a government agency—such as the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency—or even from threat intelligence researchers at private cybersecurity firms. Government and industry investigators sometimes post their findings to their websites or share them with media, but it often takes days, weeks, or even months to come to confirmed conclusions. Hence, step five.
paras.zh: 如果黑客事件的肇事者和目标都没有确认攻击，有时可以首先从政府机构（例如网络安全和基础设施安全局）甚至私人网络安全公司的威胁情报研究人员处进行确认。政府和行业调查人员有时会将他们的调查结果发布到网站上或与媒体分享，但通常需要几天、几周甚至几个月的时间才能得出确认的结论。因此，第五步。

paras.en: If all these other measures of determining the cause of an outage don’t offer a clear understanding of the situation, the best approach may be patience. “It's going to get a little conclusive at some point,” Madory says. “Sometimes you just have to just sit and wait.”
paras.zh: 如果确定中断原因的所有其他措施都不能清楚地了解情况，那么最好的方法可能是耐心。 “到了某个时候，就会得出一些结论，”马多里说。 “有时候你只需要坐下来等待。”

paras.en: Aside from the time it takes for companies to admit to their screwups—or hackers to claim a win—the length of an outage can also sometimes offer a clue to its cause. A faulty update, power outage, or cascading bug can often be resolved quickly. Determined hackers who have maximized their damage, who shift tactics to outsmart defenders, or who may still be in a network they’ve breached can cause far longer and more severe outages. “A rollback takes minutes or hours,” Tomé says, referring to reverting to older code as a fix for a faulty update that introduces a bug. “Ransomware takes days or sometimes even weeks.”
paras.zh: 除了公司承认自己搞砸了所需的时间（或者黑客声称获胜所需的时间）之外，中断的持续时间有时也可以提供其原因的线索。错误的更新、断​​电或级联错误通常可以快速解决。那些意志坚定的黑客已经将其损害最大化，他们改变策略以智胜防御者，或者他们可能仍然处于他们所破坏的网络中，可能会导致更长时间和更严重的中断。 “回滚需要几分钟或几小时，”Tomé 说，他指的是恢复到旧代码，作为对引入错误的错误更新的修复。 “勒索软件需要几天甚至几周的时间。”

paras.en: In other words, as with all breaking news, when facts are in short supply, it’s better to maintain skepticism about early rumors or conspiracy theories and wait for more concrete evidence.
paras.zh: 换句话说，与所有突发新闻一样，当事实缺乏时，最好对早期谣言或阴谋论保持怀疑，等待更具体的证据。

paras.en: In the information vacuum that precedes that evidence, it can be easy to see connections between events that may just be coincidences. What are the odds, you may ask, that five major IT outages occurred on a sequential Thursday, Friday, Monday, and Tuesday?
paras.zh: 在证据出现之前的信息真空中，很容易看出可能只是巧合的事件之间的联系。您可能会问，周四、周五、周一和周二连续发生五次重大 IT 中断的可能性有多大？

paras.en: For Doug Madory, who tracks those network outages every day of the week, that string of failures may just be a sign of the increasing complexity of technology—and how fundamentally our civilization has come to depend on it. “For better or worse, modern society is completely mediated through internet-based services. They have outages from time to time. And that’s a reality I don't think we’ll ever completely eliminate,” Madory says.
paras.zh: 道格·马多里（Doug Madory）每周都会跟踪这些网络中断情况，对于他来说，这一系列故障可能只是技术日益复杂的标志，以及我们的文明从根本上依赖于技术的标志。 “无论好坏，现代社会完全是通过基于互联网的服务来调节的。它们时不时会出现中断。我认为我们永远无法完全消除这一现实，”马多里说。

paras.en: “If you're immersed in that world of looking at outages for years on end, then they don't really surprise you,” he adds. “You just try to understand what's different about each one. And maybe what we can learn from it.”
paras.zh: “如果您连续多年沉浸在停电的世界中，那么它们并不会让您感到惊讶，”他补充道。 “你只需尝试了解每个人的不同之处。也许我们可以从中学到什么。”

articles.title: Trump’s ‘trade deal’ with Thailand is not a done deal.
articles.author: Verena Hölzl

paras.en: President Trump landed in Manila on Tuesday to begin a 48-hour Asia trip in which he will meet with Xi Jinping of China and other world leaders, with an unpredictable agenda that could include the future of American tariffs, nuclear arms control, the war in Ukraine and U.S. restrictions on advanced A.I. chips.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统周二抵达马尼拉，开始为期 48 小时的亚洲之行，期间他将与中国习近平和其他世界领导人会面，议程不可预测，其中可能包括美国关税的未来、核武器控制、乌克兰战争以及美国对先进人工智能的限制。筹码。

paras.en: Mr. Trump was scheduled to meet with President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. of the Philippines and attend a gathering of Southeast Asian leaders. After less than 24 hours in Manila, he will head to the APEC economic summit in Shenzhen, China, where he was expected to meet with Mr. Xi and President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普原定会见菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯，并出席东南亚领导人聚会。在马尼拉停留不到24小时后，他将前往中国深圳参加亚太经合组织经济峰会，并预计会见习近平主席和俄罗斯总统普京。

paras.en: The brief itinerary appears to reflect Mr. Trump’s preferences. He dislikes big summits where he often is not the sole subject of attention. And he enjoys meeting with leaders of powerful nations — especially Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin, two authoritarian leaders he often talks about in admiring terms.
paras.zh: 简短的行程似乎反映了特朗普的偏好。他不喜欢大型峰会，因为在那里他常常不是唯一受到关注的对象。他喜欢与强国领导人会面，尤其是习近平和普京，他经常以钦佩的言辞谈论这两位独裁领导人。

paras.en: Mr. Trump will be meeting Mr. Xi for the third time this year, and a three-way meeting between China, Russia and the United States would be the first of its kind.
paras.zh: 特朗普今年将第三次会见习近平，而中国、俄罗斯和美国之间的双向会晤将是首次。

paras.en: On Tuesday, Mr. Trump caught the end of a dayslong meeting of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, or ASEAN, after issuing tariffs on countries across the region, even allies. Those moves added to a sentiment in Asia that the United States was not a reliable partner but rather one that treasured its commercial interests over its security interests. The only event of substance on the president’s schedule on Tuesday — signing what he had called a “trade deal” with Thailand — did not happen because Mr. Trump said it was still being finalized.
paras.zh: 周二，特朗普在东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）为期一天的会议结束后对该地区各国（甚至是盟友）征收关税。这些举动加剧了亚洲的一种情绪，即美国不是一个可靠的伙伴，而是一个重视商业利益而非安全利益的伙伴。总统周二日程上唯一的实质性活动——与泰国签署他所谓的“贸易协议”——没有发生，因为特朗普表示该协议仍在敲定中。

paras.en: Mr. Trump met with leaders from the so-called Quad — the United States, India, Japan and Australia — soon after his arrival. All three partners are smarting from high energy prices triggered by the Iran war, a conflict Mr. Trump never discussed with them before launching it in late February.
paras.zh: 特朗普抵达后不久就会见了所谓的“四方”——美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚的领导人。所有三个合作伙伴都对伊朗战争引发的高能源价格感到痛苦，特朗普在二月底发动战争之前从未与他们讨论过这场冲突。

paras.en: In Shenzhen — the heart of China’s robotics and artificial intelligence industries — Mr. Trump will pursue détente with Mr. Xi. He needs to extend a soon-expiring trade truce that limited tariffs on Chinese goods entering the United States in return for a Chinese commitment not to cut off rare earths and magnets.
paras.zh: 在中国机器人和人工智能产业的中心深圳，特朗普将寻求与习近平缓和关系。他需要延长即将到期的贸易休战协议，该休战协议限制了进入美国的中国商品的关税，以换取中国承诺不切断稀土和磁铁的供应。

paras.en: Then comes the main event: the meeting with Mr. Xi and Mr. Putin. Referring to the trilateral meeting, Mr. Trump told reporters before leaving Washington: “We are going to be talking about denuclearization, a tough subject because it is very hard for any of us to say we’ll get rid of our nukes.” Chinese officials have made clear they are not interested in nuclear talks until their arsenal is roughly the size of the American one.
paras.zh: 接下来是重头戏：与习近平和普京的会面。谈到三边会议，特朗普在离开华盛顿前对记者表示：“我们将讨论无核化，这是一个棘手的话题，因为我们中的任何人都很难说我们会放弃核武器。”中国官员已明确表示，除非其核武库规模大致相当于美国的核武库，否则他们对核谈判不感兴趣。

paras.en: Mr. Trump also said, “We will talk about Iran a little,” insisting the situation was in “very good shape.” Analysts say it is unlikely that the meeting will make any progress on Iran, with Russia happy to see energy prices elevated since the war began, and China eager to see them rapidly decline.
paras.zh: 特朗普还表示，“我们将稍微讨论一下伊朗”，并坚称局势“非常好”。分析人士表示，这次会议不太可能在伊朗问题上取得任何进展，俄罗斯乐于看到战争开始以来能源价格上涨，而中国则渴望看到能源价格迅速下跌。

paras.en: - North Korea: Mr. Putin could meet with Kim Jong-un if the North Korean leader also travels to China for the APEC summit, Russian state news agencies reported, citing the Kremlin’s spokesman. It was not clear whether Mr. Kim would attend the summit.
paras.zh: - 朝鲜：俄罗斯国家通讯社援引克里姆林宫发言人的话说，如果朝鲜领导人金正恩也前往中国参加亚太经合组织峰会，普京可能会见金正恩。目前尚不清楚金正恩是否会出席峰会。

paras.en: - Ukraine: Mr. Trump also said he would talk about Ukraine, on which Mr. Putin’s aides are engaging in talks with the U.S. and Ukrainian officials, but also renewing demands that NATO pull back its troops to where they were before the alliance expanded toward Russia.
paras.zh: - 乌克兰：特朗普还表示，他将谈论乌克兰问题，普京的助手正在与美国和乌克兰官员就乌克兰问题进行会谈，但他还再次要求北约将其部队撤回到该联盟向俄罗斯扩张之前的位置。

paras.en: President Vladimir V. Putin of Russia could meet with Kim Jong-un if the North Korean leader travels to China for the APEC summit this week, the Kremlin said, reflecting the deepening of ties between their countries in recent years.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫表示，如果朝鲜领导人金正恩本周前往中国参加亚太经合组织峰会，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京可能会见金正恩，这反映出近年来两国关系不断深化。

paras.en: Asked about the possibility of a meeting, Dmitri S. Peskov, the Kremlin spokesman, said on Monday that it would “of course” happen if Mr. Kim went to Shenzhen, the Chinese economic hub and host city, according to Russian state news agencies. North Korea has not confirmed whether Mr. Kim plans to attend the summit.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯国家通讯社报道，在被问及会面的可能性时，克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·S·佩斯科夫(Dmitri S. Peskov)周一表示，如果金正恩前往中国经济中心和主办城市深圳，那“当然”会发生。朝鲜尚未证实金正恩是否计划参加峰会。

paras.en: Mr. Putin and Mr. Kim have publicly met three times since 2022, and North Korea has been a key supporter of Russia’s military actions in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 自 2022 年以来，普京和金正恩已公开会面 3 次，朝鲜一直是俄罗斯在乌克兰军事行动的主要支持者。

paras.en: As the war in Ukraine nears its fifth anniversary, with no end in sight, the Kremlin is expected to use Mr. Putin’s many meetings at the APEC summit to showcase how Russia is regarded as one of the major international powers alongside the United States and China.
paras.zh: 随着乌克兰战争接近五周年，而且还看不到结束的迹象，预计克里姆林宫将利用普京在亚太经合组织峰会上的多次会面来展示俄罗斯如何被视为与美国和中国并列的主要国际大国之一。

paras.en: A visit by Mr. Kim would be a rare foray outside North Korea for the leader, and it would further raise the prospect that he could meet with President Trump in China. On the first day of his 48-hour trip to Asia, Mr. Trump told reporters that Mr. Kim “would like” to come to the APEC summit. The president has repeatedly said he would like to meet with Mr. Kim again.
paras.zh: 金正恩的访问将是这位领导人在朝鲜之外的罕见尝试，这将进一步提高他在中国与特朗普总统会面的可能性。在 48 小时亚洲之行的第一天，特朗普告诉记者，金正恩“愿意”参加 APEC 峰会。总统多次表示他希望再次与金正恩会面。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Mr. Putin is scheduled to meet with Xi Jinping, China’s leader. On Thursday, he is set to take part in a trilateral summit with Mr. Xi and Mr. Trump, the first meeting of its kind. The Kremlin said on Monday that it was working to arrange a bilateral meeting between Mr. Putin and Mr. Trump.
paras.zh: 普京计划于周三会见中国领导人习近平。周四，他将参加与习近平和特朗普举行的三边峰会，这是此类会议的首次。克里姆林宫周一表示，正在努力安排普京和特朗普之间的双边会晤。

paras.en: Before his departure for China, Mr. Putin met on Monday in the Kremlin with Jo Yong-won, a secretary of North Korea’s ruling Workers’ Party. During the meeting, Mr. Putin said that North Korea’s help in driving Ukrainian forces from the Kursk region of Russia last year “marked a new chapter in the history of military cooperation between our countries.”
paras.zh: 在启程前往中国之前，普京周一在克里姆林宫会见了朝鲜执政党劳动党书记赵甬元。普京在会见期间表示，去年朝鲜帮助将乌克兰军队赶出俄罗斯库尔斯克地区，“标志着我们两国军事合作历史的新篇章”。

paras.en: Moscow planned to unveil a monument in Kursk by the end of the year to honor the North Korean troops, Mr. Putin said.
paras.zh: 普京表示，莫斯科计划于今年年底前在库尔斯克揭幕一座纪念碑，以纪念朝鲜军队。

paras.en: During the final meeting of the day, with ASEAN leaders, President Trump told President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. of the Philippines: “I don’t want to date myself, but I knew your parents very well. They were great. I believe in genetics. They did a good job. You have very good genetics, I can tell you that.”
paras.zh: 在当天与东盟领导人的最后一次会议上，特朗普总统对菲律宾总统小费迪南德·R·马科斯说：“我不想和自己约会，但我很了解你的父母。他们很棒。我相信遗传学。他们做得很好。我可以告诉你，你有很好的遗传学。”

paras.en: It was not the first time Mr. Trump has praised the family of Mr. Marcos, who is the son of the dictator Ferdinand E. Marcos, who ruled the Philippines for 20 years, imposed martial law and was ousted in 1986.
paras.zh: 这并不是特朗普第一次赞扬马科斯的家人。马科斯是独裁者费迪南德·马科斯 (Ferdinand E. Marcos) 的儿子，费迪南德·马科斯统治菲律宾 20 年，实施戒严令，并于 1986 年被赶下台。

paras.en: The only event of substance on President Trump’s schedule today, the signing of a trade deal between the United States and Thailand, did not happen because it was still being finalized. Trump told reporters that “Thailand will eliminate all tariffs on U.S. imports” and that the United States would provide tariff relief, but the two sides signed only a memorandum about the agreement. The president said the deal would be done in the coming weeks.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统今天日程上唯一的实质性事件，即美国和泰国之间签署贸易协议，并未发生，因为该协议仍在敲定之中。特朗普对记者表示，“泰国将取消对美国进口产品的所有关税”，美国将提供关税减免，但双方仅签署了一份有关协议的备忘录。总统表示，该协议将在未来几周内完成。

paras.en: During an address to Quad leaders, President Trump called Prime Minister Narendra Modi of India, which is a member of the group, “a great leader and a friend of mine, highly respected by everybody all over the world.” The president also praised Modi as he stood with other leaders and took a few questions, calling him a “very tough man.”
paras.zh: 在向四方领导人发表讲话时，特朗普总统称该组织成员之一的印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪是“一位伟大的领导人，也是我的朋友，受到全世界所有人的高度尊重”。总统还称赞莫迪与其他领导人站在一起并回答了一些问题，称他是一个“非常强硬的人”。

paras.en: India and the United States are navigating a rocky patch in their relationship, largely tied to trade and India’s purchases of Russian oil. Although Modi and Trump signed an interim framework for a trade deal in February, talks have dragged on, frustrating both parties.
paras.zh: 印度和美国的关系正经历一段艰难的时期，这主要与贸易和印度购买俄罗斯石油有关。尽管莫迪和特朗普在二月份签署了贸易协议临时框架，但谈判却一拖再拖，令双方都感到沮丧。

paras.en: The Nvidia turmoil and its implications for the U.S.-China relationship is a backdrop to President Trump’s visit. On Tuesday, shares of technology companies in Asia tumbled after the Trump administration announced rules to restrict overseas access to advanced A.I. chips like those sold by Nvidia. In Hong Kong trading, Alibaba fell 5 percent, while Tencent’s stock dropped nearly 4 percent. The Chinese A.I. firms MiniMax Group fell 7 percent, and Z.AI Co. declined 5 percent.
paras.zh: 英伟达的动荡及其对中美关系的影响是特朗普总统访问的背景。周二，在特朗普政府宣布限制海外获取先进人工智能的规则后，亚洲科技公司的股价暴跌。像 Nvidia 销售的芯片一样。在香港交易中，阿里巴巴股价下跌 5%，而腾讯股价下跌近 4%。中国人工智能MiniMax Group 下跌 7%，Z.AI Co. 下跌 5%。

paras.en: In the United States, tech stocks stabilized from a sell-off the day before. Nvidia shares were up about 1 percent before the start of regular trading in New York. The company is set to report its latest financial results later on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 在美国，科技股从前一天的抛售中企稳。在纽约常规交易开始前，Nvidia 股价上涨了约 1%。该公司定于周二晚些时候公布最新的财务业绩。

paras.en: President Trump is expected to meet with Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul of Thailand on Tuesday in Manila to sign what the White House has described as a “trade deal.”
paras.zh: 预计特朗普总统将于周二在马尼拉会见泰国总理阿努丁·占维拉古 (Anutin Charnvirakul)，签署白宫所说的“贸易协议”。

paras.en: But Thailand’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs said in a statement on Tuesday that Bangkok was expecting to agree only on a “joint statement marking progress in negotiations.”
paras.zh: 但泰国外交部周二在一份声明中表示，曼谷预计只会就“标志着谈判取得进展的联合声明”达成一致。

paras.en: The dissonance comes amid growing signs within ASEAN, the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, that the United States is not a reliable partner. The meeting between Mr. Trump and Mr. Anutin is taking place on the sidelines of an ASEAN summit.
paras.zh: 这种不和谐之际，东盟内部越来越多的迹象表明美国不是一个可靠的合作伙伴。特朗普和阿努廷之间的会面是在东盟峰会期间举行的。

paras.en: For more than a year, Washington and Bangkok have been negotiating a new trade agreement that covers items like tariffs, food imports and labor rights.
paras.zh: 一年多来，华盛顿和曼谷一直在谈判一项新的贸易协定，涵盖关税、食品进口和劳工权利等项目。
