articles.title: 'Neuromancer:' Release date, cast & everything we know about Apple TV's new cyberpunk series
articles.author: Jeff Spry

paras.en: We're in a bit of a cyberpunk revival at the moment. 2026 gave the excellent second season of Netflix’s "Cyberpunk: Edgerunners," and Prime Video's "Blade Runner 2099" is just around the corner. 2027 will continue this trend with "Neuromancer" blasting onto Apple TV.
paras.zh: 我们现在正处于赛博朋克复兴之中。 2026 年，Netflix 的《赛博朋克：边缘奔跑者》第二季精彩纷呈，Prime Video 的《银翼杀手 2099》也即将上映。 2027 年，《神经漫游者》将登陆 Apple TV，延续这一趋势。

paras.en: Based on cyberspace guru William Gibson’s seminal 1984 novel, "Neuromancer" follows Case, a brilliant hacker who falls into a web of digital espionage and crime as he attempts an impossible corporate heist. The pulp noir novel has been hailed as a generational revelation, and its slang and terminology have become ingrained in computer nerd subcultures.
paras.zh: 《神经漫游者》改编自网络空间大师威廉·吉布森 1984 年的开创性小说，讲述了凯斯的故事，凯斯是一位才华横溢的黑客，在尝试进行不可能的企业抢劫时，陷入了数字间谍和犯罪网络。这部通俗黑色小说被誉为一代人的启示，它的俚语和术语已经在电脑迷亚文化中根深蒂固。

paras.en: After decades of development hell and failed attempts at various studios, "Neuromancer" and its plugged-in digital dystopia are finally jacking into the small screen in January 2027.
paras.zh: 经过几十年的开发地狱和各个工作室的失败尝试，《神经漫游者》及其插入的数字反乌托邦终于在 2027 年 1 月登陆小屏幕。

paras.en: Apple TV is already the secret home of amazing sci-fi, and "Neuromancer" will join the streamer's impressive roster of science fiction stalwarts like "Foundation", "Silo", "Invasion", "Dark Matter", "Murderbot", "For All Mankind", "Pluribus", and "Star City."
paras.zh: Apple TV 已经是精彩科幻小说的秘密家园，《神经漫游者》将加入该流媒体令人印象深刻的科幻小说中流砥柱，如《基地》、《筒仓》、《入侵》、《暗物质》、《谋杀机器人》、《为了全人类》、《Pluribus》和《星城》。

paras.en: Can it live up to the hype? We won't have to wait long for an answer. In the meantime, let's jack into cyberspace and scour the code for everything we know about Apple TV's "Neuromancer!"
paras.zh: 它能辜负炒作吗？我们不必等待很长时间就能得到答复。与此同时，让我们进入网络空间，在代码中搜索我们所知道的有关 Apple TV 的《神经漫游者》的所有内容！

paras.en: Apple TV+’s Neuromancer officially powers up on Jan 22, 2027.
paras.zh: Apple TV+ 的《神经漫游者》将于 2027 年 1 月 22 日正式上线。

paras.en: It was first announced to be in full production back on July 1, 2025, which actually coincided with the 41st anniversary of the publication of William Gibson's absorbing book.
paras.zh: 该书首次宣布于 2025 年 7 月 1 日全面制作，恰逢威廉·吉布森这本引人入胜的书出版 41 周年。

paras.en: Filming took place in Tokyo, Los Angeles, Istanbul, Canada, and London to create a truly international flair to replicate the novel’s action.
paras.zh: 拍摄在东京、洛杉矶、伊斯坦布尔、加拿大和伦敦进行，以创造真正的国际风格来复制小说的情节。

paras.en: Travelling outside the US and still want access to Neuromancer? Good news: NordVPN can help you get around those pesky geo-blocking restrictions so you can watch the streaming service you've paid for anywhere in the world.
paras.zh: 在美国境外旅行但仍想访问《神经漫游者》？好消息：NordVPN 可以帮助您绕过那些烦人的地理封锁限制，这样您就可以在世界任何地方观看您付费的流媒体服务。

paras.en: Gibson's "Neuromancer" is a dense, jargon-heavy juggernaut of a book that demands intense concentration to absorb all the slang, lingo, computer terms, and staccato literary rhythms, but it's a fantastic immersion into a fully fleshed-out world. It's also worryingly prophetic, showing a world not unlike ours today in 2026.
paras.zh: 吉布森的《神经漫游者》是一本内容密集、行话重的巨著，需要高度集中注意力才能吸收所有俚语、行话、计算机术语和断断续续的文学节奏，但它是对一个完全充实的世界的一种奇妙的沉浸。这也是令人担忧的预言，展示了 2026 年的世界与我们今天的世界没有什么不同。

paras.en: "Neuromancer's" TV iteration seems to be following the novel closely and will center around Case, a brilliant, cocky, neurologically damaged hacker who is forced into a logistical quagmire of digital corporate espionage with his cyber-enhanced partner Molly after embezzling cash from an employer.
paras.zh: 《神经漫游者》的电视剧版似乎紧随小说，以凯斯为中心，凯斯是一位才华横溢、自大、神经受损的黑客，在盗用雇主的现金后，被迫与他的网络增强合作伙伴莫莉陷入数字企业间谍活动的后勤泥潭。

paras.en: Molly is a "razor-girl" mercenary with mirrored eyes who dreams of attempting a dangerous heist against a nefarious corporate dynasty hiding deep, dark secrets. Hackers (known as console cowboys) "jack in" to guarded computer systems using sophisticated software and surgically implanted ports to bypass firewalls and security protocols.
paras.zh: 莫莉是一名拥有镜面眼睛的“剃刀女孩”雇佣兵，她梦想着对一个隐藏着深层黑暗秘密的邪恶企业王朝进行危险的抢劫。黑客（称为控制台牛仔）使用复杂的软件和手术植入的端口“侵入”受保护的计算机系统，以绕过防火墙和安全协议。

paras.en: Molly’s mysterious client is Armitage, a former black ops military operative with a shadowy past. The team’s prime target is a next-generation super AI entity named Wintermute.
paras.zh: 莫莉的神秘客户是阿米蒂奇，他是一名前黑人行动军事特工，有着不为人知的过去。该团队的主要目标是名为 Wintermute 的下一代超级人工智能实体。

paras.en: Everything goes smoothly until it doesn’t, and Case and Molly are soon running for their lives before eventually coming into contact with Wintermute’s AI sibling, called Neuromancer. A merger of the two systems seems inevitable, and the crux of the narrative is focused on that certainty.
paras.zh: 一切都很顺利，直到事情变得不那么顺利，凯斯和莫莉很快就开始逃命，最终接触到了温特穆特的人工智能兄弟姐妹——神经漫游者。这两个系统的合并似乎是不可避免的，而叙述的关键就集中在这种确定性上。

paras.en: Are there any trailers for "Neuromancer"?
paras.zh: 有《神经漫游者》的预告片吗？

paras.en: The first cryptic teaser trailer for "Neuromancer" landed back on July 1, 2025, to mark the start of filming.
paras.zh: 《神经漫游者》的首支神秘预告片于 2025 年 7 月 1 日回归，标志着拍摄的开始。

paras.en: Revealed in the brief video was a murky cocktail watering hole that springs to life in a flourish of humming lights and tinkling pinball machines. A bright blue-and-orange neon sign blinks on in the back, spelling out the name Bar Chatsubo, the iconic Chiba City hacker lounge that's well known to dedicated readers of the 1984 novel.
paras.zh: 这段简短的视频中展示的是一个昏暗的鸡尾酒酒吧，在嗡嗡作响的灯光和叮叮当当的弹球机声中焕发出勃勃生机。背面闪烁着明亮的蓝橙色霓虹灯，拼出 Bar Chatsubo 的名字，这是千叶市标志性的黑客休息室，为 1984 年小说的忠实读者所熟知。

paras.en: A second teaser came on July 6, 2026, in which a retro computer was powered up to display the opening sentence of Gibson’s book, describing the dour atmosphere of Japan's Chiba City... "The sky above the port was the color of television, tuned to a dead channel."
paras.zh: 第二个预告片于 2026 年 7 月 6 日发布，其中一台复古电脑启动，显示吉布森书的开头句，描述日本千叶市的阴沉气氛……“港口上方的天空是电视的颜色，调到死频道。”

paras.en: It's such a classic line that perfectly reflects that bleak cyberpunk mood.
paras.zh: 这句经典台词完美地体现了赛博朋克的凄凉情绪。

paras.en: Then, on July 25, 2026, Apple TV released the first full teaser (or short trailer) that revealed much of the series' visual style, the mega-city setting, and the main cast of Callum Turner, Brianna Middleton, and Mark Strong.
paras.zh: 然后，Apple TV 于 2026 年 7 月 25 日发布了首个完整预告片（或简短预告片），展示了该剧的大部分视觉风格、大城市背景以及卡勒姆·特纳、布里安娜·米德尔顿和马克·斯特朗的主要演员阵容。

paras.en: It’s got a serious edge and attitude that sets the tone with bold graphics and enticing sounds.
paras.zh: 它具有严肃的边缘和态度，以大胆的图形和诱人的声音奠定了基调。

paras.en: "Neuromancer’s" eclectic cast is a mix of fresh faces and wily veterans that includes:
paras.zh: 《神经漫游者》的演员阵容不拘一格，既有新鲜面孔，也有狡猾的老手，其中包括：

paras.en: - Clémence Poésy as Marie-France Tessier
paras.zh: - 克蕾曼斯·波西 饰 Marie-France Tessier

paras.en: Who are the "Neuromancer" TV show creators?
paras.zh: 《神经漫游者》电视剧的创作者是谁？

paras.en: "Neuromancer" was co-created for TV by Graham Roland ("Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan," "Dark Winds") and J.D. Dillard ("Devotion," "The Outsider," "Sleight").
paras.zh: 《神经漫游者》由格雷厄姆·罗兰（《汤姆克兰西的杰克·瑞恩》、《暗风》）和 J.D.迪拉德（《献身》、《局外人》、《诡计》）共同创作。

paras.en: It’s a 10-episode prestige series collaboration between Skydance Television and Anonymous Content that's also produced by Drake's production company, DreamCrew Entertainment. Graham Roland serves as "Neuromancer's" showrunner, with J.D. Dillard inked to direct the pilot episode and perhaps other installments.
paras.zh: 这是 Skydance Television 和 Anonymous Content 合作制作的 10 集知名剧集，同样由 Drake 的制作公司 DreamCrew Entertainment 制作。格雷厄姆·罗兰 (Graham Roland) 担任《神经漫游者》的剧集主管，J.D. 迪拉德 (J.D. Dillard) 已签约执导试播集以及其他剧集。

paras.en: "We're incredibly excited to be bringing this iconic property to Apple TV+," executive producers Roland and Dillard announced last year in a statement.
paras.zh: 执行制片人 Roland 和 Dillard 去年在一份声明中宣布：“我们非常高兴能够将这一标志性作品引入 Apple TV+。”

paras.en: "Since we became friends nearly 10 years ago, we've looked for something to team up on, so this collaboration marks a dream come true. 'Neuromancer' has inspired so much of the science fiction that's come after it, and we’re looking forward to bringing television audiences into Gibson's definitive 'cyberpunk' world.”
paras.zh: “自从我们在近 10 年前成为朋友以来，我们一直在寻找可以合作的东西，因此这次合作标志着梦想成真。《神经漫游者》为之后的科幻小说提供了很多灵感，我们期待着将电视观众带入吉布森最终的‘赛博朋克’世界。”

paras.en: Jeff Spry is an award-winning screenwriter and veteran freelance journalist covering TV, movies, video games, books, and comics. His work has appeared at SYFY Wire, Inverse, Collider, Bleeding Cool and elsewhere. Jeff lives in beautiful Bend, Oregon amid the ponderosa pines, classic muscle cars, a crypt of collector horror comics, and two loyal English Setters.
paras.zh: 杰夫·斯普里 (Jeff Spry) 是一位屡获殊荣的编剧和资深自由记者，报道电视、电影、视频游戏、书籍和漫画。他的作品曾出现在 SYFY Wire、Inverse、Collider、Bleeding Cool 等网站上。杰夫住在俄勒冈州美丽的本德，周围有黄松、经典肌肉车、收藏恐怖漫画的地窖和两只忠诚的英国塞特犬。

articles.title: Space is filling up with junk. Could laser-reflecting mirrors help humanity clean things up?
articles.author: Elizabeth Howell

paras.en: A British startup thinks it can help humanity deal with its space junk problem.
paras.zh: 一家英国初创公司认为它可以帮助人类解决太空垃圾问题。

paras.en: Millions of pieces of space debris circle Earth at the moment, according to the European Space Agency (ESA). Even the smallest fragments are potentially dangerous, given how fast stuff travels in orbit.
paras.zh: 据欧洲航天局（ESA）称，目前有数百万块太空碎片环绕地球运行。考虑到物体在轨道上传播的速度，即使是最小的碎片也有潜在的危险。

paras.en: Experts have proposed a range of measures to deal with this junk. The smallest bits, for example, may require big space nets, or lasering the stuff down to Earth. Large satellites are increasingly being deliberately deorbited these days, and a few have even been refueled to keep them operating in orbit — something that will likely start happening more and more over the coming years.
paras.zh: 专家提出了一系列措施来处理这些垃圾。例如，最小的碎片可能需要大型太空网，或者用激光将这些东西发射到地球。如今，越来越多的大型卫星被故意脱轨，有一些卫星甚至被补充燃料以使其在轨道上运行——这种情况在未来几年可能会越来越多地发生。

paras.en: Now, the British startup Foundational has another idea to throw into the mix: retroreflectors. The company argues that its tech can help fight the space-junk problem — and it just proved out a demo version in an orbital test.
paras.zh: 现在，英国初创公司 Foundational 有了另一个想法：后向反射器。该公司声称其技术可以帮助解决太空垃圾问题——而且它刚刚在轨道测试中证明了其演示版本。

paras.en: London-based Foundational recently tested its Retro-2 laser retroreflector system, which it developed in collaboration with ESA. The early-stage test was designed to ensure that Foundational's retroreflectors can return laser-ranging signals from a satellite, at altitudes between about 600 kilometers and 870 kilometers (about 370 to 540 miles).
paras.zh: 总部位于伦敦的 Foundational 最近测试了与 ESA 合作开发的 Retro-2 激光后向反射器系统。早期测试的目的是确保 Foundational 的后向反射器能够从海拔约 600 公里至 870 公里（约 370 至 540 英里）的卫星返回激光测距信号。

paras.en: The long-term aim is to create a sort of tracking device for spacecraft, so they can be monitored in orbit even after they fall silent.
paras.zh: 长期目标是为航天器创建一种跟踪装置，这样即使它们陷入沉默，也可以在轨道上对其进行监控。

paras.en: The tech, Foundational said in a statement today (Nov. 17), needs "no electronics, power or commands from its host spacecraft" and allows ground stations to keep tabs on the orbiting spacecraft.
paras.zh: Foundational 在今天（11 月 17 日）的一份声明中表示，这项技术“不需要来自其主航天器的电子设备、电源或命令”，并允许地面站密切监视轨道航天器。

paras.en: The demo mission launched this past July on SpaceX's Transporter-17 rideshare flight. It attached Retro-2 — a mini device with seven reflectors — to a small satellite that was integrated into an ION carrier craft operated by the Italian company D-Orbit.
paras.zh: 今年 7 月，该演示任务在 SpaceX 的 Transporter-17 拼车飞行中发射。它将 Retro-2（一种带有七个反射器的迷你设备）连接到一颗小型卫星上，该卫星集成到意大利 D-Orbit 公司运营的 ION 运载飞船中。

paras.en: Retro-2 worked as advertised, successfully returning 6,111 laser shots beamed from the from the ground across five passes in low Earth orbit.
paras.zh: Retro-2 的工作正如宣传的那样，成功返回了从地面发射的 6,111 束激光，穿过近地轨道五次。

paras.en: "Our tests have shown that a device weighing just 50 grams [1.8 ounces] can deliver millimeter-level ranging precision," Dave Gooding, Foundational's co-founder and chief technical officer, said in today's statement. "As space becomes increasingly crowded, keeping satellites trackable throughout their lifetime and beyond is critical to managing collision risks."
paras.zh: Foundational 联合创始人兼首席技术官 Dave Gooding 在今天的声明中表示：“我们的测试表明，重量仅为 50 克（1.8 盎司）的设备可以提供毫米级的测距精度。” “随着太空变得越来越拥挤，保持卫星在其整个生命周期及之后的可跟踪性对于管理碰撞风险至关重要。”

paras.en: Foundational is in its early stages — it was founded in 2025 and just emerged from stealth last month. Nevertheless the company has already raised £8.2 million ($10.9 million) in pre-seed funding.
paras.zh: Foundational 正处于早期阶段——它成立于 2025 年，上个月刚刚从隐秘状态中脱颖而出。尽管如此，该公司已经筹集了 820 万英镑（1090 万美元）的种子前资金。

paras.en: Foundational is part of a range of companies involved in debris removal, satellite servicing or debris tracking that have raised funds in 2026. Others include Starfish Space (which raised more than $100 million in a Series B), Katalyst Space ($12 million in funding) and international companies like India's Cosmoserve Space.
paras.zh: Foundational 是一系列涉及碎片清除、卫星服务或碎片追踪的公司之一，这些公司已于 2026 年筹集了资金。其他公司包括 Starfish Space（在 B 轮融资中筹集了超过 1 亿美元）、Katalyst Space（融资 1200 万美元）以及印度 Cosmoserve Space 等国际公司。

paras.en: Elizabeth Howell (she/her), Ph.D., was a staff writer in the spaceflight channel between 2022 and 2024 specializing in Canadian space news. She was contributing writer for Space.com for 10 years from 2012 to 2024. Elizabeth's reporting includes multiple exclusives with the White House, leading world coverage about a lost-and-found space tomato on the International Space Station, witnessing five human spaceflight launches on two continents, flying parabolic, working inside a spacesuit, and participating in a simulated Mars mission. Her latest book, "Why Am I Taller?" (ECW Press, 2022) is co-written with astronaut Dave Williams.
paras.zh: 伊丽莎白·豪厄尔（Elizabeth Howell）（她/她）博士于 2022 年至 2024 年间担任太空飞行频道的特约撰稿人，专门报道加拿大太空新闻。从 2012 年到 2024 年，她在 Space.com 担任特约撰稿人长达 10 年。伊丽莎白的报道内容包括多份白宫独家报道、主导国际空间站失物招领太空番茄的全球报道、见证五次载人航天在两大洲的发射、抛物线飞行、在宇航服内工作以及参与模拟火星任务。她的最新书《为什么我更高？》 （ECW Press，2022 年）与宇航员戴夫·威廉姆斯 (Dave Williams) 共同撰写。

articles.title: CCIA Report Highlights Satellite Connectivity’s Potential to Expand Internet Access and Drive Economic Growth
articles.author: CCIA

paras.en: Washington — The Computer & Communications Industry Association today released Connecting the World: Unlocking the Potential of Satellite Connectivity, a new report examining how satellite technology can expand internet access, strengthen emergency communications, and drive economic growth.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——计算机和通信行业协会今天发布了一份新报告《连接世界：释放卫星连接的潜力》，该报告探讨了卫星技术如何扩大互联网接入、加强应急通信和推动经济增长。

paras.en: The report examines how the post-pandemic shift to digital services and economic opportunities exposed connectivity gaps across the world, and how next-generation satellite networks can complement terrestrial infrastructure to connect underserved communities and support applications across agriculture, transportation, and other industries.
paras.zh: 该报告探讨了大流行后向数字服务和经济机遇的转变如何暴露了世界各地的连接差距，以及下一代卫星网络如何补充地面基础设施，以连接服务不足的社区并支持农业、运输和其他行业的应用。

paras.en: CCIA recommends modernizing outdated spectrum and licensing rules, strengthening satellite supply chains and launch capacity, and adopting technology-neutral policies that improve connectivity affordability and digital literacy.
paras.zh: CCIA 建议对过时的频谱和许可规则进行现代化改造，加强卫星供应链和发射能力，并采取技术中立政策来提高连接负担能力和数字素养。

paras.en: The following can be attributed to Karina Perez, Director of CCIA’s Space & Spectrum Policy Center:
paras.zh: 以下内容来自 CCIA 空间与频谱政策中心主任 Karina Perez：

paras.en: “Satellite connectivity can help bring more people online while creating new opportunities for businesses, communities, and consumers. Policymakers should modernize outdated rules and reduce unnecessary barriers to ensure satellite technologies can complement existing networks, expand consumer choice, and help connect underserved populations.”
paras.zh: “卫星连接可以帮助更多的人上网，同时为企业、社区和消费者创造新的机会。政策制定者应该对过时的规则进行现代化改造，减少不必要的障碍，以确保卫星技术能够补充现有网络，扩大消费者的选择，并帮助连接服务不足的人群。”

paras.en: CCIA is an international, not-for-profit trade association representing a broad cross section of communications and technology firms. For more than 50 years, CCIA has promoted open markets, open systems, and open networks. CCIA members employ more than 1.6 million workers, invest more than $100 billion in research and development, and contribute trillions of dollars in productivity to the global economy. For more, visit www.ccianet.org.
paras.zh: CCIA 是一个国际性非营利贸易协会，代表广泛的通信和技术公司。 50多年来，CCIA一直致力于推动开放市场、开放系统和开放网络。 CCIA 成员雇用了超过 160 万名工人，在研发方面投资超过 1000 亿美元，为全球经济贡献了数万亿美元的生产力。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.ccianet.org。

articles.title: Commercial Space Federation Welcomes CesiumAstro as a New Associate Member
articles.author: Commercial Space Federation

paras.en: November 13, 2026— Washington, D.C.—The Commercial Space Federation (CSF) is pleased to welcome CesiumAstro as its newest Associate Member. A global leader in advanced connectivity solutions for the space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. CesiumAstro’s addition further strengthens CSF’s diverse membership and the Federation’s work to advance a competitive, innovative, and sustainable U.S. commercial space economy.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月 13 日——华盛顿特区——商业航天联合会 (CSF) 很高兴欢迎 CesiumAstro 成为其最新准会员。 CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。 CesiumAstro 的加入进一步加强了 CSF 的多元化成员资格以及联合会推动竞争性、创新性和可持续的美国商业太空经济的工作。

paras.en: CesiumAstro is a lobal leader in advanced connectivity solutions for space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. Its full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads and advanced computing systems. CesiumAstro maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards. Headquartered near Austin, Texas, the company operates additional facilities in Colorado, California, Washington, D.C., Florida, the United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore, Taiwan, and Japan.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，CesiumAstro 提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。其全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。 CesiumAstro 保持与内部设计、制造和测试能力的完全垂直整合，并通过了 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证。该公司总部位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀附近，在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、华盛顿特区、佛罗里达州、英国、德国、新加坡、台湾和日本设有其他工厂。

paras.en: CesiumAstro recently announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion, and unveiled Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation. The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 最近宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元，并推出了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划中的 737 颗卫星、支持人工智能的星座。新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has expanded its capabilities through three strategic acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr, strengthening the company’s capabilities across semiconductor technology, mission software, and artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 在过去的 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项战略收购扩大了其能力：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr，增强了公司在半导体技术、任务软件和人工智能方面的能力。

paras.en: CesiumAstro’s full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads, and advanced compute systems. The company maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 的全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。该公司与通过 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证的内部设计、制造和测试能力保持完整的垂直整合。

paras.en: “A thriving commercial economy in low Earth orbit needs reliable communications and a clear path from development to operations. CesiumAstro is joining CSF’s Commercial LEO Council to bring our communications expertise to that effort. We look forward to advancing policies that encourage investment, expand government use of commercial services, and support companies building the next generation of space infrastructure.”
paras.zh: “近地轨道蓬勃发展的商业经济需要可靠的通信以及从开发到运营的清晰路径。CesiumAstro 正在加入 CSF 的商业 LEO 委员会，将我们的通信专业知识用于这一努力。我们期待推进鼓励投资、扩大政府对商业服务的使用以及支持企业建设下一代空间基础设施的政策。”

paras.en: – Josh Ingersoll, Director of Spectrum and Regulatory Affairs at CesiumAstro
paras.zh: – Josh Ingersoll，CesiumAstro 频谱和监管事务总监

paras.en: Founded in 2006, the Commercial Space Federation (CSF) and its members are laying the foundation for democratizing access to outer space for scientists, students, civilians, and businesses. All while working towards the goal of expanding the U.S. Commercial Space Economy. Through the promotion of technological innovation, CSF and its diverse membership are guiding the bolstering of U.S. leadership in aerospace and inspiring America’s next generation of engineers and explorers. CSF also serves as the commercial space industry’s primary advocate with the U.S. Congress and the Administration, helping inform the development and implementation of policy priorities. By engaging with congressional players, CSF is able to provide recommendations on commercial space issues that will impact the commercial space industry in the short and long term.
paras.zh: 商业太空联盟 (CSF) 及其成员成立于 2006 年，正在为科学家、学生、平民和企业进入外太空的民主化奠定基础。同时努力实现扩大美国商业太空经济的目标。通过促进技术创新，CSF 及其多元化成员正在指导巩固美国在航空航天领域的领导地位，并激励美国下一代工程师和探险家。 CSF 还担任美国国会和政府商业航天业的主要倡导者，帮助为政策优先事项的制定和实施提供信息。通过与国会参与者合作，CSF 能够就商业航天问题提供建议，这些问题将在短期和长期影响商业航天行业。

articles.title: How AI is pushing satellites to evolve
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: During the first day of Space Tech Expo Europe, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss sits down with Pieter van Duijn, the chief technology officer of Loft Orbital. They discuss the growing level of trust in artificial intelligence in the commercial space industry, how using a satellite can be like renting a car and the obstacles to adoption.
paras.zh: 在欧洲航天科技博览会的第一天，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 与 Loft Orbital 的首席技术官 Pieter van Duijn 进行了座谈。他们讨论了商业航天行业对人工智能日益增长的信任度、使用卫星如何像租车一样以及采用的障碍。

paras.en: This episode is sponsored by Space Inventor
paras.zh: 本集由 Space Inventor 赞助

paras.en: Satellites built in Denmark for the ultimate combination of pioneer and partner – where bold innovation meets absolute reliability. From modules to mini constellations of payload centric fleets, Space Inventor uniquely adapts to achieve your mission and to always – Make Space for Progress.
paras.zh: 丹麦制造的卫星是先锋与合作伙伴的终极结合——大胆的创新与绝对的可靠性相结合。从模块到以有效载荷为中心的微型星座，Space Inventor 能够以独特的方式实现您的使命，并始终——为进步创造空间。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

paras.en: Watch a new episode every Thursday on SpaceNews.com and on our YouTube, Spotify and Apple channels.
paras.zh: 每周四在 SpaceNews.com 以及我们的 YouTube、Spotify 和 Apple 频道上观看新剧集。

articles.title: NASA to Cover 35th SpaceX Resupply Mission Space Station Departure
articles.author: Lauren E. Low

paras.en: NASA and its international partners are set to receive scientific research samples and hardware as a SpaceX Dragon spacecraft departs the International Space Station no earlier than Wednesday, Nov. 18, for its return to Earth.
paras.zh: NASA 及其国际合作伙伴将在 SpaceX Dragon 飞船不早于 11 月 18 日星期三离开国际空间站返回地球时接收科学研究样本和硬件。

paras.en: Pending weather conditions, the Dragon spacecraft will undock from the Harmony module’s space-facing port at 11:05 a.m. EST, following a command sent by ground controllers at SpaceX’s facility in Hawthorne, California.
paras.zh: 根据天气条件，龙飞船将于美国东部时间上午 11 点 05 分，按照 SpaceX 位于加利福尼亚州霍桑工厂的地面控制人员发出的命令，从 Harmony 模块的面向太空的端口脱离。

paras.en: NASA’s live coverage of undocking and departure begins at 10:45 a.m., streaming through a variety of platforms. Learn where to watch online:
paras.zh: NASA 的脱离对接和离开现场直播从上午 10 点 45 分开始，通过各种平台进行直播。了解在哪里在线观看：

paras.en: NASA and SpaceX are monitoring weather forecasts and targeting splashdown off the California coast no earlier than 1:50 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 19 (10:50 p.m. PST Nov. 18). Teams will adjust plans as needed based on splashdown conditions in the Dragon recovery area and will provide updates on splashdown timing when available. NASA will not stream the splashdown but will post updates on its space station blog.
paras.zh: NASA 和 SpaceX 正在监测天气预报，并计划在 11 月 19 日星期四凌晨 1:50（太平洋标准时间 11 月 18 日晚上 10:50）之前在加利福尼亚海岸溅落。团队将根据龙回收区的溅落条件根据需要调整计划，并在可用时提供溅落时间的更新。美国宇航局不会直播溅落事件，但会在其空间站博客上发布最新消息。

paras.en: Thousands of pounds of cargo are returning from the space station, including research samples that could advance future space exploration and improve life on Earth. The returning research includes a 3D-bioprinted blood vessel construct scientists used to study vascular aging and cardiovascular disease in space and on Earth. Frozen tumor organoids treated aboard the station also will return, helping researchers identify new ways to improve cancer treatments and advance personalized medicine. Scientists will analyze frozen microbial samples to better understand how antibiotic-resistant bacteria survive, adapt, and evolve in space. In addition, a lighting system will return after more than three years aboard the space station, where researchers tested its potential to support astronauts’ sleep and well-being during long-duration missions.
paras.zh: 数千磅的货物正在从空间站返回，其中包括可以推进未来太空探索和改善地球生活的研究样本。返回的研究包括科学家用于研究太空和地球上的血管老化和心血管疾病的 3D 生物打印血管结构。在空间站上治疗的冷冻肿瘤类器官也将返回，帮助研究人员找到改善癌症治疗和推进个性化医疗的新方法。科学家将分析冷冻微生物样本，以更好地了解抗生素耐药细菌如何在太空中生存、适应和进化。此外，照明系统将在空间站上运行三年多后返回，研究人员测试了其在长期任务期间支持宇航员睡眠和健康的潜力。

paras.en: Filled with more than 6,300 pounds of crew supplies, science investigations, and equipment, the spacecraft arrived at the space station on Oct. 15. It launched two days earlier on a Falcon 9 rocket from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida for the agency’s SpaceX 35th commercial resupply services mission.
paras.zh: 这艘航天器满载着超过 6,300 磅的乘员补给品、科学调查和设备，于 10 月 15 日抵达空间站。两天前，它利用猎鹰 9 号火箭从佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空部队站的 40 号航天发射场发射升空，执行该机构的 SpaceX 第 35 次商业补给服务任务。

paras.en: For more than 26 years, people have lived and worked continuously aboard the International Space Station, advancing scientific knowledge and making research breakthroughs not possible on Earth. The space station helps NASA understand and overcome the challenges of human spaceflight, expand commercial opportunities in low Earth orbit, and build on the foundation for long-duration missions to the Moon, as part of the Artemis and Moon Base programs, and to Mars.
paras.zh: 26 年多来，人们在国际空间站上持续生活和工作，推进科学知识进步，取得地球上不可能的研究突破。该空间站帮助美国宇航局了解和克服载人航天的挑战，扩大近地轨道的商业机会，并为长期月球任务（作为阿尔忒弥斯和月球基地计划的一部分）和火星任务奠定基础。

articles.title: New Album of Baby Star Sounds Shared by NASA’s Chandra

paras.en: A new album from NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory collects snapshots of baby stars across the galaxy and beyond and transforms that data into sound.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局钱德拉 X 射线天文台的一张新专辑收集了整个银河系及更远地区的婴儿恒星的快照，并将这些数据转化为声音。

paras.en: Four new sonifications use data of stars that are actively forming, captured by Chandra and other NASA telescopes By studying places in the universe where stars are currently being born and young stars are present, astronomers can better understand the lifecycle of all stars, including our own Sun.
paras.zh: 四种新的超声处理技术使用由钱德拉和其他 NASA 望远镜捕获的正在活跃形成的恒星数据。通过研究宇宙中目前正在诞生恒星和存在年轻恒星的位置，天文学家可以更好地了解所有恒星的生命周期，包括我们自己的太阳。

paras.en: The galaxy Messier 82 (M82) is called a starburst galaxy because stars are forming there at a rate tens or even hundreds of times higher than in our Milky Way galaxy. This stellar birth boom may be due to a collision with another galaxy in the past. Today, Chandra sees giant plumes of hot gas that are the byproduct of young, giant stars that quickly explode and other star formation activity. One of the new sonifications combines Chandra’s data with optical data from NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope, as well as infrared views from NASA’s James Webb and retired Spitzer space telescopes. The sonification of the three types of light begins with a radar-like scan that is louder where sources are brighter. The X-ray data is mapped to the highest range of frequencies heard. Infrared data is heard as a low drone plus plucked sounds, while the optical data turns into a range of musical pitches and textures.
paras.zh: 梅西耶 82 星系 (M82) 被称为星爆星系，因为那里恒星形成的速度比银河系高数十甚至数百倍。这次恒星诞生热潮可能是由于过去与另一个星系的碰撞造成的。今天，钱德拉看到了巨大的热气体羽流，它们是年轻巨型恒星快速爆炸和其他恒星形成活动的副产品。其中一项新的超声处理技术将钱德拉的数据与美国宇航局哈勃太空望远镜的光学数据以及美国宇航局詹姆斯·韦伯和退役斯皮策太空望远镜的红外视图结合起来。三种类型的光的声音化从类似雷达的扫描开始，当光源更亮时，扫描的声音更大。 X 射线数据被映射到听到的最高频率范围。红外数据听起来像是低沉的嗡嗡声加上弹拨的声音，而光学数据则变成了一系列音乐音高和纹理。

paras.en: One of the closest and busiest star formation regions to Earth is the Orion Nebula (visible just below the belt in the Orion constellation with a small telescope and dark skies). Chandra sees more than a thousand stars in this area that are very energetic and active in their infancy. In the sonified version of the Chandra data, these stars are twinkling sounds, while the diffuse X-ray emission is mapped to pure high tones. An infrared image from NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope reveals the raw material of dust and gas used to build these new stars, and its data is heard as lower musical tones, distorted string instruments, and a digital harp.
paras.zh: 距离地球最近、最繁忙的恒星形成区域之一是猎户座星云（在猎户座星云的带下方，用小型望远镜和黑暗的天空就可以看到）。钱德拉在这个区域看到了一千多颗恒星，它们在婴儿期都非常充满活力和活跃。在钱德拉数据的声音化版本中，这些恒星是闪烁的声音，而漫射 X 射线发射则映射为纯高音。美国宇航局詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜的红外图像揭示了用于构建这些新恒星的尘埃和气体的原材料，其数据听起来像是较低的音乐音调、扭曲的弦乐器和数字竖琴。

paras.en: A portion of the Carina Nebula, another star formation region, is nicknamed the “Cosmic Cliffs” because of its spectacular structure seen in infrared by NASA’s Webb. Chandra also looks at this region, seeing through the dust and gas, and detects individual baby stars – which are turned into short string sounds in the sonification. A diffuse X-ray glow throughout the region has longer strings notes assigned to it. The nebula in the Webb data is mapped to a sustained sound, punctuated by other instruments to denote features like stars and ridges.
paras.zh: 船底座星云是另一个恒星形成区域，其一部分被昵称为“宇宙悬崖”，因为美国宇航局韦伯在红外线中看到了其壮观的结构。钱德拉还观察这个区域，透过尘埃和气体，探测到单个的婴儿恒星——它们在可听化中变成了短弦声音。整个区域的漫射 X 射线辉光分配了较长的弦乐音符。韦伯数据中的星云被映射为持续的声音，并被其他仪器打断以表示恒星和山脊等特征。

paras.en: Rho Ophiuchi is a striking star-forming cloud, filled with gas and stars of different sizes and ages. Chandra reveals infant stars that violently flare and produce X-rays. Infrared data from Webb provides views of the cloud’s regions of gas and dust. When this data is made audible, Chandra’s X-rays become high-pitched glassy tones, along with other sustained sounds to mark the appearance of extended bright sources. The clouds in Webb’s infrared data are mapped as differently pitched sounds, and stars are played as metallic plucks. There is a gap in the middle of the piece due to dark dust clouds that emit very little light.
paras.zh: 蛇夫座 Rho Ophiuchi 是一个引人注目的恒星形成云，充满了不同大小和年龄的气体和恒星。钱德拉揭示了猛烈耀斑并产生 X 射线的婴儿恒星。来自韦伯的红外数据提供了云中气体和尘埃区域的视图。当这些数据被听起来时，钱德拉的 X 射线会变成高音调的玻璃音，以及其他持续的声音，以标记扩展明亮源的出现。韦伯红外数据中的云被映射为不同音调的声音，星星被演奏为金属弹奏。由于黑暗的尘埃云发出的光很少，因此这件作品的中间有一个间隙。

paras.en: NASA's Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama, manages the Chandra program. The Smithsonian Astrophysical Observatory's Chandra X-ray Center controls science operations from Cambridge, Massachusetts, and flight operations from Burlington, Massachusetts.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局位于阿拉巴马州亨茨维尔的马歇尔太空飞行中心负责管理钱德拉计划。史密森天体物理观测站的钱德拉 X 射线中心控制着马萨诸塞州剑桥的科学业务和马萨诸塞州伯灵顿的飞行业务。

paras.en: The sonification program is led by the Chandra X-ray Center (CXC). The collaboration was driven by visualization scientist Kimberly Arcand (CXC), Matt Russo, astrophysicist, and Andrew Santaguida, musician (SYSTEM Sounds), along with Christine Malec, consultant. More sonifications can be found at chandra.si.edu/sound.
paras.zh: 该超声处理项目由钱德拉 X 射线中心 (CXC) 领导。此次合作由可视化科学家 Kimberly Arcand (CXC)、天体物理学家 Matt Russo、音乐家 (SYSTEM Sounds) Andrew Santaguida 以及顾问 Christine Malec 推动。更多可听化信息请访问 chandra.si.edu/sound。

articles.title: BPS Digital AVATAR Challenge
articles.author: Bailey Light

paras.en: The NASA Space Biology Program within the Biological and Physical Sciences (BPS) Division investigates how living systems respond across the full spectrum of biological organization to advance understanding of how living systems respond to the unique stressors of space exploration—including microgravity, ionizing radiation, low magnetic fields, and elevated CO₂. As NASA prepares for long-duration deep space missions, the need to protect individual crew members with personalized, data-driven health strategies is becoming increasingly important.
paras.zh: NASA 生物和物理科学 (BPS) 部门的空间生物学计划研究生命系统如何在整个生物组织中做出反应，以加深对生命系统如何应对太空探索的独特压力源（包括微重力、电离辐射、低磁场和升高的二氧化碳）的理解。随着 NASA 为长期深空任务做准备，通过个性化、数据驱动的健康策略来保护个别机组人员的需求变得越来越重要。

paras.en: The original AVATAR (A Virtual Astronaut Tissue Analog Response) investigation, which flew aboard the Artemis II mission, marks a significant milestone: organ-on-a-chip devices constructed from the cells of actual crew members returned from a 10-day lunar flyby on April 10, 2026. AVATAR is the first demonstration of an Artemis astronaut analog using an organ-on-a-chip model to generate personalized biological insights that can inform medical kits and countermeasures for future deep space missions.
paras.zh: 最初的 AVATAR（虚拟宇航员组织模拟反应）调查在 Artemis II 任务中进行，标志着一个重要的里程碑：由 2026 年 4 月 10 日从月球飞越 10 天返回的实际宇航员的细胞构建的片上器官设备。AVATAR 是 Artemis 宇航员模拟的首次演示，使用片上器官模型生成个性化的生物学见解，为医疗包和对策提供信息用于未来的深空任务。

paras.en: Digital twins represent a key strategy for addressing these challenges. By developing individualized computational physiological models that can be iteratively refined with empirical data, these frameworks integrate environmental, physiological, and multi-omics inputs. This approach allows for the simulation and prediction of how a specific individual will respond to spaceflight stressors.
paras.zh: 数字孪生代表了应对这些挑战的关键策略。通过开发可以用经验数据迭代完善的个性化计算生理模型，这些框架集成了环境、生理和多组学输入。这种方法可以模拟和预测特定个体对太空飞行压力源的反应。

paras.en: The BPS Digital AVATAR Challenge invites the scientific community to apply innovative computational digital twin technologies to accelerate biological discovery, biochemical and molecular modeling, and predictions of individual astronaut health outcomes. The digital twin will be a computational model of how the AVATAR bone marrow chip responds to spaceflight stressors.
paras.zh: BPS 数字阿凡达挑战赛邀请科学界应用创新的计算数字孪生技术来加速生物发现、生化和分子建模以及个体宇航员健康结果的预测。数字孪生将成为 AVATAR 骨髓芯片如何响应太空飞行压力的计算模型。

paras.en: The proposed digital twin frameworks must be capable of processing diverse multi-modal datasets and leverage established computational biology methods alongside modern digital twin architectures to create personalized, predictive models of astronaut physiology. These systems are expected to model each astronaut’s immune and bone marrow hematopoietic responses to spaceflight, integrating multi-modal data to generate tailored health predictions — including comparative analysis that distinguishes individual-specific effects from effects common across the crew. Proposals should also demonstrate a pathway to continuous model updating as new empirical data become available, reflecting the iterative nature of a true digital twin.
paras.zh: 所提出的数字孪生框架必须能够处理不同的多模式数据集，并利用现有的计算生物学方法和现代数字孪生架构来创建宇航员生理学的个性化预测模型。这些系统预计将模拟每位宇航员对太空飞行的免疫和骨髓造血反应，整合多模式数据来生成量身定制的健康预测，包括区分个人特定影响和机组人员常见影响的比较分析。提案还应展示随着新的经验数据的出现而不断更新模型的途径，反映真正的数字孪生的迭代性质。

articles.title: Jockey De Boinville 'escorted to his vehicle' after threat received

paras.en: Nico de Boinville 'escorted to his vehicle' and given security support after threat received
paras.zh: 收到威胁后，尼科·德·博安维尔“被护送到他的车上”并提供安全支持

paras.en: Top jockey Nico de Boinville was racing at Plumpton and finished fifth in the opening race of the afternoon, before finishing third on his only other ride; he was given additional security protection throughout the day after a threat had been made to Nicky Henderson's yard
paras.zh: 顶级骑师尼科·德·博恩维尔 (Nico de Boinville) 在普兰普顿 (Plumpton) 比赛，在下午的首场比赛中获得第五名，然后在他唯一的另一场比赛中获得第三名；在尼基·亨德森的院子受到威胁后，他全天都得到了额外的安全保护

paras.en: Nico de Boinville was given security support at Plumpton on Monday after a threat against the jockey was received and passed on to authorities.
paras.zh: 周一，尼科·德·布安维尔收到针对骑师的威胁并将其转交给当局后，在普兰普顿得到了安全支持。

paras.en: The multiple Grade One-wining jockey finished fifth aboard even-money favourite Ginolo for his boss Nicky Henderson in the opening race of the afternoon at the East Sussex track, after which he was informed he would be provided with extra security after officials became aware of the situation.
paras.zh: 这位多次获得一级赛冠军的骑师在下午于东苏塞克斯赛道举行的首场比赛中，在他的老板尼基·亨德森 (Nicky Henderson) 的平价热门吉诺洛 (Ginolo) 上获得第五名，之后他被告知，在官员意识到这一情况后，他将获得额外的安全保障。

paras.en: De Boinville went on to finish third on his only other ride, the Henderson-trained Ionian in a handicap chase, the third race on the card.
paras.zh: 德博因维尔在他唯一的另一场比赛中获得第三名，亨德森训练的爱奥尼亚人在让分追逐赛中获得第三名，这是卡上的第三场比赛。

paras.en: Explaining the sequence of events, Plumpton's clerk of the course Marcus Waters said: "We got a phone call from a person representing the PJA (Professional Jockeys Association) and the NTF (National Trainers Federation) regarding a threat that had gone in to the Henderson yard.
paras.zh: 普兰普顿球场的职员马库斯·沃特斯（Marcus Waters）在解释事件的顺序时说：“我们接到代表 PJA（职业骑师协会）和 NTF（国家练马师联合会）的人打来的电话，称亨德森围场受到了威胁。

paras.en: "We put on security for Nico for the rest of the day. He had one further ride and they escorted him from the weighing room to the parade ring and then once the race was done they escorted him to his vehicle, just in case there was anything that came with the threat.
paras.zh: “当天剩下的时间里，我们为尼科安排了保安。他又骑了​​一次，他们护送他从称重室到游行场地，然后比赛结束后，他们护送他到他的车上，以防万一出现任何威胁。

paras.en: "It's obviously not a nice situation for anyone to be involved with."
paras.zh: “对于任何人来说，这显然都不是一个好的情况。”

paras.en: Speaking to Racing HQ at Newbury's pre-Coral Gold Cup gallops morning on Tuesday, De Boinville explained: "After the first race yesterday the security detail at Plumpton who are very good, top-level people who dealt with the Brighton bombings and things like that, came in and dragged me out and said there's been a threat called in to me, so I needed security for the rest of the day.
paras.zh: 周二早上，德布恩维尔在纽伯里珊瑚金杯赛前赛前对赛车总部发表讲话时解释道：“昨天第一场比赛结束后，普兰普顿的安保人员进来，把我拖了出来，他们是处理布莱顿爆炸事件和类似事件的顶级人员，他们非常优秀，他们把我拖了出来，并说我受到了威胁，所以今天剩下的时间我需要安保。”

paras.en: "The threat came into the yard and then the PJA and then BHA, and then it gets called through to the racecourse. I need to find out a bit more about it but it's the trials and tribulations of being a jockey.
paras.zh: “威胁来到了赛场，然后是PJA，然后是BHA，然后它被传到了赛马场。我需要了解更多关于它的信息，但这是作为一名骑师的考验和磨难。

paras.en: "It is bizarre and I'm going to work like everyone else and you don't expect that when you go to work. I just feel sorry for whoever it was and I hope they get the help they need - it was probably because I got beat."
paras.zh: “这很奇怪，我会像其他人一样工作，但当你去上班时你不会想到这一点。我只是为无论是谁感到难过，我希望他们得到他们需要的帮助 - 这可能是因为我被打败了。”

articles.title: Ecclestone ruled out of WBBL

paras.en: Sophie Ecclestone: Adelaide Strikers spinner ruled out of entire WBBL tournament with injury

paras.en: Adelaide Strikers announced on Tuesday that England spinner Sophie Ecclestone would be ruled out for the remainder of the WBBL season; it comes as Issy Wong has been withdrawn from England A's squad to take on India A in a multi-format series
paras.zh: 阿德莱德前锋队周二宣布，英格兰旋转选手索菲·埃克莱斯顿将缺席 WBBL 赛季剩余比赛；在此之际，伊西·黄(Issy Wong)已退出英格兰A队阵容，将在多赛制系列赛中迎战印度A队

paras.en: Sophie Ecclestone has been ruled out of the remainder of the WBBL season due to a back injury.
paras.zh: 索菲·埃克莱斯顿因背部受伤而无法参加 WBBL 赛季剩余比赛。

paras.en: Adelaide Strikers revealed the England spinner picked the injury prior to their match against the Perth Scorchers.
paras.zh: 阿德莱德前锋队透露，这位英格兰旋转球员是在对阵珀斯热火队的比赛前受伤的。

paras.en: After undergoing scans, the England and Wales Cricket Board and the Strikers determined in consultation that Ecclestone would "require a period of rehabilitation".
paras.zh: 经过扫描后，英格兰和威尔士板球委员会和前锋队协商后确定埃克莱斯顿“需要一段时间的康复”。

paras.en: - Read the latest cricket news on Sky Sports
paras.zh: - 阅读天空体育的最新板球新闻

paras.en: - Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: Ecclestone, who has taken four wickets in four matches for the Strikers in the WBBL this season with an economy of 7.62, said she was devastated her season has come to an end prematurely.
paras.zh: 埃克莱斯顿本赛季在 WBBL 的四场比赛中为前锋队拿下四个三柱门，经济率为 7.62，她表示她对自己的赛季过早结束感到震惊。

paras.en: "I've loved my time in Adelaide and with the Strikers, and I'll be supporting the team every step of the way for the remainder of the season," she said.
paras.zh: “我很喜欢在阿德莱德和前锋队的时光，我将在本赛季剩下的时间里支持球队的每一步，”她说。

paras.en: "Our squad has produced some incredible performances this year, and I'll be cheering the girls on as they push for finals."
paras.zh: “我们的球队今年取得了一些令人难以置信的表现，我将为女孩们为她们冲进决赛加油。”

paras.en: It comes as a huge blow for the Strikers, who are already without fast bowler Darcie Brown, who has also been sidelined with a back injury.
paras.zh: 这对前锋来说是一个巨大的打击，他们已经失去了快速投球手达西·布朗，他也因背部受伤而缺席比赛。

paras.en: Strikers coach Luke Williams said: "Sophie has been an incredible addition to the Strikers, not only with her batting and bowling, but also through her leadership and experience.
paras.zh: 前锋队教练卢克·威廉姆斯表示：“索菲对前锋队来说是一个令人难以置信的补充，不仅因为她的击球和保龄球，还因为她的领导力和经验。

paras.en: "She is one of the world's premier bowlers and, while we're disappointed to lose her, we're incredibly grateful for everything she has contributed during her time at the club.
paras.zh: “她是世界上最优秀的保龄球手之一，虽然我们对失去她感到失望，但我们非常感谢她在俱乐部期间所做出的一切贡献。

paras.en: "We wish Sophie all the very best with her recovery and look forward to welcoming her back to Adelaide in the future."
paras.zh: “我们祝愿索菲康复一切顺利，并期待着她将来回到阿德莱德。”

paras.en: Wong, Lamb withdrawn from England A squads
paras.zh: 黄、兰姆退出英格兰A队

paras.en: Issy Wong has been withdrawn from England A's multi-format tour of India due to a stress fracture in her right foot.
paras.zh: 由于右脚应力性骨折，伊西·黄(Issy Wong)已退出英格兰A队对印度的多种形式巡回赛。

paras.en: She'll be replaced by Alexa Stonehouse for the four-day squad, while no replacement for Wong has been called up for the white-ball matches.
paras.zh: 亚历克斯·斯通豪斯(Alexa Stonehouse)将取代她参加为期四天的阵容，而黄的替代者尚未被征召参加白球比赛。

paras.en: Lancashire's Emma Lamb has undergone surgery on a back injury and has subsequently been withdrawn from the 50-over and four-day squads.
paras.zh: 兰开夏郡的艾玛·兰姆因背部受伤接受了手术，随后退出了为期四天的 50 人以上阵容。

paras.en: She is replaced by 19-year-old Durham batting all-rounder Grace Thompson.
paras.zh: 接替她的是 19 岁的达勒姆击球手格蕾丝·汤普森。

articles.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if asked to return as Nvidia CEO
articles.author: Brennan Leach

paras.en: Jensen Huang said Tuesday that he would be “honored” to return to his job as CEO of Nvidia if the chip giant’s board of directors decided to bring him back.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋周二表示，如果芯片巨头英伟达董事会决定将他召回，他将“很荣幸”重返英伟达首席执行官的职位。

paras.en: In a statement posted to X, Huang, who resigned as CEO last week over allegations of extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy, said he would welcome the opportunity to retake the reins of the company he co-founded in 1993.
paras.zh: 上周，因婚外情指控（其中包括与一名疑似中国间谍的婚外情）而辞去首席执行官职务的黄黄在发给 X 的一份声明中表示，他欢迎有机会重新掌管他于 1993 年共同创立的公司。

paras.en: “Since my departure, I’ve seen an outpouring of calls from Nvidia’s employees, investors, business partners, and customers for me to return as CEO,” Huang said in a short statement.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋在一份简短的声明中表示：“自从我离开以来，我看到英伟达的员工、投资者、业务合作伙伴和客户纷纷呼吁我重新担任首席执行官。”

paras.en: “If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO.”
paras.zh: “如果董事会认为我的回归符合我们的股东、员工、公司和美国的最佳利益，我将很荣幸回应这些呼吁并重新担任首席执行官。”

paras.en: Huang also said he “did not live up to the standards expected of everyone at NVIDIA, and I have made serious mistakes in my personal life.”
paras.zh: 黄还表示，他“没有达到 NVIDIA 每个人的期望标准，我在个人生活中犯了严重错误。”

paras.en: “I created problems for the Board that I deeply regret,” he said. “I own my mistakes completely, and I am committed to cooperating with the Board’s independent investigation.”
paras.zh: “我给董事会带来了问题，对此我深感遗憾，”他说。 “我完全承认自己的错误，并且我致力于配合董事会的独立调查。”

paras.en: A portion of the statement was first reported by The Wall Street Journal, prompting shares of Nvidia to erase their earlier losses.
paras.zh: 该声明的部分内容首先由《华尔街日报》报道，促使英伟达股价回吐早先的跌幅。

paras.en: Earlier Tuesday, Republicans announced that Huang had agreed to sit for an interview with several House committees about whether the computer chip giant’s sales to China may have endangered U.S. national security.
paras.zh: 周二早些时候，共和党人宣布，黄仁勋已同意接受众议院多个委员会的采访，讨论这家计算机芯片巨头对中国的销售是否可能危及美国国家安全。

paras.en: Huang is set to appear before the House Foreign Affairs Committee, the Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party and the House Intelligence Committee on Dec. 1. Nvidia’s general counsel Tim Teter will sit for an interview the following day.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋将于 12 月 1 日出席众议院外交事务委员会、中国共产党特别委员会和众议院情报委员会的听证会。英伟达总法律顾问蒂姆·泰特将于次日接受采访。

paras.en: Their remarks will not be publicly televised but will be transcribed and could be released at a later date.
paras.zh: 他们的言论不会公开电视转播，但会被转录并可能在晚些时候发布。

paras.en: “We look forward to hearing from Jensen Huang and Tim Teter on their roles in a potential breach of our national security,” the chairmen of the three committees — Republican Reps. Brian Mast of Florida, John Moolenaar of Michigan and Rick Crawford of Arkansas — said in a joint statement Tuesday.
paras.zh: 三个委员会的主席——佛罗里达州共和党众议员布莱恩·马斯特、密歇根州众议员约翰·穆勒纳尔和阿肯色州众议员里克·克劳福德——在周二的一份联合声明中表示，“我们期待听到黄仁勋和蒂姆·泰特关于他们在可能违反我们国家安全的行为中所扮演的角色”。

paras.en: “The American people need answers on Mr. Huang and Nvidia’s role in allowing dangerous PRC actors to access our most advanced chips, as well as the role of a potential Chinese intelligence asset in this scandal,” they wrote referring to the People’s Republic of China.
paras.zh: “美国人民需要了解黄先生和英伟达在允许危险的中国行为者获取我们最先进的芯片方面所扮演的角色，以及潜在的中国情报资产在这起丑闻中所扮演的角色，”他们在提到中华人民共和国时写道。

paras.en: Nvidia has previously denied violating any national security laws and said that it makes every effort to comply with protocols for overseas sales.
paras.zh: 英伟达此前否认违反任何国家安全法，并表示将尽一切努力遵守海外销售协议。

paras.en: “We look forward to meeting with the Chairmen on December 2,” an Nvidia spokesperson said in an email, notably referring only to the date of Teter’s interview, and not Huang’s.
paras.zh: Nvidia 发言人在一封电子邮件中表示：“我们期待在 12 月 2 日与董事长会面。”他特别提到的是泰特接受采访的日期，而不是黄仁勋接受采访的日期。

paras.en: Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO last week following allegations of extramarital relationships, including one with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 黄上周因涉嫌婚外情（其中包括与一名被指控为中国间谍的女性）而辞去了英伟达首席执行官的职务。

paras.en: The company is expected to report quarterly earnings following the market close Tuesday.
paras.zh: 该公司预计将在周二收盘后公布季度收益。

paras.en: Analysts will be closely watching Nvidia’s outlook for future chip sales, and whether slowdowns elsewhere in the AI space are impacting the company.
paras.zh: 分析师将密切关注英伟达未来芯片销售的前景，以及人工智能领域其他领域的放缓是否对该公司产生影响。

paras.en: Nvidia shares have declined more than 13% over the past week and 28% over the past month, as a confluence of factors have spooked investors, including higher costs, Democratic midterm election victories and cracks in AI demand that have helped send tech stocks broadly lower.
paras.zh: 英伟达股价在过去一周下跌了超过 13%，在过去一个月下跌了 28%，原因是一系列因素令投资者感到恐慌，其中包括成本上升、民主党中期选举的胜利以及人工智能需求的裂缝，这些因素导致科技股普遍走低。

paras.en: “Nvidia’s stock is not just falling because of the loss of Jensen and the China scrutiny,” said said Peter Boockvar, chief investment officer at OnePoint BFG financial group.
paras.zh: OnePoint BFG 金融集团首席投资官彼得·布克瓦尔 (Peter Boockvar) 表示：“英伟达股价下跌不仅仅是因为詹森的失利和中国的审查。”

paras.en: “At the end of the day, they are also another picks and shovels company selling their wares into the data center buildout and we’ve seen what’s happened to many of those stocks, they are down sharply,” he wrote in a note early Tuesday.
paras.zh: 他在周二早些时候的一份报告中写道：“归根结底，他们也是另一家将产品出售给数据中心扩建的镐和铲子公司，我们已经看到其中许多股票的情况，它们大幅下跌。”

articles.title: A Kremlin trap? Europe sees danger in Vladimir Putin’s new demand in U.S. talks
articles.author: Alexander Smith

paras.en: LONDON — When European nations said they wanted greater involvement in Ukraine peace talks, this was almost certainly not what they had in mind.
paras.zh: 伦敦——当欧洲国家表示希望更多地参与乌克兰和谈时，几乎可以肯定这并不是他们的初衷。

paras.en: Europe has long demanded more say in negotiations to end Russia’s war, fearful of being frozen out by Washington and Moscow. They dread a deal favorable to President Vladimir Putin — who will meet President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping at a historic three-way meeting in Shenzhen, China, on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 长期以来，欧洲一直要求在结束俄罗斯战争的谈判中拥有更多发言权，担心被华盛顿和莫斯科排除在外。他们担心达成一项对弗拉基米尔·普京总统有利的协议——普京将于周三在中国深圳举行历史性的三方会晤，与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国领导人习近平会面。

paras.en: The good news for them is that the United States says it is now pushing to include Europe in the next rounds of diplomacy. The bad news, say governments, officials and foreign policy analysts, is the alarming new suggestion from Trump’s team: that the entire future of European security should be up for discussion too — the same demand that Putin has pushed for years.
paras.zh: 对他们来说，好消息是美国表示正在推动将欧洲纳入下一轮外交。各国政府、官员和外交政策分析师表示，坏消息是特朗普团队提出的令人震惊的新建议：欧洲安全的整个未来也应该进行讨论——这也是普京多年来一直提出的要求。

paras.en: To the Russian leader, redrawing Europe’s security map means scaling back NATO’s presence, righting what he perceives as the injustices imposed on Moscow after the Soviet Union’s collapse. A succession of senior European officials have lambasted the idea, warning that Washington risks “walking into Moscow’s trap,” as Kaja Kallas, the European Union’s foreign policy chief, put it.
paras.zh: 对这位俄罗斯领导人来说，重新绘制欧洲安全版图意味着缩减北约的存在，纠正他认为的苏联解体后对莫斯科施加的不公正现象。正如欧盟外交政策负责人卡亚·卡拉斯(Kaja Kallas)所说，一连串欧洲高级官员严厉批评了这一想法，警告华盛顿有“陷入莫斯科陷阱”的风险。

paras.en: “This is all rather bizarre,” former Estonian President Toomas Hendrik Ilves said, summing up this sentiment in an interview with NBC News on Monday.
paras.zh: “这一切都相当奇怪，”爱沙尼亚前总统托马斯·亨德里克·伊尔维斯 (Toomas Hendrik Ilves) 周一在接受 NBC 新闻采访时总结了这种观点。

paras.en: It’s not clear how or why the U.S. came to float a maximalist demand that Putin first made in 2021, one that was widely rejected by Western governments months before Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine. But in recent days, as Washington ups its pressure for a breakthrough in peace talks, Russia and the U.S. have both revived the idea.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚美国如何或为何提出普京在 2021 年首次提出的最高要求，但在俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰的几个月前，这一要求遭到西方政府的广泛拒绝。但最近几天，随着华盛顿加大压力，要求和平谈判取得突破，俄罗斯和美国都重新提出了这一想法。

paras.en: Jared Kushner, the president’s son-in-law and envoy, wrote Friday that talks should tackle the “broader postwar European security arrangements.”
paras.zh: 总统女婿兼特使贾里德·库什纳周五写道，会谈应解决“更广泛的战后欧洲安全安排”。

paras.en: Earlier this month, he lamented “decades of mistrust” and “competing security concerns” between Russia and Europe, vowing to address these by building an “enduring framework for long-term European security and stability.” Kushner has also stressed that NATO would remain central to European defense and that no country should have a veto over another’s alliances.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，他对俄罗斯和欧洲之间“数十年的不信任”和“相互竞争的安全担忧”表示遗憾，并发誓要通过建立“欧洲长期安全与稳定的持久框架”来解决这些问题。库什纳还强调，北约仍将是欧洲防务的核心，任何国家都不应对其他国家的联盟拥有否决权。

paras.en: Trump himself has also hinted that he seeks a final deal encompassing the entire continent. “It’s going to be a big agreement and it’s going to involve more than Ukraine,” he told reporters in the Oval Office earlier this month. “I could even say it might involve all of Europe. It’s going to be a big, beautiful agreement, and everyone’s going to be thrilled.”
paras.zh: 特朗普本人也暗示，他寻求达成一项涵盖整个非洲大陆的最终协议。 “这将是一项重大协议，涉及的不仅仅是乌克兰，”他本月早些时候在椭圆形办公室对记者表示。 “我什至可以说，这可能涉及整个欧洲。这将是一项重大而美好的协议，每个人都会感到兴奋。”

paras.en: Instead, the idea has been met with unease and dismay, viewed by many in Europe as echoing Putin’s hard-line war goals.
paras.zh: 相反，这个想法引起了不安和沮丧，许多欧洲人认为这呼应了普京的强硬战争目标。

paras.en: Whereas Kushner described Europe and Russia as neighbors unable to resolve their differences, the historical record shows the aggression has chiefly been directed one way. Russia seized Ukraine’s Crimean Peninsula in 2014, then launching a full-scale invasion in 2022, while waging sabotage, cyberattacks and disinformation against the West.
paras.zh: 尽管库什纳将欧洲和俄罗斯描述为无法解决分歧的邻国，但历史记录显示，侵略主要是单向的。俄罗斯于 2014 年占领了乌克兰克里米亚半岛，然后于 2022 年发动全面入侵，同时对西方发动破坏、网络攻击和虚假信息。

paras.en: Kushner’s suggestion also touches on a central European fear: that Washington will pursue a deal at almost any cost, even if that emboldens Putin to expand his aggression.
paras.zh: 库什纳的建议还触及了中欧的担忧：华盛顿将不惜一切代价寻求达成协议，即使这会鼓励普京扩大侵略。

paras.en: “Why are two real estate agents pushing this idea?” Ilves said referring to Kushner and Steve Witkoff, another Trump envoy, both of whom made their fortunes in real estate before entering diplomacy.
paras.zh: “为什么两个房地产经纪人要推动这个想法？”伊尔维斯指的是库什纳和另一位特朗普特使史蒂夫·威特科夫，他们在进入外交领域之前都在房地产领域发了财。

paras.en: “These people aren’t even diplomats,” said Ilves, who led his former Soviet republic from 2006 to 2016. “I’m not sure they have much of an idea of the long history of the development of security architecture in Europe relating to Russia.”
paras.zh: “这些人甚至不是外交官，”2006 年至 2016 年领导他的前苏联共和国的伊尔维斯说。“我不确定他们对与俄罗斯有关的欧洲安全架构发展的悠久历史有多少了解。”

paras.en: Asked about the criticisms, assistant White House press secretary Olivia Wales said the U.S. proposal sought to “strengthen existing European security arrangements, with NATO at their core, while developing practical mechanisms to prevent future conflict.”
paras.zh: 在被问及这些批评时，白宫助理新闻秘书奥利维亚·威尔士表示，美国的提议旨在“加强以北约为核心的现有欧洲安全安排，同时制定防止未来冲突的实用机制。”

paras.en: Security guarantees for Ukraine “cannot be designed without understanding the broader security framework in which they will operate,” she said in an email, adding that any final agreement must respect Europe and Ukraine’s sovereignty “and be agreed by the relevant parties.”
paras.zh: 她在一封电子邮件中表示，对乌克兰的安全保障“不能在不了解其运作的更广泛安全框架的情况下设计”。她补充说，任何最终协议都必须尊重欧洲和乌克兰的主权，“并得到有关各方的同意”。

paras.en: European officials are nonetheless unnerved by Kushner’s remarks.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，欧洲官员仍对库什纳的言论感到不安。

paras.en: Kallas, the E.U. foreign policy chief, described Russia’s maximalist war demands as “really absurd,” while German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul pointed out that “Europe has a security architecture — we don’t need a new one.”
paras.zh: 卡拉斯，欧盟德国外交部长约翰·瓦德菲尔指出，“欧洲有一个安全架构——我们不需要新的”。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Lithuanian Foreign Minister Kęstutis Budrys said the rules were not the issue: “The problem is that Russia is breaking them.” And even Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney was adamant that the “security architecture for free Europe will be determined by free Europe and NATO, not by Russia.”
paras.zh: 在其他地方，立陶宛外交部长凯斯图蒂斯·布德里斯表示，规则不是问题：“问题在于俄罗斯正在违反这些规则。”甚至加拿大总理马克·卡尼也坚称“自由欧洲的安全架构将由自由欧洲和北约决定，而不是由俄罗斯决定。”

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy described the idea as “dangerous,” saying that European security “should not be the main agenda.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基称这一想法“危险”，并表示欧洲安全“不应成为主要议程”。

paras.en: Ukraine’s view is that Russia is in no place to make such demands, given that it’s spent more than four years failing to win the war.
paras.zh: 乌克兰认为，俄罗斯没有资格提出这样的要求，因为俄罗斯四年多来都未能赢得战争。

paras.en: “At this stage, the most Putin can negotiate is a fair ceasefire along the current line of contact,” Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andriy Sybiha said. And “frankly, Europe does not need a new security order; it already exists, and Russia is constantly violating it.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰外交部长安德烈·西比哈表示：“现阶段，普京最多可以谈判的是沿当前接触线实现公平停火。” “坦率地说，欧洲不需要新的安全秩序；它已经存在，而俄罗斯却不断违反它。”

paras.en: Kyiv and its European backers also argue that a ceasefire must come before any peace talks, accusing Russia of stalling so it can keep bombing civilian infrastructure ahead of the frigid winter.
paras.zh: 基辅及其欧洲支持者还认为，停火必须先于任何和平谈判，并指责俄罗斯拖延，以便在寒冷的冬季之前继续轰炸民用基础设施。

paras.en: If Europe accepts Russia’s demands about wider continental security before there is a ceasefire, Moscow “will try to create the impression that it’s our fault that the war continues, because we don’t want to accept all their demands,” according to Sven Biscop, a director at the Egmont Institute, a Belgian think tank.
paras.zh: 比利时智​​库埃格蒙特研究所所长斯文·比斯科普表示，如果欧洲在停火之前接受俄罗斯关于更广泛大陆安全的要求，莫斯科“将试图给人留下这样的印象：战争继续下去是我们的错，因为我们不想接受他们的所有要求”。

paras.en: He said he believed dialogue with Russia is a good thing, a view echoed by influential Finnish President Alexander Stubb, who in an interview with the Financial Times published Tuesday said that it had been “irresponsible” to outsource talks with Putin to the U.S., which he said could be leaning toward carving up Europe into spheres of influence.
paras.zh: 他表示，他相信与俄罗斯的对话是一件好事，这一观点得到了颇具影响力的芬兰总统亚历山大·斯塔布的赞同。他在周二发表的《金融时报》采访中表示，将与普京的谈判外包给美国是“不负责任的”，他认为这可能会导致欧洲分裂为势力范围。

paras.en: Back in Washington, the top Democrat on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, Sen. Jeanne Shaheen, D-N.H., urged Trump’s team to refuse Putin’s demands.
paras.zh: 回到华盛顿，参议院外交关系委员会民主党领袖、新罕布什尔州民主党参议员珍妮·沙欣敦促特朗普团队拒绝普京的要求。

paras.en: The Russian leader not only wanted control of Ukraine but “he wants to redesign NATO to accommodate his revisionist ambitions,” Shaheen said, adding that any discussions about European security infrastructure should be a “nonstarter,” for the U.S. which “has benefited from the Alliance.”
paras.zh: 沙欣说，俄罗斯领导人不仅想控制乌克兰，而且“他想重新设计北约，以适应他的修正主义野心”。他补充说，对于“从该联盟中受益”的美国来说，任何有关欧洲安全基础设施的讨论都应该是“不可能的”。

paras.en: Amid all of this, any substantial progress toward ending the war remains elusive.
paras.zh: 在这一切之中，结束战争的任何实质性进展仍然难以实现。

paras.en: The latest round of talks between the U.S., Russia and Ukraine in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, last week produced no major breakthrough. Kushner said Washington was working toward what could be the largest prisoner swap of the war, while reporting that Russia had agreed to give Europe a seat at the table during the next round.
paras.zh: 美国、俄罗斯和乌克兰上周在阿联酋阿布扎比举行的最新一轮会谈没有取得重大突破。库什纳表示，华盛顿正在努力实现战争中最大规模的战俘交换，同时报道称，俄罗斯已同意在下一轮谈判中让欧洲获得席位。

paras.en: Russia hasn’t quite confirmed that, instead saying that it needs “to understand from the Europeans themselves” what they can “contribute to the peace process” before allowing them to join, as Putin’s spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters Monday.
paras.zh: 普京发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫周一对记者表示，俄罗斯尚未完全证实这一点，而是表示需要“从欧洲人自己那里了解”他们可以“为和平进程做出什么贡献”，然后才允许他们加入。

paras.en: There has been some internal wrangling among the European nations about who might represent them. Leaders have agreed on a team comprising the United Kingdom (which left the E.U. in 2020), France, Germany, Italy and Poland, alongside representatives of the European Commission and European Council. Kallas herself was left off the team.
paras.zh: 欧洲国家之间对于谁可以代表他们存在一些内部争论。领导人已商定成立一个由英国（于 2020 年离开欧盟）、法国、德国、意大利和波兰以及欧盟委员会和欧洲理事会代表组成的团队。卡拉斯本人被排除在团队之外。

paras.en: “I don’t know who among the current leaders could be a sane dialogue partner,” Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov told the state-run news agency Tass on Monday.
paras.zh: “我不知道现任领导人中谁可以成为理智的对话伙伴，”俄罗斯外交部长谢尔盖·拉夫罗夫周一告诉国营通讯社塔斯社。

paras.en: He likened the chosen group of European countries to “the Quartet,” a satirical poem by Russian author Ivan Krylov. In it, a monkey, a donkey, a goat and a bear blame their failure to form a string quartet on the seating arrangement rather than their lack of musical ability.
paras.zh: 他将选定的欧洲国家集团比作俄罗斯作家伊万·克雷洛夫的讽刺诗“四重奏”。其中，一只猴子、一只驴、一只山羊和一只熊将他们未能组成弦乐四重奏的原因归咎于座位安排，而不是他们缺乏音乐能力。

paras.en: That, at least, involved agreeing to a seating arrangement.
paras.zh: 这至少涉及同意座位安排。

articles.title: NT's female leaders speak about experiences of abuse and harassment
articles.author: Olivana Lathouris

paras.en: Women in all levels of government in the NT say they have experienced gendered abuse, bullying and harassment.
paras.zh: 北领地各级政府的女性表示，她们遭受过性别虐待、欺凌和骚扰。

paras.en: They have raised concerns about the issue driving strong female leaders away from the job.
paras.zh: 他们对导致强势女性领导者离职的问题表示担忧。

paras.en: The NT's branch of the Australian Local Government Women's Association has been revived to support women entering public life.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚地方政府妇女协会北领地分会已恢复活力，以支持妇女进入公共生活。

paras.en: From threats of physical violence to having men say she "deserved to die a slow and painful death", Jacinta Nampijinpa Price says after years in public office, she is "no stranger" to abuse.
paras.zh: 杰辛塔·南皮金帕·普赖斯 (Jacinta Nampijinpa Price) 表示，从身体暴力威胁到男人说她“应该缓慢而痛苦地死去”，她在担任公职多年后表示，她对虐待“并不陌生”。

paras.en: "Being a conservative Aboriginal woman and having views that are contrary to those that are the stereotype of an Indigenous person in our country has meant that for many years, there's been threats directed at me," she said.
paras.zh: “作为一名保守的原住民妇女，她的观点与我们国家原住民的刻板印象相反，这意味着多年来我一直受到针对我的威胁，”她说。

paras.en: The safety of female politicians has been in the spotlight over the last month since the alleged attack on federal independent MP Helen Haines outside her Wangaratta office in Victoria's north-east.
paras.zh: 上个月，自联邦独立议员海伦·海恩斯 (Helen Haines) 在维多利亚州东北部旺加拉塔 (Wangaratta) 办公室外据称遭到袭击以来，女性政客的安全一直受到关注。

paras.en: In the Northern Territory, where communities are small and politicians are easily accessible, the conversation has struck a chord.
paras.zh: 在北领地，社区规模较小，政客也很容易接触到，这种对话引起了共鸣。

paras.en: "For those of us who are portrayed as being controversial, if you like, it makes us even more understanding of the fact that we need to be much more alert, much more wary," Senator Nampijinpa Price said.
paras.zh: 参议员南皮金帕·普莱斯 (Nampijinpa Price) 表示：“对于我们这些被描绘成有争议的人来说，如果你愿意的话，这让我们更加理解这样一个事实：我们需要更加警惕、更加谨慎。”

paras.en: "I've had men who are considered elders in parts of the country … who said that I deserved to die a slow and painful death because of my position on the Voice and on issues like Australia Day.
paras.zh: “在这个国家的一些地方，我有一些被认为是长辈的人……他们说，由于我在《声音》和澳大利亚国庆日等问题上的立场，我应该缓慢而痛苦地死去。

paras.en: "There were threats [by] an individual in my hometown, using expletives, but saying if they saw me, they'd come and punch me in the head."
paras.zh: “在我的家乡，有人用脏话进行威胁，但说如果他们看到我，就会过来打我的头。”

paras.en: During the 2023 referendum on the Indigenous Voice to Parliament, Senator Nampijinpa Price had her personal information doxxed, opening the floodgates to a barrage of abusive messages and phone calls.
paras.zh: 在 2023 年议会土著之声公投期间，参议员南皮金帕·普赖斯 (Nampijinpa Price) 的个人信息被人肉搜索，从而为大量辱骂性信息和电话打开了闸门。

paras.en: Senator Nampijinpa Price described what happened to Ms Haines as "deeply distressing", although not entirely surprising.
paras.zh: 参议员南皮金帕·普莱斯 (Nampijinpa Price) 称海恩斯女士的遭遇“令人深感悲痛”，尽管并不完全令人惊讶。

paras.en: "It speaks to the state of social cohesion in our country at the moment, which I think is really quite fractured, more fractured than it ever has been," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“这说明了我们国家目前的社会凝聚力状况，我认为这种状况确实相当破碎，而且比以往任何时候都更加破碎。”

paras.en: She said media and policymakers had a role in supporting constructive debate without fanning division and distrust in governments.
paras.zh: 她表示，媒体和政策制定者有责任支持建设性辩论，而不煽动分裂和对政府的不信任。

paras.en: But Senator Nampijinpa Price's experience with abuse and harassment began long before her time in the national spotlight.
paras.zh: 但参议员南皮金帕·普莱斯 (Nampijinpa Price) 的虐待和骚扰经历早在她成为全国焦点之前就已经开始了。

paras.en: While serving as deputy mayor of Alice Springs in 2015, she said her outspoken views on domestic violence and Indigenous affairs made her a target — an experience that is in line with a recent survey that found women in local government were at the greatest risk of abuse or intimidation linked to their jobs.
paras.zh: 2015 年担任爱丽斯泉副市长期间，她表示，她对家庭暴力和原住民事务的直言不讳的观点使她成为目标——这一经历与最近的一项调查一致，该调查发现，地方政府中的女性面临与其工作相关的虐待或恐吓的风险最大。

paras.en: The survey of 110 female politicians and candidates across the country, conducted by not-for-profit Women For Election, found women in local government reported "the highest levels of stress and anxiety and are the most likely to have become less willing to speak publicly".
paras.zh: 由非营利组织“女性选举”对全国 110 名女性政治家和候选人进行的调查发现，地方政府中的女性报告“压力和焦虑程度最高，而且最有可能变得不太愿意公开发言”。

paras.en: In the small outback community of Alice Springs, Mayor Asta Hill said she had experienced online abuse and harassing phone calls since taking on the role in her hometown in 2024.
paras.zh: 在爱丽丝泉的内陆小社区，市长阿斯塔·希尔 (Asta Hill) 表示，自从 2024 年在家乡担任市长以来，她经历过网络辱骂和骚扰电话。

paras.en: "It's been more challenging than I could have ever imagined," she said.
paras.zh: “这比我想象的更具挑战性，”她说。

paras.en: The Greens mayor said being "visible, connected and accessible" was "critical" in smaller communities, but it also came with risks.
paras.zh: 绿党市长表示，对于较小的社区来说，“可见、互联和可达”是“至关重要的”，但它也伴随着风险。

paras.en: "Many people know where you live and most people could easily find out where you live,"
paras.zh: “很多人都知道你住在哪里，而且大多数人都能轻松找到你住在哪里。”

paras.en: Now in her third term as Palmerston mayor, Athina Pascoe-Bell said she had also endured "bullying and harassment" online.
paras.zh: 雅典娜·帕斯科-贝尔 (Athina Pascoe-Bell) 已是帕默斯顿市长的第三个任期，她表示，她也曾在网上遭受过“欺凌和骚扰”。

paras.en: In her first year as mayor, she also experienced people photographing her children, including her then three-year-old, while out in the community.
paras.zh: 在担任市长的第一年，她还经历过有人在社区里给她的孩子们拍照，包括她当时三岁的孩子。

paras.en: Ms Pascoe-Bell and Ms Hill said they remained committed to speaking out on issues impacting their communities, but said they wanted all women to feel empowered and safe.
paras.zh: 帕斯科-贝尔女士和希尔女士表示，她们仍然致力于就影响社区的问题大声疾呼，但表示她们希望所有女性都感到被赋予权力和安全。

paras.en: Both women are part of the NT branch of the Australian Local Government Women's Association, which has been reinstated this year for the first time in a decade.
paras.zh: 两名女性都是澳大利亚地方政府妇女协会北领地分会的成员，该协会今年十年来首次恢复会员资格。

paras.en: The association has been revived in the hopes of providing support and resources to female councillors and council staff.
paras.zh: 该协会已重新启动，希望为女性议员和议会工作人员提供支持和资源。

paras.en: During the annual Local Government Association of the NT conference earlier this month, councils from across the Territory also unanimously supported a motion calling for stronger legal protections for councillors.
paras.zh: 在本月早些时候举行的北领地地方政府协会年度会议上，全北领地的议会也一致支持一项呼吁加强对议员法律保护的动议。

paras.en: According to NT independent MLA Justine Davis, it is not only the potential for abuse within their communities that could discourage women from entering politics, it is also what happens inside chambers in all levels of government.
paras.zh: 北领地独立议员贾斯汀·戴维斯 (Justine Davis) 表示，不仅社区内可能存在的虐待行为会阻碍女性进入政坛，各级政府内部也会发生这种情况。

paras.en: After being elected as Johnston MP in 2024, Ms Davis said while her experience in the community had been wholly positive, the abuse on the floor of parliament had been "shocking".
paras.zh: 戴维斯女士于 2024 年当选为约翰斯顿议员后表示，虽然她在社区的经历完全是积极的，但议会中的虐待行为却“令人震惊”。

paras.en: "I've been screamed at in the chamber … a man so irate that he's spitting at me,"
paras.zh: “我在房间里被人尖叫……一个人非常愤怒，他向我吐口水，”

paras.en: "We've heard women called 'gutter trash'.
paras.zh: “我们听说过女性被称为‘阴沟垃圾’。

paras.en: "We've had women's partners called out completely inappropriately."
paras.zh: “我们曾对女性伴侣进行过完全不恰当的称呼。”

paras.en: Ms Davis said the treatment of female leaders in parliament could have impacts beyond individuals in government.
paras.zh: 戴维斯女士表示，议会中女性领导人的待遇可能会产生超出政府个人的影响。

paras.en: "I think that the behaviour and bullying that myself and other members of the chamber have been subjected to absolutely would and does give other women pause when thinking about coming into these kinds of roles," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“我认为，我自己和商会其他成员所遭受的行为和欺凌绝对会让其他女性在考虑担任此类角色时犹豫不决。”

paras.en: "What that means is we're narrowing our democracy and we're narrowing the kinds of people who are willing to put their hands up to do this kind of work."
paras.zh: “这意味着我们正在缩小我们的民主范围，我们正在缩小愿意举手做这种工作的人的范围。”

paras.en: It is a concern shared by Ms Pascoe-Bell, who said it was "incredibly important for political decision-making" so that "the best people" were elected.
paras.zh: 帕斯科-贝尔女士也有同样的担忧，她表示，“对于政治决策来说非常重要”，这样才能选出“最优秀的人”。

paras.en: "And if you feel like it's an unsafe environment or you just can't deal with it for three or four years, you're just not going to put your hand up," she said.
paras.zh: “如果你觉得这是一个不安全的环境，或者你在三四年内都无法应对，你就不会举手，”她说。

paras.en: "That means that potentially, the quality of people we see representing the community is declining."
paras.zh: “这意味着我们看到代表社区的人的素质可能正在下降。”

articles.title: NSW Labor's 'newsroom' social media account raises a political eyebrow

paras.en: At first glance, you could be forgiven for thinking there is a new player on the New South Wales politics beat.
paras.zh: 乍一看，你可能会认为新南威尔士州的政治舞台上出现了一位新玩家，这是情有可原的。

paras.en: The Instagram account called @nswnewsroom invites users to "keep up to date with news from NSW govt [sic]".
paras.zh: Instagram 帐户@nswnewsroom 邀请用户“及时了解新南威尔士州政府的最新消息[原文如此]”。

paras.en: From a "breaking" post about the gun buyback to a video of jacarandas blooming, the newshounds have been busy.
paras.zh: 从有关枪支回购的“突发”帖子到蓝花楹盛开的视频，新闻界一直在忙碌。

paras.en: "LIBERAL LEADER SAYS SHE WOULD BE 'HAPPY TO WORK WITH ONE NATION'," screams one headline.
paras.zh: “自由党领袖表示她‘乐意与一个国家合作’，”一个标题尖叫道。

paras.en: "JUST IN: The first metro service has left Bankstown," the page tells its readers in another.
paras.zh: “刚刚：第一趟地铁服务已经离开班克斯敦，”该页面在另一页上告诉读者。

paras.en: An explainer video with glossy graphics and what sounds like an AI voiceover describes how "the Liberals used public money to build a private hospital".
paras.zh: 一段带有精美图形和听起来像人工智能画外音的解说视频描述了“自由党如何利用公共资金建造一家私立医院”。

paras.en: The account even has a culture desk, which filed a scoop ahead of the opening of the Parramatta Powerhouse.
paras.zh: 该账户甚至还设有一个文化服务台，在帕拉马塔发电站开业前提供了一份独家新闻。

paras.en: It is only when you leave your Instagram feed and tap through to the profile itself that the hardworking scribes at nswnewsroom are revealed.
paras.zh: 只有当你离开你的 Instagram feed 并点击个人资料本身时，nswnewsroom 勤奋的抄写员才会被揭露。

paras.en: "Authorised by D Ofner Australian Labor Party (NSW Branch) 377 Sussex Street Sydney," the bio says.
paras.zh: “由 D Ofner 澳大利亚工党（新南威尔士州分会）授权，地址：377 Sussex Street Sydney，”简介中写道。

paras.en: The page's first post coincided with the opening of the Bankstown Metro on October 30.
paras.zh: 该页面的第一篇文章恰逢 10 月 30 日 Bankstown 地铁开通。

paras.en: But according to a Sydney Morning Herald column on November 3, the disclosure in the bio did not appear until the paper approached the government for comment.
paras.zh: 但据《悉尼先驱晨报》11 月 3 日的专栏报道，直到该报联系政府征求意见后，简历中的披露才出现。

paras.en: NSW election laws require an authorisation statement to appear on paid social media posts, but where the platform has not been paid for, the disclosure merely needs to be put in the bio.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州选举法要求付费社交媒体帖子上必须出现授权声明，但如果该平台尚未付费，则只需将披露内容放在简历中即可。

paras.en: NSW Labor's Instagram account stands in stark contrast to the pseudo news outlet.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州工党的 Instagram 账户与伪新闻媒体形成鲜明对比。

paras.en: The official party page is plastered with red, Labor logos and references to the "Minns Labor Government".
paras.zh: 党的官方页面上贴满了红色的工党标志，并提到了“明斯工党政府”。

paras.en: The nswnewsroom account, on the other hand, uses blue graphics and refers more generically to the "Minns government" or "NSW government".
paras.zh: 另一方面，nswnewsroom 帐户使用蓝色图形，更笼统地指代“明斯政府”或“新南威尔士州政府”。

paras.en: The word "Labor" barely gets a mention. By the ABC's count on Tuesday, it appeared in just three of 28 posts.
paras.zh: “劳工”这个词几乎没有被提及。根据 ABC 周二的统计，该帖子仅出现在 28 个帖子中的 3 个中。

paras.en: Curiously, the outlet seemed to miss stories the government might have found embarrassing, like its recent backflips on train timetables and shelving of real estate underquoting laws.
paras.zh: 奇怪的是，该媒体似乎忽略了政府可能认为令人尴尬的故事，例如最近在火车时刻表上的倒转以及根据法律报价而搁置房地产。

paras.en: Some of the posts feature material the government has supplied to the media to promote announcements and infrastructure projects.
paras.zh: 有些帖子展示了政府向媒体提供的用于宣传公告和基础设施项目的材料。

paras.en: The page has clips from press conferences, which the ABC understands are filmed by employees of the premier's office rather than departmental employees.
paras.zh: 该页面包含新闻发布会的片段，据美国广播公司了解，这些片段是由总理办公室的员工而不是部门员工拍摄的。

paras.en: According to a 2022 circular by the Department of Premier and Cabinet, material on a government website may be reused by political parties provided the copyright and licensing arrangements permit reuse.
paras.zh: 根据总理和内阁部 2022 年发布的通知，只要版权和许可安排允许重复使用，政党就可以重复使用政府网站上的材料。

paras.en: "Any reuse of publicly available NSW Government material should be done in a manner that does not suggest that the NSW Government endorses the political party or the use of the material by the political party," the policy states.
paras.zh: 该政策指出：“任何对新南威尔士州政府公开材料的重复使用，都不应表明新南威尔士州政府认可该政党或该政党对这些材料的使用。”

paras.en: NSW Labor did not respond to questions sent by the ABC.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州工党没有回应澳大利亚广播公司提出的问题。

paras.en: A government spokesperson said: "This is a Labor-affiliated social media page, consistent with the practices of all major political parties and a significant number of minor parties across Australia."
paras.zh: 一位政府发言人表示：“这是一个工党附属的社交媒体页面，与澳大利亚所有主要政党和大量小政党的做法一致。”

paras.en: 'Is it going to be taken as a bit of propaganda?'
paras.zh: “这会被视为一种宣传吗？”

paras.en: Edward Hurcombe, a media researcher at RMIT University, said the page was "a bit misleading".
paras.zh: 皇家墨尔本理工大学媒体研究员爱德华·赫科姆表示，该页面“有点误导”。

paras.en: "It seems to be using the branding of generic news media … maybe to make sure that users don't know that this is basically PR for the New South Wales Government,"
paras.zh: “它似乎在使用通用新闻媒体的品牌……也许是为了确保用户不知道这基本上是新南威尔士州政府的公关，”

paras.en: "So that is a bit concerning that it's not clearly stated outside the bio that this is messaging from the government."
paras.zh: “所以这有点令人担忧，因为在简历之外并没有明确说明这是来自政府的信息。”

paras.en: University of Sydney media trust researcher Timothy Kolskie said while "you don't have to do a lot of digging" to see Labor was behind the account, some could be left with impression it was an independent news outlet.
paras.zh: 悉尼大学媒体信托研究员蒂莫西·科尔斯基(Timothy Kolskie)表示，虽然“你不需要做很多挖掘”就能看到工党是该账户的幕后黑手，但有些人可能会留下这是一个独立新闻媒体的印象。

paras.en: "The bigger issue is how it's going to enter the information system that's surrounding voters," Dr Kolskie said.
paras.zh: “更大的问题是它将如何进入选民周围的信息系统，”科尔斯基博士说。

paras.en: "Is it going to be taken as some useful bit of information that helps them make their decision, or is it going to be taken as a bit of propaganda?"
paras.zh: “这会被视为一些有用的信息来帮助他们做出决定，还是会被视为一种宣传？”

paras.en: Greens MLC Sue Higginson said the account was misleading and called for a ban on such political advertising.
paras.zh: 绿党 MLC 苏·希金森 (Sue Higginson) 表示，该报道具有误导性，并呼吁禁止此类政治广告。

paras.en: "Labor Premier Chris Minns saw that Donald Trump had his own state-run TV channel, Pauline Hanson had her own fake 'One News' site, and he wanted a propaganda unit of his own," she said.
paras.zh: “工党总理克里斯·明斯看到唐纳德·特朗普拥有自己的国营电视频道，宝琳·汉森拥有自己的假‘一新闻’网站，他想要一个自己的宣传单位，”她说。

paras.en: As parliament sits for the final time ahead of the March election, propaganda machines are ramping up on all sides of politics.
paras.zh: 随着三月大选前议会最后一次开会，政治各方面的宣传机器都在加强。

articles.title: Medical practice squeezed as business confidence slumps in SA
articles.author: Daniel Keane and Leah MacLennan

paras.en: Business confidence in SA has again been dented, according to the latest snapshot produced by the state's Business Chamber.
paras.zh: 根据该州商会发布的最新快照，该州的商业信心再次受到削弱。

paras.en: The group's CEO says confidence has slumped to levels "we haven't seen since COVID".
paras.zh: 该集团首席执行官表示，信心已降至“自新冠疫情以来从未见过的水平”。

paras.en: The most recent quarterly survey found almost 75 per cent of respondents felt the pressure of wage, energy, rent and other costs.
paras.zh: 最近的季度调查发现，近75%的受访者感受到了工资、能源、租金和其他成本的压力。

paras.en: Quentin Black helps people deal with life's pressures, but he himself knows what it's like to be under the pump.
paras.zh: 昆汀·布莱克帮助人们应对生活压力，但他自己也知道生活在压力之下是什么感觉。

paras.en: The clinical psychologist manages a not-for-profit practice in Adelaide, which he said was currently being squeezed.
paras.zh: 这位临床心理学家在阿德莱德管理着一家非营利性诊所，他说该诊所目前正在受到挤压。

paras.en: Dr Black said the practice was too big for small business support, but too small to qualify for other forms of financial assistance.
paras.zh: 布莱克博士表示，这种做法对于小企业支持来说太大了，但对于其他形式的财务援助来说又太小了。

paras.en: "There's a lot of pressures on businesses at the moment," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“目前企业面临很大压力。”

paras.en: "Small enterprises like PsychMed that employ a lot of South Australians actually don't get any assistance whatsoever. In fact, we end up paying a lot of the burden.
paras.zh: “像 PsychMed 这样雇用大量南澳人的小企业实际上没有得到任何援助。事实上，我们最终付出了很多负担。

paras.en: "Even though we're running not-for-profit programs, we pay payroll tax to the state government for employing people on the programs."
paras.zh: “尽管我们正在运行非营利项目，但我们仍要向州政府缴纳工资税，以雇用参与这些项目的人员。”

paras.en: Dr Black's comments reflect a mood that is corroborated by the latest snapshot of business confidence in South Australia.
paras.zh: 布莱克博士的评论反映了一种情绪，南澳大利亚商业信心的最新快照证实了这一点。

paras.en: According to the September quarterly survey produced by the South Australian Business Chamber, confidence has again been dented, slumping to its fourth-lowest level since 2001.
paras.zh: 根据南澳大利亚商会9月份的季度调查，信心再次受到削弱，跌至2001年以来的第四低水平。

paras.en: "Business confidence … remains among the lowest recorded in over 25 years,"
paras.zh: “商业信心……仍处于 25 年来最低水平，”

paras.en: Among the factors driving that result — which reversed an uptick in confidence in June — were cost pressures and government policies, the chamber's CEO Andrew Kay said.
paras.zh: 该商会首席执行官安德鲁·凯 (Andrew Kay) 表示，推动这一结果的因素包括成本压力和政府政策，这扭转了 6 月份信心的上升趋势。

paras.en: "Business confidence in South Australia is back to levels we haven't seen since COVID," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“南澳大利亚的商业信心已恢复到新冠疫情以来从未见过的水平。”

paras.en: About three quarters of survey respondents listed costs — including wages, energy and rent — as major obstacles to confidence.
paras.zh: 大约四分之三的受访者将成本（包括工资、能源和租金）列为信心的主要障碍。

paras.en: Dr Black, who is a long-time member of the ALP, said he was all-too-familiar with those challenges.
paras.zh: 布莱克博士是工党的长期成员，他表示他对这些挑战非常熟悉。

paras.en: "There's been regular increases in wages as part of the inflationary spiral. That's a yearly event now," he said.
paras.zh: “作为通胀螺旋的一部分，工资定期上涨。现在这是每年都会发生的事情，”他说。

paras.en: "Also, insurance costs have gone up significantly along with energy costs which have really skyrocketed for businesses."
paras.zh: “此外，保险成本随着能源成本的大幅上涨而增加，这对企业来说确实是飙升。”

paras.en: More than two thirds of respondents to the confidence survey were anxious about profitability, while more than 60 per cent highlighted government policies and legislation.
paras.zh: 信心调查中超过三分之二的受访者对盈利能力感到焦虑，而超过 60% 的受访者强调政府政策和立法。

paras.en: "Government needs to find ways to reduce cost pressures on businesses, to reduce red tape, and to find ways to encourage investment, rather than detract from investors coming to this country," Mr Kay said.
paras.zh: 凯表示：“政府需要找到方法来减轻企业的成本压力，减少繁文缛节，并找到鼓励投资的方法，而不是分散投资者来到这个国家的注意力。”
