paras.en: Herbert completed only 12 passes for 129 yards, but his 22-yard scoring run on the first Los Angeles possession gave the Chargers a lead they wouldn't relinquish.
paras.zh: 赫伯特仅完成 12 次传球，推进 129 码，但他在洛杉矶首个控球权中的 22 码跑动为闪电队带来了无法放弃的领先优势。

paras.en: "I respect those guys in that locker room so much, for sticking together, not pointing fingers," said Herbert. "It's been a tough year, but the way they continue to show up to work, they're true professionals and I'm honoured to be part of it."
paras.zh: 赫伯特说：“我非常尊重更衣室里的那些人，他们团结在一起，而不是相互指责。” “这是艰难的一年，但从他们继续工作的方式来看，他们是真正的专业人士，我很荣幸能成为其中的一部分。”

paras.en: With the Chargers up 23-20, Baltimore's Zay Flowers lost a fumble after catching a pass near the Los Angeles 45 with 2:03 remaining.
paras.zh: 在闪电队以 23-20 领先的情况下，巴尔的摩队的扎伊·弗劳尔斯在比赛还剩 2 分 03 秒时在洛杉矶 45 洞附近接到传球后失手。

paras.en: Then Herbert threw to ex-Raven Charlie Kolar for the first down that all but ended the game.
paras.zh: 然后赫伯特将第一球传给了前乌鸦队球员查理·科拉尔，这几乎结束了比赛。

paras.en: Jacoby Brissett threw for 340 yards in his Baltimore debut. With Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley both on injured reserve, the Ravens traded for Brissett in the hope that the veteran could at least keep the offense functional as Baltimore tries to avoid falling out of playoff contention.
paras.zh: 雅各比·布里塞特 (Jacoby Brissett) 在他的巴尔的摩首秀中传出 340 码。由于拉马尔·杰克逊和泰勒·亨特利都处于伤病储备名单中，乌鸦队交易了布里塞特，希望这位老将至少能在巴尔的摩试图避免退出季后赛争夺时至少保持进攻功能。

paras.en: The Ravens began the game by going three-and-out three straight times, and boos rained down on a Baltimore team that's now lost seven of its last eight home games - four at night - at a time when it was supposed to be competing for Super Bowls.
paras.zh: 乌鸦队以连续三场三胜出局的方式开始了比赛，而巴尔的摩队现在已经输掉了过去八场主场比赛中的七场（其中四场是晚上），而此时这支巴尔的摩队本应争夺超级碗的席位，却遭到了嘘声。

paras.en: Brissett and the offense gradually improved. A two-yard touchdown run by Henry cut the Los Angeles lead to 10-7, but after an interception, Hampton produced one of the game's key plays.
paras.zh: 布里塞特的进攻也逐渐有了起色。亨利的两码达阵将洛杉矶队的领先优势缩小到10-7，但在拦截后，汉普顿打出了比赛的关键一球。

paras.en: On fourth down from the one, he was initially stopped by linebacker Roquan Smith, but Hampton was able to power into the end zone with some help from a couple of team-mates. That made it 17-7 with 1:56 left in the half.
paras.zh: 在倒数第四个位置上，他最初被线卫罗泉·史密斯拦住，但汉普顿在几名队友的帮助下冲入达阵区。半场还剩1分56秒时，比分是17-7。

paras.en: Neither team reached the end zone again until Henry's one-yard run made it 23-20 with 10:23 left.
paras.zh: 直到比赛还剩10分23秒时，亨利的一码跑动将比分改写为23-20，双方都没有再次到达达阵区。

articles.title: Motor City win first overtime match in WTGL history against Woad's Boston

paras.en: WTGL: Motor City Golf Club win first overtime match in tournament's history vs Lottie Woad's Boston Common Golf
paras.zh: WTGL：汽车城高尔夫俱乐部战胜洛蒂·沃德 (Lottie Woad) 的波士顿公园高尔夫俱乐部 (Boston Common Golf)，赢得锦标赛历史上第一场加时赛

paras.en: Motor City Golf Club secure 7-6 overtime victory over Boston Common Golf in dramatc WTGL victory - the first ever to go to overtime; England's Lottie Woad part of beaten side, but chipped in sensationally to force overtime session; Albane Valenzuela then beat Woad to clinch victory
paras.zh: 汽车城高尔夫俱乐部在加时赛中以 7-6 战胜 Boston Common Golf，取得 WTGL 的戏剧性胜利，这是有史以来第一次进入加时赛；英格兰队的洛蒂·沃德（Lottie Woad）虽然是被击败的一方，但他的出色表现将比赛拖入加时赛；阿尔巴内·巴伦苏埃拉 (Albane Valenzuela) 击败沃德 (Woad) 夺得胜利

paras.en: Albane Valenzuela narrowly topped England's Lottie Woad in the last leg of closest-to-the-pin to give Motor City Golf Club a 7-6 WTGL overtime victory over Boston Common Golf in one of the most thrilling matches SoFi Center has seen.
paras.zh: 在SoFi中心见证的一场最激动人心的比赛中，Albane Valenzuela在最后一轮“最接近旗杆”的比赛中险胜英国的Lottie Woad，为汽车城高尔夫俱乐部带来了7-6的WTGL加时赛胜利，战胜了波士顿公园高尔夫俱乐部。

paras.en: Motor City are in full control at 2-0-0 but things weren't nearly as easy this time as they were for an 8-3 win over Los Angeles Golf Club in their opener.
paras.zh: 汽车城队以 2-0-0 完全掌控局面，但这一次事情并不像他们在揭幕战中以 8-3 战胜洛杉矶高尔夫俱乐部那样轻松。

paras.en: Boston (0-0-1) overcame an early 3-0 deficit and never stopped fighting in their debut match, earning one point in the standings for the overtime loss.
paras.zh: 波士顿队（0-0-1）克服了早早0-3落后的局面，在首场比赛中从未停止过战斗，在加时赛的失利中在积分榜上赢得一分。

paras.en: Detroit hasn't wasted any time getting acclimated around SoFi Center. The new team has already put up 15 points in their first two matches and proved itself as a serious contender on Monday with Lexi Thompson, Jeeno Thitikul and Valenzuela staying poised when Boston rallied down the stretch.
paras.zh: 底特律没有浪费任何时间来适应 SoFi 中心。这支新球队在前两场比赛中已经拿下了 15 分，并在周一证明了自己是一个强有力的竞争者，莱克西·汤普森、吉诺·蒂蒂库尔和巴伦苏埃拉在波士顿队在最后阶段反弹时保持了镇定。

paras.en: They also have plenty of confidence and a firm grasp of strategy, throwing the Hammer before players teed off at No 14 and leaning on world No 2 Thitikul to deliver. She did just that, winning the hole to earn two points and give Detroit a 6-4 advantage amid a wild singles session.
paras.zh: 他们也有足够的信心和对策略的坚定把握，在 14 号选手开球之前就投出了铁锤，并依靠世界排名第二的蒂蒂库尔来实现这一目标。她做到了这一点，赢得该洞赢得两分，并在狂野的单打比赛中帮助底特律队以 6-4 领先。

paras.en: Boston had the advantage off the tee at the par-three third and threw the Hammer looking for a quick 2-0 lead. When Lexi Thompson made a 30-foot birdie putt and raised her putter in celebration, Detroit threw a Hammer of their own and Khang's nine-footer didn't fall as MCGC took a 3-0 lead for a big momentum swing.
paras.zh: 波士顿队在第三洞三杆洞开球时就取得了优势，并投出了铁锤队希望快速取得 2-0 的领先优势。当莱克西·汤普森 (Lexi Thompson) 推入 30 英尺小鸟推并举起推杆庆祝时，底特律队也投出一记锤子，康的 9 英尺推杆没有落下，MCGC 取得了 3-0 的领先优势，势头强劲。

paras.en: It was the perfect example of how quickly things can change in WTGL with this format, and a sign of things to come later in the match.
paras.zh: 这是一个完美的例子，说明了 WTGL 中这种赛制的变化有多快，也是比赛后期发生的事情的一个迹象。

paras.en: Woad, who came out with an homage to her home country sporting a Leeds United Premier League jersey, was part of a Boston side who put forth an outstanding effort in their first go-round at SoFi Center.
paras.zh: 沃德身穿利兹联英超球衣向祖国致敬，她是波士顿球队的一员，他们在索菲中心的第一轮比赛中表现出色。

paras.en: Boston and Motor City were still scoreless entering the par-three third, where Thompson rolled in a 30-footer for birdie and gave Motor City a 3-0 lead with two Hammers in play.
paras.zh: 进入三杆洞第三洞时，波士顿队和汽车城队仍然没有得分，汤普森在 30 英尺外抓到小鸟，在两锤子队的比赛中让汽车城队以 3-0 领先。

paras.en: Khang cut into the lead at the next, nailing a seven-foot birdie putt to make it 3-1. But MCGC continued to pour it on with a 19-foot birdie make from Valenzuela at No 5, giving her team a 4-1 advantage.
paras.zh: 康在接下来的比赛中切入领先，推入七英尺小鸟推，将比分改写为3-1。但 MCGC 继续发力，五号位巴伦苏埃拉 (Valenzuela) 抓到 19 英尺小鸟，让她的球队以 4-1 领先。

paras.en: Boston continued to fight back and keep the match within reach, earning another point at the sixth on an eight-foot birdie make from Iwai to cut the deficit to two. Iwai came through with the flatstick again at No 9, rolling a perfect lag putt from 63 feet for a conceded birdie to make it 4-3 Motor City entering singles.
paras.zh: 波士顿队继续反击，将比赛保持在可及的范围内，在第六局凭借岩井俊彦的八英尺小鸟球再得一分，将差距缩小到两分。岩井在九号洞再次用平杆完成比赛，从 63 英尺处打出完美的滞后推杆，抓到小鸟，将汽车城队进入单打比赛的比分改写为 4-3。

paras.en: With the deficit down to one, Khang stepped up and made birdie at No 10 to best Thompson and tie the match at 4-4.
paras.zh: 在比分差距缩小到一分的情况下，康挺身而出，在10号洞抓到小鸟，击败汤普森，将比分追成4-4平。

paras.en: Iwai and Thitikul traded birdies at the 11th with impressive up-and-downs as the intensity continued to build down the stretch. Things continued to ramp up at the 12th, where Valenzuela drained a 25-footer for birdie to match Woad and keep it tied as Detroit and Boston continued to go shot-for-shot.
paras.zh: 随着比赛强度在接下来的比赛中不断增强，岩井和蒂蒂库尔在第 11 号洞抓到小鸟，表现令人印象深刻。第 12 洞比赛继续升温，巴伦苏埃拉在 25 英尺处抓到小鸟，与沃德追平，底特律队和波士顿队继续打得难解难分。

paras.en: Thompson and Khang traded pars at the 13th and Detroit threw the Hammer before players teed off at the 14th, meaning Iwai had to accept. That showed how much confidence MCGC has in Thitikul and she delivered with a beautiful pin-high tee shot while Iwai's tee ball bounced off the bridge of The Last Toll and into the penalty area.
paras.zh: 汤普森和康在第 13 号洞交换了标准杆，底特律在第 14 号洞球员开球前扔出了铁锤，这意味着岩井不得不接受。这表明了 MCGC 对 Thitikul 的信心，她打出了一记漂亮的高位开球，而 Iwai 的开球从 The Last Toll 的桥上弹回，进入禁区。

paras.en: Boston eventually conceded the hole and Detroit regained the lead, 6-4.
paras.zh: 波士顿队最终丢掉一洞，底特律队以 6-4 重新领先。

paras.en: Boston threw a Hammer at the last, needing to win two points to stay alive. Needing to get up-and-down from off the green to have a chance, Woad instead chipped in to win the hole and send the match to overtime in spectacular fashion.
paras.zh: 波士顿队最后扔出了铁锤，需要赢得两分才能保级。沃德需要在果岭外上下移动才能获得机会，但他却通过切球赢得了该洞，并以壮观的方式将比赛拖入加时赛。

paras.en: Thompson hit it inside nine feet to start the best-of-three, closest-to-the-pin overtime session, giving Motor City the early advantage.
paras.zh: 汤普森在九英尺内击球，开始了三局两胜、最接近旗杆的加时赛，为汽车城带来了早期的优势。

paras.en: Khang narrowly inched out Thitikul in the second round as the match came down to the final shots.
paras.zh: 当比赛进入最后一杆时，康在第二轮以微弱优势险胜蒂蒂库尔。

paras.en: Valenzuela came through for Detroit in the end, besting Woad to cap an epic victory for MCGC that could have gone either way down the stretch.
paras.zh: 最终，瓦伦苏埃拉为底特律挺进，击败了沃德，为 MCGC 赢得了一场史诗般的胜利，而这场胜利本来可能会在最后阶段取得胜利。

paras.en: The WTGL follows on from the success of the Tomorrow's Golf League (TGL), founded by Tiger Woods and Rory McIlroy's TMRW Sports, in partnership with the PGA Tour.
paras.zh: WTGL 是继泰格·伍兹 (Tiger Woods) 和罗里·麦克罗伊 (Rory McIlroy) 的 TMRW Sports 与 PGA 巡回赛合作创办的明天高尔夫联盟 (TGL) 的成功之后的又一赛事。

paras.en: The women's edition of the tech-infused golf league will see LPGA Tour stars feature in a unique team format, with five teams (representing five different cities) of five-player rosters confirmed for the inaugural season.
paras.zh: 在充满科技的女子高尔夫联赛中，LPGA 巡回赛明星将以独特的球队形式亮相，首个赛季将确定五支球队（代表五个不同城市）的五名球员名单。

paras.en: The season-long competition takes place across November and December at the SoFi Center in Florida, a purpose-built indoor venue, with every shot live and all the players mic'd up for the made-for-TV format.
paras.zh: 整个赛季的比赛于 11 月和 12 月在佛罗里达州的 SoFi 中心举行，这是一个专门建造的室内场地，每一个镜头都是现场直播，所有选手都配有麦克风以适应电视格式。

paras.en: Both the 2026 and 2027 editions of WTGL will be broadcast exclusively on Sky Sports as part of an expansion of its golf rights, which also includes a further two years of TGL presented by SoFi.
paras.zh: 作为扩大其高尔夫转播权的一部分，2026 年和 2027 年的 WTGL 都将在天空体育独家转播，其中还包括由 SoFi 提供的另外两年的 TGL。

articles.title: Ukraine faces new Starshield disruptions as Trump envoys meet with Putin
articles.author: Henry Austin

paras.en: Hours after an American delegation touched down in Moscow for peace talks, Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said his country’s military had experienced a renewed wave of “significant disruptions” to the Starshield satellite internet service, hampering its ability to defend itself against Russia.
paras.zh: 在美国代表团抵达莫斯科进行和平谈判几小时后，乌克兰总统泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰军队的星盾卫星互联网服务遭遇了新一波“严重中断”，削弱了其抵御俄罗斯的能力。

paras.en: “These are not random errors but systematic speed restrictions,” he said in a Telegram post. “For us, this primarily means a significant complication in intercepting Russian jet-powered drones.”
paras.zh: “这些不是随机错误，而是系统性的速度限制，”他在 Telegram 帖子中表示。 “对我们来说，这主要意味着拦截俄罗斯喷气式无人机的过程会变得非常复杂。”

paras.en: His comments came as U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, President Donald Trump’s son-in-law, arrived in the Russian capital for peace talks with President Vladimir Putin, a day after trilateral talks aimed at ending the war were held in the United Arab Emirates.
paras.zh: 他发表上述言论之际，美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和唐纳德·特朗普总统的女婿贾里德·库什纳抵达俄罗斯首都与总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行和平谈判，一天前，旨在结束战争的三方会谈在阿拉伯联合酋长国举行。

paras.en: The two-day Abu Dhabi summit, the first such meeting since February, ended with no major breakthrough, although representatives of Russia and Ukraine agreed on a large exchange of prisoners of war.
paras.zh: 为期两天的阿布扎比​​峰会是自二月份以来的首次此类会议，尽管俄罗斯和乌克兰代表同意大规模交换战俘，但峰会没有取得重大突破。

paras.en: In Moscow, Kushner told Putin that Europe wanted a role in future negotiations, according to Russia’s Tass state news agency.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯塔斯社报道，库什纳在莫斯科告诉普京，欧洲希望在未来的谈判中发挥作用。

paras.en: European countries cut communications with the Kremlin and refused to engage with Russia directly after Putin launched his invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, but have since expressed concern about the Trump administration’s softening stance toward the Kremlin. Kushner last week said he also wanted to address “long-term European security and stability,” signaling a focus beyond just Ukraine that prompted a firm response from European leaders.
paras.zh: 普京于 2022 年 2 月入侵乌克兰后，欧洲国家切断了与克里姆林宫的沟通，并拒绝直接与俄罗斯接触，但此后对特朗普政府对克里姆林宫的软化立场表示担忧。库什纳上周表示，他还希望解决“欧洲的长期安全与稳定”问题，这表明他的关注点不仅仅限于乌克兰，这促使欧洲领导人做出了坚定的回应。

paras.en: Expanding on that theme on Thursday, Kushner said there was a “very strong momentum and desire” from European leaders to “engage together,” adding that “understanding the long-term security between Russia, Ukraine, and Europe is a conversation that we started having with them.”
paras.zh: 库什纳周四进一步阐述了这一主题，表示欧洲领导人有“非常强烈的动力和愿望”“共同参与”，并补充说“了解俄罗斯、乌克兰和欧洲之间的长期安全是我们开始与他们进行的对话。”

paras.en: While representatives from several European countries were in Abu Dhabi, they did not play a direct role in the talks. Russian negotiators have previously opposed their involvement, citing Europe’s support for Kyiv as an obstacle.
paras.zh: 虽然有几个欧洲国家的代表也来到了阿布扎比，但他们并未在谈判中发挥直接作用。俄罗斯谈判代表此前曾反对他们参与，并以欧洲对基辅的支持为由，认为这是个障碍。

paras.en: At the meeting in Moscow, the Interfax news agency reported that Putin proposed a joint Russian-Ukrainian humanitarian mission to the city of Kostiantynivka in eastern Ukraine, similar to the Melania Trump-brokered mission in Oleshky that allowed residents to leave the Russian-controlled town.
paras.zh: 据国际文传电讯社报道，在莫斯科的会议上，普京提议向乌克兰东部的科斯蒂安蒂尼夫卡市派遣俄罗斯和乌克兰联合人道主义特派团，类似于梅拉尼娅·特朗普斡旋的奥列什基特派团，允许居民离开俄罗斯控制的城镇。

paras.en: Thursday’s talks were “substantive, constructive, frank and useful,” Putin’s aide Yuri Ushakov said.
paras.zh: 普京的助手尤里·乌沙科夫表示，周四的会谈“具有实质性、建设性、坦率且有益”。

paras.en: Kushner and Witkoff met with Putin for about two hours before going to Dublin, where they met with Zelenskyy for more than an hour as the conflict stretches toward the five-year mark.
paras.zh: 库什纳和维特科夫在前往都柏林之前与普京会面了大约两个小时，在冲突接近五年之际，他们在那里与泽连斯基会面了一个多小时。

paras.en: Zelenskyy in Dublin indicated the Europeans would not be on the sidelines. “Next meeting, Europe will be during negotiations, will be a negotiation team — not some way, not separately. They will have a voice,” he said.
paras.zh: 都柏林的泽伦斯基表示欧洲人不会袖手旁观。 “下次会议，欧洲将参加谈判，将成为一个谈判小组——不是以某种方式，也不是单独进行。他们将有发言权，”他说。

paras.en: The U.S. and Zelenskyy want Europe to appoint a single person to negotiate with Moscow.
paras.zh: 美国和泽伦斯基希望欧洲任命一个人与莫斯科进行谈判。

paras.en: Zelenskyy also said Thursday that military units had for several days reported internet speed restrictions affecting the entire front line and Russian-occupied parts of the country.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周四还表示，军事单位连续几天报告了影响整个前线和俄罗斯占领地区的互联网速度限制。

paras.en: A limit of 100 mph is once again being “imposed on Starshield,” he said of the military version of SpaceX’s Starlink communications service. The system normally runs at a stable speed exceeding around 250 mph.
paras.zh: 他谈到SpaceX星链通信服务的军用版时表示，100英里/小时的限速再次“被施加于Starshield”。该系统通常以超过250英里/小时的稳定速度运行。

paras.en: “These are not random errors but systematic speed restrictions,” he said. “For us, this primarily means a significant complication in intercepting Russian jet-powered drones.”
paras.zh: “这些不是随机错误，而是系统性的速度限制，”他说。 “对我们来说，这主要意味着拦截俄罗斯喷气式无人机的过程会变得非常复杂。”

paras.en: “Unfortunately, there have already been strikes that got through because our interception systems cannot reach sufficient speeds and are unable to intercept in time,” he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“不幸的是，由于我们的拦截系统无法达到足够的速度并且无法及时拦截，已经发生了一些袭击。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy added that Ukraine was trying to clarify the reasons for the restriction with the U.S. side.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基补充说，乌克兰正试图与美国方面澄清实施限制的原因。

paras.en: SpaceX did not immediately respond to a request for comment from NBC News.
paras.zh: SpaceX未立即回应NBC新闻的置评请求。

paras.en: Craig Albert, the graduate director of national defense studies at Augusta University, said decreasing Starshield’s speed would slow down how fast Ukraine’s offensive drones travel, “which makes them pretty much target practice for faster interceptor drones by the Russians.”
paras.zh: 奥古斯塔大学国防研究研究生主任克雷格·艾伯特（Craig Albert）表示，降低Starshield的速度将减缓乌克兰进攻性无人机的飞行速度，“这使它们几乎成为俄罗斯更快拦截无人机的靶子”。

paras.en: It would also slow down Ukrainian interceptor drones and their missile defense systems, meaning “Russian drones can get through their defenses much quicker.”
paras.zh: 它还会减慢乌克兰拦截无人机及其导弹防御系统的速度，这意味着“俄罗斯无人机可以更快地突破其防御系统。”

paras.en: “The Russians can target more infrastructure, and the Ukrainians just don’t have the speed to counteract,” he said, adding that “for the price, the scale, the speed, the scalability, and the efficiency,” there were no real options other than Starshield.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯人可以瞄准更多基础设施，而乌克兰人根本没有足够的速度来应对。”他说道，并补充说，“就价格、规模、速度、可扩展性和效率而言”，除了Starshield之外，没有其他真正的选择。

paras.en: Ukraine first raised the alarm last month about speed limits being imposed on Starshield, which is crucial to its battlefield operations and air defenses.
paras.zh: 乌克兰上个月首次就星盾号的速度限制发出警报，这对其战场行动和防空至关重要。

paras.en: Starlink owner Elon Musk initially put the responsibility for the restrictions on Trump, who has been trying to pressure Kyiv to make concessions to end the war. The U.S. government said that any such decision could only have been made by Musk.
paras.zh: 星链所有者埃隆·马斯克最初将这些限制的责任归咎于特朗普，后者一直试图向基辅施压，要求其做出让步以结束战争。美国政府表示，任何此类决定只能由马斯克做出。

paras.en: Moscow has so far resisted such efforts to bring Europe to the main negotiating table, something Ukraine has long sought.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，莫斯科一直拒绝将欧洲带入主谈判桌，而这正是乌克兰长期以来所寻求的。

paras.en: The talks came against the backdrop of continued fighting on the front lines, where neither side has achieved significant progress for months.
paras.zh: 这次会谈是在前线持续战斗的背景下进行的，几个月来双方都没有取得重大进展。

paras.en: Instead, the focus has shifted to daily attacks with long-range missiles and drones. Russia has targeted Ukrainian cities, aiming to cut off water and power supplies as winter sets in. Kyiv has resumed attacks on energy infrastructure, a campaign that drew Trump’s ire.
paras.zh: 相反，焦点已转向远程导弹和无人机的日常攻击。俄罗斯以乌克兰城市为目标，旨在在冬季到来时切断水和电力供应。基辅恢复了对能源基础设施的攻击，这一行动引起了特朗普的愤怒。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials said Thursday that five civilians had been killed by Russian strikes on the country overnight, and 29 people injured. The Russian Defense Ministry said it had shot down 71 drones.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员周四表示，俄罗斯夜间对乌克兰发动的袭击已造成 5 名平民死亡，29 人受伤。俄罗斯国防部称已击落71架无人机。

articles.title: Buses rerouted, stops closed during Story Bridge closure
articles.author: Ellen-Maree Elliot

paras.en: Brisbane City Council's LNP administration has announced the bus route changes and bus stop changes for the Story Bridge closures.
paras.zh: 布里斯班市议会 LNP 管理部门已宣布因故事桥关闭而调整巴士路线和巴士站。

paras.en: Brisbane's Labor opposition has called it a "public transport disaster".
paras.zh: 布里斯班的工党反对党称其为“公共交通灾难”。

paras.en: The Story Bridge closes to general traffic on Sunday, December 27 to January 18.
paras.zh: 故事桥于 12 月 27 日至 1 月 18 日（星期日）禁止一般交通。

paras.en: Buses will be rerouted and five bus stops closed during the three-week closure of the landmark Story Bridge in Brisbane over summer.
paras.zh: 夏季，布里斯班地标性建筑故事桥将关闭三周，公交车将改道，五个公交车站将关闭。

paras.en: The bridge will close to general traffic from 1am Sunday, December 27, to 5am Monday, January 18, for the northern and southern approaches to be resurfaced, and structural maintenance and waterproofing to be completed.
paras.zh: 该桥将于 12 月 27 日（星期日）凌晨 1 点至 1 月 18 日（星期一）凌晨 5 点禁止一般交通，以便重新铺设北部和南部引道，并完成结构维护和防水工作。

paras.en: A council spokeswoman said the works on the bridge will cost $14 million, with funds to come out of the Operation Smooth resurfacing budget and the Story Bridge Renewal Project budget.
paras.zh: 市议会发言人表示，大桥工程将耗资 1400 万澳元，资金来自“平滑重铺行动”预算和“故事桥更新项目”预算。

paras.en: LNP Transport chair Andrew Wines told Brisbane City Council chambers all buses that use the bridge will be rerouted and five stops closed.
paras.zh: LNP 交通主席 Andrew Wines 告诉布里斯班市议会，所有使用该桥的公交车都将改变路线，并关闭五个站点。

paras.en: Councillor Wines said there would be alternative stops nearby the closed ones for passengers to use, including two temporary bus stops.
paras.zh: 威恩斯议员表示，关闭的车站附近将有其他车站供乘客使用，其中包括两个临时公交车站。

paras.en: "While the bridge will be closed during these works Brisbane will remain very much open," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“虽然大桥将在这些工程期间关闭，但布里斯班将保持开放。”

paras.en: "Those services that would ordinarily cross the bridge will be diverted through the inner south busway and across Victoria Bridge."
paras.zh: “那些通常穿过大桥的服务将改道通过内南公交专用道并穿过维多利亚大桥。”

paras.en: As Labor opposition councillors called out, Cr Wines continued:
paras.zh: 随着工党反对派议员的呼吁，Cr Wines 继续说道：

paras.en: "Some of my councillor colleagues didn't understand, so I'll say it again," he said.
paras.zh: “我的一些议员同事不明白，所以我再说一遍，”他说。

paras.en: "If your bus ordinarily crosses the Story Bridge, what will happen to it while the works are on, it will come through the inner south busway and cross Victoria Bridge.
paras.zh: “如果你的公交车通常穿过故事桥，那么在施工期间会发生什么，它将穿过内南公交专用道并穿过维多利亚桥。

paras.en: "You'll just use a different bridge, that's really all I'm saying. It really isn't that hard an idea."
paras.zh: “你只需使用不同的桥梁，这就是我所说的。这确实不是一个很难的主意。”

paras.en: He said there would be a shuttle service for parts of Kangaroo Point that would take passengers to Woolloongabba Station.
paras.zh: 他说，袋鼠角部分地区将有班车服务，将乘客送往乌龙戈巴站。

paras.en: Three-week bridge closure 'unprecedented'
paras.zh: 桥梁关闭三周“史无前例”

paras.en: Labor Opposition Leader Jared Cassidy told the meeting that never in its history had the bridge closed for three weeks.
paras.zh: 工党反对党领袖贾里德·卡西迪在会议上表示，这座桥在其历史上从未关闭过三周。

paras.en: He told the meeting that the council administration should have added more public transport services during the closure to compensate drivers.
paras.zh: 他在会议上表示，市政府应该在关闭期间增加更多的公共交通服务，以补偿司机。

paras.en: "Their only alternative route is through a toll road, or they can spend hours and hours and hours stuck in CBD gridlock," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“他们唯一的替代路线是通过收费公路，否则他们可能会在中央商务区的交通堵塞中花费数小时、数小时、数小时。”

paras.en: "The LNP's lack of a public transport plan during the Story Bridge closure over Christmas is going to be a public transport disaster for our city, let alone the congestion disaster we will see, and the hip-pocket disaster we will see by forcing people (to use toll roads)."
paras.zh: “在圣诞节故事桥关闭期间，LNP 缺乏公共交通计划，这将给我们的城市带来一场公共交通灾难，更不用说我们将看到的拥堵灾难，以及我们将通过强迫人们（使用收费公路）而造成的口袋灾难。”

paras.en: The administration chose to close the bridge during the quieter summer holidays to reduce the impact on drivers and passengers.
paras.zh: 政府选择在较为安静的暑假期间关闭大桥，以减少对司机和乘客的影响。

paras.en: Cr Wines urged people to look up the changes on Translink's Journey Planner and plan ahead.
paras.zh: Cr Wines 敦促人们查看 Translink 旅程规划器上的变化并提前计划。

paras.en: The routes will be available on the website from November 30.
paras.zh: 这些路线将于 11 月 30 日起在网站上发布。

paras.en: - Routes 227, 228, 231, 232 and 236: Services will divert via Wellington Road and Latrobe Street, with temporary stops 350 to 400 metres from affected Shafston Avenue stops.
paras.zh: - 227、228、231、232 和 236 路：服务将改道 Wellington Road 和 Latrobe Street，在距离受影响的 Shafston Avenue 车站 350 至 400 米处设有临时车站。

paras.en: - Routes 227, 232 and 234: The Main Street stop at Story Bridge East will close, with an alternative stop at Thornton Street, approximately 200 metres away.
paras.zh: - 227、232 和 234 路：位于 Story Bridge East 的 Main Street 车站将关闭，并在大约 200 米外的 Thornton Street 设有另一个车站。

paras.en: - Routes 216, 221, 227, 228, 231, 232 and 236: Services will divert around Shafston Avenue at Connor Street, with alternative stops 250 to 500 metres away.
paras.zh: - 216、221、227、228、231、232 和 236 路：服务将在 Connor Street 的 Shafston Avenue 周围改道，并在 250 至 500 米外设有替代站点。

paras.en: - Route N154: Five Main Street stops will no longer be serviced by this route. Passengers can use Route N226 to Wellington Street, with safe drop-offs available along the route.
paras.zh: - N154 路线：该路线将不再为五个主街车站提供服务。乘客可以使用 N226 号公路前往 Wellington Street，沿途设有安全下车处。

paras.en: - Shafston Avenue at Salstone Street, stop 11. Residents can use the nearby stops on Latrobe Street and Wellington Road.
paras.zh: - Shafston Avenue 位于 Salstone Street 的 11 号站。居民可以使用附近的 Latrobe Street 和 Wellington Road 站。

paras.en: - Shafston Avenue at Connor Street, stop 10/6. Residents can use the nearby stops Main Street at St Vincent's Hospital, Pearson Street, or River Terrace.
paras.zh: - Shafston Avenue 康纳街 (Connor Street) 10/6 站。居民可以使用附近的 Main Street at St Vincent's Hospital、Pearson Street 或 River Terrace 车站。

paras.en: - Shafston Avenue at Connor Street, stop 7/10. Residents can use the nearby stops Main Street at St Vincent's Hospital, Pearson Street, or River Terrace.
paras.zh: - Shafston Avenue 康纳街 (Connor Street) 7/10 站。居民可以使用附近的 Main Street at St Vincent's Hospital、Pearson Street 或 River Terrace 车站。

paras.en: - Main Street at Story Bridge East, stop 6. Residents can use the nearby stop, Main Street at Thornton Street.

articles.title: Queensland YouTuber brothers granted bail after police drug bust
articles.author: Aisling Brennan

paras.en: Andrew Young and Stuart Douglas Blair Young have been granted bail after being charged with a string of trafficking offences.
paras.zh: 安德鲁·杨和斯图尔特·道格拉斯·布莱尔·杨在被指控犯有一系列贩运罪后获准保释。

paras.en: The pair, who have a popular drift car racing YouTube account, were arrested in October.
paras.zh: 两人拥有一个受欢迎的漂移赛车 YouTube 帐户，于 10 月被捕。

paras.en: Their cases will return to Toowoomba Magistrates' Court at a later date.
paras.zh: 他们的案件稍后将返回图文巴地方法院。

paras.en: Two Queensland brothers, whose YouTube channel about drift cars has nearly 40,000 followers, have been granted bail after being charged over alleged drug trafficking.
paras.zh: 昆士兰州的两名兄弟在被指控涉嫌贩毒后获准保释，他们的 YouTube 漂移车频道拥有近 4 万名粉丝。

paras.en: Andrew Young, 39, and Stuart Douglas Blair Young, 36, were arrested in October following a three-month investigation into alleged drug trafficking across Toowoomba.
paras.zh: 39 岁的安德鲁·杨 (Andrew Young) 和 36 岁的斯图尔特·道格拉斯·布莱尔·杨 (Stuart Douglas Blair Young) 在对图文巴涉嫌贩毒进行了为期三个月的调查后于 10 月被捕。

paras.en: The two men were driving a 2022 Toyota HiAce along the Gore Highway south of the city on October 10 when police intercepted the vehicle.
paras.zh: 10 月 10 日，两名男子驾驶一辆 2022 款丰田 HiAce 沿着该市以南的戈尔高速公路行驶，当时警察拦截了这辆车。

paras.en: Police will allege officers searched the vehicle and found quantities of cocaine and MDMA, more than $9,000 in cash and seven mobile phones.
paras.zh: 警方称，警察搜查了车辆，发现了大量可卡因和摇头丸、超过 9,000 美元的现金和七部手机。

paras.en: The pair were charged with a string of offences and were on remand until today when they successfully applied for bail in the Supreme Court in Toowoomba.
paras.zh: 两人被指控犯有一系列罪行，并被还押，直到今天他们向图文巴最高法院成功申请保释。

paras.en: The court was told that, during the police investigation into the brothers' alleged offending, an undercover law enforcement participant (LEP) had been communicating with Andrew Young about buying drugs from him.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，在警方调查兄弟俩涉嫌犯罪的过程中，一名卧底执法参与者 (LEP) 一直与安德鲁·杨 (Andrew Young) 就从他那里购买毒品一事进行沟通。

paras.en: Barrister Scott Lynch for Andrew Young, who faces 32 offences, including 23 counts of supplying dangerous drugs and one count of trafficking, told the court his client's case was a "bit peculiar".
paras.zh: 安德鲁·杨 (Andrew Young) 的律师斯科特·林奇 (Scott Lynch) 面临 32 项罪名，其中包括 23 项供应危险药物罪和一项贩运罪，他告诉法庭，他当事人的案件“有点特殊”。

paras.en: "On the material disclosed so far, it seems it's a very low-level trafficking where the purchasers have been asking for some drugs and then, of course, the LEP becomes involved and the quantities become … significant," Mr Lynch told the court.
paras.zh: 林奇先生告诉法庭：“根据迄今为止披露的材料，这似乎是一次非常低水平的贩运活动，购买者一直在索要一些毒品，然后，当然，LEP 介入了，数量变得……巨大。”

paras.en: When Mr Lynch said he was yet to see the transcripts of those interactions his client had with the LEP, Justice Catherine Muir interjected to add the transcripts would show "if he's being encouraged" by the officer he was allegedly unknowingly supplying drugs to.
paras.zh: 当林奇先生说他还没有看到他的当事人与 LEP 的互动记录时，法官凯瑟琳·缪尔 (Catherine Muir) 插话道，补充道，这些记录将显示“他是否受到了据称他在不知情的情况下向其提供毒品的警官的鼓励”。

paras.en: Defence lawyer Nathan Bouchier said his client, Stuart Young, who is charged with 12 offences, including two counts each of supplying dangerous drugs and one count of trafficking, was facing "quite a different" case to his brother.
paras.zh: 辩护律师内森·布奇尔 (Nathan Bouchier) 表示，他的当事人斯图尔特·杨 (Stuart Young) 被指控犯有 12 项罪名，其中包括两项提供危险毒品罪名和一项贩运罪名，他面临着与他兄弟“完全不同”的案件。

paras.en: Mr Bouchier said the "only evidence" about his clients' alleged involvement in the case was that he was with his brother at times when his brother was supplying the drugs to the undercover officer.
paras.zh: 布奇耶表示，他的客户涉嫌参与此案的“唯一证据”是，当他的兄弟向卧底警官提供毒品时，他和他的兄弟在一起。

paras.en: Crown prosecutor Abby Kong told the court she did not oppose both applications for bail, if strict conditions were ordered.
paras.zh: 皇家检察官 Abby Kong 告诉法庭，如果下令遵守严格的条件，她并不反对这两项保释申请。

paras.en: She said she also did not object to the brothers communicating with each other because they operated a business together.
paras.zh: 她说，她也不反对兄弟俩互相交流，因为他们一起经营生意。

paras.en: Justice Muir granted both men bail with strict conditions, including a strict curfew, surrendering their passports, and undergoing mandatory drug testing.
paras.zh: 缪尔法官在严格的条件下批准了两人保释，包括严格的宵禁、交出护照以及接受强制性药物测试。

paras.en: They are also prohibited from leaving Queensland.
paras.zh: 他们也被禁止离开昆士兰。

paras.en: The matter will return to Toowoomba Magistrates' Court at a later date for a mention hearing.
paras.zh: 此事稍后将返回图文巴地方法院举行听证会。

paras.en: Police have also charged four other men during the investigation codenamed Operation Starcourt with a string of supply drug charges, including a 23-year-old Toowoomba City man, a 40-year-old Westbrook man, a 31-year-old Cotswold Hills man and a 45-year-old Coral Cove man.
paras.zh: 警方还在代号为“星阁行动”的调查中对另外四名男子提出一系列供应毒品指控，其中包括一名 23 岁的图文巴市男子、一名 40 岁的威斯布鲁克男子、一名 31 岁的科茨沃尔德山男子和一名 45 岁的珊瑚湾男子。

paras.en: Their matters also remain before Toowoomba Magistrates' Court.
paras.zh: 他们的案件也仍在图文巴地方法院审理。

articles.title: Teenage boy fighting for life after being hit by car in Toowoomba

paras.en: Police say a teenage boy has suffered life-threatening injuries after being hit by a car on a suburban street in Toowoomba.
paras.zh: 警方称，一名十几岁的男孩在图文巴郊区的街道上被汽车撞到，受伤，有生命危险。

paras.en: Paramedics say they were called to McGregor Street in Wilsonton at 3:15pm, following reports that a pedestrian had been struck by a car.
paras.zh: 医护人员称，接到报告称一名行人被汽车撞倒后，他们于下午 3 点 15 分被叫到威尔逊顿的麦格雷戈街。

paras.en: Crews remain at the scene just off Taylor Street, and drivers are being urged to seek alternative routes.
paras.zh: 工作人员仍在泰勒街附近的现场，并敦促司机寻找替代路线。

articles.title: United Airlines says issue affecting departing flights has been resolved

paras.en: United Airlines says issue affecting departing flights has been resolved
paras.zh: 美联航表示影响离港航班的问题已得到解决

paras.en: The airline's outage on Monday was the latest high-profile technology meltdown
paras.zh: 该航空公司周一的停运是最新的备受瞩目的技术崩溃

paras.en: United Airlines said Monday that it had resolved a technology issue that delayed departing flights, just days after a malfunction in the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration's network prompted a nationwide ground stop.
paras.zh: 联合航空周一表示，已解决了导致起飞航班延误的技术问题，而就在几天前，美国联邦航空管理局的网络出现故障，导致全国范围内停飞。

paras.en: Chicago-based United said in a statement that while some flights were delayed because of the issue Monday afternoon, flights that were in the air and flights on its United Express regional network were not impacted. It also said, "There is no indication that this was a cybersecurity-related issue."
paras.zh: 总部位于芝加哥的联合航空在一份声明中表示，虽然周一下午部分航班因这一问题而延误，但正在飞行的航班以及联合快运区域网络上的航班并未受到影响。它还表示，“没有迹象表明这是与网络安全相关的问题。”

paras.en: United apologized to customers for the inconvenience on social media. It resolved the issue about one hour and 40 minutes after pilots first began reporting problems to air traffic controllers.
paras.zh: 美联航就社交媒体上给乘客带来的不便表示歉意。在飞行员首次开始向空中交通管制员报告问题后约一小时 40 分钟，该问题得到了解决。

paras.en: United did not immediately provide details about which of its systems were affected, but pilots told air traffic controllers that the problem was related to a system that helps them determine a plane’s final weight.
paras.zh: 美联航没有立即提供有关哪些系统受到影响的详细信息，但飞行员告诉空中交通管制员，问题与帮助他们确定飞机最终重量的系统有关。

paras.en: Before every departure, pilots use performance software, often on a cockpit tablet, to check that the aircraft can safely take off under current weather and runway conditions. The pre-flight calculations include the aircraft's weight along with information about the fuel, baggage, cargo and passengers the plane is carrying.
paras.zh: 每次起飞前，飞行员通常会在驾驶舱平板电脑上使用性能软件来检查飞机是否可以在当前天气和跑道条件下安全起飞。飞行前的计算包括飞机的重量以及飞机所载的燃油、行李、货物和乘客的信息。

paras.en: In August 2025, United grounded planes at major U.S. airports, delaying more than 1,000 flights because of an hourslong outage of a system called Unimatic, which houses flight information that is fed to other systems including those that calculate weight and balance and track flight times.
paras.zh: 2025 年 8 月，美联航在美国主要机场停飞飞机，导致 1,000 多个航班延误，原因是 Unimatic 系统出现长达一个小时的中断，该系统保存的航班信息被输入到其他系统，包括计算重量和平衡以及跟踪飞行时间的系统。

paras.en: United said in response to a message from The Associated Press that it had no further information to provide about whether the same system was affected by Monday's outage.
paras.zh: 美联航在回应美联社的消息时表示，它没有提供有关同一系统是否受到周一停电影响的进一步信息。

paras.en: - Listen Is $30 billion the price tag on preventing another FAA ground stop order?
paras.zh: - 听着，阻止 FAA 再次发出地面停止令的代价是 300 亿美元吗？

paras.en: - Trump breaks silence on FAA's nationwide ground stop, demands more money for air traffic control
paras.zh: - 特朗普在美国联邦航空局全国地面站上打破沉默，要求为空中交通管制提供更多资金

paras.en: A recording posted on the ATC app showed a United pilot in Houston asking the tower for permission to stay put at the gate until the system was working again. The app combines live air traffic control radio feeds with real-time visual aircraft tracking.
paras.zh: ATC 应用程序上发布的一段录音显示，休斯顿的一名美联航飞行员请求塔台允许其留在登机口，直到系统再次正常工作。该应用程序将实时空中交通管制无线电信号与实时视觉飞机跟踪相结合。

paras.en: The flight-tracking website FlightAware showed United with about 600 delayed flights Monday evening, though it was unclear how many were directly related to the system outage.
paras.zh: 航班跟踪网站 FlightAware 周一晚间向美联航显示约 600 架航班延误，但尚不清楚有多少航班与系统故障直接相关。

paras.en: The United computer problem is just the latest high-profile technology meltdown.
paras.zh: 联合航空计算机问题只是最新的备受瞩目的技术崩溃。

paras.en: Earlier in the day, thousands of people reported being unable to access their online accounts at several major U.S. banks after JP Morgan Chase had a technical problem.
paras.zh: 当天早些时候，数千人报告称，在摩根大通遇到技术问题后，他们无法访问美国几家主要银行的在线账户。

paras.en: On Friday, the FAA ordered every U.S. flight grounded because a new router that was installed malfunctioned and overwhelmed the aging air traffic control system.
paras.zh: 周五，美国联邦航空局下令停飞所有美国航班，因为安装的新路由器出现故障，导致老化的空中交通管制系统不堪重负。

paras.en: And one day earlier, Microsoft experienced a major disruption to its Outlook email service. Microsoft said Saturday that services were fully restored.
paras.zh: 一天前，微软的 Outlook 电子邮件服务遭遇重大中断。微软周六表示，服务已全面恢复。

articles.title: The U.K. is granting pardons to women convicted for having abortions
articles.author: Sheena Goodyear

paras.en: The U.K. is granting pardons to women convicted for having abortions
paras.zh: 英国将赦免因堕胎而被定罪的妇女

paras.en: 'Today is a historic day,' says a friend of a woman charged in 2020
paras.zh: 一名 2020 年被指控女性的朋友说，“今天是历史性的一天”

paras.en: The U.K. government is granting automatic pardons to all women convicted of having illegal abortions over the last 165 years.
paras.zh: 英国政府自动赦免所有在过去 165 年来因非法堕胎而被定罪的妇女。

paras.en: What's more, it says it will expunge the records of those who have been investigated for abortion offences related to their own pregnancies, regardless of whether they were ultimately arrested or charged.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，它表示将删除那些因与自己怀孕有关的堕胎罪而接受调查的人的记录，无论他们最终是否被逮捕或指控。

paras.en: U.K. Labour MP Tonia Antoniazzi, who successfully fought to decriminalize abortion last year, says these clean records will bring justice to women who were "dragged from hospital beds to police cells."
paras.zh: 去年成功争取堕胎合法化的英国工党议员托尼亚·安东尼亚齐表示，这些干净的记录将为那些“从医院病床拖到警察牢房”的妇女伸张正义。

paras.en: "This trauma cannot be erased," Antoniazzi said. "I hope that this offers some alleviation of the pain these women have endured, enabling them to participate fully in society again, living their lives to the full, working the jobs they've always wanted to."
paras.zh: “这种创伤无法消除，”安东尼亚齐说。 “我希望这能减轻这些女性所承受的痛苦，使她们能够再次充分参与社会，过上充实的生活，从事她们一直想做的工作。”

paras.en: The U.K.'s Abortion Act of 1967 allows legal abortions up to 24 weeks, under a specific set of criteria agreed upon by two doctors.
paras.zh: 英国 1967 年的《堕胎法》允许根据两名医生商定的一套具体标准进行长达 24 周的合法堕胎。

paras.en: Until last year, women in England and Wales could be charged for procuring abortions outside that framework under a Victorian-era abortion ban, which is still on the books and carries a maximum sentence of life imprisonment.
paras.zh: 直到去年，根据维多利亚时代的堕胎禁令，英格兰和威尔士的妇女可能会因在该框架之外进行堕胎而受到指控，该禁令仍在记录中，最高可判处无期徒刑。

paras.en: But in April 2025, U.K. Parliament voted to amend its Crime and Policing Bill so that people could not be prosecuted for "an abortion offence relating to their own pregnancy." It recieved royal assent in April of this year, and those amendments came into force on Monday.
paras.zh: 但在 2025 年 4 月，英国议会投票修改了《犯罪和治安法案》，以便人们不会因“与自己怀孕有关的堕胎罪”而受到起诉。该法案于今年四月获得皇室同意，这些修正案于周一生效。

paras.en: The measure was opposed by anti-abortion groups that argued it would open the door to abortion on demand at any stage of pregnancy.
paras.zh: 这项措施遭到反堕胎团体的反对，他们认为这将为怀孕任何阶段的按需堕胎打开大门。

paras.en: But advocates cited what they described as an alarming increase in women being investigated for abortion-related offences, including several high-profile cases.
paras.zh: 但倡导者称，因堕胎相关罪行而接受调查的女性数量惊人增加，其中包括几起引人注目的案件。

paras.en: Nicola Packer, left, and her friend Helle Tumbridge. Packer was criminally charged in 2020 after she took legally prescribed abortion pills at home, not realizing she was past the legal threshold of 24 weeks. (Submitted by Helle Tumbridge)
paras.zh: 尼古拉·帕克（左）和她的朋友海勒·塔姆布里奇。 2020 年，帕克因在家服用合法规定的堕胎药而没有意识到自己已经超过了 24 周的法定门槛，因此受到刑事指控。 （海勒·坦布里奇提交）

paras.en: Among them was Nicola Packer, who was criminally charged after she took legally prescribed abortion pills during the COVID-19 lockdown in 2020.
paras.zh: 其中包括尼古拉·帕克 (Nicola Packer)，她在 2020 年 COVID-19 封锁期间服用合法处方的堕胎药后受到刑事指控。

paras.en: Packer, who argued she didn't know she was past the 24-week threshold for legal abortion, was cleared in a jury trial last year.
paras.zh: 帕克辩称，她不知道自己已经超过了合法堕胎的 24 周门槛，去年的陪审团审判中获得了无罪释放。

paras.en: "It's a bittersweet day for her," Packer's friend and spokesperson, Helle Tumbridge, told As It Happens host Nil Kӧksal.
paras.zh: “这对她来说是苦乐参半的一天，”帕克的朋友兼发言人海勒·图姆布里奇 (Helle Tumbridge) 告诉《当事发生》节目主持人尼尔·凯克萨尔 (Nil Kקksal)。

paras.en: "She is, of course, pleased that this has happened … but, for her, this really never should have happened in the first place. And she will live with the trauma for the rest of her life."
paras.zh: “她当然很高兴这件事发生了……但是，对她来说，这件事从一开始就不应该发生。她将在余生中承受创伤。”

paras.en: Tumbridge says Packer experienced what's known as a cryptic pregnancy, which means that she didn't experience the tell-tale signs she was expecting.
paras.zh: 塔姆布里奇说，帕克经历了所谓的神秘怀孕，这意味着她没有经历她所期待的迹象。

paras.en: As a result, she believed she was only a few weeks pregnant when she procured an over-the-phone prescription for mifepristone and misoprostol. It turned out, however, that she was 26 weeks pregnant, and the medication induced a stillbirth.
paras.zh: 因此，当她通过电话购买米非司酮和米索前列醇处方时，她认为自己怀孕只有几周。然而，事实证明她已经怀孕26周，药物导致了死产。

paras.en: She required emergency surgery in hospital and, when she awoke, two police officers were waiting for her in the recovery room.
paras.zh: 她需要在医院接受紧急手术，当她醒来时，两名警察正在康复室等她。

paras.en: "Then, when she'd barely recovered, they took her off to the police station, where she was subjected to questioning and appalling treatment for a length of time," Tumbridge said.
paras.zh: “然后，当她刚刚康复时，他们把她带到了警察局，在那里她受到了很长一段时间的审问和令人震惊的待遇，”坦布里奇说。

paras.en: "It took five years for her case to come to trial, so she was living all that time with this horrible trauma and stress, her life was on hold. And it was incredibly hard."
paras.zh: “她的案子花了五年时间才进入审判阶段，所以她一直生活在这种可怕的创伤和压力中，她的生活被搁置了。这非常艰难。”

paras.en: Tumbridge says her friend suffers from post-traumatic stress disorder and has authorized her to act as her voice in media interviews so she doesn't have to relive her experiences.
paras.zh: 坦布里奇说，她的朋友患有创伤后应激障碍，并授权她在媒体采访中代言，这样她就不必重温自己的经历。

paras.en: "While today is a historic day, it's an amazing day, and all campaigners and women everywhere are celebrating, I think for Nicola and the women involved, it is also a very difficult day," she said.
paras.zh: “虽然今天是历史性的一天，也是令人惊奇的一天，世界各地的所有活动家和妇女都在庆祝，但我认为对于尼古拉和参与其中的妇女来说，这也是非常困难的一天，”她说。

paras.en: Doctors and abortion providers hail decision
paras.zh: 医生和堕胎服务提供者对这一决定表示欢迎

paras.en: The Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists (RCOG) welcomed the decision in a joint letter with several reproductive rights organizations.
paras.zh: 英国皇家妇产科学院（RCOG）在与几个生殖权利组织的联合信中对这一决定表示欢迎。

paras.en: "Today's pardons are an important next step," said Dr. Alison Wright, RCOG's president. "They recognize the injustice of historical convictions and mean women no longer have to live with the consequences of a criminal record for something that should never have been treated as a crime."
paras.zh: “今天的赦免是重要的下一步，”RCOG 主席艾莉森·赖特 (Alison Wright) 博士说。 “他们认识到历史定罪的不公正，意味着女性不再需要承受因一些不应该被视为犯罪的事情而有犯罪记录的后果。”

paras.en: The British Pregnancy Advisory Service, a U.K. charity and abortion provider, also welcomed the news.
paras.zh: 英国慈善机构和堕胎服务机构英国怀孕咨询服务中心也对这一消息表示欢迎。

paras.en: "For too long, women have faced the devastating consequences of outdated abortion laws," said Heidi Stewart, the organization's chief executive.
paras.zh: 该组织首席执行官海蒂·斯图尔特表示：“长期以来，女性一直面临着过时堕胎法带来的毁灭性后果。”

paras.en: The Society for the Protection of Unborn Children (SPUC), a U.K. anti-abortion group that opposed decriminalization, called the pardons an attempt to impose a "barbaric ideology on a past that showed more respect for human life."
paras.zh: 反对非罪化的英国反堕胎组织保护未出生儿童协会（SPUC）称，此次赦免是试图将“野蛮的意识形态强加于对人类生命更加尊重的过去”。

paras.en: In a written statement, SPUC spokesperson Alithea Williams decried the measure as "performative virtue signalling."
paras.zh: SPUC 发言人 Alithea Williams 在一份书面声明中谴责这一措施是“表现性美德信号”。

paras.en: The Society for the Protection of Unborn Children organized a rally against the U.K.'s decriminalization measure in March 2026. (Dan Kitwood/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 保护未出生儿童协会于 2026 年 3 月组织了一场集会，反对英国的非刑事化措施。（丹·基特伍德/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: The government has not said how many women will receive pardons or have their records cleared.
paras.zh: 政府尚未透露有多少女性将获得赦免或清除她们的记录。

paras.en: But Antoniazzi estimates that more than 100 women were investigated for abortion-related offences in the five years preceding last year's decriminalization vote.
paras.zh: 但安东尼亚齐估计，在去年非刑罪化投票之前的五年里，有超过 100 名妇女因与堕胎相关的犯罪行为受到调查。

paras.en: According to the Guardian newspaper, those investigations include women, and at least one teenager, who were later determined to have had natural stillbirths and miscarriages.
paras.zh: 据《卫报》报道，这些调查对象包括女性和至少一名青少年，后来被确定为自然死产和流产。

paras.en: - Conservatives lose candidate for Pontiac after reporting on anti-abortion, 2SLGBTQ+ remarks
paras.zh: - 保守党在报道反堕胎、2SLGBTQ+ 言论后失去了庞蒂亚克的候选人

paras.en: - Q&A How Gloria Steinem and her colleagues set out to 'change the world' with Ms. Magazine
paras.zh: - 问答格洛丽亚·斯泰纳姆和她的同事如何开始通过《女士杂志》“改变世界”

paras.en: The U.K. government says the pardons and record wipings will be automatic, and those affected don't need to take any actions.
paras.zh: 英国政府表示，赦免和记录擦除将是自动的，受影响的人不需要采取任何行动。

paras.en: Tumbridge, meanwhile, says Packer is calling for an official apology from the government, the police and the Crown Prosecution Service.
paras.zh: 与此同时，坦布里奇表示，帕克要求政府、警方和皇家检察署正式道歉。

paras.en: "We've had women doing jail time. It's really shocking," she said. "These cases should never have been brought to trial."
paras.zh: “我们有女性入狱。这真的令人震惊，”她说。 “这些案件根本不应该受到审判。”

paras.en: With files from The Associated Press. Interview with Helle Tumbridge produced by Nishat Chowhury
paras.zh: 来自美联社的文件。尼沙特·乔胡里 (Nishat Chowhury) 制作的 Helle Tumbridge 访谈

articles.title: Data centres in the U.S. put out more carbon emissions in a year than Denmark, says Harvard study

paras.en: Data centres in the U.S. put out more carbon emissions in a year than Denmark, says Harvard study
paras.zh: 哈佛大学研究表明，美国数据中心一年的碳排放量比丹麦还多

paras.en: Study results come as nations at COP31 pledge to power data centres with clean energy
paras.zh: 研究结果出炉之际，各国在 COP31 上承诺使用清洁能源为数据中心供电

paras.en: The 400 largest data centres in the United States put more heat-trapping gases into the atmosphere in one year than the entire nation of Denmark did, and that was before the artificial intelligence boom really got going, according to a Harvard University study published Monday.
paras.zh: 哈佛大学周一发表的一项研究显示，美国 400 个最大的数据中心一年内向大气中排放的吸热气体比丹麦全国排放的还要多，而那是在人工智能热潮真正开始之前。

paras.en: Researchers found that more than half of the electricity powering hyperscale data centres in the U.S. was generated using fossil fuels, contributing to a significant increase in emissions.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，美国超大规模数据中心一半以上的电力是使用化石燃料产生的，导致排放量大幅增加。

paras.en: The study results come as negotiators at the United Nations COP31 climate talks in Antalya, Turkey, which the U.S. skipped this year, launched a voluntary pledge Monday calling on companies and countries to power the world's data centres with clean energy and be more transparent about their power and water consumption and emissions.
paras.zh: 这项研究结果出炉之际，正值土耳其安塔利亚举行的联合国 COP31 气候谈判（美国今年没有参加）的谈判代表周一发布了一项自愿承诺，呼吁企业和国家使用清洁能源为世界数据中心供电，并提高电力、水消耗和排放的透明度。

paras.en: "We cannot ask people to accept higher bills, more planet heating pollution and deeper inequality today in exchange for promises of a better tomorrow," United Nations climate chief Simon Stiell said Monday during the launch of the pledge. "Claims about future emissions savings cannot excuse rising pollution now, making climate disasters even worse."
paras.zh: 联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔周一在启动承诺时表示：“我们不能要求人们接受今天更高的账单、更多的地球供暖污染和更严重的不平等，以换取更美好明天的承诺。” “关于未来减排的说法不能成为现在污染加剧的借口，这会使气候灾难变得更加严重。”

paras.en: As public opposition to data centres continues to mount, the political backlash has played out in U.S. elections and major local objections for new sites.
paras.zh: 随着公众对数据中心的反对不断增加，政治上的强烈反对已经在美国大选和当地对新站点的主要反对中体现出来。

paras.en: In Canada, plans for massive data centres have triggered protests in communities across the country, including this fall over a proposed data centre for AI giant Anthropic in Nova Scotia and a $52-billion data centre near Regina, Saskatchewan.
paras.zh: 在加拿大，大型数据中心的计划引发了全国各地社区的抗议，包括今年秋天为人工智能巨头 Anthropic 在新斯科舍省提议的数据中心和萨斯喀彻温省里贾纳附近耗资 520 亿美元的数据中心提出的抗议。

paras.en: Harvard researchers looked at 403 of the largest U.S. data centres between May 2024 and April 2025, using available data and modelling to analyze their electricity use and emissions. They estimated electricity used by the centres produced around 28.3 million tons (25.7 million metric tons) of carbon dioxide, according to the study in Monday's Nature Sustainability.
paras.zh: 哈佛大学研究人员在 2024 年 5 月至 2025 年 4 月期间研究了 403 个美国最大的数据中心，利用现有数据和模型来分析它们的电力使用和排放。根据周一《自然可持续发展》杂志上的研究，他们估计这些中心使用的电力产生了约 2830 万吨（2570 万吨）二氧化碳。

paras.en: The Dave Johnson coal-fired power plant is silhouetted against the morning sun in Glenrock, Wyo. in this 2018 file photo. (J. David Ake/ The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 在这张 2018 年资料照片中，怀俄明州格伦罗克的戴夫·约翰逊燃煤发电厂在早晨的阳光下呈现出剪影。 （J·大卫·阿克/美联社）

paras.en: More than half their 82 terawatt-hours of electricity use, enough to power nearly seven million homes for a year, came from fossil fuels, the primary cause of global warming, the researchers found. Coal, widely considered the most environmentally damaging fossil fuel, generated 15 per cent of the electricity used.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，其 82 太瓦时的用电量中有一半以上来自化石燃料，这些电力足以为近 700 万家庭提供一年的电力，而化石燃料是全球变暖的主要原因。煤炭被广泛认为是对环境破坏最大的化石燃料，其发电量占所用电量的 15%。

paras.en: - Protests across Nova Scotia oppose AI data centres
paras.zh: - 新斯科舍省各地抗议人工智能数据中心

paras.en: - ASK CBC NEWS Why are there suddenly so many data centres planned in Canada? Your questions answered
paras.zh: - 询问 CBC 新闻 为什么加拿大突然计划建设这么多数据中心？您的问题得到解答

paras.en: The emissions estimate is two to three times higher than previous studies had shown, said Francesca Dominici, the study's senior author and a Harvard biostatistics professor.
paras.zh: 该研究的资深作者、哈佛大学生物统计学教授弗朗西斯卡·多米尼奇表示，排放量估计值比之前的研究显示的要高出两到三倍。

paras.en: "It is the equivalent to the CO2 emission of an entire state like Michigan or a small European country," Dominici said, adding that plans for 2,000 more data centres make that quantity more worrisome for the future. "We are going backwards toward the goal of controlling CO2 emissions."
paras.zh: 多米尼奇表示：“这相当于密歇根州或欧洲小国等整个州的二氧化碳排放量。”他补充说，新增 2,000 个数据中心的计划使未来的排放量更加令人担忧。 “我们正在朝着控制二氧化碳排放的目标倒退。”

paras.en: - Canada presented itself as a global leader in methane reductions at COP31. But is Alberta holding it back?
paras.zh: - 加拿大在 COP31 上展示了自己在减少甲烷排放方面的全球领先地位。但艾伯塔省会阻止它吗？

paras.en: - Video Why data centre communities worry about water
paras.zh: - 视频为什么数据中心社区担心水

paras.en: - Bell AI data centre expansion raises questions over power, water and local impact
paras.zh: - 贝尔人工智能数据中心扩建引发了对电力、水和当地影响的质疑

paras.en: Researchers noted that data centre construction has only expanded since the study period, meaning emissions from this industry are probably even higher now.
paras.zh: 研究人员指出，自研究期间以来，数据中心建设一直在扩大，这意味着该行业的排放量现在可能更高。

paras.en: "What we're seeing is already striking, but it's only a snapshot of a rapidly expanding industry," lead author Gianluca Guidi, postdoctoral fellow in the Department of Biostatistics, said in a press release.
paras.zh: “我们所看到的已经令人震惊，但这只是一个快速扩张的行业的一个快照，”主要作者、生物统计学系博士后研究员吉安卢卡·吉迪在一份新闻稿中说。

paras.en: Several outside experts in climate, energy and artificial intelligence said Monday's study reached realistic conclusions and that its use of modelling was reasonable because companies disclose little about their power consumption and pollution.
paras.zh: 几位气候、能源和人工智能领域的外部专家表示，周一的研究得出了现实的结论，并且模型的使用是合理的，因为公司很少披露其电力消耗和污染情况。

paras.en: "We cannot manage environmental impacts effectively without reliable measurements and disclosure," said Fengqi You, a Cornell University energy systems scientist who wasn't involved in the study. "Ultimately, the environmental footprint of AI is not fixed. It depends on where we build data centres, how efficiently they operate, and how we supply their electricity."
paras.zh: “如果没有可靠的测量和披露，我们就无法有效地管理环境影响，”未参与这项研究的康奈尔大学能源系统科学家尤凤起说。 “最终，人工智能的环境足迹并不是固定的。这取决于我们在哪里建立数据中心、它们的运行效率以及我们如何为其供电。”

paras.en: 'Selling us hope while hiding the harms'
paras.zh: “在隐藏危害的同时向我们兜售希望”

paras.en: The Antalya Artificial Intelligence Pledge, launched by COP31 host Turkey and the International Telecommunication Union, says data centres should use clean power and efficient energy and water systems.
paras.zh: 由 COP31 主办国土耳其和国际电信联盟发起的《安塔利亚人工智能承诺》表示，数据中心应使用清洁电力以及高效的能源和水系统。

paras.en: The pledge says the environmental impacts of data centres should be assessed and disclosed, but it also calls for harnessing artificial intelligence to help address climate change, which some climate experts see as a contradiction given AI's growing environmental footprint.
paras.zh: 该承诺称，应评估和披露数据中心的环境影响，但它也呼吁利用人工智能来帮助应对气候变化，一些气候专家认为，鉴于人工智能对环境的影响不断扩大，这是一个矛盾。

paras.en: - Video 'The planet is not dying, it is being killed' - Thunberg at COP 31
paras.zh: - 视频“地球没有消亡，而是正在被杀死”——Thunberg 在 COP 31 上

paras.en: - Canada can't control climate change on its own, economist tells landmark trial
paras.zh: - 经济学家称加拿大无法独自控制气候变化

paras.en: - Canada's credibility on the line at COP31 as it defends fossil fuel expansion while trumpeting clean energy
paras.zh: - 加拿大在 COP31 上的信誉岌岌可危，因为它在捍卫化石燃料扩张的同时大力宣扬清洁能源

paras.en: The explosion of new and planned data centres has driven demand for new sources of power generation and contributed to some of the biggest tech companies missing their climate goals, according to a report by the advocacy group Climate Action Against Disinformation.
paras.zh: 根据倡导组织“反虚假信息气候行动”的一份报告，新建和规划中的数据中心的激增推动了对新发电来源的需求，并导致一些最大的科技公司未能实现其气候目标。

paras.en: The report, published earlier this month, found that electricity consumption by Amazon, Microsoft and Google had risen 240 per cent between 2022 and 2025 amid the AI race. Its authors accused Big Tech of "greenwashing" AI by obscuring its current environmental impact behind claims of future climate gains.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候发布的报告发现，在人工智能竞赛中，亚马逊、微软和谷歌的电力消耗在 2022 年至 2025 年间增长了 240%。其作者指责大型科技公司通过在未来气候收益的背后掩盖其当前的环境影响来“洗绿”人工智能。

paras.en: Former U.S. vice-president and climate advocate Al Gore said that while it is essential for data centres to be powered by carbon-free energy, he is hopeful their computing power could help find new ways to fight climate change.
paras.zh: 美国前副总统兼气候倡导者戈尔表示，虽然数据中心必须由无碳能源供电，但他希望它们的计算能力能够帮助找到应对气候变化的新方法。

paras.en: In an interview with The Associated Press, Gore cited research by prominent British economist and climate advocate Nicholas Stern, who predicted that by 2030 "we will see 6 to 9 per cent reduction in emissions of greenhouse gases because of the use of advanced AI in finding new ways to be far more efficient in the use of materials and energy."
paras.zh: 在接受美联社采访时，戈尔引用了英国著名经济学家和气候倡导者尼古拉斯·斯特恩的研究，斯特恩预测，到 2030 年，“由于使用先进的人工智能来寻找更有效地使用材料和能源的新方法，我们将看到温室气体排放量减少 6% 至 9%。”

paras.en: Caleb Max, president of the National Artificial Intelligence Association, said, "AI will solve not only the energy usage issues that data centres face, but unlock numerous currently unknown advances in science and technology that will address climate change and make lives better for humanity. I respect the concerns about energy and water consumption from data centres, but the fears may be overblown."
paras.zh: 美国国家人工智能协会主席 Caleb Max 表示：“人工智能不仅将解决数据中心面临的能源使用问题，还将带来许多目前未知的科学技术进步，这些进步将解决气候变化问题，让人类生活得更美好。我尊重人们对数据中心能源和水消耗的担忧，但这种担忧可能被夸大了。”

paras.en: But Climate Action Against Disinformation spokesman Philip Newell was skeptical.
paras.zh: 但反虚假信息气候行动发言人菲利普·纽厄尔对此表示怀疑。

paras.en: "We have hope in one hand and then harms in the other," Newell said. "They're selling us hope while hiding the harms from us."
paras.zh: 纽厄尔说：“我们一方面抱有希望，但另一方面却受到伤害。” “他们向我们兜售希望，同时向我们隐瞒伤害。”

paras.en: With files from CBC News's Alexandra Mae Jones
paras.zh: 来自 CBC 新闻的亚历山德拉·梅·琼斯 (Alexandra Mae Jones) 的文件

articles.title: ASEAN offers Myanmar's sidelined leaders a path back to summits, but says restrictions will stay until there is meaningful progress on its peace plan

paras.en: Southeast Asian leaders agreed on Sunday to engage Myanmar's government in stages, while making its return to high-level meetings conditional on progress on a regional peace plan.
paras.zh: 东南亚领导人周日同意分阶段与缅甸政府接触，但其重返高级别会议的条件是区域和平计划取得进展。

paras.en: Myanmar remains a member of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), but its political leaders have been barred from summits and foreign ministers' meetings since October 2021.
paras.zh: 缅甸仍然是东南亚国家联盟 (ASEAN) 成员，但自 2021 年 10 月以来，其政治领导人被禁止参加峰会和外交部长会议。

paras.en: The military seized power that year, overthrowing the elected government led by Nobel Peace Prize laureate Aung San Suu Kyi and triggering a civil war that continues today.
paras.zh: 军方当年夺取政权，推翻了诺贝尔和平奖获得者昂山素季领导的民选政府，并引发了一场持续至今的内战。

paras.en: In a joint statement, the leaders called for "a calibrated engagement with Myanmar through a phased and progress-based approach, taking into account developments on the ground.”
paras.zh: 在一份联合声明中，领导人呼吁“通过分阶段、基于进展的方法与缅甸进行有针对性的接触，同时考虑到当地的事态发展。”

paras.en: They said ASEAN could gradually restore Myanmar's full political representation if it makes "sustained and concrete progress” on the bloc's five-point peace plan. The plan has yielded little since it was agreed on in 2021, and fighting continues between the military and pro-democracy and ethnic armed groups.
paras.zh: 他们表示，如果东盟在东盟五点和平计划上取得“持续和具体进展”，东盟就可以逐步恢复缅甸的全面政治代表性。该计划自 2021 年达成一致以来收效甚微，军方与民主派和少数民族武装团体之间的战斗仍在继续。

paras.en: "What more can we do for Myanmar?” Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. asked at the leaders' retreat in Manila. He urged the bloc to find practical ways to advance the peace plan and support an inclusive process led by Myanmar.
paras.zh: “我们还能为缅甸做些什么？”菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯在马尼拉领导人非正式会议上提出这一问题。他敦促该集团找到切实可行的方法来推进和平计划并支持缅甸领导的包容性进程。

paras.en: Thailand has pushed for closer engagement since coup leader Min Aung Hlaing took office as civilian president this year following elections that monitors dismissed as a sham.
paras.zh: 自从政变领导人敏昂莱今年就任文职总统以来，泰国一直在推动更密切的接触，此前选举监督员被认为是一场骗局。

paras.en: Leaders are also discussing trade, regional security and ways to share fuel supplies to cope with disruptions caused by the war in Iran. Australia and the Philippines signed a defense agreement on Sunday, while Canada and the Philippines announced on Saturday that they had concluded free trade negotiations.
paras.zh: 领导人还在讨论贸易、地区安全以及共享燃料供应以应对伊朗战争造成的破坏的方法。澳大利亚和菲律宾周日签署了防务协议，加拿大和菲律宾周六宣布结束自由贸易谈判。

paras.en: A proposed code of conduct for the South China Sea remains unresolved. Philippine Foreign Secretary Theresa Lazaro said negotiations between ASEAN and China were 80% complete, but diplomats told AFP a deal was unlikely in Manila. Chinese Premier Li Qiang is representing Beijing at the summit.
paras.zh: 拟议的南海行为准则仍未得到解决。菲律宾外交大臣特蕾莎·拉扎罗表示，东盟与中国之间的谈判已完成 80%，但外交官告诉法新社，在马尼拉达成协议的可能性不大。中国总理李强代表北京出席峰会。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump is expected to arrive on Tuesday, toward the end of the summit, and meet the leaders of India, Japan and Australia, the other members of the Quad. The meeting is expected to precede talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen on Thursday.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普预计将于周二峰会接近尾声时抵达，并会见四方其他成员印度、日本和澳大利亚的领导人。预计此次会议将于周四在深圳与中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统普京举行会谈。

paras.en: Activists plan to march against Trump's visit on Tuesday. Their protest is aimed in part at a US-backed industrial project north of Manila that they say could displace Indigenous families.
paras.zh: 活动人士计划周二举行游行反对特朗普的访问。他们的抗议部分针对的是美国支持的马尼拉北部工业项目，他们称该项目可能会导致原住民家庭流离失所。

paras.en: The Philippines hands the rotating ASEAN chair to Singapore next year, with Thailand due to take over in 2028.
paras.zh: 菲律宾明年将东盟轮值主席国交给新加坡，泰国将于 2028 年接任。

articles.title: Mozambique's justice under scrutiny as Venancio Mondlane faces trial

paras.en: The trial of Venancio Mondlane will shape the political future of Mozambique, and influence how much trust citizens place in state institutions.
paras.zh: 对韦南西奥·蒙德拉内的审判将塑造莫桑比克的政治未来，并影响公民对国家机构的信任程度。

paras.en: From November 17, the country will be watching the opposition politician and former presidential candidate as he faces five counts, including publicly advocating crimes and inciting collective disobedience and terrorism after the October 2024 elections.
paras.zh: 从 11 月 17 日起，全国将密切关注这位反对派政客和前总统候选人面临的五项罪名，包括在 2024 年 10 月选举后公开鼓吹犯罪、煽动集体不服从和恐怖主义。

paras.en: If convicted, he could be sentenced to more than 20 years in jail.
paras.zh: 如果罪名成立，他可能会被判处20年以上监禁。

paras.en: Mondlane has denied all the charges, and said he never called for violence. In fact, he said, his public statements were meant to prevent violence.
paras.zh: 蒙德兰否认了所有指控，并表示他从未呼吁暴力。事实上，他说，他的公开声明是为了防止暴力。

paras.en: "I have more than enough evidence that numerous statements I made went in exactly the opposite direction," he told DW during a Septembervisit to the European Parliament in Strasbourg. "I have more than sufficient evidence that numerous statements I made were in exactly the opposite direction."
paras.zh: 他在9月份访问斯特拉斯堡欧洲议会时对德国之声表示：“我有足够的证据表明，我发表的许多言论都走向了完全相反的方向。” “我有足够的证据证明我所做的许多陈述都指向完全相反的方向。”

paras.en: The post-election protests had two main goals: To pressure authorities to investigate extrajudicial killings of members of Mondlane's political movement, and to find out the truth about election results.
paras.zh: 选举后的抗议活动有两个主要目标：向当局施压，调查对蒙德莱内政治运动成员的法外处决，并查明选举结果的真相。

paras.en: "These were the fundamental issues of our entire protest," he said. "This has absolutely nothing to do with violence."
paras.zh: “这些是我们整个抗议活动的根本问题，”他说。 “这与暴力完全无关。”

paras.en: In the October 2024 presidential and parliamentary elections, Mondlane ran as a presidential candidate with the support of the left-wing opposition party Podemos. Afterwards, he did not recognize the official election results.
paras.zh: 在2024年10月的总统和议会选举中，蒙德拉内在左翼反对党我们能党的支持下作为总统候选人参选。事后他并不承认正式的选举结果。

paras.en: The election saw Daniel Chapo of the Frelimo party declared winner. Frelimo has governed Mozambique since independence in 1975.
paras.zh: 此次选举中，解阵党的丹尼尔·查波 (Daniel Chapo) 宣布获胜。自 1975 年莫桑比克独立以来，莫桑比克解放阵线一直执政。

paras.en: After the elections were called, Mondlane and his supporters protested. For months, there were demonstrations, strikes and road blockades as well as violent clashes with security forces nationwide. According to reports from civil society groups, more than 400 people died. Shops and public facilities were looted or destroyed.
paras.zh: 选举结束后，蒙德莱恩和他的支持者提出抗议。几个月来，全国各地发生了示威、罢工、封锁道路以及与安全部队的暴力冲突。据民间社会团体报告，已有 400 多人死亡。商店和公共设施遭到抢劫或破坏。

paras.en: The public prosecutor's office has alleged a connection between Mondlane's public calls to action and the violence. The indictment is based on his live broadcasts on social media, in which he called for protests, strikes and civil disobedience.
paras.zh: 检察官办公室声称蒙德兰公开呼吁采取行动与暴力事件之间存在联系。起诉书基于他在社交媒体上的直播，他在直播中呼吁抗议、罢工和公民不服从。

paras.en: Albino Forquilha, who heads Podemos and is Mondlane's former political ally, is expected to testify at the trial. However, he told DW that he would not appear as a witness for the prosecution.
paras.zh: 我们能党主席阿尔比诺·福奎利亚（Albino Forquilha）预计将在审判中出庭作证，他是蒙德拉内的前政治盟友。不过，他告诉德国之声，他不会作为检方证人出庭。

paras.en: Forquilha said he would report his own observations of the protests and would only testify to what he personally experienced. He cannot predict whether his statements will benefit Mondlane or the state.
paras.zh: 福奎拉表示，他将报告自己对抗议活动的观察，并且只会证明他个人的经历。他无法预测他的言论是否会给蒙德莱恩或国家带来好处。

paras.en: Prosecution overstating some aspects, says critic
paras.zh: 批评者称检方夸大了某些方面

paras.en: Baltazar Fael, a prominent Mozambican lawyer, argues that the prosecution's case is problematic.
paras.zh: 莫桑比克著名律师巴尔塔扎·法埃尔（Baltazar Fael）认为检方的案件有问题。

paras.en: Speaking with DW, he warned against equating indictment with conviction. "What we currently have is an indictment by the public prosecutor," he argued. "And this does not mean that the accused has already been convicted."
paras.zh: 他在接受德国之声采访时警告不要将起诉与定罪等同起来。 “我们目前收到的是检察官的起诉书，”他辩称。 “这并不意味着被告已经被定罪。”

paras.en: The court will hear arguments from both sides and must decide whether what happened constitutes a criminal offense. Predicting the outcome is difficult.
paras.zh: 法庭将听取双方的论点，并必须决定所发生的事情是否构成刑事犯罪。预测结果很困难。

paras.en: Fael is particularly critical about the charge of incitement to terrorism. For this charge to be valid, a plausible connection between Mondlane's statements and specific acts must be proven. Acts of violence that occurred following his calls to action will not be enough to convict him on this charge, Fael said.
paras.zh: 法埃尔对煽动恐怖主义的指控尤其批评。为了使这一指控有效，必须证明 Mondlane 的陈述与具体行为之间存在合理的联系。菲尔说，在他呼吁采取行动后发生的暴力行为不足以对他定罪。

paras.en: The question is whether Mondlane actually intended to incite terrorist acts. "What power did Venancio Mondlane actually have to incite people to commit all these crimes?" Fael asked, adding that, after reading the indictment, he believes the prosecution is overstating some aspects of its case.
paras.zh: 问题是蒙德莱恩是否真的有意煽动恐怖行为。 “维南西奥·蒙德兰到底有什么权力煽动人们犯下所有这些罪行？”菲尔问道，并补充说，在阅读起诉书后，他认为检方夸大了案件的某些方面。

paras.en: There are also questions as to whether the trial might be politically motivated in some way. For years, Mozambique's justice system has been criticized because of potential political interference.
paras.zh: 还有人质疑这次审判是否可能出于某种政治动机。多年来，莫桑比克的司法系统因潜在的政治干预而受到批评。

paras.en: Fael said several factors have raised doubts. "The timing of the trial and the circumstances that led to it — namely, a challenge to the election results — are clearly political in nature," he said.
paras.zh: 菲尔表示，有几个因素引起了质疑。 “审判的时机和导致审判的情况——即对选举结果的挑战——本质上显然是政治性的，”他说。

paras.en: Additionally, the speed at which the trial was prepared might also give the impression that there's some political pressure at work here, he added.
paras.zh: 此外，他补充说，审判的准备速度也可能给人留下一些政治压力的印象。

paras.en: Adelino Muchanga, chief justice of Mozambique, has emphasized that his court will decide the case based on facts. But observers are still asking how independent the judiciary can be when the defendant is one of the most prominent critics of Mozambique's political leadership.
paras.zh: 莫桑比克首席大法官阿德利诺·穆昌加强调，法院将根据事实裁决此案。但观察人士仍在询问，当被告是莫桑比克政治领导层最著名的批评者之一时，司法机构能有多独立。

paras.en: The Supreme Court's decision not to allow a live broadcast of the trial has drawn further criticism. Mondlane's defense requested a live broadcast but was denied by the court, which reasoned that such a broadcast could endanger the safety of those involved, influence or intimidate witnesses and disrupt proper conduct of the trial.
paras.zh: 最高法院不允许直播庭审的决定引发了进一步的批评。蒙德莱恩的辩方请求进行现场直播，但遭到法院拒绝，法院认为这种直播可能会危及涉案人员的安全，影响或恐吓证人，并扰乱审判的正常进行。

paras.en: Critics see this refusal as a setback for transparency, especially since another recent, prominent trial, the so-called "hidden debt scandal" where state-owned companies secretly borrowed billions from international banks, got extensive media coverage.
paras.zh: 批评者认为这种拒绝是透明度的挫折，特别是因为最近另一起著名的审判，即国有企业秘密向国际银行借款数十亿美元的所谓“隐性债务丑闻”，得到了媒体的广泛报道。

paras.en: Additionally, the causes of the protests that sparked this trial have not disappeared. DW's interviews with citizens in the northern Mozambican city of Nampula make this clear.
paras.zh: 此外，引发这次审判的抗议活动的原因并没有消失。德国之声对莫桑比克北部城市楠普拉市民的采访清楚地表明了这一点。

paras.en: "The people still want the same thing," one resident told DW. "They wanted Venancio to become president."
paras.zh: “人们仍然想要同样的东西，”一位居民告诉德国之声。 “他们希望维南西奥成为总统。”

paras.en: Another Nampula resident pointed out that "the population protested against hunger and the lack of jobs for young people. And that's legitimate."
paras.zh: 另一位楠普拉居民指出，“人们抗议饥饿和年轻人缺乏工作。这是合法的。”

paras.en: Still, some in Nampula just want to see closure, preferring to have peace and an end to the demonstrations. Even if the economic situation could be better, the country has to return to normality at some stage, they argued.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，楠普拉的一些人只是希望看到事情结束，希望和平并结束示威活动。他们认为，即使经济形势可能好转，该国也必须在某个阶段恢复正常。

paras.en: Additional reporting by Amos Fernando and Conceicao Matende in Maputo.
paras.zh: 阿莫斯·费尔南多 (Amos Fernando) 和康塞桑·马滕德 (Conceicao Matende) 在马普托的补充报道。

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: Jordan bans Telegram app over 'radicalisation' claims

paras.en: Jordan on Monday announced a ban on instant messaging service Telegram after a deadly attack on a church last month.
paras.zh: 在上个月一座教堂遭受致命袭击后，约旦周一宣布禁止即时通讯服务 Telegram。

paras.en: Jordan's Public Security Directorate said the move aimed to protect the society from "the attempts to spread extremism and radicalisation."
paras.zh: 约旦公共安全局表示，此举旨在保护社会免受“传播极端主义和激进主义的企图”。

paras.en: All of which pose a "threat to societal security and national interests," it said.
paras.zh: 报告称，所有这些都对“社会安全和国家利益构成威胁”。

paras.en: In December 2022, Jordan also banned TikTok over videos authorities claimed "promoted killing and chaos."
paras.zh: 2022 年 12 月，约旦还因当局声称“宣扬杀戮和混乱”的视频而禁止 TikTok。

paras.en: The ban on Telegram comes after a shooting on October 23 at a Greek Orthodox church in the southern Karak governate which left seven people dead and another 34 wounded.
paras.zh: Telegram 禁令是在 10 月 23 日卡拉克省南部一座希腊东正教教堂发生枪击事件后发布的，该事件造成 7 人死亡、另外 34 人受伤。

paras.en: Jordan, in retaliation, organised airstrikes on neighbouring Syria and said it had killed 20 so-called "Islamic State" militants. The government also acknowledged that a number of civilians had been killed in the strikes.
paras.zh: 作为报复，约旦组织了对邻国叙利亚的空袭，并称已打死20名所谓“伊斯兰国”武装分子。政府还承认，一些平民在袭击中丧生。

paras.en: A Jordanian court sentenced three men to death by hanging on Sunday in connection with the attack. Authorities identified them as "followers of a hardline Islamist ideology."
paras.zh: 周日，约旦一家法院以与袭击有关的三名男子被判处绞刑。当局将他们认定为“强硬伊斯兰意识形态的追随者”。

paras.en: Attacks on Christian minorities are very rare in Jordan, a relatively stable Middle Eastern state and close ally of the United States and which maintains diplomatic and military relations with neighboring Israel.
paras.zh: 在约旦，针对基督教少数群体的袭击非常罕见。约旦是一个相对稳定的中东国家，也是美国的亲密盟友，并与邻国以色列保持着外交和军事关系。

paras.en: Christians make up around 3% of Jordan's population of 10 million. The Levantine country is home to one of the oldest Christian communities in the world.
paras.zh: 约旦 1000 万人口中基督徒约占 3%。这个黎凡特国家是世界上最古老的基督教社区之一的所在地。

paras.en: The media and communications authority in Iraq said on Monday the ban was to pressure Telegram to review Iraqi content and "take measures to prevent violations."
paras.zh: 伊拉克媒体和通信当局周一表示，该禁令是为了向 Telegram 施压，要求其审查伊拉克内容并“采取措施防止违规行为”。

paras.en: "The operating company failed to take the necessary measures to address non-compliant content published on the platform and did not adhere to Iraqi laws," the authority said in a statement.
paras.zh: 该机构在一份声明中表示：“运营公司未能采取必要措施来解决平台上发布的不合规内容，也没有遵守伊拉克法律。”

paras.en: It gave Telegram 30 days to comply, with no indication of what action would follow.
paras.zh: 它给了 Telegram 30 天的时间来遵守，但没有表明接下来会采取什么行动。

paras.en: Over the years, so-called "Islamic State" militants have used Telegram for propaganda and communication purposes.
paras.zh: 多年来，所谓的“伊斯兰国”武装分子一直利用 Telegram 进行宣传和通讯。

paras.en: The Russian-born billionaire Pavel Durov, now based in Dubai, built the Telegram messaging app with his brother Nikolai and launched it in 2013.
paras.zh: 现居迪拜的出生于俄罗斯的亿万富翁帕维尔·杜罗夫 (Pavel Durov) 与其兄弟尼古拉 (Nikolai) 共同开发了 Telegram 消息应用程序，并于 2013 年推出。

paras.en: In July, Russia said it had charged him with "aiding terrorist activities," accusing the platform of hosting tools used to coordinate deadly attacks and sabotage across Russia.
paras.zh: 7月，俄罗斯表示指控他“协助恐怖活动”，并指责该平台托管用于协调俄罗斯各地致命袭击和破坏活动的工具。

paras.en: Durov rejects the allegations, arguing that Telegram has gone "beyond its obligations in moderating content and assisting authorities in tackling crime."
paras.zh: 杜罗夫否认了这些指控，认为 Telegram 已经“超出了其审核内容和协助当局打击犯罪的义务”。

paras.en: He describes himself as a libertarian and has repeatedly clashed with governments seeking greater access to the platform.
paras.zh: 他将自己描述为自由主义者，并多次与寻求更多使用该平台的政府发生冲突。

articles.title: The new French malaise

paras.en: Fifty years ago, Alain Peyrefitte, who served as a spokesperson for French President Charles de Gaulle, published a book entitled Le Mal français (The French Malaise). In the book, Peyrefitte wrote that the progress of the French nation was impeded by the lack of trust – within society and between society and state institutions. In reaction, the state exercised excessive control through rules, bureaucracy and centralisation, which resulted in stagnation.
paras.zh: 50年前，担任法国总统戴高乐发言人的阿兰·佩雷菲特出版了一本名为《Le Mal français》（法国的不适）的书。佩雷菲特在书中写道，法国民族的进步因社会内部以及社会与国家机构之间缺乏信任而受到阻碍。作为回应，国家通过规则、官僚主义和集权实行过度控制，导致经济停滞。

paras.en: Today, the French malaise persists, but its symptoms are quite different from the ones observed by Peyrefitte. We now have the dramatic protests by French students as well as workers and other disaffected groups, which at times have turned violent.
paras.zh: 如今，法国的萎靡不振依然存在，但其症状与佩雷菲特观察到的症状截然不同。现在，法国学生、工人和其他不满团体发起了激烈的抗议活动，有时甚至演变成暴力活动。

paras.en: But these demonstrations are only the tip of the iceberg. The malaise runs much deeper.
paras.zh: 但这些示威活动只是冰山一角。不适感更加严重。

paras.en: Following the events of October 17, in which symbols of state authority were attacked – including the town halls of Limoges and Marseille and an official building in Lyon – and businesses were looted, French President Emmanuel Macron stated that these acts sought “to tear down our institutions”.
paras.zh: 10 月 17 日的事件发生后，国家权威的象征 — — 包括利摩日和马赛的市政厅以及里昂的一座官方建筑 — — 以及企业遭到抢劫，法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙表示，这些行为旨在“摧毁我们的机构”。

paras.en: The use of such strong words reminds one of the rhetoric employed by the French government during the protests of May 1968, when students challenged the established order, and their actions were portrayed as an “attack on the Republic”.
paras.zh: 如此强烈的措辞让人想起法国政府在1968年5月的抗议活动中所使用的言辞之一，当时学生挑战既定秩序，他们的行为被描述为“对共和国的攻击”。

paras.en: There is, in fact, a tendency to compare the current wave of demonstrations with the events of May 1968. Yet the two movements differ. The protesters of 1968 were calling for more freedom, while today’s protesters are demanding equality and dignity. The former demonstrations were led by privileged youth; the latter are driven by those who have been left behind.
paras.zh: 事实上，人们倾向于将当前的示威浪潮与 1968 年 5 月的事件进行比较。然而，这两个运动有所不同。 1968 年的抗议者呼吁更多自由，而今天的抗议者则要求平等和尊严。以前的示威活动是由有特权的年轻人领导的；现在是由有特权的年轻人领导的。后者是由那些被抛在后面的人推动的。

paras.en: Perhaps a more relevant episode to examine is the upheaval of 2005 in the suburbs of Paris and other major cities following the deaths of two teenagers, Bouna and Zyed, who were pursued by the police.
paras.zh: 也许一个更值得研究的相关事件是2005年巴黎郊区和其他主要城市发生的动乱，当时两名青少年布纳和齐德被警方追捕身亡。

paras.en: For three weeks, residents of impoverished neighbourhoods, living on the fringes of society both geographically and socially, expressed their anger at police violence and their own marginalisation.
paras.zh: 三个星期以来，生活在地理和社会边缘的贫困社区的居民表达了对警察暴力和自身边缘化的愤怒。

paras.en: Two elements of the French malaise were already apparent at the time. First was the deep divide between two segments of society: the prosperous urban population and the marginalised, racialised poor, living in the underdeveloped and underserviced outskirts.
paras.zh: 法国的萎靡不振的两个因素当时已经很明显。首先是社会两部分之间的深刻鸿沟：富裕的城市人口和生活在欠发达和服务不足的郊区的边缘化、种族化的穷人。

paras.en: The second was the French police itself, which has overwhelmingly focused on policing the latter with ever-growing brutality.
paras.zh: 第二个是法国警察本身，他们主要专注于以日益残酷的方式对后者进行治安。

paras.en: In any country, a citizen-oriented police force can help build the bonds that unite a nation. But in France, the police is tasked with defending the state, not protecting the citizens.
paras.zh: 在任何国家，一支以公民为导向的警察部队都可以帮助建立团结国家的纽带。但在法国，警察的任务是保卫国家，而不是保护公民。

paras.en: It does not contribute to the cohesion of a nation. It does not abide by proportionality in the use of force or opt for de-escalation; it openly practises a discriminatory approach to policing which differentiates between affluent neighbourhoods and impoverished areas, between the white majority and the communities of colour.
paras.zh: 它无助于一个国家的凝聚力。它不遵守使用武力的相称性或选择降级；它公开对治安采取歧视性做法，区分富裕社区和贫困地区、白人多数和有色人种社区。

paras.en: It is no wonder that upwards of 60 percent of the police and military forces of France vote for the far right.
paras.zh: 难怪法国 60% 以上的警察和军队投票支持极右翼。

paras.en: In 2019, French political scientist Jérôme Fourquet wrote a book entitled The French Archipelago: The birth of a diverse and divided nation. In it, he argues that France has undergone a societal shift which has fundamentally altered people’s relationship with themselves and with the “other”. As a result, French society has split into small “islands” which are increasingly isolated from one another.
paras.zh: 2019年，法国政治学家杰罗姆·福凯写了一本题为《法国群岛：一个多元化和分裂国家的诞生》的书。在其中，他认为法国经历了一场社会变革，从根本上改变了人们与自己以及与“他人”的关系。结果，法国社会分裂成一个个日益孤立的小“岛”。

paras.en: This transformation cannot be attributed solely to immigration. It is, above all, the result of the secession of the elite, which has grown distant and indifferent to the fate of the rest of the nation. This includes the political left, who are now commonly referred to as the gauche caviar (the caviar left).
paras.zh: 这种转变不能仅仅归因于移民。首先，这是精英阶层分裂的结果，他们对国家其他人的命运变得疏远和漠不关心。这包括政治左派，他们现在通常被称为“gauche caviar”（鱼子酱左派）。

paras.en: It has been the elite’s abandonment and self-isolation that has caused the revolt of the masses, rather than the other way around.
paras.zh: 正是精英的抛弃和自我孤立导致了群众的反抗，而不是相反。

paras.en: The institutions that traditionally fostered socialisation between various groups, bestowing a sense of belonging, including schools, summer camps and compulsory military service, are no longer functioning effectively, or are cancelled.
paras.zh: 传统上促进不同群体之间社会化、赋予归属感的机构，包括学校、夏令营和义务兵役制，已不再有效运作或被取消。

paras.en: In this fragmented society, one segment has been picked as a scapegoat for all problems, diverting attention from the real roots of the malaise.
paras.zh: 在这个支离破碎的社会中，某个群体被选为所有问题的替罪羊，从而转移了人们对问题真正根源的注意力。

paras.en: Islamophobia is flourishing in France, as is the belief in the “Great Replacement”, a conspiracy theory that people of colour are meant to “replace” the white majority. Islamophobia has even become institutionalised through legislation and a political culture that has transformed blasphemy into something resembling a duty.
paras.zh: 伊斯兰恐惧症在法国盛行，“大替代”信仰也盛行，这是一种阴谋论，认为有色人种要“取代”占多数的白人。仇视伊斯兰教甚至通过立法和政治文化变得制度化，将亵渎变成了一种类似义务的东西。

paras.en: The paradox is that France – compared with its neighbours – has a smaller immigrant population while it espouses a much louder rhetoric about “integration”.
paras.zh: 矛盾的是，与邻国相比，法国的移民人口较少，但其“一体化”的言论却更为响亮。

paras.en: And there is a considerable gap between rhetoric and reality. While those in power demand that people of immigrant background “integrate”, very little is done by the state to actually drive this process.
paras.zh: 而且言辞与现实之间存在相当大的差距。尽管当权者要求有移民背景的人“融入”，但国家在实际推动这一进程方面却做得很少。

paras.en: As a result, some French citizens feel they are French only on paper. They understand that citizenship cannot be reduced to a political discourse. Without genuine access to rights, which necessarily entails social justice and human dignity, there can be no meaningful citizenship.
paras.zh: 因此，一些法国公民觉得自己只是纸面上的法国人。他们明白公民身份不能被简化为政治话语。如果没有真正获得权利（这必然涉及社会正义和人类尊严），就不可能有有意义的公民身份。

paras.en: In 2005, a group of activists went as far as declaring themselves the “Natives of the Republic” and calling for its decolonisation. Indeed, anyone familiar with French society can recognise that France has reproduced a colonial order within.
paras.zh: 2005年，一群活动人士甚至宣称自己是“共和国原住民”并呼吁其非殖民化。确实，熟悉法国社会的人都知道，法国内部已经再现了殖民秩序。

paras.en: The country that gave birth to the Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen has failed to treat some of its own people as full citizens. And that stands at the core of the new French malaise.
paras.zh: 制定《人权和公民权利宣言》的国家未能将自己的一些人民视为正式公民。这是法国新的萎靡不振的核心。

paras.en: The views expressed in this article are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
paras.zh: 本文表达的观点是作者自己的观点，并不一定反映半岛电视台的编辑立场。

articles.title: Portugal coach Jorge Jesus responds to criticism from Ronaldo’s mother

paras.en: Portugal coach Jorge Jesus believes he will still be responding to questions about Cristiano Ronaldo next year, after he was asked for his thoughts on scathing comments by the football great’s mother.
paras.zh: 葡萄牙教练豪尔赫·热苏斯相信，在被问及对这位足球伟人母亲严厉言论的看法后，他明年仍将回答有关克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多的问题。

paras.en: “Now I have to respond to Cristiano Ronaldo’s mother?” Jesus asked on Tuesday, addressing the media before Portugal’s final Nations League group fixture away to Wales.
paras.zh: “现在我必须回应克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多的母亲？”周二，热苏斯在葡萄牙国联小组最后一场客场对阵威尔士的比赛前向媒体发表了这样的疑问。

paras.en: “I don’t know when it is going to stop. If you guys ask the questions, I have to answer. If you ask about Ronaldo next year, I will answer.”
paras.zh: “我不知道什么时候会停止。如果你们问问题，我必须回答。如果你们明年问起罗纳尔多，我会回答。”

paras.en: Jesus’s frustration stemmed from his lingering tensions with Ronaldo following the recent international retirement of football’s all-time greats.
paras.zh: 热苏斯的沮丧源于他与罗纳尔多之间挥之不去的紧张关系，因为最近这位足球史上最伟大的球员在国家队退役。

paras.en: The 72-year-old head coach responded to comments from Ronaldo’s mother in the wake of the team’s latest defeat – their first since the 41-year-old forward quit national duties.
