paras.zh: 这位72岁的主教练在球队最近失利后回应了罗纳尔多母亲的评论，这是自这位41岁的前锋辞去国家队职务以来的第一次失利。

paras.en: Jesus wondered when he would stop being peppered about Ronaldo after a 4-1 Nations League defeat to Denmark prompted criticism from the five-time Ballon d’Or winner’s mother, Dolores Aveiro.
paras.zh: 在国联1-4输给丹麦的比赛中，热苏斯想知道他什么时候才能停止对罗纳尔多的热议，这引起了五届金球奖得主母亲多洛雷斯·阿威罗的批评。

paras.en: Aveiro said she was glad to see Jesus suffer his first defeat since taking charge after the World Cup as Ronaldo had been “deceived” by the former Benfica boss.
paras.zh: 阿威罗表示，她很高兴看到热苏斯在世界杯后执掌球队后首次遭遇失败，因为罗纳尔多被前本菲卡主帅“欺骗”。

paras.en: Ronaldo’s decision to hang up his boots for country followed a falling out with Jesus, who was previously the superstar’s coach at Saudi club Al-Nassr.
paras.zh: 罗纳尔多在与耶稣发生争执后决定为国家队挂靴，耶稣曾是这位超级巨星在沙特俱乐部阿尔纳斯尔的教练。

paras.en: The ex-Manchester United, Real Madrid and Juventus star accused Jesus of broken promises after he was asked to warm up during a match against Norway in September without being introduced as a substitute.
paras.zh: 这位前曼联、皇马和尤文图斯球星指责热苏斯在九月份对阵挪威的比赛中被要求热身，但没有作为替补上场，因此他违背了承诺。

paras.en: Ronaldo left the team camp and was handed a 30-day suspension and a token fine.
paras.zh: C罗离开了球队训练营，并被处以30天禁赛和象征性罚款。

paras.en: He apologised and was expected to return to the Portugal squad, but instead brought down the curtain on a 23-year international career.
paras.zh: 他道了歉，并有望重返葡萄牙队，但却结束了23年的国家队生涯。

paras.en: His 234 appearances and 146 goals are both world records in the men’s game.
paras.zh: 他的234场比赛和146个进球均是男子比赛的世界纪录。

paras.en: Ronaldo’s lack of mobility was often pinpointed as a factor in a richly talented Portugal squad falling short in recent major tournaments.
paras.zh: 罗纳尔多缺乏流动性经常被认为是才华横溢的葡萄牙队在最近的重大赛事中表现不佳的一个因素。

paras.en: Jesus’s side had made a perfect start with four consecutive wins prior to Saturday’s shock defeat to the Danes.
paras.zh: 在周六令人震惊地输给丹麦队之前，热苏斯的球队已经取得了四连胜的完美开局。

paras.en: “After the game against Denmark, everyone is asking me about different individuals, not about the team or winning here,” added Jesus.
paras.zh: “在对阵丹麦的比赛之后，每个人都在问我关于不同个人的问题，而不是关于球队或在这里获胜的问题，”热苏斯补充道。

paras.en: “We played one bad game and it’s harder to move on when we have a result like that, but we are going to try and win the game.”
paras.zh: “我们踢了一场糟糕的比赛，当我们得到这样的结果时，继续前进就更困难了，但我们会努力赢得比赛。”

paras.en: Portugal only need a point in Cardiff to secure top spot in Nations League group A4 against a Wales side that will finish bottom of the section.
paras.zh: 葡萄牙只需要在卡迪夫拿下一分，就可以在欧国联 A4 组中对阵垫底的威尔士队，从而确保小组头名的位置。

paras.en: “You were all having a go at him for playing, and then as soon as he retires, suddenly it’s all hell breaking loose!” Wales boss Craig Bellamy told the Portuguese media.
paras.zh: “你们都因为他打球而批评他，然后他一退役，突然一切都乱了套！”威尔士主帅克雷格·贝拉米告诉葡萄牙媒体。

paras.en: “He is one of the best players that has ever played the game. We’re all going to miss him.”
paras.zh: “他是有史以来最好的球员之一。我们都会想念他的。”

articles.title: Bahrain thwarts drone attack, Iran claims targeting US military radar

paras.en: Bahraini air defence has thwarted a drone attack, according to the Gulf country’s state television, after Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) launched a barrage of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs).
paras.zh: 据海湾国家国家电视台报道，在伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）发射了一系列无人机（UAV）后，巴林的防空系统挫败了无人机袭击。

paras.en: The IRGC said on Tuesday that it carried out a drone attack on a US radar system at the Isa airbase in Bahrain.
paras.zh: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队周二表示，它对巴林伊萨空军基地的美国雷达系统进行了无人机袭击。

paras.en: The reported attacks in Bahrain – home to the US Navy’s Fifth Fleet – come amid stalled diplomatic efforts to end the US-Israel war on Iran, which began on February 28 and has affected the entire Gulf region and beyond.
paras.zh: 据报道，在美国海军第五舰队所在地巴林发生袭击事件之际，为结束美以对伊朗战争而进行的外交努力陷入停滞。这场战争于 2 月 28 日开始，影响到整个海湾地区及其他地区。

paras.en: It is the latest of several Iran-claimed attacks on US radar systems in Bahrain in recent days.
paras.zh: 这是最近几天伊朗声称的针对美国驻巴林雷达系统的几起袭击事件中的最新一起。

paras.en: The IRGC said the attack was “part of efforts to counter the hostile activities of US forces in the region”, according to a statement carried by Iran’s state broadcaster IRIB.
paras.zh: 伊朗国家广播公司 IRIB 发表声明称，伊斯兰革命卫队表示，这次袭击是“反击美军在该地区敌对活动的努力的一部分”。

paras.en: Blasts echoed over the Bahraini capital, Manama, after residents received a mobile phone alert warning of a “potential threat”. Explosions were heard after the Ministry of Interior’s alert urged residents to “proceed to the nearest safe location”.
paras.zh: 在居民收到“潜在威胁”的手机警报后，巴林首都麦纳麦上空回响着爆炸声。内政部发出警报，敦促居民“前往最近的安全地点”后，听到爆炸声。

paras.en: On Sunday, the IRGC launched six drones at a US air defence radar system at Bahrain’s Riffa airbase, which hosts US forces, in response to what it described as hostile US actions.
paras.zh: 周日，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队向美军驻扎的巴林里法空军基地的美国防空雷达系统发射了六架无人机，以回应美国的敌对行动。

paras.en: On Friday, the IRGC also claimed to have targeted a US early-warning radar system in Bahrain, but the US military denied that the facility had been hit, saying it intercepted two Iranian drones without damage or casualties.
paras.zh: 周五，伊朗革命卫队还声称袭击了位于巴林的美国预警雷达系统，但美国军方否认该设施遭到袭击，称其拦截了两架伊朗无人机，没有造成任何损坏或人员伤亡。

paras.en: Bahrain has faced renewed security concerns amid escalating tensions between Washington and Tehran.
paras.zh: 随着华盛顿和德黑兰之间的紧张局势升级，巴林面临新的安全担忧。

articles.title: Fuel crisis and protests pressure Chile's far-right president
articles.author: John Bartlett

paras.en: Fuel crisis and protests pressure Chile's far-right president
paras.zh: 燃料危机和抗议给智利极右翼总统带来压力

paras.en: SANTIAGO, Chile — Chile's ultraconservative president finds himself on the back foot after just eight months in power.
paras.zh: 智利圣地亚哥——智利极端保守的总统在上任仅八个月后就发现自己陷入了困境。

paras.en: José Antonio Kast, a politician who spent a career railing against progressive issues, reproductive rights and welfare policies from the extreme fringes of right-wing politics, now finds himself with just 24% approval in the polls.
paras.zh: 何塞·安东尼奥·卡斯特 (José Antonio Kast) 是一位政治家，他的职业生涯一直在反对右翼政治极端边缘的进步问题、生殖权利和福利政策，现在他发现自己在民意调查中的支持率仅为 24%。

paras.en: It is less than a year since Kast stormed to the presidency in December 2025 by avoiding all mention of his hardline stances on social matters, focusing instead on two hot-button issues whipped up in the national media: illegal immigration and public security.
paras.zh: 距离卡斯特于 2025 年 12 月上任总统不到一年，他避免提及自己在社会问题上的强硬立场，而是将注意力集中在国家媒体上掀起的两个热点问题：非法移民和公共安全。

paras.en: But rather than pressing ahead with those at the top of his agenda, he has floundered. And as elsewhere around the Americas and worldwide, rising costs of living have come to hit him hard.
paras.zh: 但他并没有继续推进他最重要的议程，而是陷入了困境。与美洲和世界其他地方一样，生活成本的上涨对他造成了沉重打击。

paras.en: "Our salaries are maybe 20% of a European income, but with a similar cost of living – it's terrible," said Simón Echavarría, a 30-year-old architect, at a march in Santiago on Friday evening.
paras.zh: 周五晚上，30 岁的建筑师西蒙·埃查瓦里亚 (Simón Echavarría) 在圣地亚哥的一次游行中表示：“我们的工资可能是欧洲人收入的 20%，但生活成本却相似，这太糟糕了。”

paras.en: "We want to protest against the measures that have set us back on environmental issues, on human rights, even reducing the sentences of pedophiles – they are implementing things that nobody asked for," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们想要抗议那些在环境问题、人权问题上让我们倒退的措施，甚至减少恋童癖者的刑期——他们正在实施没有人要求的事情。”

paras.en: Behind him, heavily armed police blocked the streets and fired water cannons at protesters chanting and waving flags in the square.
paras.zh: 在他身后，全副武装的警察封锁了街道，并向广场上高呼口号、挥舞旗帜的抗议者发射高压水枪。

paras.en: Much of the recent ire stems from the revelation last month that Kast's government had signed decrees to cut the sentences of 56 prisoners whose crimes range from the rape of children to dictatorship-era human rights violations.
paras.zh: 最近的愤怒很大程度上源于上个月卡斯特政府签署法令对 56 名囚犯减刑的消息，这些囚犯的罪行包括强奸儿童和独裁时代侵犯人权等。

paras.en: Kast has since admitted that this was an "error", but came out in support of the undersecretary who signed the decrees nonetheless.
paras.zh: 卡斯特此后承认这是一个“错误”，但仍然站出来支持签署这些法令的副部长。

paras.en: But beneath the more egregious moves Kast has made in his first year in power is simmering discontent over affordability.
paras.zh: 但在卡斯特执政第一年采取的更令人震惊的举措背后，隐藏着对负担能力的不满。

paras.en: In July, Kast's government chose not to apply an anti-inflation tool available to the Chilean state to ease the rise in fuel prices brought about by the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran.
paras.zh: 7月，卡斯特政府选择不采用智利政府可用的反通胀工具，以缓解美以与伊朗战争带来的燃油价格上涨。

paras.en: Protests exploded as prices shot up overnight and motorists joined long queues at gas stations to fill their tanks before the rise came into effect.
paras.zh: 随着价格一夜之间飙升，驾车者在涨价生效之前在加油站排起长队加油，引发了抗议活动。

paras.en: This week, Chile's formidable truckers' unions blockaded two major highways in an effort to exert pressure on the government and address high fuel prices.
paras.zh: 本周，智利强大的卡车司机工会封锁了两条主要高速公路，试图向政府施加压力并解决高油价问题。

paras.en: On Friday, the strike was broken after the government backed down, sending a bill to Chile's congress which will reverse planned fuel price rises.
paras.zh: 周五，在政府作出让步后，罢工被打破，并向智利国会提交了一项法案，该法案将扭转计划中的燃油价格上涨。

paras.en: It is expected to be approved this month, but public anger continues to grow over the cost of living.
paras.zh: 预计该法案将于本月获得批准，但公众对生活成本的愤怒持续增长。

paras.en: Politicians across the Americas who have enthusiastically aligned themselves with President Donald Trump are facing challenges similar to those confronting the U.S. administration, as rising fuel prices and the cost of everyday goods fuel public discontent.
paras.zh: 美洲各地热情支持唐纳德·特朗普总统的政治家面临着与美国政府类似的挑战，因为不断上涨的燃油价格和日常用品成本加剧了公众的不满。

paras.en: In Argentina, far-right libertarian Javier Milei faces reelection in less than a year, with 60% of the country disapproving of his leadership amid spiraling inflation. In Peru, President Keiko Fujimori is also facing growing discontent, with 53% disapproving of her government, according to a recent Ipsos poll.
paras.zh: 在阿根廷，极右翼自由主义者哈维尔·米莱 (Javier Milei) 在不到一年的时间内面临连任，在通货膨胀不断上升的情况下，该国 60% 的人不赞成他的领导。在秘鲁，总统藤森庆子也面临着日益增长的不满情绪，根据益普索 (Ipsos) 最近的一项民意调查，53% 的人不赞成她的政府。

paras.en: At the march in Santiago on Friday, 30-year-old veterinarian Patricia Pereira said that she was concerned about cuts to science funding, but that her discontent ran deeper.
paras.zh: 在周五圣地亚哥的游行中，30 岁的兽医帕特里夏·佩雷拉 (Patricia Pereira) 表示，她对科学经费的削减感到担忧，但她的不满情绪更深了。

paras.en: "Here in Chile, it was a hard-won victory for children to have free education, achieved through protests, and now even that's also being called into question," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“在智利，孩子们通过抗议获得了免费教育，这是来之不易的胜利，但现在连这一点也受到了质疑。”

paras.en: Protests are likely to grow in Santiago if the government fails to address the rising cost of living. President Kast has shown little sign of doing so.
paras.zh: 如果政府不能解决生活成本上升的问题，圣地亚哥的抗议活动可能会加剧。卡斯特总统几乎没有表现出这样做的迹象。

paras.en: To the contrary, his budget proposal is making its way through Congress, with the government seeking cuts to education, culture, science and a host of social programs.
paras.zh: 相反，他的预算提案正在国会获得通过，政府寻求削减教育、文化、科学和一系列社会项目。

articles.title: Trump heads to Asia to meet with Xi and Putin amid Nvidia fallout
articles.author: Deepa Shivaram

paras.en: Trump heads to Asia to meet with Xi and Putin amid Nvidia fallout
paras.zh: 在英伟达的影响下，特朗普前往亚洲会见习近平和普京

paras.en: President Trump heads to Asia this week where he's set to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian leader Vladimir Putin for a high-stakes trilateral summit.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统本周将前往亚洲，与中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯领导人普京举行高风险的三边峰会。

paras.en: The trip to China marks Trump's second visit this year, and comes as the president and his party face widespread backlash from voters in the recent midterm elections, potentially weakening his bargaining position across the Pacific.
paras.zh: 此次中国之行是特朗普今年的第二次访问，正值总统及其政党在最近的中期选举中面临选民的广泛强烈反对，这可能会削弱他在太平洋彼岸的讨价还价地位。

paras.en: The president and administration officials – including Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick – are also under scrutiny after the recent resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an extramarital affair with a woman who U.S. intelligence officials believe was recruited by China's top spy agency, according to The New York Times. NPR has not independently confirmed those reports.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋最近辞职后，总统和政府官员 - 包括商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克 - 也受到了审查。黄仁勋承认与一名美国情报官员认为是由中国最高间谍机构招募的女性发生婚外情。 NPR 尚未独立证实这些报道。

paras.en: Huang traveled to China with Trump earlier this year – this time, tech billionaire Elon Musk is joining Trump in Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 黄今年早些时候与特朗普一起访问了中国——这一次，科技亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克将与特朗普一起前往深圳。

paras.en: The expectation for major deals or pronouncements coming out of the meetings this week are low – but the meeting is still expected to make waves over the imagery of the trilateral summit. Trump said as he left the White House Monday that he may also meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.
paras.zh: 对本周会议达成的重大协议或声明的预期较低，但会议仍有望对三边峰会的形象产生影响。特朗普周一离开白宫时表示，他也可能会见朝鲜领导人金正恩。

paras.en: Before China, Trump will first travel to the Philippines where he'll meet with allies at the ASEAN summit in Manila.
paras.zh: 在中国之前，特朗普将首先前往菲律宾，并在马尼拉举行的东盟峰会上与盟友会面。

paras.en: The president is expected to be in the region for just about three days.
paras.zh: 预计总统将在该地区停留大约三天。

paras.en: For weeks the president has said he's keen to discuss the Iran war and denuclearization with Putin and Xi. But Edgard Kagan, the former ambassador to Malaysia and a senior adviser at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, said it's a topic that Xi likely won't want to get into. The White House confirmed Friday that Trump is expected to meet with Xi and Putin together.
paras.zh: 几周来，总统一直表示他热衷于与普京和习近平讨论伊朗战争和无核化问题。但前驻马来西亚大使、战略与国际研究中心高级顾问埃德加德·卡根表示，习近平可能不想讨论这个话题。白宫周五证实，特朗普预计将与习近平和普京一起会面。

paras.en: "The Chinese strongly disagree with the idea that they should be involved in any kind of trilateral discussions with the United States and Russia on nuclear weapons," Kagan said.
paras.zh: 卡根说：“中国强烈反对他们应该参与与美国和俄罗斯就核武器问题进行任何形式的三边讨论。”

paras.en: "China wants to avoid this because they don't want to be locked into a subservient position. And they also don't want to create a precedent. I think the main thing for the Chinese is they know if they do a meeting and nuclear issues are discussed, it becomes much harder for them to refuse to do it in the future," he said.
paras.zh: “中国希望避免这种情况，因为他们不想陷入屈从的地位。他们也不想开创先例。我认为对中国人来说最重要的是他们知道如果他们举行会议并讨论核问题，他们将来就很难拒绝这样做，”他说。

paras.en: A White House official said they do not expect any agreement to come out of the meeting on denuclearization.
paras.zh: 一名白宫官员表示，他们预计此次会议不会就无核化问题达成任何协议。

paras.en: "We do not expect to get to any kind of agreement," the official said, calling the trilateral an "entry point" for the three countries to talk about reducing nuclear weapons stock.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示：“我们预计不会达成任何形式的协议。”他称三边会谈是三个国家讨论削减核武器库存的“切入点”。

paras.en: Another U.S. official not authorized to speak on the record acknowledged that denuclearization is a "difficult" topic for China.
paras.zh: 另一位未获授权公开发言的美国官员承认，无核化对中国来说是一个“困难”的话题。

paras.en: "But we do think it's time for China to sort of step up to the adult table, if you will, and have adult conversations about adult things," the official said.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示：“但我们确实认为，如果你愿意的话，中国现在是时候站到成人的餐桌上，就成人的事情进行成人对话了。”

paras.en: Putin, for his part, stands to benefit from a meeting with Trump and Xi, as Russia's war with Ukraine nears its five-year mark. Trump has made friendlier moves toward Russia in recent months, siding with Putin and striking a deal to release more Russian oil into the market ahead of the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 就普京而言，随着俄罗斯与乌克兰的战争接近五年，他将从与特朗普和习近平的会晤中受益。近几个月来，特朗普对俄罗斯采取了更加友好的举措，与普京站在一起，并达成协议，在中期选举前向市场释放更多俄罗斯石油。

paras.en: Trump said last month that he was fine with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy not being present at a potential meeting with Putin about the war.
paras.zh: 特朗普上个月表示，他同意乌克兰总统泽连斯基不出席与普京就战争问题举行的可能会面。

paras.en: "Anything I can do to end the war, whether somebody's there or not," Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“我会尽一切努力结束战争，无论是否有人在场。”

paras.en: A White House official said Ukraine is not intended to come up in the meeting with Xi and Putin. And there is no plan for Putin and Trump to have a separate meeting.
paras.zh: 一名白宫官员表示，乌克兰无意在习近平和普京的会晤中被提及。普京和特朗普没有单独会面的计划。

paras.en: But Trump said Monday he would be talking about his "favorite subject Ukraine."
paras.zh: 但特朗普周一表示，他将谈论他“最喜欢的话题乌克兰”。

paras.en: Kagan said the meeting with Xi, Trump and Putin could end up being on the shorter side if there isn't much all parties are willing to discuss. But at the same time, "I could see this going longer because President Trump likes dealing with Putin and Xi. He sees them as his peers. He sees them as important world leaders," Kagan said.
paras.zh: 卡根表示，如果各方都不愿意讨论太多内容，与习近平、特朗普和普京的会面最终可能会持续较短的时间。但与此同时，“我认为这种情况会持续更长时间，因为特朗普总统喜欢与普京和习近平打交道。他将他们视为他的同僚。他将他们视为重要的世界领导人，”卡根说。

paras.en: Either way, a photo of the three leaders meeting together is enough to make headlines.
paras.zh: 不管怎样，三位领导人会面的照片足以成为头条新闻。

paras.en: "That picture alone is going to be worth well over a thousand words," Kagan said.
paras.zh: 卡根说：“仅这张照片就足以胜过千言万语。”

paras.en: This is the second time Trump and Xi are meeting on the sidelines of the APEC summit – but this year's meeting is notably different from last year's in Busan, South Korea, when tensions between the US and China were fraught amid the escalating trade war.
paras.zh: 这是特朗普和习近平第二次在亚太经合组织峰会期间会面，但今年的会议与去年在韩国釜山举行的会议明显不同，当时中美之间的紧张局势因贸易战不断升级而紧张。

paras.en: The meeting in Busan established a sort-of truce between the two countries. The U.S. immediately lowered some tariffs on Chinese goods and China agreed to loosen exports on rare earths. But the execution of the agreement has been spotty.
paras.zh: 釜山会议在两国之间建立了某种休战协议。美国立即降低了对中国商品的部分关税，中国同意放松稀土出口。但该协议的执行情况却参差不齐。

paras.en: "There's friction in this truce. It's not smooth, but it's basically functional," Kurt Tong, Managing Partner at The Asia Group, said.
paras.zh: “这次休战中存在摩擦。虽然并不顺利，但基本上是有效的，”亚洲集团执行合伙人唐伟表示。

paras.en: A White House official said the U.S. isn't getting rare earths from China at the pace or level they'd like.
paras.zh: 一位白宫官员表示，美国从中国获取稀土的速度或水平没有达到他们想要的水平。

paras.en: "We really want to focus minds among our counterparts in China on compliance with this," they said.
paras.zh: 他们表示：“我们确实希望中国同行能够集中精力遵守这一规定。”

paras.en: Still, Tong expects the agreement to be renewed past its January expiration. The two sides will likely agree to the renewal either in Shenzhen or later this year at the G20 summit Trump is hosting in Miami, according to Tong.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，Tong 预计该协议将在一月份到期后续签。唐表示，双方可能会在深圳或今年晚些时候特朗普在迈阿密主办的 G20 峰会上同意续签协议。

paras.en: Before the president arrives in China, he's holding meetings with several allies in Manila, including a meeting with the other leaders of the Quad nations: India, Japan and Australia.
paras.zh: 在总统抵达中国之前，他将在马尼拉与几个盟友举行会议，其中包括与四国其他领导人的会议：印度、日本和澳大利亚。

paras.en: "I think it's quite significant symbolically and politically that the U.S., Australia, Japan and India, the major democracies of Asia and the Pacific, get together… it's especially significant that they're doing it just before the meetings in China," Tong said.
paras.zh: 童说：“我认为，美国、澳大利亚、日本和印度这些亚洲及太平洋地区的主要民主国家齐聚一堂，具有非常重要的象征意义和政治意义……尤其重要的是，他们在中国举行会议之前这样做。”

paras.en: The White House said Trump will also sign a trade deal with Thailand while in the Philippines.
paras.zh: 白宫表示，特朗普还将在菲律宾期间与泰国签署贸易协议。

paras.en: The opportunity in Manila for Trump is to repair and reinforce relationships with countries like Japan and India, and the host country the Philippines. The ASEAN summit is also the region's first look at the president since his party lost control of Congress and on a global stage, a chance to see what the last two years of Trump's presidency may look like.
paras.zh: 特朗普在马尼拉的机会是修复和加强与日本和印度等国家以及东道国菲律宾的关系。东盟峰会也是自特朗普所在政党失去国会控制权以来该地区首次在全球舞台上审视特朗普，这是一次了解特朗普总统任期最后两年可能会是什么样子的机会。

paras.en: "I think the real thing that people will be looking at first is, how does he present himself?" Kagan said. "How does his behaviour towards Modi and towards India change? Those are things people will be looking at very, very closely for clues for what the next two years are likely to be like."
paras.zh: “我认为人们首先关注的真正问题是，他如何展现自己？”卡根说。 “他对莫迪和印度的行为有何变化？人们将非常非常密切地关注这些事情，以寻找未来两年可能发生的情况的线索。”

paras.en: A White House official said they don't expect Trump to raise the issue of Huang's affair and resignation with Xi. The focus of the meeting is about trade, the official said.
paras.zh: 一名白宫官员表示，他们预计特朗普不会向习近平提出黄的婚外情和辞职问题。这位官员表示，会议的焦点是贸易问题。

paras.en: Huang resigned last week after admitting the extramarital affair with Alice Huang. Trump administration officials are now facing scrutiny and questions about how much they knew about Huang's affair and how much Huang had access to Trump and his orbit.
paras.zh: 黄上周在承认与黄爱丽的婚外情后辞职。特朗普政府官员现在面临着审查和质疑，他们对黄的事件了解多少，以及黄对特朗普及其轨道有多少了解。

paras.en: Trump reiterated Monday he wasn't sure if Alice Huang was a Chinese spy and that he wouldn't mind seeing Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia's CEO.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一重申，他不确定黄爱丽丝是否是中国间谍，并且他不介意看到黄仁勋恢复担任英伟达首席执行官。

paras.en: "I think the main impact is here in the United States, where there are calls for accountability with respect to Mr. Huang's activities with the U.S. government and questions about what happened… the net result of that is to provide a tailwind to persons who are interested in tightening up the technology denial regime toward China," Tong said.
paras.zh: “我认为主要影响在美国，有人呼吁对黄先生与美国政府的活动进行问责，并对所发生的事情提出质疑……最终结果是为那些有兴趣收紧针对中国的技术拒绝制度的人提供了顺风车，”童说。

paras.en: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick agreed last week to appear in front of the Senate Banking Committee to answer further questions. Trump stood by Lutnik on Monday, saying there were differing views on how to treat China in his administration.
paras.zh: 商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克上周同意出席参议院银行委员会回答进一步问题。特朗普周一站在卢特尼克一边，表示他的政府对于如何对待中国存在不同看法。

articles.title: Africa: Trading in yuan
articles.author: Kate Bartlett

paras.en: The dollar has long ruled Africa's financial landscape. But as more countries turn to China's yuan, the balance of economic power could be shifting.
paras.zh: 美元长期以来统治着非洲的金融格局。但随着越来越多的国家转向人民币，经济力量的平衡可能会发生变化。

paras.en: President Trump will meet Chinese President Xi Jinping in China next week on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic summit. The meeting is likely to be overshadowed by allegations that the head of U.S. chipmaker Nvidia, Jensen Huang, had an affair with a Chinese spy. The U.S. and China are in the midst of an AI race, and the two countries are also competing on many other fronts, including in mineral-rich Africa, as Kate Bartlett reports from Johannesburg.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统将于下周亚太经济峰会期间在中国会见中国国家主席习近平。这次会议可能会因为美国芯片制造商英伟达(Nvidia)董事长黄仁勋与中国间谍有染的指控而蒙上阴影。正如凯特·巴特利特 (Kate Bartlett) 在约翰内斯堡报道的那样，美国和中国正处于一场人工智能竞赛之中，两国还在许多其他领域展开竞争，包括在矿产资源丰富的非洲。

paras.en: KATE BARTLETT, BYLINE: In Africa, the greenback has long been king.
paras.zh: 凯特·巴特利特连线：在非洲，美元长期以来一直是王者。

paras.en: BARTLETT: Zimbabwe's Victoria Falls Stock Exchange trades exclusively in U.S. dollars, and most everyday transactions on the street are also in dollars, a legacy of the hyperinflation that devastated the country's own currency two decades ago.
paras.zh: 巴特利特：津巴布韦的维多利亚瀑布证券交易所只以美元进行交易，街上的大多数日常交易也是以美元进行的，这是二十年前摧毁该国货币的恶性通货膨胀的遗产。

paras.en: BARTLETT: Directly across the border in Zambia, it's long been a similar situation, but this is changing, as this recent Zambian government advert points out.
paras.zh: 巴特利特：在赞比亚边境，长期以来一直存在类似的情况，但正如赞比亚政府最近的广告所指出的那样，这种情况正在发生变化。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED COMMENTATOR: Zambia has officially become the first African nation to accept China's yuans, also known as RMB, for the payment of mine taxes and royalties.
paras.zh: 身份不明的评论员：赞比亚正式成为第一个接受中国人民币支付矿税和特许权使用费的非洲国家。

paras.en: BARTLETT: And it's not only Zambia that's conducting business in RMB. China is, by far, Africa's biggest trading partner, and now more and more African countries are turning to the Chinese yuan for trade and to pay their debt. According to Cobus van Staden, a China expert at the South Africa (ph) Institute of International Affairs in Johannesburg, the trend reflects China's growing influence across the continent.
paras.zh: 巴特利特：不仅仅是赞比亚在用人民币开展业务。迄今为止，中国是非洲最大的贸易伙伴，现在越来越多的非洲国家开始使用人民币进行贸易和偿还债务。约翰内斯堡南非国际事务研究所中国问题专家科布斯·范斯塔登表示，这一趋势反映出中国在整个非洲大陆的影响力日益增强。

paras.en: COBUS VAN STADEN: The interesting thing is going to be whether this starts to chip away at dollar dominance in certain specific commodity fields, whether increasingly, we're going to be looking at lithium or copper or cobalt and see those fields becoming more and more de-dollarized over time. We'll have to see.
paras.zh: COBUS VAN STADEN：有趣的是，这是否会开始削弱美元在某些特定商品领域的主导地位，无论是越来越多，我们都会关注锂、铜或钴，并看到这些领域随着时间的推移变得越来越去美元化。我们得看看。

paras.en: BARTLETT: These are some of the critical minerals the U.S. and China are competing for on the continent. Christian-Géraud Neema is an editor with the China-Global South Project, an Africa-based think tank which tracks Beijing's influence across the continent. He points out several African countries, like Kenya, have already restructured their debt to China and are now paying it in yuan rather than dollars.
paras.zh: 巴特利特：这些是美国和中国在非洲大陆争夺的一些关键矿产。克里斯蒂安·热罗·尼玛 (Christian-Géraud Neema) 是中国-全球南方项目的编辑，该项目是一家总部位于非洲的智库，追踪北京在非洲大陆的影响力。他指出，肯尼亚等几个非洲国家已经重组了对中国的债务，现在用人民币而不是美元偿还。

paras.en: CHRISTIAN-GÉRAUD NEEMA: When you have China as your main trade partners, it really just makes sense for many African countries now to starting to trade with China in renminbi instead of trading with China in U.S. dollar.
paras.zh: CHRISTIAN-GÉRAUD NEEMA：当中国成为主要贸易伙伴时，许多非洲国家现在开始用人民币与中国进行贸易，而不是用美元与中国进行贸易，这确实是有意义的。

paras.en: BARTLETT: Paul Nantulya, of the Africa Center for Strategic Studies in Washington, points to another sign of the yuan's growing reach. More major African banks are now offering direct yuan payments and currency conversion, like South Africa's Standard Bank.
paras.zh: 巴特利特：华盛顿非洲战略研究中心的保罗·南图亚指出了人民币影响力不断扩大的另一个迹象。更多的非洲主要银行现在提供直接人民币支付和货币兑换服务，例如南非标准银行。

paras.en: PAUL NANTULYA: It is expanding. It is growing. I expect it to continue growing over the next five to 10 years.
paras.zh: PAUL NANTULYA：它正在扩大。它正在增长。我预计它在未来五到十年内将继续增长。

paras.en: BARTLETT: That's attractive to importers and exporters on the continent as it saves them double conversion costs. The Trump administration's shifting tariff policies have only strengthened the case for African businesses to diversify away from the dollar. Still, Nantulya is circumspect.
paras.zh: 巴特利特：这对非洲大陆的进口商和出口商很有吸引力，因为它可以为他们节省双倍的转换成本。特朗普政府不断变化的关税政策只会强化非洲企业摆脱美元、实现多元化的理由。尽管如此，南图亚还是很谨慎。

paras.en: NANTULYA: I don't think you're going to see a rapid departure from the use of the U.S. dollar, however. What I think you're going to see instead, and what you're already seeing right now, is diversification.
paras.zh: NANTULYA：不过，我认为人们不会看到美元的使用迅速消失。我认为你将会看到的，以及你现在已经看到的，是多元化。

paras.en: BARTLETT: In other words, the dollar isn't about to be displaced, but across Africa, the alternatives are rapidly gaining ground.
paras.zh: 巴特利特：换句话说，美元不会被取代，但在整个非洲，其他替代货币正在迅速普及。

paras.en: (SOUNDBITE OF RONNIE FOSTER'S "MYSTIC BREW")
paras.zh: （罗尼·福斯特的“神秘酿造”原声片段）

articles.title: Engine failure forces Sen Ashley Moody’s American Airlines flight to divert for emergency landing

paras.en: An American Airlines flight carrying Sen. Ashley Moody, R-Fla., was diverted to Orlando after a reported engine failure, according to a spokesperson for the senator's office.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州共和党参议员阿什利·穆迪 (Ashley Moody) 的一架美国航空公司 (American Airlines) 航班在报告发动机故障后改道飞往奥兰多，参议员办公室发言人称。

paras.en: American Airlines Flight 496 was heading from Tampa to Washington, D.C., when it was forced to divert to Orlando.
paras.zh: 美国航空 496 号航班正从坦帕飞往华盛顿特区，被迫改道飞往奥兰多。

paras.en: Moody missed Senate votes on Monday night due to the incident, but the aircraft landed safely, her office said.
paras.zh: 穆迪办公室表示，由于该事件，穆迪错过了周一晚上的参议院投票，但飞机安全着陆。

paras.en: "Earlier today, the American Airlines flight she was on had engine failure and had to make an emergency landing in Orlando," the spokesperson said in a statement to Punchbowl News.
paras.zh: 这位发言人在给 Punchbowl News 的一份声明中表示：“今天早些时候，她乘坐的美国航空航班发动机出现故障，不得不紧急降落在奥兰多。”

paras.en: "She got on the next available flight to DC but unfortunately landed just after votes closed," the spokesperson continued.
paras.zh: 发言人继续说道：“她搭乘了下一趟飞往华盛顿的航班，但不幸的是，她在投票结束后就降落了。”

paras.en: The spokesperson added that Moody is "grateful to the pilots and crew for getting everyone on board on the ground safely."
paras.zh: 该发言人补充说，穆迪“感谢飞行员和机组人员让所有人安全抵达地面。”

paras.en: It was not immediately clear if anyone was hurt in the incident.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚是否有人在这起事件中受伤。

paras.en: Fox News Digital has reached out to Moody's office and American Airlines for comment.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道已联系穆迪办公室和美国航空征求评论。

paras.en: This is a developing story. Check back for updates.
paras.zh: 这是一个发展的故事。请回来查看更新。

articles.title: Chargers, Justin Herbert finally win first game of season after brutal mistake by Ravens star

paras.en: It’s happened, folks. There is no longer a winless team in the 2026 NFL season.
paras.zh: 事情已经发生了，伙计们。 2026 年 NFL 赛季不再有不胜的球队。

paras.en: The Los Angeles Chargers have notched their first victory of the season, as Justin Herbert and company took down the Baltimore Ravens on "Monday Night Football," spoiling Jacoby Brissett’s first game with his new team since being traded by the Arizona Cardinals.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶闪电队取得了本赛季的首场胜利，贾斯汀·赫伯特和他的队友在《周一橄榄球之夜》中击败了巴尔的摩乌鸦队，破坏了雅各比·布里塞特被亚利桑那红雀队交易后与新球队的第一场比赛。

paras.en: The Ravens’ troubles continue, as they dropped their fifth straight game and fell to 4-6 on a season that seems to be slipping away from them.
paras.zh: 乌鸦队的麻烦还在继续，他们连续第五场比赛失利，战绩跌至 4 胜 6 负，赛季似乎正在离他们而去。

paras.en: Meanwhile, head coach Jim Harbaugh and everyone within the Chargers organization can all breathe a sigh of relief knowing they’ve at least avoided some embarrassing NFL history.
paras.zh: 与此同时，主教练吉姆·哈博和闪电队内部的每个人都可以松一口气，因为他们知道他们至少避免了一些令人尴尬的 NFL 历史。

paras.en: It was no easy feat against a desperate Baltimore team trying to right the ship in any way possible, especially at quarterback. The injuries to Lamar Jackson and Tyler "Snoop" Huntley have decimated the team’s offense, leading to a necessary trade with the Cardinals, who had made Brissett their third-string signal caller amid their own struggles.
paras.zh: 面对一支绝望的巴尔的摩队，他们试图以任何可能的方式扭转局面，尤其是在四分卫方面，这并不是一件容易的事。拉马尔·杰克逊和泰勒·“史努比”·亨特利的受伤严重削弱了球队的进攻，导致他们与红雀队进行了必要的交易，红雀队在自己的困境中让布里塞特成为了他们的第三线信号呼叫者。

paras.en: The Ravens and its fan base hoped Brissett would be the answer to get the ball rolling again, but he was forced into a late fourth-quarter comeback scenario, down 23-20, but with ample time, and timeouts, to work with.
paras.zh: 乌鸦队及其球迷希望布里塞特能成为让球队再次运转起来的答案，但他被迫在第四节末卷土重来，以20-23落后，但有充足的时间和暂停来应对。

paras.en: On second-and-10 from their own 39-yard line, Brissett hit receiver Zay Flowers right between the numbers, and he crossed midfield into Chargers territory. But, instead of trying to get out of bounds or simply taking the first down and heading back to the huddle, Flowers tried fighting through two Chargers defenders.
paras.zh: 在距离本方 39 码线的第 2 号和第 10 号位置，布里塞特击中了接球手扎伊·弗劳尔斯 (Zay Flowers)，他穿过中场进入闪电队的区域。但是，弗劳尔斯并没有试图出界，也没有简单地拿下第一个球，然后回到人群中，而是尝试突破两名闪电队的防守球员。

paras.en: Tarheeb Still made a tremendous play, stripping Flowers of the ball and Elijah Molden fell on it for a clutch fumble recovery with 2:11 to play in the game.
paras.zh: 塔希布·斯蒂尔 (Tarheeb Still) 发挥出色，抢断了弗劳尔斯 (Flowers) 的球权，比赛还剩 2 分 11 秒时，伊利亚·莫尔登 (Elijah Molden) 在关键时刻掉球后恢复。

paras.en: All Herbert needed to do was kill the clock with a couple of first downs, and considering he was doing everything in his power to will his team to victory on Monday night, he knew he was just about at the finish line.
paras.zh: 赫伯特所需要做的就是通过几次首轮击球来消磨时间，考虑到他正在竭尽全力让他的球队在周一晚上取得胜利，他知道自己即将到达终点线。

paras.en: Los Angeles did their jobs, with Herbert finding Charlie Kolar for a first down just after the two-minute warning. It was enough to melt the clock down to 18 seconds, and with no timeouts on their end, the Ravens couldn’t muster the miracle Hail Mary to avoid disaster as the pass from Brissett was batted down near the goal line as the clock struck zero.
paras.zh: 洛杉矶队完成了他们的任务，赫伯特在两分钟警告后找到查理·科拉尔（Charlie Kolar）率先进攻。这足以让时间缩短到 18 秒，而且由于他们没有暂停，乌鸦队无法召唤奇迹万福玛丽来避免灾难，因为当时间指向零时，布里塞特的传球在球门线附近被击中。

paras.en: In the end, the Ravens are not going to win games if Derrick Henry is rushing for only 10 total yards on 10 carries. He had nine rushing yards on 16 carries back in 2023 during his time with the Tennessee Titans, but this performance, or lack thereof, was astonishing to see, especially for a Ravens home game and considering the circumstances heading into Monday night.
paras.zh: 最终，如果德里克·亨利 10 次冲球仅推进 10 码，乌鸦队将无法赢得比赛。 2023 年，他在田纳西泰坦队效力期间，16 次冲球推进 9 码，但这种表现（或者说缺乏这种表现）令人惊讶，尤其是在乌鸦队的主场比赛中，并考虑到周一晚上的情况。

paras.en: No team rushing for a team total of 16 yards can function as an offense, and that’s credit to a hungry Chargers defense that certainly did their part in keeping Brissett uncomfortable in his first start for Baltimore.
paras.zh: 没有一支球队能冲出 16 码的总距离来发挥进攻作用，这要归功于闪电队饥饿的防守，这无疑让布里塞特在巴尔的摩的第一次首发中感到不舒服。

paras.en: Brissett did, however, look better once settled in the second half. He finished 33-of-49 for 340 yards, though he was unable to notch his first touchdown pass while throwing an interception. He seems to like tight end Mark Andrews, who had a team-high eight catches and 82 yards.
paras.zh: 然而，布里塞特在下半场稳定下来后看起来确实好多了。他49投33中，推进340码，但在拦截时未能完成第一次达阵传球。他似乎很喜欢近端锋马克·安德鲁斯，他有全队最高的 8 次接球和 82 码。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Herbert was 12-of-18 for 129 yards through the air, but it was his legs that played such a vital role in the Chargers getting things done on the road. He was a running threat, rushing for 51 yards on seven carries with the game’s first touchdown under his belt.
paras.zh: 与此同时，赫伯特 18 投 12 中，空中推进 129 码，但他的双腿在闪电队在客场取得胜利的过程中发挥了至关重要的作用。他是一个跑动威胁，7次冲球冲出51码，并完成了本场比赛的第一次达阵。

paras.en: Then, Omarion Hampton had the running performance he’s been searching for since the start of the season, racking up 105 yards on 22 carries with his own touchdown run.
paras.zh: 随后，奥马里昂·汉普顿 (Omarion Hampton) 展现了他自赛季开始以来一直在寻找的跑动表现，22 次冲球推进 105 码，达阵。

paras.en: While Harbaugh and his Chargers can celebrate and look to build off their first win, head coach Jesse Minter and his staff are back to the drawing board as their playoff hopes hang in the balance after handing their opponent its first win of the year.
paras.zh: 虽然哈博和他的闪电队可以庆祝并期待取得他们的首场胜利，但主教练杰西·明特和他的工作人员又回到了绘图板，因为在让对手取得今年的首场胜利后，他们的季后赛希望悬而未决。

articles.title: Duffy vows to modernize aging air traffic system after nationwide ground stop

paras.en: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy on Monday said he plans to modernize America’s aging air traffic control system and build new architecture that is "worthy of America" following a nationwide ground stop on Friday that stranded more than a million passengers.
paras.zh: 美国交通部长肖恩·达菲周一表示，他计划对美国老化的空中交通管制系统进行现代化改造，并建造“值得美国”的新建筑，此前周五全国范围内的一次地面停留导致超过一百万名乘客滞留。

paras.en: During an appearance on Fox News' "Hannity," Duffy said he wants to build a brand-new modern architecture "of a resilient telecom network."
paras.zh: 达菲在福克斯新闻的“汉尼提”节目中露面时表示，他希望建立一个“弹性电信网络”的全新现代架构。

paras.en: "Congress did give me $12.5 billion. That’s for radar and radios. I am well on my way to deploying all that money. You can’t buy this off the shelf, so I’ve ordered it. As it is delivered, we pay for it, and we deploy it into the NAS. But what’s really important is the next phase of the investment," he told host Sean Hannity on Monday.
paras.zh: “国会确实给了我 125 亿美元。用于雷达和无线电。我正在部署所有这些资金。你无法购买现成的产品，所以我已经订购了它。交付后，我们付款，然后将其部署到 NAS 中。但真正重要的是下一阶段的投资，”他周一告诉主持人 Sean Hannity。

paras.en: The $12.5 billion in congressional funding is part of a broader effort to modernize the nation's air traffic control system, including communications, surveillance and other infrastructure.
paras.zh: 国会拨款 125 亿美元是国家空中交通管制系统现代化更广泛努力的一部分，其中包括通信、监视和其他基础设施。

paras.en: "So you saw a telecom issue on Friday. We’re replacing old copper wires with fiber, but this is an old architecture of a network. You’ve seen Newark go down. You’ve seen Dallas go down. You saw all of New York go down just a couple of months ago because of telecom issues. I want to build a brand-new architecture of a resilient telecom network that’s worthy of 2026 and worthy of America," he continued.
paras.zh: “所以你在周五看到了电信问题。我们正在用光纤取代旧的铜线，但这是一个旧的网络架构。你已经看到了纽瓦克的瘫痪。你已经看到了达拉斯的瘫痪。就在几个月前，你还看到整个纽约都因为电信问题而瘫痪。我想建立一个全新的弹性电信网络架构，无愧于 2026 年，无愧于美国，”他继续说道。

paras.en: Duffy added that the department needs new software.
paras.zh: 达菲补充说，该部门需要新的软件。

paras.en: "The software we use to manage our airplanes in the airspace was built in the 1990s. It works. It works well. But if we’re going to drive more safety and more efficiency, we need brand-new software," he explained.
paras.zh: “我们用来管理空域飞机的软件是在 20 世纪 90 年代开发的。它很有效。效果很好。但如果我们要提高安全性和效率，我们需要全新的软件，”他解释道。

paras.en: The secretary also said intelligence agencies found no evidence that a cyberattack forced the ground stop on Friday and that the Federal Aviation Administration was investigating whether a network problem, router issue or installation error caused the system failure.
paras.zh: 国务卿还表示，情报机构没有发现任何证据表明周五是网络攻击迫使飞机停止飞行，联邦航空管理局正在调查是否是网络问题、路由器问题或安装错误导致了系统故障。

paras.en: The FAA is working with contractor L3Harris, which installed the router in question and is assisting with the investigation at its Florida laboratory.
paras.zh: FAA 正在与承包商 L3Harris 合作，该公司安装了有问题的路由器，并正在佛罗里达州实验室协助调查。

paras.en: "We had all of our intelligence agencies, at Donald Trump’s direction, talk on Friday night," Duffy said. "No one was seeing any kind of hack into our system. And we’ve now secured the router."
paras.zh: 达菲说：“我们所有的情报机构在唐纳德·特朗普的指示下于周五晚上进行了交谈。” “没有人发现我们的系统受到任何形式的黑客攻击。我们现在已经保护了路由器的安全。”

paras.en: "We’re doing an analysis in Florida with L3Harris and the FAA. I actually asked the FBI to come in just to make sure, to put people at ease, that this was not a hack. So I think it was a network problem or a router problem or an installation error," he continued.
paras.zh: “我们正在佛罗里达州与 L3Harris 和 FAA 进行分析。实际上，我要求 FBI 介入只是为了确保让人们放心，这不是黑客攻击。所以我认为这是网络问题、路由器问题或安装错误，”他继续说道。

paras.en: The roughly five-hour ground stop affected more than 1.5 million passengers whose flights were scheduled to depart on Friday afternoon and evening. More than 12,000 flights were canceled that day, according to the FAA, while delays and cancellations continued through the weekend.
paras.zh: 此次大约五个小时的地面停留影响了超过 150 万名原定于周五下午和晚上起飞的航班的乘客。据美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 称，当天有超过 12,000 架航班被取消，而整个周末延误和取消的情况仍在继续。

articles.title: Hundreds arrested in anti-Trump protests in Philippines amid anger over Iran war and AI pact
articles.author: Tom McIlroy in Manila

paras.en: Hundreds of people have been arrested in heated demonstrations against Donald Trump in Manila, as authorities braced for more protests ahead of the US president’s arrival in the city for a leaders’ summit.
paras.zh: 数百人在马尼拉针对唐纳德·特朗普的激烈示威活动中被捕，当局准备在美国总统抵达该市参加领导人峰会之前迎接更多抗议活动。

paras.en: Organisers claim as many as 10,000 people will join protests against Trump in the Philippine capital on Tuesday, when he will attend the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) summit. The crowds are expected to try to walk to the summit site.
paras.zh: 组织者声称，周二将有多达 1 万人参加在菲律宾首都举行的针对特朗普的抗议活动，届时特朗普将出席东南亚国家联盟 (ASEAN) 峰会。预计人群将尝试步行前往山顶。

paras.en: Authorities have arrested nearly 300 people in widespread protests in held in the days leading up to the summit, with large parts of the capital closed off and tight security in place.
paras.zh: 峰会前几天举行的大规模抗议活动中，当局逮捕了近 300 人，首都大部分地区被封锁，安全措施严密。

paras.en: Some burned effigies of Trump and faced off with police officers armed with batons and shields. Slogans on placards called the American leader the world’s “number one terrorist” in protests held on Monday.
paras.zh: 一些人烧毁了特朗普的肖像，并与手持警棍和盾牌的警察对峙。在周一举行的抗议活动中，标语牌上的标语称这位美国领导人是世界“头号恐怖分子”。

paras.en: Demonstrators angry at the cost-of-living and energy shock caused by the Iran war, and the new US-led Pax Silica initiative on AI and critical minerals, tried to reach the summit at the Philippine International Convention Center on Monday, but were blocked by police.
paras.zh: 示威者对伊朗战争造成的生活成本和能源冲击以及美国主导的关于人工智能和关键矿产的新的“硅和平”倡议感到愤怒，周一试图前往菲律宾国际会议中心举行的峰会，但遭到警方阻止。

paras.en: Pax Silica has sparked tensions in the Philippines over plans to build a tech hub outside Manila that critics say will affect water and energy supplies, and displace members of the Ayta Indigenous community.
paras.zh: Pax Silica 因计划在马尼拉郊外建立一个科技中心而在菲律宾引发紧张局势，批评者称该中心将影响水和能源供应，并取代艾塔原住民社区的成员。

paras.en: Large sections of central Manila were closed to the public as part of the security cordon, and public holidays instituted for the Asean summit.
paras.zh: 作为安全警戒线的一部分，马尼拉市中心的大部分地区对公众关闭，并为东盟峰会设立公共假期。

paras.en: Trump will meet with the leaders of Australia, Japan and India on Tuesday night before heading to Shenzhen, China, on Wednesday. There he will attend the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) summit and hold trilateral talks with China’s president, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin of Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普将于周二晚上会见澳大利亚、日本和印度领导人，然后于周三前往中国深圳。他将在那里出席亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会，并与中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京举行三边会谈。

paras.en: The backlash against Trump follows the ouster of Nvidia boss Jensen Huang, and allegations members of the US administration, including the commerce secretary, Howard Lutnick, knew about his affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 英伟达老板黄仁勋被赶下台，美国政府成员（包括商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克）被指控了解他与一名所谓的中国间谍的恋情，随后特朗普遭到强烈反对。

paras.en: Trump’s delegation was expected to include businessman Elon Musk.
paras.zh: 特朗普代表团预计将包括商人埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)。

paras.en: Protest leader Renato Reyes blamed the arrests in Manila on the heavy handed response of the government on the president, Ferdinand Marcos Jr., calling Monday the largest single day of police arrests since Marcos came to office in 2022.
paras.zh: 抗议领袖雷纳托·雷耶斯 (Renato Reyes) 将马尼拉的逮捕归咎于政府对小费迪南德·马科斯 (Ferdinand Marcos Jr.) 总统的严厉回应，并称周一是自 2022 年马科斯上任以来警察逮捕人数最多的一天。

paras.en: “It is really crazy that the Philippine government is rolling out the red carpet for someone who has been so flatly rejected by the American people,” Reyes said.
paras.zh: 雷耶斯说：“菲律宾政府为一个遭到美国人民断然拒绝的人铺上红地毯，这真是太疯狂了。”

paras.en: “Trump started a war that devastated the global economy and pushed oil prices in the Philippines to historic highs. It has caused untold suffering on the Filipino people.
paras.zh: “特朗普发动的战争摧毁了全球经济，并将菲律宾的油价推至历史高位。它给菲律宾人民带来了难以言表的痛苦。

paras.en: “So yes, Trump will have to pay for his crimes and he will have to be answerable, not just to the American people, but to the people of the world.”
paras.zh: “所以，是的，特朗普将不得不为他的罪行付出代价，他必须对美国人民负责，而且对世界人民负责。”

paras.en: The Philippine national police said some officers were injured during confrontations with demonstrators opposed to the summit, including when objects were allegedly thrown at officers.
paras.zh: 菲律宾国家警察表示，一些警察在与反对峰会的示威者的对抗中受伤，据称有人向警察投掷物体。

paras.en: Pax Silica will include a technology hub planned at New Clark City in Tarlac, about 120km from Manila.
paras.zh: Pax Silica 将包括一个技术中心，计划位于打拉省的新克拉克市，距离马尼拉约 120 公里。

paras.en: Intended to bolster western stocks of AI technology and reduce “excessive dependencies” on single source supply chains, including from China, Pax Silica will provide chips and critical minerals to 25 participating signatory governments.
paras.zh: Pax Silica 旨在增强西方人工智能技术库存并减少对单一来源供应链（包括中国）的“过度依赖”，将向 25 个参与签署国政府提供芯片和关键矿物。

paras.en: Amnesty Philippines said demonstrations should not be forcibly or violently dispersed.
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织菲律宾表示，不应强行或暴力驱散示威活动。

paras.en: “Reports of arrests during the protests demand immediate scrutiny,” director Ritz Lee Santos III said.
paras.zh: 导演里兹·李·桑托斯三世 (Ritz Lee Santos III) 表示：“抗议期间逮捕的报道需要立即进行审查。”

paras.en: “Authorities must explain the specific grounds for each arrest and any continued detention. Anyone detained solely for peacefully exercising their rights must be released immediately.”
paras.zh: “当局必须解释每次逮捕和任何持续拘留的具体理由。任何仅仅因为和平行使权利而被拘留的人都必须立即释放。”

articles.title: ‘Disgusted by it’: body of Melbourne Cup race horse found dumped in Sydney skip bin
articles.author: Jordyn Beazley

paras.en: The body of a horse that placed eighth in Australia’s Melbourne Cup two weeks ago and recently fell ill has been found dumped in skip bin in Sydney.
paras.zh: 两周前在澳大利亚墨尔本杯上获得第八名、最近生病的一匹马的尸体被发现被扔在悉尼的垃圾箱里。

paras.en: The horse So You Are, a five-year-old gelding, was put down after it suffered from a severe bout from colic and was taken to hospital on Monday for surgery.
paras.zh: 这匹五岁的骟马“So You Are”因严重绞痛而被安乐死，并于周一被送往医院接受手术。

paras.en: The same day, Gregg Jowett posted to his personal social media account a video that showed a dead horse inside a skip bin in Sydney. Guardian Australia has chosen not to publish the video.
paras.zh: 同一天，格雷格·乔伊特在他的个人社交媒体账户上发布了一段视频，视频显示悉尼的一个垃圾箱里有一匹死马。澳大利亚卫报选择不发布该视频。

paras.en: “I’m at the tip. It’s a fucking horse. They tipped a horse in the fucking bin at the tip,” he can be heard saying in the video.
paras.zh: “我在尖端。那是一匹该死的马。他们把一匹马扔进了尖端的垃圾箱里，”视频中可以听到他说道。

paras.en: “[I’m] quite shocked about that; that’s not normal. Please let me know if I’m wrong, but that’s not normal.”
paras.zh: “[我]对此感到非常震惊；这不正常。如果我错了，请告诉我，但这不正常。”

paras.en: Jowett later told Guardian Australia he didn’t know when he found the horse that it was So You Are, or a horse that had competed in Australia’s most famous race, the Melbourne Cup.
paras.zh: 乔伊特后来告诉《澳大利亚卫报》，他不知道什么时候发现了这匹马，它就是“So You Are”，或者是一匹参加过澳大利亚最著名的比赛——墨尔本杯的马。

paras.en: The horse’s trainer, Bjorn Baker, said the handling of So You Are’s remains had compounded an already devastating loss.
paras.zh: 这匹马的驯马师比约恩·贝克 (Bjorn Baker) 表示，对“原来如此”遗体的处理让本已惨重的损失雪上加霜。

paras.en: “Like everyone who has seen the footage, I am deeply distressed by the apparent handling of So You Are’s remains,” he said in a statement.
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中说：“和所有看过这段视频的人一样，我对《原来如此》遗体的明显处理方式深感悲痛。”

paras.en: “He was a much-loved horse, and he deserved to be treated with dignity and respect after his death.
paras.zh: “他是一匹深受喜爱的马，他死后应该得到尊严和尊重。

paras.en: “I understand the hospital facility REC Equine Specialists are investigating the circumstances, and I expect a full explanation of what occurred.
paras.zh: “据我所知，医院机构 REC 马术专家正在调查这一情况，我希望对所发生的事情做出全面解释。

paras.en: “My thoughts remain with [So You Are breeders] the Ramsey family, and with all my staff, for whom this has compounded an already devastating loss.”
paras.zh: “我的思念仍然与拉姆齐家族（所以你们是饲养员）以及我的所有员工在一起，这对他们来说已经是毁灭性的损失。”

paras.en: Dr Jonathan Lumsden, the managing partner of REC Equine Specialists, which treated So You Are after he was brought to the service with colic, apologised “unreservedly for the distress caused by footage shared on social media today”.
paras.zh: REC Equine Specialists 的管理合伙人乔纳森·拉姆斯登 (Jonathan Lumsden) 博士在 So You Are 因肠绞痛被送往医院后接受了治疗，他“对今天社交媒体上分享的视频所造成的痛苦毫无保留地道歉”。

paras.en: “Despite the best efforts of our veterinary team, he could not be saved and was humanely euthanised under anaesthesia,” Lumsden said.
paras.zh: 拉姆斯登说：“尽管我们的兽医团队尽了最大努力，但他还是没能获救，只能在麻醉下人道地安乐死。”

paras.en: “After his death, So You Are was collected by our contracted provider and taken to a licensed landfill. He should have been promptly and respectfully buried.
paras.zh: “他去世后，《So You Are》被我们的签约供应商收集并送往有执照的垃圾填埋场。他应该被及时、有尊严地埋葬。

paras.en: “What happened was unacceptable and disrespectful to So You Are and to everyone who cared for him. We are deeply sorry.
paras.zh: “所发生的事情是不可接受的，也是对 So You Are 和所有关心他的人的不尊重。我们深感抱歉。

paras.en: “So You Are was in our care. We did not carry out the burial ourselves, but we chose the provider and the arrangements, and we take full responsibility for that. We should have known exactly how horses were handled after leaving our hospital, and we did not. That process is not good enough, and it must change.
paras.zh: “所以你是在我们的照顾下。我们没有自己进行埋葬，但我们选择了提供者和安排，我们对此承担全部责任。我们应该确切地知道马匹离开医院后是如何处理的，但我们没有。这个过程不够好，必须改变。

paras.en: “We have spoken with So You Are’s owners and trainer to apologise personally,” he said. “We are working with our disposal provider and the facility operators, together with Racing NSW, to establish how this happened and to put in processes to ensure it never happens again.”
paras.zh: “我们已经与 So You Are 的老板和教练进行了交谈，并亲自道歉，”他说。 “我们正在与我们的处置提供商和设施运营商以及新南威尔士州赛马会合作，以确定这种情况是如何发生的，并制定流程以确保这种情况不再发生。”

paras.en: Lumsden said the service had, effective immediately, stopped using the contract provider and was undertaking a review of how other providers care for horses after death.
paras.zh: 拉姆斯登表示，该服务已立即停止使用合同提供商，并正在审查其他提供商如何照顾死后的马匹。

paras.en: “Out of respect for So You Are and those who loved him, we ask that the footage not be shared further,” Lumsden said.
paras.zh: 拉姆斯登说：“出于对《So You Are》和那些爱他的人的尊重，我们要求不要进一步分享这段视频。”

paras.en: David Harris, the minister for gaming and racing, said Racing NSW had launched an investigation into the incident.
paras.zh: 博彩和赛马部长戴维·哈里斯 (David Harris) 表示，新南威尔士州赛马会已对此事件展开调查。

paras.en: “This is a concerning incident, the racing legislative framework and Racing NSW as the sport’s controlling body has measures in place to safeguard racing integrity and animal welfare,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这是一个令人担忧的事件，赛马立法框架和新南威尔士州赛马局作为这项运动的控制机构，已采取措施保障赛马诚信和动物福利。”

paras.en: Georgie Purcell, the Animal Justice party MP for northern Victoria,
paras.zh: 乔治·珀塞尔 (Georgie Purcell)，维多利亚州北部动物正义党议员，

paras.en: said the incident should “force serious questions the industry’s so-called duty of care”.
paras.zh: 表示这一事件应该“迫使人们严肃质疑该行业所谓的谨慎义务”。

paras.en: “The racing industry breeds these horses and profits for them but fails the most basic obligation to treat them with dignity after death,” she said.
paras.zh: “赛马业培育这些马匹并为它们带来利润，但却没有履行在它们死后给予它们尊严的最基本义务，”她说。

articles.title: Ukraine critically damages Kerch bridge linking occupied Crimea with Russia
articles.author: Luke Harding and Dan Sabbagh in Kyiv

paras.en: Ukraine has critically damaged the Kerch bridge linking occupied Crimea with Russia in an overnight missile attack, in what Ukrainian officials say is a symbolic blow to the Kremlin.
paras.zh: 乌克兰在夜间导弹袭击中严重损坏了连接被占领克里米亚和俄罗斯的刻赤大桥，乌克兰官员称这是对克里姆林宫的象征性打击。

paras.en: Footage showed a Ukrainian Flamingo cruise missile seconds before it hit the road and railway crossing, followed by an explosion. The strike follows an earlier attack on Monday that targeted an arch across its central section.
paras.zh: 视频显示，一枚乌克兰火烈鸟巡航导弹在击中公路和铁路道口前几秒钟，随后发生爆炸。这次袭击是在周一早些时候发生的一次袭击事件之后发生的，袭击目标是其中央部分的一个拱门。

paras.en: Russian forces struck two major bridges in Kyiv that straddle the Dnipro River late on Monday, along with some other critical infrastructure, amid drone and missile attacks across Ukraine.
paras.zh: 周一晚间，在乌克兰各地的无人机和导弹袭击中，俄罗斯军队袭击了基辅横跨第聂伯河的两座主要桥梁以及其他一些关键基础设施。

paras.en: Ukraine has declared that the Kerch bridge, built eight years ago after Vladimir Putin’s 2014 annexation of Crimea and known officially as the Crimean Bridge, is illegal. It has repeatedly attempted to destroy it, with a truck bomb in 2022 and a sea drone strike the following year.
paras.zh: 乌克兰宣布刻赤大桥是非法的，该大桥是弗拉基米尔·普京 2014 年吞并克里米亚后八年前建造的，正式名称为克里米亚大桥。它曾多次试图摧毁它，2022 年使用卡车炸弹，次年使用海上无人机袭击。

paras.en: The latest drone and missile barrage appears to have succeeded, after months in which Ukrainian unmanned systems forces have systematically knocked out the peninsula’s multi-layered air defences.
paras.zh: 在乌克兰无人系统部队几个月来系统性地摧毁了半岛的多层防空系统之后，最新的无人机和导弹攻击似乎已经取得了成功。

paras.en: The Kremlin-appointed governor of Crimea, Sergey Aksyonov, confirmed the bridge, which was temporarily closed on Monday, was no longer usable. “The enemy has once again attacked the Crimean Bridge. At the moment, traffic has been suspended,” he posted.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫任命的克里米亚总督谢尔盖·阿克肖诺夫证实，这座周一暂时关闭的大桥已无法使用。 “敌人再次袭击克里米亚大桥。目前交通已暂停，”他发帖称。

paras.en: He added on Telegram: “We ask residents and visitors in Crimea to refrain from traveling toward the bridge and to take these restrictions into account when planning their routes.”
paras.zh: 他在 Telegram 上补充道：“我们要求克里米亚居民和游客不要前往大桥，并在规划路线时考虑到这些限制。”

paras.en: Photos on Tuesday suggest that a 227-metre road arch span has fallen into the Kerch strait, which connects the Sea of Azov with the Black Sea. The adjacent railway arch span has also sustained damage.
paras.zh: 周二的照片显示，一个227米长的公路拱桥已经落入连接亚速海和黑海的刻赤海峡。邻近的铁路拱跨也遭到破坏。

paras.en: Ukrainian commentators say the massive steel arch cannot easily be replaced. The closure of the bridge means that traffic from Crimea can travel out of the peninsula only via a land corridor through occupied southern Ukraine, vulnerable to Ukrainian drones.
paras.zh: 乌克兰评论员表示，巨大的钢拱门无法轻易更换。大桥的关闭意味着来自克里米亚的交通只能通过一条穿过被占领的乌克兰南部的陆地走廊离开克里米亚半岛，而该走廊很容易受到乌克兰无人机的攻击。

paras.en: The debris appears to have blocked the main navigable route beneath the bridge, used by maritime traffic from the Sea of Azov and the ports of Berdiansk and Mariupol. The channel is 120 metres wide and 8.3 metres deep. Submerged steel struts could prevent large vessels from passing until the debris is removed.
paras.zh: 这些碎片似乎堵塞了桥下的主要航行路线，该路线用于亚速海以及别尔江斯克和马里乌波尔港口的海上交通。航道宽120米，深8.3米。淹没的钢支柱可能会阻止大型船只通过，直到残骸被清除。

paras.en: Ukrainian observers were gleeful at the bridge’s long-awaited destruction. They pointed out that Ukraine’s armed forces could hit the bridge again to prevent repair work from being carried out. Serhii Sternenko, a former adviser to the defence ministry in Kyiv, wrote: “In response to your many questions. Yes, the bridge is fucked.”
paras.zh: 乌克兰观察家对这座桥期待已久的被毁感到高兴。他们指出，乌克兰武装部队可能会再次袭击大桥，以阻止修复工作的进行。基辅国防部前顾问谢尔希·斯特年科(Serhii Sternenko)写道：“为了回答你的许多问题。是的，这座桥完蛋了。”

paras.en: In Kyiv, loud explosions could be heard as Russian forces struck two bridges over the Dnipro River. The mayor of the Ukrainian capital, Vitali Klitschko, wrote on Telegram that according to “preliminary information, there have been hits on the north and south bridges in the capital”. There were water and power cuts in parts of the city, he added later.
paras.zh: 在基辅，当俄罗斯军队撞上第聂伯河上的两座桥梁时，可以听到巨大的爆炸声。乌克兰首都市长维塔利·克里琴科在Telegram上写道，根据“初步信息，首都南北桥均遭到撞击”。他后来补充说，该市部分地区停水停电。

paras.en: Russian forces launched a series of attacks on bridges crossing the river earlier this month and in October.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯军队本月早些时候和十月对跨河桥梁发动了一系列袭击。

paras.en: A Russian missile attack had injured three people in the region of Cherkasy and also targeted Kharkiv, Ukraine’s second-biggest city, local officials said on Telegram.
paras.zh: 当地官员在 Telegram 上表示，俄罗斯导弹袭击造成切尔卡瑟地区三人受伤，乌克兰第二大城市哈尔科夫也受到袭击。

paras.en: Russia’s defence ministry claimed on Tuesday its forces had carried out a massive overnight strike on Ukrainian military-industrial facilities, transport infrastructure in Kyiv and Zaporizhzhia and the Cherkasy and Dnipropetrovsk regions.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部周二声称，其部队对基辅和扎波罗热以及切尔卡瑟和第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克地区的乌克兰军工设施、交通基础设施进行了大规模的夜间袭击。

paras.en: The ministry said the strikes had also targeted energy facilities, port infrastructure and vessels used by Ukraine’s armed forces.
paras.zh: 该部表示，袭击还针对能源设施、港口基础设施和乌克兰武装部队使用的船只。

paras.en: The Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, said earlier on Monday that intelligence showed Russia’s military was planning strikes for Monday evening and throughout Tuesday.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基周一早些时候表示，情报显示俄罗斯军方正计划在周一晚上和整个周二发动袭击。

paras.en: Russian defence ministry data from Monday showed that an overnight Ukrainian drone barrage on was the biggest since the start of full-scale war in 2022.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部周一的数据显示，乌克兰夜间无人机袭击是自 2022 年全面战争爆发以来最大规模的一次。

paras.en: Zelenskyy also said on Monday that Ukraine had held new online talks with the US presidential envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, as well as European representatives, on the prospects of ending the war with Russia.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周一还表示，乌克兰已与美国总统特使史蒂夫·维特科夫和贾里德·库什纳以及欧洲代表就结束与俄罗斯战争的前景举行了新的线上会谈。

paras.en: Kushner said progress had been made toward an agreement, though important challenges remain to end the war that Russia started by invading Ukraine in February 2022. Moscow annexed the Black Sea Crimea peninsula in 2014.
paras.zh: 库什纳表示，达成协议方面已经取得了进展，但结束俄罗斯 2022 年 2 月入侵乌克兰引发的战争仍面临重大挑战。莫斯科于 2014 年吞并了黑海克里米亚半岛。

articles.title: Vance says he will decide 'sometime next year' about 2028 US presidential run

paras.en: US Vice-President JD Vance has said he will make a decision "sometime next year" about whether or not he will run for president in 2028.
paras.zh: 美国副总统万斯表示，他将在“明年某个时候”就是否参加 2028 年总统竞选做出决定。

paras.en: In an interview with Fox News, Vance would not provide a timeline on making a determination, but signaled he is not in a hurry to make up his mind.
paras.zh: 在接受福克斯新闻采访时，万斯没有提供做出决定的时间表，但表示他并不急于做出决定。

paras.en: "I haven't made a decision. We'll figure it out sometime next year," Vance said. When pressed by host Laura Ingraham, he added: "When I make a decision, I'll be all in on whatever that decision is."
paras.zh: “我还没有做出决定。我们会在明年某个时候做出决定，”万斯说。当主持人劳拉·英格拉汉姆追问时，他补充道：“当我做出决定时，无论这个决定是什么，我都会全力以赴。”

paras.en: The comments came amid growing interest in Vance's next moves in the weeks since voters handed both President Donald Trump and Republicans a resounding defeat in the midterm elections.
paras.zh: 自从选民在中期选举中让唐纳德·特朗普总统和共和党都惨败以来，几周来人们对万斯下一步行动的兴趣日益浓厚。

paras.en: People in Vance's orbit who have spoken to the BBC said the November elections did not change the timeline around his decision-making process for 2028. He is expected to run but allies believe he could wait several months to make a final decision.
paras.zh: 与 BBC 交谈过的万斯周边人士表示，11 月的选举并没有改变他 2028 年决策过程的时间表。预计他将参选，但盟友认为他可能要等待几个月才能做出最终决定。

paras.en: Speculation about Vance's White House aspirations began the moment President Trump selected him as his 2024 running mate. The pick positioned Vance, who entered the White House as one of the youngest vice-presidents in US history, as the most likely heir to Trump's Make America Great Again (Maga) movement.
paras.zh: 从特朗普总统选择万斯作为 2024 年竞选搭档的那一刻起，关于万斯入主白宫的猜测就开始了。作为美国历史上最年轻的副总统之一入主白宫的万斯被选中，成为特朗普“让美国再次伟大”（Maga）运动最有可能的继承人。

paras.en: But while serving in office, Vance has carefully avoided discussing his own political ambitions.
paras.zh: 但在任职期间，万斯小心翼翼地避免讨论自己的政治野心。

paras.en: He kept that up during the midterms, when supporters frequently interrupted his campaign speeches to urge him to run in 2028. Vance's stock response was that Republicans needed to focus on the election at hand in November.
paras.zh: 他在中期选举期间一直坚持这一立场，当时支持者经常打断他的竞选演讲，敦促他参加 2028 年的竞选。万斯一贯的反应是，共和党人需要专注于 11 月份即将举行的选举。

paras.en: But with the midterms in the rearview mirror, and Republicans eager to move on from their 2026 drubbing, the next election at hand is now the 2028 presidential race.
paras.zh: 但随着中期选举成为过去，共和党人渴望摆脱 2026 年的惨败，下一场选举现在是 2028 年的总统竞选。

paras.en: Vance would likely jump to the top of the Republican primary field whenever he launches his bid, should he choose to run. But the contest is expected to be a competitive process with a large field of candidates.
paras.zh: 如果万斯选择参选，每当他发起竞选时，他很可能会跃居共和党初选榜首。但预计比赛将是一个竞争激烈的过程，候选人范围广泛。

paras.en: Numerous other high-profile Republicans are rumoured to be interested in running or have said publicly that they are mulling a White House bid.
paras.zh: 据传，许多其他知名共和党人也有兴趣参选，或公开表示他们正在考虑入主白宫。

paras.en: The list includes Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Senator Ted Cruz of Texas, outgoing Florida Governor and 2024 hopeful Ron DeSantis, and former New Jersey Governor Chris Christie, among others.
paras.zh: 该名单包括国务卿马可·卢比奥、德克萨斯州参议员特德·克鲁兹、即将卸任的佛罗里达州州长和 2024 年候选人罗恩·德桑蒂斯以及前新泽西州州长克里斯·克里斯蒂等。

paras.en: Trump has praised Vance and Rubio on several occasions, while also insisting that he is not sure who he will endorse in 2028 - or if he will weigh in at all.
paras.zh: 特朗普曾多次赞扬万斯和卢比奥，同时坚称他不确定自己会在 2028 年支持谁，或者是否会参与其中。

paras.en: The president's endorsement would be influential with the Maga base. But the midterms revealed widespread frustration with many of his second-term policies, complicating the path forward for potential candidates like Vance who are tied to Trump's agenda.
paras.zh: 总统的支持将对马加基地产生影响。但中期选举显示，人们对他的许多第二任期政策普遍感到沮丧，这使得像万斯这样与特朗普议程相关的潜在候选人的前进道路变得复杂化。

paras.en: Vance blamed the midterm results on the war with Iran in a post-election social media post. In it, he also mapped out a plan for winning back Republican voters, which included ending the war and focusing on the economy.
paras.zh: 万斯在选举后的社交媒体帖子中将中期结果归咎于与伊朗的战争。在其中，他还制定了一项赢回共和党选民的计划，其中包括结束战争和关注经济。

paras.en: The message was widely seen as a first step by Vance to distance himself from Trump ahead of a 2028 run.
paras.zh: 这一信息被广泛认为是万斯在 2028 年竞选之前与特朗普保持距离的第一步。

paras.en: In the Fox News interview, Vance reiterated his view that the war came with a "political cost", but said it has not damaged his relationship with Trump.
paras.zh: 在接受福克斯新闻采访时，万斯重申了他的观点，即战争带来了“政治成本”，但表示这并没有损害他与特朗普的关系。

paras.en: "There's no daylight" on the Iran war between Trump and senior administration officials including himself, Vance said.
paras.zh: 万斯说，特朗普和包括他本人在内的高级政府官员之间的伊朗战争“没有光明”。

paras.en: He added that Trump would not let the conflict become a "forever war" and said the administration would not let the war, which was launched by the US and Israel in February 2026, even become "a two-year commitment".
paras.zh: 他补充说，特朗普不会让这场冲突成为“永远的战争”，并表示政府不会让美国和以色列于2026年2月发动的这场战争甚至成为“两年的承诺”。

paras.en: Vance also discussed the nationwide air traffic outrage last week, which brought air travel across the US to a standstill for several hours. The vice-president called on lawmakers to fix the issue in the final weeks of the current congressional session.
paras.zh: 万斯还讨论了上周全国范围内的空中交通骚乱，该事件导致美国各地的航空旅行陷入停滞几个小时。副总统呼吁立法者在本届国会会议的最后几周解决这个问题。

paras.en: He also touched on the scandal engulfing Nvidia, its former CEO Jensen Huang and its implications for US-China relations. Vance said there was still no "clarity" about the accuracy of reports that a woman with whom Huang reportedly had an affair with was indeed a Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 他还谈到了英伟达及其前首席执行官黄仁勋的丑闻及其对中美关系的影响。万斯表示，目前还不清楚与黄有染的一名女性确实是中国间谍的报道的准确性。

paras.en: "There is a lack of clarity about it. I don't know and [Trump] doesn't know whether this woman was a spy or not," Vance said.
paras.zh: “这件事尚不清楚。我不知道，[特朗普]也不知道这个女人是否是间谍，”万斯说。

articles.title: Ukraine accuses Russia of targeting rescue operation after 'double-tap' strike kills 72

paras.en: Ukrainian officials have accused Russia of targeting rescue and recovery operations two weeks after a deadly "double-tap" strike at a village close to the front line killed at least 72 people.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员指责俄罗斯在前线附近的一个村庄发生致命的“双击”袭击并造成至少 72 人死亡两周后，将救援和恢复行动作为目标。

paras.en: Ukraine says Russia carried out two attacks in succession on a humanitarian aid centre in the village of Komyshuvakha on 2 November - including the use of what it said was a 3,000kg (6,600lb) aerial bomb on a shelter where residents had fled for safety.
paras.zh: 乌克兰称，俄罗斯于 11 月 2 日连续对 Komyshuvakha 村的一个人道主义援助中心发动了两次袭击，其中包括对居民避难所使用了据称重 3,000 公斤（6,600 磅）的航空炸弹。

paras.en: Verified images posted in the days after the attack show damage to emergency vehicles and excavation equipment at the site.
paras.zh: 袭击发生后几天发布的经过验证的图像显示，现场的应急车辆和挖掘设备遭到损坏。

paras.en: The State Emergency Service of Ukraine (DSNS) told BBC Verify there have been multiple Russian strikes during the rescue.
paras.zh: 乌克兰国家紧急服务局 (DSNS) 告诉 BBC verify，在救援过程中，俄罗斯多次发动袭击。

paras.en: The DSNS said three police officers, four workers and two rescue dogs were injured while five vehicles were damaged.
paras.zh: DSNS 表示，三名警察、四名工人和两只救援犬受伤，五辆汽车受损。

paras.en: "Due to the threat of repeated shelling, emergency workers are constantly forced to periodically suspend work and retreat to a safe place," it added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“由于反复炮击的威胁，紧急救援人员不断被迫定期暂停工作并撤退到安全的地方。”

paras.en: The DSNS said the death toll had risen to at least 72 people making it one of the deadliest single incidents since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.
paras.zh: DSNS 表示，死亡人数已上升至至少 72 人，成为自 2022 年 2 月俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以来最致命的单一事件之一。

paras.en: Oleksiy, an intelligence officer investigating the incident for Ukraine's SBU security service, who asked to be identified only by his first name, said rescue vehicles were "clearly marked" and accused Russia of "deliberately destroying humanitarian equipment".
paras.zh: 乌克兰 SBU 安全部门负责调查这一事件的情报官员奥莱克西 (Oleksiy) 要求仅透露自己的名字。他表示，救援车辆上有“清晰的标记”，并指责俄罗斯“故意摧毁人道主义设备”。

paras.en: He added the village's infrastructure and the people still living in Komyshuvakha are also being systematically targeted by drones and bombs. Oleksiy accused Russian forces of "outright terror against civilians, against peaceful residents" to make life on the front line impossible.
paras.zh: 他补充说，该村的基础设施和仍然居住在 Komyshuvakha 的人们也成为无人机和炸弹系统性攻击的目标。奥莱克西指责俄罗斯军队“对平民和和平居民进行公然恐怖”，使前线的生活变得不可能。

paras.en: BBC Verify has confirmed videos being shared by Ukrainian police that show rescue workers at the scene shouting "drone, drone" and running for cover on the day after the 2 November attack. A group can also be seen treating a victim.
paras.zh: BBC verify 已证实乌克兰警方分享的视频显示，11 月 2 日袭击发生后的第二天，救援人员在现场高喊“无人机，无人机”并奔跑寻找掩护。还可以看到一群人在治疗受害者。

paras.en: Bodies are still to be recovered from the rubble, Oleksiy said. "The enemy knows perfectly well that what is being carried out there is essentially a humanitarian operation to search for the dead."
paras.zh: 奥莱克西说，尸体仍有待从废墟中打捞出来。 “敌人非常清楚，那里正在开展的行动本质上是一场搜寻死者的人道主义行动。”

paras.en: BBC Verify has asked the Russian Ministry of Defence for comment specifically about the Komyshuvakha attacks but has not received a response.
paras.zh: BBC verify 已要求俄罗斯国防部就 Komyshuvakha 袭击事件发表具体评论，但尚未收到回应。

paras.en: A general statement released on 2 November by the Russian MoD said it had targeted energy and transport infrastructure used by the Ukrainian military across the country.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部 11 月 2 日发布的一份一般性声明称，其目标是乌克兰军队在全国各地使用的能源和运输基础设施。

paras.en: While there are no military or industrial facilities in Komyshuvakha it is close to a key route used for Ukrainian troop movements, supplies and evacuations. The village was previously reported to have been struck by the Russians on 28 October.
paras.zh: 虽然科梅舒瓦卡没有军事或工业设施，但它靠近乌克兰军队调动、补给和疏散的主要路线。此前有报道称，该村庄于 10 月 28 日遭到俄罗斯人的袭击。

paras.en: Fears of second strike heard on police radios
paras.zh: 警方无线电中听到对第二次罢工的担忧

paras.en: Local people headed to the shelter area on 2 November after being told by a local Telegram group that aid would be distributed between 10:00 and 12:00 local time (08:00-10:00 GMT). Ukrainian authorities said an initial strike, at 09:45 local time, hit buildings above ground killing one woman.
paras.zh: 11 月 2 日，当地民众得知当地 Telegram 群组将在当地时间 10:00 至 12:00（格林威治标准时间 08:00-10:00）分发援助物资后，前往避难区。乌克兰当局表示，当地时间 09:45 的首次袭击击中了地面建筑物，造成一名妇女死亡。

paras.en: Bodycam footage, released by Ukrainian police in edited segments and analysed by BBC Verify, shows people trying to free a casualty from the rubble before declaring she had died.
paras.zh: 乌克兰警方以经过剪辑的片段发布了随身摄像机的录像，并由 BBC verify 进行了分析，显示人们在宣布一名伤员死亡之前试图将她从废墟中救出。

paras.en: Throughout the footage, warnings of an impending second strike can be heard on police radios with increasing urgency until people are instructed to run to the underground shelter.
paras.zh: 在整个镜头中，警察无线电中可以听到即将发生的第二次袭击的警告，而且越来越紧迫，直到人们被指示跑到地下避难所。

paras.en: The same footage, which was taken around an hour after the first attack, goes on to show people in a shelter. As they wait in silence a large explosion can be heard and the video goes dark.
paras.zh: 相同的镜头是在第一次袭击发生大约一个小时后拍摄的，随后显示了避难所中的人们。当他们静静等待时，可以听到巨大的爆炸声，视频随即变暗。

paras.en: Aftermath video filmed later shows bodies being recovered from a large crater immediately above the shelter. Twisted iron and rubble from the structure below can be seen beneath the surface.
paras.zh: 后来拍摄的视频显示，尸体从避难所上方的一个大陨石坑中被打捞出来。在地表之下可以看到下面结构中扭曲的铁和碎石。

paras.en: Funerals have been held almost daily for the victims of the attack, including locals working to administer aid distribution, those seeking to collect it and soldiers who officials say arrived to assist with rescue efforts.
paras.zh: 几乎每天都会为袭击受害者举行葬礼，其中包括负责分发援助物资的当地人、寻求领取援助物资的人以及官员称抵达协助救援工作的士兵。

paras.en: Trevor Ball, bomb disposal expert at intelligence firm at Armament Research Services, said a crater seen in the footage was consistent with the damage and depth left by a FAB-3000, a 3,000kg Russian bomb which can destroy underground structures.
paras.zh: 军备研究服务情报公司的炸弹处理专家特雷弗·鲍尔表示，视频中看到的弹坑与 FAB-3000 留下的损坏和深度一致，FAB-3000 是一种重 3000 公斤的俄罗斯炸弹，可以摧毁地下结构。

paras.en: His comments were echoed by Chris Proops, an ex-UK National Crime Agency investigator, who said the scale of the damage at the scene matched the size of the FAB-3000.
paras.zh: 英国国家犯罪局前调查员克里斯·普罗普斯 (Chris Proops) 也赞同他的言论，他表示现场损坏的规模与 FAB-3000 的大小相当。

paras.en: Ball and Proops both confirmed verified photos of munition fragments obtained by BBC Verify from Ukrainian authorities show part of a guidance kit that is compatible with the FAB-3000, which increases the weapon's accuracy and allows it to be fired from a greater distance from the target.
paras.zh: 鲍尔和普罗普斯均证实，BBC verify 从乌克兰当局获得的弹药碎片照片显示了与 FAB-3000 兼容的制导套件的一部分，该套件提高了武器的准确性，并使其能够从距目标更远的距离发射。

paras.en: International law experts told BBC Verify that Russia had committed a war crime if it knowingly attacked rescue workers.
paras.zh: 国际法专家告诉 BBC verify，如果俄罗斯故意袭击救援人员，则已犯下战争罪。

paras.en: Ben Saul, professor of international law at the University of Sydney, said this "appears to be either a deliberate attack on civilians or civilian objects - a war crime - or an indiscriminate attack - also a war crime".
paras.zh: 悉尼大学国际法教授本·索尔表示，这“似乎要么是对平民或民用物体的蓄意攻击——一种战争罪——要么是不分青红皂白的攻击——也是一种战争罪”。

paras.en: Prof Samuel Moyn of Yale University said "directly targeting rescuers or their equipment is a gross violation of international humanitarian law". Precautions have to be taken to ensure that strikes target combatants rather than others, he added.
paras.zh: 耶鲁大学塞缪尔·莫因教授表示，“直接针对救援人员或其设备的行为严重违反了国际人道法”。他补充说，必须采取预防措施，确保袭击目标是战斗人员而不是其他人。

paras.en: Additional reporting by Margaryta Maliukova, BBC Monitoring
paras.zh: BBC 监测部门 Margaryta Maliukova 的补充报道

articles.title: Crimea bridge shut after reported Ukrainian strike, as Russia hits Kyiv crossings

paras.en: A key bridge linking occupied Crimea and Russia is closed after reports a Ukrainian strike inflicted major damage, during a night in which the warring countries both targeted major crossings.
paras.zh: 据报道，乌克兰的袭击造成了重大破坏，连接被占领的克里米亚和俄罗斯的一座重要桥梁被关闭，交战双方都在夜间袭击了主要过境点。

paras.en: A former adviser to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky shared images purporting to show that a section of the Crimea bridge - also known as the Kerch Bridge - had collapsed into the water.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基的一位前顾问分享了一些图像，据称显示克里米亚大桥（也称为刻赤大桥）的一部分已经倒塌入水中。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said the Northern and Southern bridges, important routes over the Dnipro River, were closed after Russian ballistic missile strikes.
paras.zh: 与此同时，基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科表示，在俄罗斯弹道导弹袭击后，第聂伯河上的重要通道——南北大桥被关闭。

paras.en: Those attacks came a day after Ukraine began its most recent attempt to disable the Crimea bridge, a prized Kremlin asset seen as a symbol of Russia's occupation.
paras.zh: 这些袭击发生前一天，乌克兰开始最近一次试图破坏克里米亚大桥，克里米亚大桥是克里姆林宫的宝贵资产，被视为俄罗斯占领的象征。

paras.en: Two people were killed in that strike overnight on Sunday, the Russian-installed governor of Crimea said.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯任命的克里米亚总督表示，周日夜间的袭击造成两人死亡。

paras.en: Former Ukrainian adviser Anton Gerashchenko shared images and video footage appearing to show extensive damage to the bridge from the latest strike, with a support arch and road section seen protruding from the water below. BBC News has not independently verified those images.
paras.zh: 乌克兰前顾问安东·格拉什琴科（Anton Gerashchenko）分享的图像和视频片段显示，最近一次袭击对桥梁造成了严重损坏，支撑拱门和路段从下面的水中突出。 BBC 新闻尚未独立验证这些图像。

paras.en: The bridge, which has come under repeated attack by Ukrainian forces, was built by Russia after it invaded and annexed the peninsula in 2014, and was personally opened by Russian President Vladimir Putin in 2018.
paras.zh: 这座曾多次遭到乌克兰军队袭击的大桥是俄罗斯在2014年入侵并吞并乌克兰半岛后修建的，并于2018年由俄罗斯总统普京亲自揭幕。

paras.en: While Ukraine has been trying to increase the cost to Russia of waging war economically, by hitting oil refineries and depots, striking the Crimea bridge is an attempt do increase the political cost on Putin.
paras.zh: 尽管乌克兰一直试图通过打击炼油厂和油库来增加俄罗斯发动战争的经济成本，但袭击克里米亚大桥却是增加普京政治成本的一种尝试。

paras.en: The severity of the latest strike on the route, which is protected with multiple layers of aerial and maritime defences, is still not fully clear - but Russian state media reported a meeting was due to be held on Tuesday to discuss the situation.
paras.zh: 该航线受到多层空中和海上防御的保护，最近一次袭击的严重程度尚不完全清楚，但俄罗斯官方媒体报道称，定于周二召开会议讨论这一情况。

paras.en: Crimea's Moscow-backed governor Sergei Aksyonov confirmed on Telegram that traffic over the bridge had been suspended.
paras.zh: 莫斯科支持的克里米亚州长谢尔盖·阿克肖诺夫在电报上证实，大桥上的交通已经暂停。

paras.en: Zelensky had warned of major attacks in the days leading up to a meeting between the Chinese, US and Russian leaders in China's Shenzhen on Thursday.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在中国、美国和俄罗斯领导人周四在中国深圳举行会议之前的几天里警告称，可能会发生重大袭击。

paras.en: Loud explosions were heard in Kyiv just before midnight on Tuesday, with Klitschko saying shortly after that the city had suffered "damage to critical infrastructure systems" and disruption to heating and water.
paras.zh: 周二午夜前，基辅传来巨大的爆炸声，克里琴科不久后表示，该市“关键基础设施系统遭到破坏”，供暖和供水中断。

paras.en: Some of Kyiv's above-ground subway services were damaged in the overnight attacks, officials said, after civilians were told to go to civil defence shelters.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，在平民被告知前往民防避难所后，基辅的一些地上地铁服务在夜间袭击中遭到破坏。

paras.en: Residents of Kyiv typically shelter in the city's underground stations during air raids.
paras.zh: 基辅居民在空袭期间通常会在城市的地铁站避难。

paras.en: Eight major bridges span the Dnipro River connecting the western and eastern parts of Kyiv, and an estimated three million residents rely on the bridges to travel across the city.
paras.zh: 八座主要桥梁横跨第聂伯罗河，连接基辅西部和东部，估计有 300 万居民依靠这些桥梁穿越城市。

paras.en: These latest Russian strikes will cause major disruption, with traffic already reportedly building in the capital.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯最近的袭击将造成重大破坏，据报道首都的交通已经开始拥堵。

paras.en: Elsewhere, three people have been injured in a Russian missile attack in the Cherkast region, according to local officials.
paras.zh: 据当地官员称，在其他地方，切尔卡斯特地区发生的俄罗斯导弹袭击造成三人受伤。

paras.en: The latest round of tit-for-tat strikes came after US, Ukrainian and European officials held talks on ways to facilitate "direct engagement" between Russia and Europe to end the war.
paras.zh: 在美国、乌克兰和欧洲官员就如何促进俄罗斯和欧洲“直接接触”以结束战争举行会谈之后，发生了最新一轮针锋相对的袭击。

paras.en: Following Monday's meeting, US envoy Jared Kushner, President Trump's son-in-law, said the US was committed to providing Ukraine with a "strong, credible security guarantees", as well as a path towards EU membership.
paras.zh: 周一的会议结束后，特朗普总统的女婿、美国特使贾里德·库什纳表示，美国致力于为乌克兰提供“强有力、可信的安全保证”，以及通往欧盟成员资格的道路。

paras.en: He added that Nato "will remain a critical pillar of European security", and that preparations are underway for a further multilateral meeting "in the near future".
paras.zh: 他补充说，北约“仍将是欧洲安全的重要支柱”，并且正在为“在不久的将来”举行进一步的多边会议做准备。

paras.en: Zelensky said that the meeting was "difficult", adding that more needed to be done to support Ukraine's defence against Russian ballistic missile strikes, which he said were being provided by North Korea.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，这次会议“很困难”，并补充说，需要采取更多行动来支持乌克兰防御俄罗斯弹道导弹袭击，他说俄罗斯的弹道导弹袭击是由朝鲜提供的。

paras.en: The Ukrainian president has long called for European nations to be included in any peace talks, which he argues is necessary because of Kyiv's longer-term ambition to join the EU.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统长期以来一直呼吁欧洲国家参与任何和平谈判，他认为这是必要的，因为基辅有加入欧盟的长期雄心。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials said the final death toll from a Russian attack on the southern Ukrainian village of Kamyshuvakha earlier this month had reached 72.
paras.zh: 与此同时，乌克兰官员表示，本月早些时候，俄罗斯对乌克兰南部村庄 Kamyshuvakha 发动袭击，最终死亡人数已达 72 人。

paras.en: Four people are still considered missing after the bombing, which Ukrainian officials said was one of the deadliest individual attacks since the start of the war in 2022.
paras.zh: 爆炸事件发生后，仍有四人被认为失踪，乌克兰官员表示，这是自 2022 年战争爆发以来最致命的个人袭击事件之一。

paras.en: Footage, from a camera on one of the killed police officers, showed residents going to an underground shelter after the initial attack on 2 November. Soon after a blast is heard and flames are seen as the shelter is hit.
paras.zh: 一名被杀警察的摄像机拍摄的视频显示，11 月 2 日初次袭击后，居民前往地下避难所。不久后，听到爆炸声，避难所被击中，看到火焰。

paras.en: Ukrainian police said of those killed were police officers, "staff of the gymnasium, utility workers and medical personnel".
