articles.title: Vitamin B12 may hold the key to treating a rare genetic disorder

paras.en: Vitamin B12 may hold the key to treating a rare genetic disorder
paras.zh: 维生素 B12 可能是治疗罕见遗传性疾病的关键

paras.en: - Max Planck Institute for Biology of Ageing
paras.zh: - 马克斯·普朗克衰老生物学研究所

paras.en: - Scientists discovered that vitamin B12 largely reversed developmental abnormalities in worms carrying a genetic mutation linked to Verheij syndrome, a rare disorder that causes growth problems and developmental delays. Similar metabolic changes were identified in human patients, raising the possibility that this common vitamin could inspire new treatments for rare genetic diseases.
paras.zh: - 科学家发现，维生素 B12 在很大程度上逆转了携带 Verheij 综合征相关基因突变的线虫的发育异常，Verheij 综合征是一种导致生长问题和发育迟缓的罕见疾病。在人类患者中也发现了类似的代谢变化，这增加了这种常见维生素可能激发罕见遗传疾病新疗法的可能性。

paras.en: A surprising discovery involving vitamin B12 could open new possibilities for understanding and potentially treating rare genetic disorders. Researchers found that the vitamin can correct developmental problems in tiny worms carrying a genetic mutation associated with Verheij syndrome, a rare human condition that causes developmental delays, impaired growth, and short stature.
paras.zh: 一项涉及维生素 B12 的惊人发现可能为理解和治疗罕见遗传性疾病开辟新的可能性。研究人员发现，这种维生素可以纠正携带 Verheij 综合征相关基因突变的小蠕虫的发育问题，Verheij 综合征是一种罕见的人类疾病，会导致发育迟缓、生长受损和身材矮小。

paras.en: The findings center on a cellular process called RNA splicing, which helps prepare the genetic instructions cells use to produce proteins. During splicing, unnecessary portions of messenger RNA are removed, and the remaining sections are joined together in the correct order. When this process goes wrong, it can disrupt essential cellular functions and contribute to serious developmental disorders.
paras.zh: 这些发现集中在一种称为RNA剪接的细胞过程上，该过程有助于准备细胞用来产生蛋白质的遗传指令。在剪接过程中，信使 RNA 中不必要的部分被去除，剩余部分以正确的顺序连接在一起。当这个过程出现问题时，它会破坏基本的细胞功能并导致严重的发育障碍。

paras.en: Mutations in genes responsible for splicing can cause conditions such as Verheij syndrome. To better understand the effects of these genetic changes, scientists investigated how a related mutation affects growth and metabolism in a laboratory model.
paras.zh: 负责剪接的基因突变可能导致 Verheij 综合征等疾病。为了更好地了解这些基因变化的影响，科学家们在实验室模型中研究了相关突变如何影响生长和新陈代谢。

paras.en: Vitamin B12 Reverses Developmental Defects in Worms
paras.zh: 维生素 B12 可逆转线虫的发育缺陷

paras.en: The discovery emerged from experiments involving C. elegans, a tiny roundworm commonly used in biological research. The researchers were initially searching for previously unknown genes that influence lifespan when they began examining a mutation in a gene involved in RNA splicing. The same gene is associated with Verheij syndrome in humans.
paras.zh: 这一发现来自对秀丽隐杆线虫的实验，秀丽隐杆线虫是一种常用于生物研究的微小蛔虫。当研究人员开始检查参与 RNA 剪接的基因突变时，他们最初是在寻找以前未知的影响寿命的基因。相同的基因与人类 Verheij 综合征相关。

paras.en: Worms carrying the mutation developed problems resembling important features of the human disorder. Their growth slowed considerably, and they remained smaller than normal.
paras.zh: 携带突变的蠕虫会出现与人类疾病的重要特征类似的问题。它们的生长速度显着放缓，并且仍然小于正常水平。

paras.en: To investigate why this happened, the scientists conducted genetic screens and analyzed the worms' metabolism. They discovered that the mutation disrupted specific metabolic pathways that depend on vitamin B12 and are essential for healthy growth and normal cellular activity.
paras.zh: 为了调查发生这种情况的原因，科学家们进行了基因筛查并分析了线虫的新陈代谢。他们发现，这种突变破坏了依赖维生素 B12 的特定代谢途径，这些途径对于健康生长和正常细胞活动至关重要。

paras.en: The researchers then tested whether providing additional vitamin B12 could counteract these changes. Remarkably, the treatment restored the affected metabolic processes to normal and corrected the developmental abnormalities associated with the mutation.
paras.zh: 研究人员随后测试了提供额外的维生素 B12 是否可以抵消这些变化。值得注意的是，这种治疗使受影响的代谢过程恢复正常，并纠正了与突变相关的发育异常。

paras.en: "We were surprised to find that a change in a fundamental process of RNA processing had such a targeted effect on vitamin B12-dependent metabolism," says Jonathan Kölschbach, first author of the study. "Even more exciting was that we were able to largely correct the consequences of this change in the worm model using vitamin B12."
paras.zh: 该研究的第一作者 Jonathan Kölschbach 表示：“我们惊讶地发现 RNA 加工基本过程的变化对维生素 B12 依赖性代谢产生了如此有针对性的影响。” “更令人兴奋的是，我们能够使用维生素 B12 很大程度上纠正线虫模型中这种变化的后果。”

paras.en: Could Vitamin B12 Help Treat a Rare Genetic Disorder?
paras.zh: 维生素 B12 能否帮助治疗罕见的遗传性疾病？

paras.en: To explore whether their findings might also apply to people, the researchers examined publicly available datasets from human cells. They also worked with Hormos Dafsari, a neuropediatrician at the University Hospital Cologne, to collect blood samples from patients diagnosed with Verheij syndrome.
paras.zh: 为了探索他们的发现是否也适用于人类，研究人员检查了来自人类细胞的公开数据集。他们还与科隆大学医院的神经儿科医生霍尔莫斯·达夫萨里 (Hormos Dafsari) 合作，从诊断为 Verheij 综合征的患者身上采集血液样本。

paras.en: These investigations uncovered evidence of similar metabolic changes in humans, suggesting that the vitamin B12-related pathways affected in the worms may also play a role in the human disorder.
paras.zh: 这些研究发现了人类类似代谢变化的证据，表明线虫中受影响的维生素 B12 相关途径也可能在人类疾病中发挥作用。

paras.en: Although the results are promising, researchers have not yet established whether vitamin B12 supplementation can improve symptoms in people with Verheij syndrome. Additional studies will be necessary to determine whether the benefits observed in worms can be translated into a treatment for patients.
paras.zh: 尽管结果令人鼓舞，但研究人员尚未确定补充维生素 B12 是否可以改善 Verheij 综合征患者的症状。还需要进行更多的研究来确定在线虫中观察到的益处是否可以转化为对患者的治疗。

paras.en: The discovery also raises a broader possibility. Metabolic disruptions may contribute more substantially to diseases caused by faulty RNA splicing than scientists previously recognized. Understanding these connections could help researchers identify new therapeutic strategies, potentially extending beyond Verheij syndrome to other rare genetic conditions.
paras.zh: 这一发现还提出了更广泛的可能性。代谢紊乱对 RNA 剪接错误引起的疾病的影响可能比科学家之前认识到的更大。了解这些联系可以帮助研究人员确定新的治疗策略，有可能从 Verheij 综合征扩展到其他罕见的遗传疾病。

paras.en: "Our study is a good example of how basic research on model organisms can provide new insights into human diseases," says Adam Antebi, Director at the Max Planck Institute for Biology of Ageing and lead author of the study. "A fundamental biological question can thus give rise to a new approach that could also become medically relevant in the long term."
paras.zh: 马克斯·普朗克衰老生物学研究所所长、该研究的主要作者 Adam Antebi 表示：“我们的研究是一个很好的例子，说明模式生物的基础研究如何为人类疾病提供新的见解。” “因此，一个基本的生物学问题可以产生一种新的方法，从长远来看，这种方法也可能在医学上具有相关性。”

paras.en: Materials provided by Max Planck Institute for Biology of Ageing. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由马克斯·普朗克衰老生物学研究所提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Jonathan KÃ¶lschbach, Hormos S. Dafsari, Emily Baum, Anna LÃ¶hrke, Chun Kew, Ivan Dikic, Wenming Huang, Adam Antebi. Vitamin B12 alleviates spliceosomopathy via phospholipid remodeling. Nature Communications, 2026; 17 (1) DOI: 10.1038/s41467-026-76295-9
paras.zh: - Jonathan Kölschbach、Hormos S. Dafsari、Emily Baum、Anna Löhrk​​e、Chun Kew、Ivan Dikic、Wenming Huang、Adam Antebi。维生素 B12 通过磷脂重塑缓解剪接病。自然通讯，2026； 17 (1) DOI: 10.1038/s41467-026-76295-9

articles.title: Elon Musk says SpaceX’s Starship, already the largest rocket on Earth, will get even bigger with next-gen V4 model
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: As usual, SpaceX and its founder Elon Musk are thinking big.
paras.zh: 与往常一样，SpaceX 及其创始人埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 雄心勃勃。

paras.en: The company recovered the upper stage of its Starship megarocket for the first time ever on Saturday (Nov. 14), plucking it out of the sky with the "chopstick" arms of its Texas launch tower.
paras.zh: 该公司于11月14日（星期六）首次回收了其星舰巨型火箭的上级，用其位于得克萨斯州的发射塔的“筷子”臂将其从空中抓取。

paras.en: It was a huge moment for SpaceX, bringing its vision of full and rapid rocket reuse much closer to reality. But Elon Musk isn't one to dwell on the past or rest on laurels, so he soon outlined an even more ambitious future for Starship.
paras.zh: 对于 SpaceX 来说，这是一个重要的时刻，让其全面、快速地重复利用火箭的愿景更加接近现实。但埃隆·马斯克不会沉迷于过去或安于现状，因此他很快就为 Starship 描绘了更加雄心勃勃的未来。

paras.en: "Starship V4 will be ~70m [230 feet] long, which is roughly a 40% length increase and allows >60% more propellant load," Musk said via X, the social media platform he owns, on Sunday evening (Nov. 15). "Engine count will be raised to 9, with 3 more Raptor-Vacuum engines added, and these will be higher-thrust V4 engines."
paras.zh: “星舰 V4 的长度将约为 70m [230 英尺]，长度增加了大约 40%，并且允许增加 60% 以上的推进剂负载，”马斯克周日晚上（11 月 15 日）通过他拥有的社交媒体平台 X 表示。 “发动机数量将增加到 9 台，并增加 3 台 Raptor-Vacuum 发动机，这些发动机将是推力更高的 V4 发动机。”

paras.en: The current version of Starship — the one that launched Friday (Nov. 13) on the vehicle's 15th test flight — is the V3. It's the largest and most powerful rocket ever built, standing 408 feet (124 m) tall when fully stacked with its Super Heavy first stage and Ship upper stage.
paras.zh: Starship 的当前版本是 V3，该版本于周五（11 月 13 日）进行了第 15 次试飞。它是迄今为止建造的最大、最强大的火箭，与超重型第一级和船上级完全堆叠时高 408 英尺 (124 m)。

paras.en: V3's Ship is 171 feet (52 m) tall and features six of SpaceX's Raptor V3 engines. (The similarly reusable Super Heavy V3 booster is powered by 33 Raptors.) So, as Musk noted in his post, the V4 Ship will be quite an upgrade in size and power.
paras.zh: V3 的飞船高 171 英尺（52 m），配备六台 SpaceX 的 Raptor V3 发动机。 （类似的可重复使用的超重型 V3 助推器由 33 个猛禽提供动力。）因此，正如马斯克在他的帖子中指出的那样，V4 船将在尺寸和功率上进行相当大的升级。

paras.en: Starship Die Cast Rocket Model Was $47.99 Now $39.99 on Amazon.
paras.zh: 星舰压铸火箭模型在亚马逊上原价 47.99 美元，现价 39.99 美元。

paras.en: Even if you can't see SpaceX's Starship in person, you can score a model of your own. Standing at 13.77 inches (35 cm), this is a 1:375 ratio of SpaceX's Starship as a desktop model. The materials here are alloy steel and it weighs just 225g.
paras.zh: 即使您无法亲眼目睹 SpaceX 的星际飞船，您也可以获得自己的模型。高度为 13.77 英寸（35 厘米），这是 SpaceX 星际飞船桌面模型的 1:375 比例。这里的材料是合金钢，重量仅为225克。

paras.en: To provide a little perspective about that vehicle's planned dimensions: The V4 Ship will be the same height as a fully stacked Falcon 9, SpaceX's workhorse two-stage rocket, and much broader: Ship is 30 feet (9 m) across, while the Falcon 9's payload fairing is 17.1 feet (5.2 m) wide.
paras.zh: 为了提供有关该飞行器计划尺寸的一些视角：V4 飞船的高度将与完全堆叠的猎鹰 9 号（SpaceX 的主力两级火箭）相同，并且要宽得多：飞船宽 30 英尺（9 m），而猎鹰 9 号的有效载荷整流罩宽 17.1 英尺（5.2 m）。

paras.en: This isn't the first we've heard about a V4 Starship. Back in August 2025, for example, Musk posted a graphic showing Starship's planned progression from the V2 to the V3 to the V4, which he said is expected to debut in 2027.
paras.zh: 这不是我们第一次听说 V4 星舰。例如，早在 2025 年 8 月，马斯克就发布了一张图表，显示 Starship 计划从 V2 发展到 V3 再到 V4，他表示预计将于 2027 年首次亮相。

paras.en: That slide pegs the future Starship's total height at 466 feet (142 m), 200 feet (61 m) of which would be Ship. But those numbers are out of date, Musk stressed in the post, saying that V4 is "probably closer to 150m height."
paras.zh: 该幻灯片将未来星舰的总高度确定为 466 英尺（142 m），其中 200 英尺（61 m）将是飞船。但马斯克在帖子中强调，这些数字已经过时，并表示 V4“可能接近 150m 的高度”。

paras.en: So, yeah: If all goes according to plan, the next Starship will be nearly 500 feet tall.
paras.zh: 所以，是的：如果一切按计划进行，下一艘星际飞船将接近 500 英尺高。

paras.en: The original Starship Flight 15 mission plan called for a double chopsticks catch, with both Super Heavy and Ship coming back to the launch tower for recovery.
paras.zh: 最初的 Starship Flight 15 任务计划要求使用双筷子捕获，Super Heavy 和 Ship 都会返回发射塔进行回收。

paras.en: This would have been feasible, as the catches were scheduled a day apart: Super Heavy would land just 6.5 minutes after launch, while Ship would circle Earth for 22.5 hours, and deploy a batch of SpaceX's Starlink V3 internet satellites, before coming home. (Ship ended up delivering the satellites as planned.)
paras.zh: This would have been feasible, as the catches were scheduled a day apart: Super Heavy would land just 6.5 minutes after launch, while Ship would circle Earth for 22.5 hours, and deploy a batch of SpaceX's Starlink V3 internet satellites, before coming home. （这艘船最终按计划交付了卫星。）

paras.en: The twofer didn't happen, however; Super Heavy experienced a low-fuel alarm and diverted to a Gulf of Mexico splashdown on Friday as a result. But that wasn't a huge deal, as SpaceX had already pulled off Super Heavy catches on three previous Starship flights.
paras.zh: 然而，这两种情况并没有发生。超重号遭遇低油警报，并因此于周五转向墨西哥湾溅落。但这并不是什么大事，因为 SpaceX 已经在之前的 3 次 Starship 飞行中实现了超重型捕获。

paras.en: The Ship catch was unprecedented, because it's been a taller order. Ship returns to Earth from orbit, so it comes in faster and hotter. SpaceX hadn't even tried the maneuver before Flight 15, so executing it was a very big deal.
paras.zh: 船舶捕获量是史无前例的，因为这是一个更高的要求。飞船从轨道返回地球，因此速度更快、温度更高。 SpaceX 在 15 号航班之前甚至没有尝试过这种机动，所以执行它是一件非常重要的事情。

paras.en: "That was the missing link," SpaceX's Dan Huot said during the company's Ship-landing webcast on Saturday. "We caught a Starship, and now everything changes."
paras.zh: “这就是缺失的环节，”SpaceX 的 Dan Huot 在周六该公司的船舶着陆网络广播中说道。 “我们抓住了一艘星舰，现在一切都变了。”

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

paras.zh: 评论前您必须确认您的公开显示名称

articles.title: Relive Starship’s historic Flight 15 with our best photos from launch and ‘Mechazilla’ tower catch
articles.author: Josh Dinner

paras.en: STARBASE, Texas — SpaceX has officially wrapped up the 15th test flight of its massive Starship rocket, successfully catching the vehicle's upper stage for the first time.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州 STARBASE——SpaceX 正式结束了其大型 Starship 火箭的第 15 次试飞，首次成功捕获了该火箭的上级。

paras.en: Flight 15 lifted off from SpaceX's Starbase facility here in South Texas on Friday (Nov. 13). The mission was billed as the first to bring both of Starship's stages, the Super Heavy booster and Ship upper stage, back to the launch site for recovery. And, while SpaceX was forced to divert Super Heavy's return to an off-shore splashdown (and explosion), the upper stage managed to survive its 22-hour jaunt in orbit and plunge through the atmosphere for a picture-perfect catch by the launch tower back at Starbase.
paras.zh: 周五（11 月 13 日），15 号航班从 SpaceX 位于德克萨斯州南部的 Starbase 设施起飞。该任务被宣传为首次将星舰的两个级（超重型助推器和飞船上级）带回发射场进行回收。而且，虽然 SpaceX 被迫将 Super Heavy 的返回方式改为离岸溅落（和爆炸），但上级成功在轨道上 22 小时的短途飞行中幸存下来，并冲入大气层，在 Starbase 的发射塔上拍摄到了完美的照片。

paras.en: It was the first-ever Ship catch, and a huge milestone toward SpaceX's ultimate goal: making Starship completely reusable.
paras.zh: 这是有史以来第一次捕获飞船，也是实现 SpaceX 最终目标的一个巨大里程碑：让星际飞船完全可重复使用。

paras.en: Liftoff occurred from Pad 2 at 5:47 p.m. EST (2247 GMT; 4:47 p.m. local time) on Friday, against a near cloudless blue sky. Super Heavy is powered by 33 Raptor 3 engines, which provide more than 18 million pounds of thrust at liftoff. And lift off the booster did.
paras.zh: 下午 5:47 从 2 号发射台升空。美国东部时间（格林威治标准时间 2247；当地时间下午 4:47），周五，蓝天万里。 Super Heavy 由 33 台 Raptor 3 发动机提供动力，起飞时可提供超过 1800 万磅的推力。然后升空了助推器。

paras.en: Starship roared off the pad under the power of those Raptors, pulsing visible shockwaves through the plume ejected from the rocket's flame trench.
paras.zh: 星舰在猛禽的力量下轰鸣着离开发射台，从火箭火焰沟中喷出的羽流发出可见的冲击波。

paras.en: The first couple minutes of flight went nominally; the vehicle climbed into the sky, gearing up for the hot-staging separation of Super Heavy and Ship — all of which was visible for miles, thanks to the clear Texas skies.
paras.zh: 飞行的最初几分钟只是名义上的；飞行器爬上天空，为超重型和船舶的热分离做好准备——由于德克萨斯州晴朗的天空，所有这些都在数英里外可见。

paras.en: Space.com's images taken from the media’s launch viewing area were shot on a Canon R5 Mark II, with an RF 200-800mm lens that made the sharp pictures of Starship’s liftoff and return possible from almost 4 miles away.
paras.zh: Space.com 从媒体发射观看区域拍摄的图像是用佳能 R5 Mark II 拍摄的，配有 RF 200-800mm 镜头，可以从近 4 英里外拍摄到星舰升空和返回的清晰照片。

paras.en: This mirrorless Canon has specs that make it one of the best cameras available right now, with impressive features and functionality, including a 45MP sensor and excellent high-ISO handling.
paras.zh: 这款佳能无反光镜相机的规格使其成为目前最好的相机之一，具有令人印象深刻的特性和功能，包括 45MP 传感器和出色的高 ISO 处理能力。

paras.en: Check our in-depth Canon R5 Mark II review.
paras.zh: 查看我们对佳能 R5 Mark II 的深入评测。

paras.en: A successful separation occurred at T+2:21 minutes, as Starship soared approximately 40 miles (65 km) overhead. Once disconnected from its booster, Ship increased its thrust and continued onward to space, while Super Heavy, reoriented for its boostback burn and return to Starbase.
paras.zh: T+2:21 分钟，星舰在头顶上空飞行约 40 英里（65 公里），成功分离。一旦与助推器断开连接，飞船就会增加推力并继续前往太空，而超重型则重新调整方向以进行助推燃烧并返回星际基地。

paras.en: That return, however, did not go entirely as planned. Super Heavy experienced a low-fuel alarm and autonomously shifted to an offshore splashdown rather than a catch attempt at Starbase.
paras.zh: 然而，这次回归并没有完全按计划进行。超重号遇到了低燃料警报，并自动转向近海溅落，而不是在星际基地进行捕获尝试。

paras.en: Super heavy performed its landing burn above the Gulf of Mexico before cutting its engines for a brief moment and exploding in a giant fireball.
paras.zh: 超重型飞机在墨西哥湾上空进行了着陆燃烧，然后短暂关闭了发动机并爆炸成一个巨大的火球。

paras.en: This was an intentional detonation, courtesy of the vehicle's flight termination system.
paras.zh: 这是一次故意爆炸，由飞行器的飞行终止系统提供。

paras.en: Ship continued on to low Earth orbit, where it deployed a payload of 26 upgraded Starlink Version 3 satellites. It was the second batch of V3 Starlinks delivered during Starship’s recent flight tests, each of which has added what SpaceX says is the equivalent of 10 Falcon 9 Starlink V2 satellite launches worth of data capacity to its orbital constellation.
paras.zh: 飞船继续进入近地轨道，在那里部署了 26 颗升级版星链第 3 版卫星的有效载荷。这是 Starship 最近的飞行测试期间交付的第二批 V3 Starlink，SpaceX 称每一批都增加了相当于 10 颗 Falcon 9 Starlink V2 卫星向其轨道星座发射的数据容量。

paras.en: Flight 15 was also Starship's second-ever mission to orbit, and its longest so far. Ship spent nearly a full day in orbit, circling Earth a total of 14 times. During its jaunt in space, the spacecraft cleared three separate check points, which allowed SpaceX the opportunity to divert the vehicle for an ocean splashdown if needed, and finally was given the green light to attempt the first-ever Ship tower catch.
paras.zh: 15 号航班也是 Starship 的第二次入轨任务，也是迄今为止最长的一次。飞船在轨道上度过了近一整天，共绕地球 14 圈。在太空短途旅行期间，飞船通过了三个独立的检查点，这使得 SpaceX 有机会在需要时转移飞船进行海洋溅落，并最终获得了尝试有史以来第一次船塔捕获的许可。

paras.en: At approximately 4:18 p.m. EST (2018 GMT, 3:18 p.m. local time in Texas) on Saturday (Nov. 14), the spacecraft broke through the cloud cover that blanketed the skies above Starbase as onlookers watched its bellyflop plunge toward the ground. Moments after becoming visible, Ship ignited its engines for a flip and burn maneuver, which oriented it upright and swung its trajectory into the tightening grip of the chopstick arms of Starbase's "Mechazilla" launch tower.
paras.zh: 下午 4 点 18 分左右美国东部时间（格林尼治标准时间 2018 年，得克萨斯州当地时间下午 3:18）周六（11 月 14 日），航天器突破了覆盖 Starbase 上空的云层，旁观者看着它的机腹坠落到地面。出现后不久，飞船就点燃了引擎进行翻转和燃烧机动，使其直立并将其轨迹摆动到Starbase“Mechazilla”发射塔的筷子臂的紧握处。

paras.en: After a slight sway back and forth suspended above Earth in Mechazilla's embrace, Ship came to a complete rest, hanging motionless as a historic milestone in SpaceX’s pursuit of fully reusable spaceflight.
paras.zh: 在 Mechazilla 的怀抱中悬浮在地球上空轻微来回摇摆后，Ship 完全静止，一动不动地悬挂着，这是 SpaceX 追求完全可重复使用的航天飞行的历史性里程碑。

paras.en: It hung there overnight as engineers, and even SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, inspected the spacecraft. Ship was lowered on Sunday (Nov. 15) and transported back to SpaceX's Starbase hanger bay for further checkouts.
paras.zh: 它挂在那里过夜，工程师们，甚至 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 都在检查这艘飞船。周日（11 月 15 日）飞船被放下并运回 SpaceX 的 Starbase 机库进行进一步检查。

paras.en: SpaceX has not yet said whether Ship 42 will fly again, but its return gives engineers a chance to examine how the spacecraft held up through launch, nearly a day in orbit and atmospheric reentry.
paras.zh: SpaceX 尚未透露 42 号飞船是否会再次飞行，但它的返回让工程师有机会检查飞船在发射、在轨运行近一天以及重返大气层期间的表现。

paras.en: Those findings will help inform upcoming flights as SpaceX ramps up production to continue testing Starship's capabilities.
paras.zh: 随着 SpaceX 提高产量以继续测试 Starship 的能力，这些发现将有助于为即将到来的飞行提供信息。

paras.en: Josh Dinner is Space.com's Spaceflight Staff Writer and a photographer with a passion for science and exploration. He has worked the space beat since 2016, covering the evolution of NASA's commercial spaceflight partnerships and crewed missions, planetary science missions, the Artemis program and humanity's return to the moon. He also enjoys building 1:144-scale model rockets and spacecraft. Find some of Josh's launch photography on Instagram, and follow him on X, where he mostly posts in haiku.
paras.zh: 乔什·丁纳 (Joshdinner) 是 Space.com 的 Spaceflight 特约撰稿人，也是一位热衷于科学和探索的摄影师。自 2016 年以来，他一直致力于太空领域的研究，报道了 NASA 商业航天合作伙伴关系和载人任务、行星科学任务、阿尔忒弥斯计划和人类重返月球的演变。他还喜欢建造 1:144 比例的火箭和航天器模型。在 Instagram 上查找 Josh 的一些首发照片，并在 X 上关注他，他主要在 X 上发布俳句。

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 16, 1974: The giant Arecibo Observatory in Puerto Rico broadcasts humanity's 1st interstellar message
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 16, 1974, humans sent their first message to the stars in an attempt to contact extraterrestrials.
paras.zh: 1974 年 11 月 16 日，人类向星星发送了第一条信息，试图联系外星人。

paras.en: They did this using what was then the largest radio telescope in the world, located at the Arecibo Observatory in Puerto Rico. A group of scientists led by Frank Drake and Carl Sagan sent their message to the M13 star cluster. The message was written in binary code and contained information about human DNA.
paras.zh: 他们使用当时世界上最大的射电望远镜（位于波多黎各阿雷西博天文台）完成了这项工作。由弗兰克·德雷克和卡尔·萨根领导的一组科学家向 M13 星团发送了他们的信息。该消息以二进制代码编写，包含有关人类 DNA 的信息。

paras.en: It also included figures of a human, the solar system and the Arecibo telescope. The idea was that if any aliens were to receive the signal and figure out how to decode it, they would know where it came from. Because M13 is 25,000 light-years away, it will take 25,000 years for any M13 aliens to hear our message — if they are even out there.
paras.zh: 它还包括人类、太阳系和阿雷西博望远镜的人物。这个想法是，如果任何外星人接收到信号并弄清楚如何解码它，他们就会知道它来自哪里。因为 M13 距离我们 25,000 光年，所以任何 M13 外星人都需要 25,000 年才能听到我们的信息——如果他们真的在那里的话。

paras.en: The Arecibo message is only one of several messages intended for extraterrestrials, but this signal sent from Puerto Rico in 1974 was humanity's first intentional olive branch to the stars. At the time, it was the most powerful broadcast ever beamed into space, according to the SETI Institute.
paras.zh: 阿雷西博信息只是发送给外星人的数条信息之一，但 1974 年从波多黎各发出的这一信号是人类第一个有意向星空发出的橄榄枝。据 SETI 研究所称，这是当时向太空发射的最强大的广播。

paras.en: "The broadcast was particularly powerful because it used Arecibo's megawatt transmitter attached to its 305 meter antenna," SETI wrote of the broadcast in a project over. "The emission was equivalent to a 20 trillion watt omnidirectional broadcast, and would be detectable by a SETI experiment just about anywhere in the galaxy, assuming a receiving antenna similar in size to Arecibo's."
paras.zh: “广播特别强大，因为它使用了连接到 305 米天线的阿雷西博兆瓦发射器，”SETI 在一个项目中这样描述广播。 “这种发射相当于 20 万亿瓦的全向广播，并且假设接收天线的大小与阿雷西博的天线相似，那么在银河系的任何地方都可以通过 SETI 实验检测到。”

paras.en: The message was designed by astronomy professor Frank Drake of Cornell University (who also developed the famed Drake Equation for alien life), as well as Cornnell graduate students Richard Isaacman and Linda May, and Arecibo staff member James Walker, with input from astronomer Carl Sagan and others, according to Cornell University.
paras.zh: 据康奈尔大学称，这条信息是由康奈尔大学天文学教授弗兰克·德雷克（他还提出了著名的外星生命德雷克方程）、康奈尔大学研究生理查德·艾萨克曼和琳达·梅以及阿雷西博工作人员詹姆斯·沃克设计的，天文学家卡尔·萨根和其他人也提供了意见。

paras.en: The message included 1,679 bits that were arranged in 73 lines of 23 characters per line, all prime numbers, with the broadcast lasting less than 3 minutes, according to SETI.
paras.zh: 据 SETI 称，该消息包含 1,679 个比特，排列成 73 行，每行 23 个字符，全部为素数，广播持续时间不到 3 分钟。

paras.en: As of 2026, the message should have traveled about 52 light-years (1 light-year is the distance light travels in a year), with 24,948 light-years to go before reaching star cluster M13.
paras.zh: 截至 2026 年，该信息应该已经传播了约 52 光年（1 光年是光一年传播的距离），距离到达 M13 星团还有 24,948 光年。

paras.en: The Arecibo message may have been the first message of its kind, but it wasn't the last. We have also included messages on several spacecraft, such as Pioneer and Voyager. NASA and Paul McCartney also beamed a performance of "Across the Universe" in 2008.
paras.zh: 阿雷西博消息可能是此类消息中的第一个，但不是最后一个。我们还包含了有关先锋号和航行者号等几艘航天器的信息。 NASA 和保罗·麦卡特尼还在 2008 年表演了《穿越宇宙》。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: Kratos and Seagate Space Partner to Advance Mobile Offshore Launch Capabilities for National Security Missions
articles.author: Seagate Space

paras.en: SAN DIEGO, CA, November 10, 2026 – Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc., a technology company in defense, national security, and global markets, today announced a long-term agreement with Seagate Space for use of the company’s first Gateway offshore launch platform. The agreement supports Kratos’ planned first mission from the platform in 2027, with multiple additional launches anticipated in each subsequent year.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州圣迭戈，2026 年 11 月 10 日 – 国防、国家安全和全球市场的技术公司 Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. 今天宣布与 Seagate Space 达成长期协议，使用该公司的首个 Gateway 海上发射平台。该协议支持 Kratos 计划于 2027 年在该平台执行首次任务，预计随后每年还会进行多次发射。

paras.en: The partnership aligns Kratos’ experience delivering real, mission-relevant products and systems, including hypersonic test vehicles, rocket systems, propulsion technologies, target vehicles, and launch services, with Seagate Space’s modular, mobile offshore platform infrastructure. The Gateway series vessels are designed to provide flexible sea-based platforms to complement traditional land-based launch sites and test ranges.
paras.zh: 此次合作将 Kratos 提供真实任务相关产品和系统（包括高超音速测试飞行器、火箭系统、推进技术、目标飞行器和发射服务）的经验与 Seagate Space 的模块化移动海上平台基础设施结合起来。 Gateway系列船舶旨在提供灵活的海基平台，以补充传统的陆基发射场和测试场。

paras.en: The announcement coincides with Seagate Space’s execution of its first Gateway platform construction contract, advancing into physical construction and toward future operational readiness.
paras.zh: 这一公告恰逢 Seagate Space 执行其第一份 Gateway 平台建设合同，推进物理建设并为未来的运营做好准备。

paras.en: “Kratos’ agreement with Seagate Space creates an important new pathway for supporting our customers’ evolving launch and test requirements,” said Dave Carter, President of Kratos Defense & Rocket Support Services. “We are focused on delivering affordable, responsive, and mission-critical solutions. Gateway has the potential to provide our customers with additional launch flexibility, expanded operating locations, and responsive access to mission-relevant test environments.”
paras.zh: Kratos 国防与火箭支持服务总裁 Dave Carter 表示：“Kratos 与 Seagate Space 达成的协议为支持客户不断变化的发射和测试需求开辟了一条重要的新途径。” “我们专注于提供经济实惠、响应迅速且关键任务的解决方案。Gateway 有潜力为我们的客户提供额外的启动灵活性、扩大的运营地点以及对任务相关测试环境的响应式访问。”

paras.en: Seagate Space’s Gateway platform is being developed as a modular and mobile offshore system to support government and commercial launch, testing, and recovery missions. Its maritime mobility can provide mission planners with added flexibility in launch geometry, range access, and scheduling while reducing dependence on fixed terrestrial infrastructure.
paras.zh: Seagate Space 的 Gateway 平台正在开发为模块化移动海上系统，以支持政府和商业发射、测试和回收任务。其海上机动性可以为任务规划者提供发射几何、范围访问和调度方面的更大灵活性，同时减少对固定地面基础设施的依赖。

paras.en: Kratos plans to use the Gateway platform initially in support of defense-related launch and target missions. The companies expect their collaboration to establish a foundation for expanded offshore mission operations as demand grows for hypersonic testing, ballistic-missile targets, responsive launch capabilities, and other national security relevant missions.
paras.zh: 奎托斯计划首先使用网关平台来支持与国防相关的发射和目标任务。随着高超音速测试、弹道导弹目标、响应发射能力和其他国家安全相关任务的需求不断增长，两家公司希望通过合作为扩大海上任务运营奠定基础。

paras.en: “From the beginning, our vision has been to make access to space as open as the ocean itself,” said Sean Fortener, President, Chief Operating Officer and Co-Founder of Seagate Space. “Partnering with Kratos and moving our first Gateway platform into construction represents a major step towards making that vision a reality. Kratos brings real mission requirements and decades of defense experience, and Seagate Space is bringing the maritime infrastructure to support them. With our first build contract signed, we are putting steel behind the vision and moving closer to delivering a capability the industry needs.”
paras.zh: “从一开始，我们的愿景就是让太空进入像海洋本身一样开放，”Seagate Space 总裁、首席运营官兼联合创始人 Sean Fortener 说道。 “与 Kratos 合作并将我们的第一个 Gateway 平台投入建设，是实现这一愿景的重要一步。Kratos 带来了真正的任务要求和数十年的防御经验，而 Seagate Space 则带来了海事基础设施来支持它们。随着我们签署的第一份建造合同，我们正在将钢铁作为愿景的后盾，并更接近于提供行业所需的能力。”

paras.en: Kratos has internally invested in rapidly developing and fielding affordable systems for demanding national security missions. Kratos’ approach is based on the belief that affordability is a technology: designing proven, leading-edge products and systems from the outset for rapid production, operational deployment, and scalable manufacturing.
paras.zh: 奎托斯在内部投资快速开发和部署负担得起的系统，以满足要求严格的国家安全任务。 Kratos 的方法基于这样的信念：可负担性是一项技术：从一开始就设计经过验证的领先产品和系统，以实现快速生产、运营部署和可扩展制造。

paras.en: “Kratos is committed to being first to market with affordable, mission-focused technologies that address the urgent requirements of the United States and its allies,” said Eric DeMarco, Kratos President and CEO. “This partnership with Seagate Space supports that strategy by creating an additional option for our customers to conduct critical launch and test missions. Sea-based launch infrastructure can provide flexibility, responsiveness, and operational choice—capabilities increasingly important to national security missions.”
paras.zh: Kratos 总裁兼首席执行官埃里克·德马科 (Eric DeMarco) 表示：“Kratos 致力于率先向市场推出价格实惠、以任务为中心的技术，以满足美国及其盟国的迫切需求。” “与 Seagate Space 的合作伙伴关系为我们的客户提供了执行关键发射和测试任务的额外选择，从而支持了这一战略。海基发射基础设施可以提供灵活性、响应能力和操作选择，这些能力对国家安全任务越来越重要。”

paras.en: The companies will continue to advance Gateway through construction, integration, and operational-readiness activities in preparation for Kratos’ first planned mission in 2027.
paras.zh: 两家公司将继续通过建设、集成和运营准备活动推进 Gateway，为 Kratos 于 2027 年执行的首次计划任务做好准备。

paras.en: About Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc.
paras.zh: 关于克雷托斯防御与安全解决方案公司

paras.en: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. (NASDAQ: KTOS) is a technology, products, system and software company addressing the defense, national security, and commercial markets. At Kratos, affordability is a technology, and Kratos makes true internally funded research, development, capital and other investments, to rapidly develop, produce and field affordable solutions that address our customers’ mission critical needs and requirements. For more information, visit www.KratosDefense.com and follow Kratos on LinkedIn and X.
paras.zh: Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：KTOS）是一家致力于国防、国家安全和商业市场的技术、产品、系统和软件公司。在 Kratos，经济实惠是一项技术，Kratos 进行真正的内部资助研究、开发、资本和其他投资，以快速开发、生产和部署经济实惠的解决方案，以满足客户的关键任务需求和要求。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.KratosDefense.com 并在 LinkedIn 和 X 上关注 Kratos。

paras.en: Seagate Space is space’s maritime partner: reinventing offshore launch, optimizing recovery, and innovating for emerging logistics needs. The company’s cutting-edge designs enable rapid, cost-effective development of offshore launch assets that can operate without the constraints of traditional land-based ranges. Seagate Space is a spARK Labs by ARK Invest member company headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida. Learn more at www.seagatespace.com and follow on LinkedIn.
paras.zh: Seagate Space 是太空的海事合作伙伴：重塑海上发射、优化回收并针对新兴物流需求进行创新。该公司的尖端设计能够快速、经济高效地开发海上发射资产，这些资产可以在不受传统陆基射程限制的情况下运行。 Seagate Space 是 spARK Labs by ARK Invest 的成员公司，总部位于佛罗里达州圣彼得堡。如需了解更多信息，请访问 www.seagatespace.com 并关注 LinkedIn。

articles.title: UARX Space Marks a Milestone for Spain’s Space Industry with the Maiden Flight of OSSIE-D, Featuring a Complete Power Subsystem Supplied by DHV Technology
articles.author: UARX Space

paras.en: Nigrán, Spain | November 12 2026 – UARX Space has achieved a major milestone for Spain’s space industry with the deployment of OSSIE-D, an Orbital Transfer Vehicle (OTV) designed and manufactured entirely in Spain, with 75% of its components developed in-house by the company. Launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, OSSIE-D was deployed using SAU&RON 24, UARX Space’s proprietary separation system. The achievement marks a world first, bringing together an orbital transfer vehicle and a separation system developed by the same company in a single mission.
paras.zh: 西班牙尼格兰| 2026 年 11 月 12 日 – UARX Space 部署了 OSSIE-D，实现了西班牙航天工业的一个重要里程碑。OSSIE-D 是一种完全在西班牙设计和制造的轨道传输飞行器 (OTV)，其 75% 的组件由该公司内部开发。 OSSIE-D 由 SpaceX Falcon 9 火箭发射，并使用 UARX Space 的专有分离系统 SAU&RON 24 进行部署。这一成就标志着世界首创，将同一家公司开发的轨道传输飞行器和分离系统结合在一次任务中。

paras.en: The mission represents a significant advance in Spain’s space technology capabilities, demonstrating the ability to develop and integrate key technologies for in-space transportation and orbital operations. By combining its OTV with its own SAU&RON 24 separation system, UARX Space reinforces its integrated approach to spacecraft development, spanning the vehicle itself and the technology required for its deployment into orbit.
paras.zh: 该任务代表了西班牙空间技术能力的重大进步，展示了开发和集成空间运输和轨道运行关键技术的能力。通过将其 OTV 与其自己的 SAU&RON 24 分离系统相结合，UARX Space 强化了其航天器开发的集成方法，涵盖航天器本身及其部署到轨道所需的技术。

paras.en: OSSIE-D also highlights the importance of collaboration between specialized companies across the European space industry. For this mission, DHV Technology designed, qualified and manufactured the vehicle’s complete electrical power subsystem, including the solar arrays, Power Conditioning and Distribution Unit (PCDU), main battery modules, SADA (Solar Array Drive Assembly) and additional supporting subsystems required to meet the mission’s power requirements.
paras.zh: OSSIE-D 还强调了欧洲航天工业专业公司之间合作的重要性。对于此次任务，DHV Technology 设计、鉴定和制造了车辆的完整电力子系统，包括太阳能电池阵列、功率调节和配电单元 (PCDU)、主电池模块、SADA（太阳能阵列驱动组件）以及满足任务电力要求所需的其他支持子系统。

paras.en: “OSSIE-D represents a milestone for the Spanish aerospace industry and shows how collaboration between companies with complementary capabilities can turn ambitious missions into reality. DHV Technology has been a key partner, with its expertise, highly reliable solutions and team commitment making a significant contribution to the mission’s energy capabilities. This partnership also highlights the potential of the Spanish space sector to innovate and compete at both European and global level,” said Dr. Andrés Villa, CTO and Co-Founder of UARX Space.
paras.zh: UARX Space 首席技术官兼联合创始人 Andrés Villa 博士表示：“OSSIE-D 代表了西班牙航空航天业的一个里程碑，展示了具有互补能力的公司之间的合作如何能够将雄心勃勃的任务变为现实。DHV Technology 一直是关键合作伙伴，其专业知识、高度可靠的解决方案和团队承诺为任务的能源能力做出了重大贡献。这种合作伙伴关系还凸显了西班牙航天部门在欧洲和全球层面的创新和竞争潜力。”

paras.en: Following launch, DHV Technology’s electrical power subsystem is operating nominally in orbit, starting from the generation of the power with the solar arrays, control and distribution with the PCDU and storage with the battery, including initial telemetry which confirms that the system is performing as expected. This represents an important milestone for DHV Technology’s engineering team and for the OSSIE-D mission as a whole.
paras.zh: 发射后，DHV Technology 的电力子系统名义上在轨道上运行，从太阳能电池阵列发电、PCDU 控制和分配以及电池存储开始，包括确认系统按预期运行的初始遥测。这对于 DHV Technology 的工程团队和整个 OSSIE-D 任务来说是一个重要的里程碑。

paras.en: “Seeing the full electrical power subsystem fully developed by DHV for OSSIE-D operating as expected in orbit is an important milestone for our team and for our collaboration with UARX Space,” said Dr. Vicente Díaz, Managing Director and Co-Founder of DHV Technology. “This achievement reflects the close cooperation between both engineering teams and the work invested throughout the design, manufacturing, testing and integration phases. We are proud to contribute to this mission and look forward to OSSIE-D continuing to deliver positive results for UARX Space and all the partners involved.”
paras.zh: DHV Technology 董事总经理兼联合创始人 Vicente Díaz 博士表示：“看到 DHV 完全开发的用于 OSSIE-D 的完整电力子系统在轨道上按预期运行，对于我们的团队以及我们与 UARX Space 的合作来说是一个重要的里程碑。” “这一成就反映了两个工程团队之间的密切合作以及在整个设计、制造、测试和集成阶段所投入的工作。我们很自豪能为这一任务做出贡献，并期待 OSSIE-D 继续为 UARX Space 和所有相关合作伙伴带来积极的成果。”

paras.en: Beyond supplying the electrical power subsystem, DHV Technology is using OSSIE-D as a platform to test innovative technological concepts in orbit. The results obtained during the mission will help increase the technological maturity of several of the company’s solutions, extending the value of the mission beyond its immediate operational objectives. These developments include novel electrical interconnection methods, improved solar panel deployment and hinge mechanisms, as well as advanced photovoltaic technologies.
paras.zh: 除了提供电力子系统之外，DHV Technology 还使用 OSSIE-D 作为在轨测试创新技术概念的平台。任务期间获得的结果将有助于提高公司多个解决方案的技术成熟度，使任务的价值超出其直接运营目标。这些发展包括新颖的电气互连方法、改进的太阳能电池板部署和铰链机构以及先进的光伏技术。

paras.en: The collaboration between UARX Space and DHV Technology underscores the importance of combining specialized engineering capabilities to deliver increasingly advanced space missions. While UARX Space leads the development of the OTV and its deployment architecture, DHV Technology’s electrical power subsystem provides a critical element for the vehicle’s operation while enabling the evaluation of new technologies under real space operating conditions.
paras.zh: UARX Space 和 DHV Technology 之间的合作强调了结合专业工程能力来交付日益先进的太空任务的重要性。虽然 UARX Space 引领 OTV 及其部署架构的开发，但 DHV Technology 的电力子系统为车辆的运行提供了关键要素，同时能够在真实的空间运行条件下评估新技术。

paras.en: OSSIE-D therefore represents progress on two fronts: it strengthens UARX Space’s capabilities and position in the in-space transportation sector, while providing an opportunity to validate technologies that could support future missions. The combination of an OTV developed in Spain, a proprietary separation system and a complete electrical power subsystem supplied by DHV Technology demonstrates the potential of Spain’s space industry to deliver increasingly complex technological projects.
paras.zh: 因此，OSSIE-D 代表了两个方面的进展：它增强了 UARX Space 在太空运输领域的能力和地位，同时提供了验证可支持未来任务的技术的机会。西班牙开发的 OTV、专有的分离系统和 DHV Technology 提供的完整电力子系统的结合展示了西班牙航天工业交付日益复杂的技术项目的潜力。

articles.title: SpaceNukes Opens Los Alamos Manufacture and Materials Facility to Build Its Next-Generation Space Reactor
articles.author: Space Nuclear Power Corporation

paras.en: LOS ALAMOS, N.M., Nov. 16, 2026 — Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) opened its Manufacture and Materials Development Facility at 150 Central Park Square in Los Alamos on Nov. 13. The facility is dedicated to manufacture and materials development for the company’s Generation 2 reactor, including additive manufacturing of nickel-based and refractory alloys. No radioactive material is handled in the facility.
paras.zh: 新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，2026 年 11 月 16 日 — Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) 于 11 月 13 日在洛斯阿拉莫斯中央公园广场 150 号开设了制造和材料开发设施。该设施致力于该公司第二代反应堆的制造和材料开发，包括镍基和耐火合金的增材制造。该设施内不处理任何放射性物质。

paras.en: SpaceNukes’ next-generation reactor is designed to run much hotter. A hotter reactor needs a much smaller radiator, which makes up most of the mass of a space fission power system. Raising the temperature at which heat is rejected lets the same-size radiator shed roughly six times as much heat. The limit is not the nuclear physics but the materials. Today’s power conversion hardware already sits at the edge of what nickel-based superalloys tolerate over a long mission, so going hotter means moving to refractory alloys of tungsten, molybdenum, tantalum, rhenium and niobium. These metals are difficult to form, and many of the component shapes and materials SpaceNukes needs cannot be bought from any supplier.
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 的下一代反应堆设计为运行温度更高。更热的反应堆需要更小的散热器，它构成了空间裂变动力系统的大部分质量。提高散热温度可以让相同尺寸的散热器散发出大约六倍的热量。限制不是核物理而是材料。当今的电力转换硬件已经处于镍基高温合金长期任务承受能力的边缘，因此变得更热意味着转向钨、钼、钽、铼和铌的难熔合金。这些金属很难成型，而且 SpaceNukes 所需的许多部件形状和材料无法从任何供应商处购买。

paras.en: “Our next-generation reactor is a bet on temperature,” said Andrew Phelps, CEO of SpaceNukes. “What stands between us and that is not the nuclear physics. The physics is in good shape, and it was proven in 2018. The limit is metal. Our next reactor is a materials and manufacturing challenge before it is a reactor problem, and that is what this building is for.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席执行官安德鲁·菲尔普斯 (Andrew Phelps) 表示：“我们的下一代反应堆押注于温度。” “阻碍我们的不是核物理学。物理学状况良好，并在 2018 年得到了证明。限制是金属。我们的下一个反应堆在成为反应堆问题之前首先是材料和制造挑战，而这就是这座建筑的用途。”

paras.en: The facility is led by Omar Mireles, director of manufacture and materials, who heads the Generation 2 program. Mireles spent 13 years as a research engineer and principal investigator at NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center, where he led the $25 million Refractory Alloy Additive Manufacturing Build Optimization project.
paras.zh: 该工厂由制造和材料总监 Omar Mireles 领导，他也是第二代项目的负责人。 Mireles 在 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心担任了 13 年的研究工程师和首席研究员，领导了价值 2500 万美元的耐火合金增材制造构建优化项目。

paras.en: “Additive manufacturing is used only for specific circumstances,” Mireles said. “You have parts that are highly complex, made from materials that are difficult to form, have a low production rate that won’t benefit from economy of scale, and have the design flexibility that can optimize designs to the manufacturing process. These lessons were learned over the last two decades in the liquid rocket engine community, and we are applying them to the needs of SpaceNukes, which have very similar conditions. We are manufacturing aerospace components at aerospace-quality standards. This building is where we learn to make them.”
paras.zh: “增材制造仅用于特定情况，”米雷莱斯说。 “零件高度复杂，由难以成型的材料制成，生产率低，无法从规模经济中受益，并且具有可以优化制造过程设计的设计灵活性。这些经验教训是液体火箭发动机界在过去二十年中吸取的经验教训，我们正在将它们应用于具有非常相似条件的 SpaceNukes 的需求。我们正在按照航空航天质量标准制造航空航天部件。这座建筑是我们学习制造它们的地方。”

paras.en: The Los Alamos facility complements SpaceNukes’ integration and test facility in Medina, Ohio, led by chief engineer Marc Gibson. SpaceNukes is now building hardware to test components for its Generation 2 reactors at the Ohio facility.
paras.zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯工厂补充了 SpaceNukes 位于俄亥俄州麦地那的集成和测试工厂，该工厂由总工程师马克·吉布森 (Marc Gibson) 领导。 SpaceNukes 目前正在俄亥俄州工厂建造硬件来测试其第二代反应堆的组件。

paras.en: The grand opening featured remarks from Phelps and Mireles, a ribbon cutting and tours of the new facility. Guests included staff from the office of Sen. Martin Heinrich, D-N.M.; Los Alamos National Laboratory and its Feynman Center for Innovation; the Los Alamos County Council; the Los Alamos County Community Development Department; the Los Alamos Commerce & Development Corp.; the Los Alamos Chamber of Commerce; Century Bank; Merrill Lynch; and space industry partners.
paras.zh: 菲尔普斯和米雷莱斯在盛大的开幕式上致辞，并剪彩并参观了新设施。嘉宾包括新墨西哥州民主党参议员马丁·海因里希 (Martin Heinrich) 办公室的工作人员；洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室及其费曼创新中心；洛斯阿拉莫斯县议会；洛斯阿拉莫斯县社区发展部；洛斯阿拉莫斯商业发展公司；洛斯阿拉莫斯商会；世纪银行；美林；以及航天工业合作伙伴。

paras.en: The facility opening follows SpaceNukes’ Oct. 21 announcement of an agreement with the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, under its Fast Capacitance (Fat Cat) program, to design, build and ground-test an actively controlled Kilopower reactor with Los Alamos National Laboratory. It comes as SpaceNukes works to fly a nuclear reactor by 2028.
paras.zh: 该设施开业之前，SpaceNukes 于 10 月 21 日宣布与国防高级研究计划局达成协议，根据其快速电容 (Fat Cat) 计划，与洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室一起设计、建造和地面测试主动控制 Kilopower 反应堆。 SpaceNukes 正致力于在 2028 年之前飞行一座核反应堆。

paras.en: Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) builds nuclear reactors that power missions in space for government and commercial clients. In March 2018, the team that is now SpaceNukes ran a space reactor at full temperature and power for 28 hours, and it performed as predicted. It was the first time this had been done in the United States in 50 years. The team took it from concept to full power in three years for less than $20 million. Today, SpaceNukes has roughly 15 full-time employees, more than $50 million in contracts and agreements with the Department of War and NASA, two completed Space Force design reviews and a Los Alamos National Laboratory license for the reactor technology its founders invented there. Space Nuclear Power Corp., headquartered in Los Alamos, New Mexico, is committed to delivering safe, affordable, reliable nuclear power wherever people and machines go in space.
paras.zh: 太空核动力公司 (SpaceNukes) 建造核反应堆，为政府和商业客户的太空任务提供动力。 2018 年 3 月，SpaceNukes 团队在全温度和全功率下运行了一个空间反应堆 28 小时，其性能符合预期。这是美国 50 年来首次这样做。该团队用了不到 2000 万美元的时间，在三年内将其从概念转变为全面发挥作用。如今，SpaceNukes 拥有大约 15 名全职员工，与战争部和 NASA 签订了价值超过 5000 万美元的合同和协议，完成了两项太空部队设计审查，并为其创始人在洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室发明的反应堆技术获得了许可证。太空核电公司总部位于新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，致力于为人类和机器进入太空的任何地方提供安全、负担得起、可靠的核电。

paras.en: Andrew Phelps, CEO, Space Nuclear Power Corp.
paras.zh: 安德鲁·菲尔普斯 (Andrew Phelps)，太空核电公司首席执行官

articles.title: Gemini Astronaut Photos Inspired Early Earth Observation Program
articles.author: Michele Ostovar

paras.en: Astronauts James A. Lovell Jr. and Edwin E. “Buzz” Aldrin Jr. orbited Earth from November 11 to 15, 1966, on Gemini XII, the final mission of NASA’s Gemini program.
paras.zh: 1966 年 11 月 11 日至 15 日，宇航员小詹姆斯·A·洛弗尔 (James A. Lovell Jr.) 和埃德温·E·“巴兹”·奥尔德林 (Edwin E. “Buzz” Aldrin Jr.) 乘坐双子座 XII 绕地球飞行，这是美国宇航局双子座计划的最后一次任务。

paras.en: In addition to successfully completing rendezvous maneuvers and spacewalks, procedures vital to sending American astronauts to the Moon, the crew was also spurring the development of a different field of exploration, observing Earth from space.
paras.zh: 除了成功完成交会机动和太空行走（对于将美国宇航员送上月球至关重要的程序）外，机组人员还推动了不同探索领域的发展，即从太空观察地球。

paras.en: The photos taken by Lovell, Aldrin, and other Gemini astronauts demonstrated the value of orbital imagery for studying Earth’s surface. Their images helped scientists make the case for a dedicated Earth observation satellite program. One of strongest advocates for accelerating the use of Earth-observing satellites was William T. Pecora, the director of the United States Geological Survey from 1965 to 1971. In a 1969 statement, Pecora noted that the Earth Resources Observation Satellite (EROS) program he championed, and which later paved the way for Landsat, was “conceived in 1966 largely as a direct result of the demonstrated utility of Mercury and Gemini orbital photography to Earth resource studies.”
paras.zh: 洛弗尔、奥尔德林和其他双子座宇航员拍摄的照片证明了轨道图像对于研究地球表面的价值。他们的图像帮助科学家论证了专门的地球观测卫星计划。加速使用地球观测卫星的最有力倡导者之一是 1965 年至 1971 年间担任美国地质调查局局长的威廉·T·佩科拉 (William T. Pecora)。佩科拉在 1969 年的一份声明中指出，他所倡导的地球资源观测卫星 (EROS) 计划（后来为陆地卫星铺平了道路）“于 1966 年构思，很大程度上是水星和双子座的实用性得到证实的直接结果”轨道摄影到地球资源研究。”

paras.en: For more than five decades, Landsat and other Earth-observing satellites have provided invaluable data used around the world to monitor crops, wildfires, flooding, vegetation health, land use, and countless other changes to our planet.
paras.zh: 五十多年来，陆地卫星和其他地球观测卫星提供了宝贵的数据，在世界各地用于监测农作物、野火、洪水、植被健康、土地利用以及地球无数其他变化。

articles.title: Contractor to Civil Servant: NASA Welcomes Jim Mirandy
articles.author: LaToya Dean

paras.en: The rumble of a rocket engine might be considered a soundtrack for Jim Mirandy’s life.
paras.zh: 火箭发动机的隆隆声可能被认为是吉姆·米兰迪一生的配乐。

paras.en: Mirandy has grown up with NASA as a constant presence, and his path to becoming a civil servant at NASA’s Stennis Space Center near Bay St. Louis, Mississippi, has been decades in the making.
paras.zh: 米兰迪是在美国宇航局的陪伴下长大的，他在密西西比州圣路易斯湾附近的美国宇航局斯坦尼斯航天中心成为一名公务员的道路已经酝酿了几十年。

paras.en: Hired under the agency’s workforce directive to restore core competencies by converting contractors to civil service, Mirandy is now a quality assurance specialist after 30 years of working as a contractor supporting NASA.
paras.zh: 米兰迪是根据该机构的劳动力指令聘用的，该指令旨在通过将承包商转变为公务员来恢复核心能力，在作为支持 NASA 的承包商工作了 30 年后，米兰迪现在是一名质量保证专家。

paras.en: “Discovery is an important job, and it is exciting to be a part of that process,” said Mirandy. “As a nation, we lead the world in space exploration, and we make that dream of reaching for the stars a reality.”
paras.zh: “发现是一项重要的工作，能够参与这一过程令人兴奋，”米兰迪说。 “作为一个国家，我们在太空探索方面处于世界领先地位，我们使到达星星的梦想成为现实。”

paras.en: His work at the nation’s largest rocket propulsion test site directly supports the agency’s mission to return American astronauts to the Moon through the Artemis program and ensure American leadership in space.
paras.zh: 他在美国最大的火箭推进试验场的工作直接支持该机构通过阿尔忒弥斯计划将美国宇航员送回月球的使命，并确保美国在太空的领导地位。

paras.en: By retaining Mirandy’s facility-specific expertise as a civil servant, NASA ensures that the critical propulsion testing at NASA Stennis continues to be executed with safety and quality in mind. Mirandy describes his team as an integral part of the process that provides a second set of eyes with a focus on potential hazards.
paras.zh: 通过保留米兰迪作为公务员的特定设施专业知识，美国宇航局确保美国宇航局斯坦尼斯的关键推进测试继续在安全和质量的情况下进行。米兰迪将他的团队描述为该过程中不可或缺的一部分，提供了第二双眼睛来关注潜在的危险。

paras.en: As a quality assurance specialist, he serves as the agency’s close call investigator at the center, helps lead the Voluntary Protection Program, and participates in the Striving to Achieve Real Safety committee, an employee safety committee that works to keep the site safe.
paras.zh: 作为一名质量保证专家，他担任该机构在该中心的近距离调查员，帮助领导自愿保护计划，并参加“努力实现真正安全”委员会，该委员会是一个致力于确保现场安全的员工安全委员会。

paras.en: Mirandy also has a long resume of critical institutional contributions, including creating high pressure and cryogenic training classes that he taught for 10 years, and helping establish safety protocols throughout various locations at the center.
paras.zh: Mirandy 还拥有一份长长的重要机构贡献履历，包括创建他教授了 10 年的高压和低温培训课程，以及帮助在该中心的各个地点建立安全协议。

paras.en: Mirandy’s connection to America’s space agency began in childhood living in Titusville, Florida. His father, Wes Mirandy, worked for Rocketdyne at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida, and Mirandy’s nearby elementary school regularly gathered to watch launches. Later, his father worked as the A-1 test stand manager for space shuttle main engine testing at NASA Stennis.
paras.zh: 米兰迪与美国航天局的联系始于童年生活在佛罗里达州泰特斯维尔的时候。他的父亲韦斯·米兰迪 (Wes Mirandy) 曾在美国宇航局佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心的火箭达因公司工作，米兰迪附近的小学定期聚集观看发射。后来，他的父亲在 NASA 斯坦尼斯担任航天飞机主发动机测试的 A-1 试验台经理。

paras.en: “My father was by far my greatest mentor,” said Mirandy. “My dad always included us whenever he worked on something around the house, so we picked up a knack for examining problems and fixing things. When I arrived at Stennis Space Center, many of his friends and coworkers took the time to help me succeed at my job. They took the time to explain the test stands and other systems and how they worked.”
paras.zh: “我的父亲是迄今为止我最伟大的导师，”米兰迪说。 “每当我父亲在家里做一些事情时，他总是把我们包括在内，所以我们学会了检查问题和解决问题的技巧。当我到达斯坦尼斯航天中心时，他的许多朋友和同事都花时间帮助我在工作中取得成功。他们花时间解释测试台和其他系统以及它们的工作原理。”

paras.en: A knack for fixing things helped launch Mirandy’s career at Michoud Assembly Facility in New Orleans. He started working hands-on as a mechanic on the Space Shuttle External Tank. When an unexpected incident occurred in a production cell, Mirandy stepped up to help the operations and safety team resolve the issue.
paras.zh: 修复问题的技巧帮助米兰迪在新奥尔良的米丘德装配厂开启了她的职业生涯。他开始在航天飞机外部储罐上担任机械师，亲自动手工作。当生产单元发生意外事件时，米兰迪挺身而出，帮助运营和安全团队解决问题。

paras.en: This moment shifted his career trajectory into safety and quality. Mirandy found his way to NASA Stennis and brought an understanding of systems and operations with him.
paras.zh: 这一刻将他的职业轨迹转向了安全和质量。米兰迪找到了进入美国宇航局斯坦尼斯的途径，并带来了对系统和操作的理解。

paras.en: A resident of Bay St. Louis and a graduate of the University of Southern Mississippi, Mirandy is motivated by helping people, keeping them safe, and improving processes.
paras.zh: 米兰迪是圣路易斯湾的居民，毕业于南密西西比大学，她的动机是帮助人们、保证他们的安全和改进流程。

paras.en: “Your reward for working safely today is tomorrow,” said Mirandy.
paras.zh: “今天安全工作的回报就是明天，”米兰迪说。

articles.title: NASA Receives 16th Consecutive ‘Clean’ Financial Audit Opinion
articles.author: Lauren E. Low

paras.en: For the 16th consecutive year, NASA has received an unmodified, or “clean,” opinion from an external auditor on its fiscal year 2026 financial statements.
paras.zh: 对于2026财年的财务报表，NASA连续第16年获得了外部审计师的无保留意见，即“清洁”意见。

paras.en: The rating is the best possible audit opinion, certifying that NASA’s financial statements conform with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles for federal agencies and accurately present the agency’s financial position.
paras.zh: 该评级是最好的审计意见，证明 NASA 的财务报表符合联邦机构的公认会计原则，并准确地反映了该机构的财务状况。

paras.en: “Our responsibility at NASA is to be disciplined stewards of the resources entrusted to us by the American people while delivering on the missions they expect from this agency,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. “Our 16th consecutive clean audit reflects a long record of financial accountability, and we intend to pair that discipline with the urgency and execution required to take on the near-impossible missions ahead.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局局长贾里德·艾萨克曼表示：“美国宇航局的责任是严格管理美国人民委托给我们的资源，同时履行他们对这个机构的期望。” “我们连续第 16 次廉洁审计反映了长期的财务问责记录，我们打算将这一纪律与承担未来近乎不可能的任务所需的紧迫性和执行力结合起来。”

paras.en: The 2026 Agency Financial Report provides key financial and performance information and demonstrates the agency’s commitment to transparency in the use of American taxpayers’ dollars. In addition, the 2026 report presents progress during the past year, and spotlights advancements in NASA missions, objectives, and workforce development with these financial resources.
paras.zh: 2026 年机构财务报告提供了关键的财务和绩效信息，并表明了该机构对美国纳税人资金使用透明度的承诺。此外，2026 年报告还介绍了过去一年的进展，并重点介绍了 NASA 在利用这些财政资源执行任务、目标和劳动力发展方面取得的进展。

paras.en: In fiscal year 2026 (FY 2026), NASA’s 10-day Artemis II mission successfully accomplished a test flight around the Moon with four crew members, delivering major human spaceflight milestones, such as the record‑breaking distance astronauts have traveled from Earth and global public engagement. NASA also announced a series of transformative agencywide initiatives designed to advance American leadership in space, including plans to build a Moon Base, which will be humanity’s first lunar outpost, and a place where astronauts will live, work, and explore near the Moon’s South Pole.
paras.zh: 2026 财年（FY 2026），美国宇航局为期 10 天的阿尔特弥斯二号任务成功完成了由四名机组人员进行的绕月试飞，实现了载人航天的重大里程碑，例如创纪录的宇航员离开地球的距离和全球公众参与。美国宇航局还宣布了一系列旨在提升美国在太空领域领导地位的全机构变革性举措，包括计划建造月球基地，该基地将成为人类第一个月球前哨站，以及宇航员在月球南极附近生活、工作和探索的地方。

paras.en: NASA’s science advancements in FY 2026 included launching the agency’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, ahead of schedule, to study dark matter, dark energy, planets outside our solar system, as well as exploration of everything from nearby stars to distant galaxies. NASA’s experimental X-59 quiet supersonic aircraft achieved a major milestone when it flew faster than the speed of sound for the first time.
paras.zh: NASA 在 2026 财年的科学进步包括提前发射该机构的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜，以研究暗物质、暗能量、太阳系外的行星，以及探索从附近恒星到遥远星系的一切。 NASA 的实验型 X-59 静音超音速飞机首次以超过音速飞行，实现了一个重要的里程碑。

paras.en: The agency also: launched NASA Force with the U.S. Office of Personnel Management, a talent track designed to recruit and deploy the nation’s top engineers and technologists to support America’s space program; announced an agencywide realignment to increase mission focus; and welcomed additional Artemis Accords signatories committing to the safe, transparent, and responsible exploration of the Moon, Mars, and beyond.
paras.zh: 该机构还： 与美国人事管理办公室共同启动了 NASA Force，这是一个旨在招募和部署美国顶尖工程师和技术专家以支持美国太空计划的人才通道；宣布在全机构范围内进行调整，以加强任务重点；并欢迎更多《阿耳忒弥斯协议》签署国致力于安全、透明和负责任地探索月球、火星及其他地方。

paras.en: For more information on NASA’s budget, visit:
paras.zh: 有关 NASA 预算的更多信息，请访问：

paras.zh: george.a.alderman@nasa.gov / jennifer.m.dooren@nasa.gov

articles.title: Syria: Progress ‘real’ but fragile, as remnants of war wreck young lives

paras.en: Syria: Progress ‘real’ but fragile, as remnants of war wreck young lives
paras.zh: 叙利亚：进展“真实”但脆弱，战争残余摧毁了年轻人的生命

paras.en: Syria is showing “undeniable signs of progress” nearly two years after the fall of the Assad regime, but explosive ordnance, the approaching winter and severe funding shortfalls threaten those fragile gains, senior UN officials told the Security Council on Monday.
paras.zh: 联合国高级官员周一向安理会表示，阿萨德政权垮台近两年后，叙利亚显示出“不可否认的进展迹象”，但爆炸性弹药、即将到来的冬季和严重的资金短缺威胁着这些脆弱的成果。

paras.en: Since the Council last met for an update last month, at least 30 people have been killed by explosive ordnance – 19 of them children – and more than 80 injured, including 35 children, said Mohamed Yahya, Assistant Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs, briefing on behalf of UN relief chief Tom Fletcher.
paras.zh: 负责人道主义事务的助理秘书长穆罕默德·叶海亚代表联合国救援负责人汤姆·弗莱彻通报情况时表示，自上个月安理会上次召开会议通报最新情况以来，至少有 30 人被爆炸物炸死，其中 19 人是儿童，80 多人受伤，其中包括 35 名儿童。

paras.en: “In short, the situation is not improving,” he said.
paras.zh: “简而言之，情况并没有改善，”他说。

paras.en: Nearly four million Syrians have voluntarily returned home since December 2024, and since October alone, a further 60,000 internally displaced people and 18,000 refugees have returned.
paras.zh: 自 2024 年 12 月以来，已有近 400 万叙利亚人自愿返回家园，仅自 10 月以来，又有 6 万名境内流离失所者和 1.8 万名难民返回家园。

paras.en: Yet “returns do not mean humanitarian needs have ended,” Mr. Yahya stressed, with more than 730,000 people still living in camps.
paras.zh: 然而，叶海亚先生强调，“返回并不意味着人道主义需求已经结束”，目前仍有超过 73 万人生活在难民营中。

paras.en: In the first half of this year, partners cleared more than 700,000 square metres of contaminated land, but much more is needed as families return, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，今年上半年，合作伙伴清理了超过 70 万平方米的受污染土地，但随着家庭返回，还需要清理更多的土地。

paras.en: Recent flash floods have also displaced explosive ordnance into areas previously considered safer.
paras.zh: 最近的山洪也将爆炸性弹药转移到了以前被认为更安全的地区。

paras.en: An estimated 2.4 million people will need additional assistance this winter, while the winter response plan – which targets more than 970,000 of those most at risk -is only 40 per cent funded. Nearly 200,000 displaced people and returnees are living in damaged shelters.
paras.zh: 据估计，今年冬天将有 240 万人需要额外援助，而针对高危人群中 97 万多人的冬季应对计划仅获得了 40% 的资金。近20万流离失所者和返回者居住在受损的避难所中。

paras.en: “Time is running out,” Mr. Yahya warned.
paras.zh: “时间已经不多了，”叶海亚先生警告说。

paras.en: Poliovirus has also been detected in two children in Deir Ez Zor. And with the country’s humanitarian appeal only a third funded, the World Food Programme (WFP) is halving its food assistance programme, and the UN sexual and reproductive health agency (UNFPA) has closed 28 health facilities.
paras.zh: 代尔祖尔省的两名儿童也发现了脊髓灰质炎病毒。由于该国的人道主义呼吁仅获得三分之一的资金，世界粮食计划署 ​​(WFP) 正在将其粮食援助计划减半，联合国性与生殖健康机构 (UNFPA) 已关闭 28 个卫生设施。

paras.en: Deputy Special Envoy for Syria Claudio Cordone welcomed the formal submission last week of the draft Law on Transitional Justice to the interim People’s Assembly, stressing that justice must not be selective and that accountability must apply to crimes “regardless of the perpetrators or the victims”.
paras.zh: 叙利亚问题副特使克劳迪奥·科尔多内对上周向临时人民议会正式提交过渡时期司法法草案表示欢迎，强调司法不能有选择性，并且必须对犯罪行为进行问责，“无论犯罪者还是受害者”。

paras.en: Preparations for a permanent constitution and credible, inclusive elections require clarity on processes and timelines, he said, echoing the view that there is no time to waste.
paras.zh: 他说，制定永久宪法和可信、包容性选举的准备工作需要明确程序和时间表，这也呼应了没有时间可以浪费的观点。

paras.en: The World Bank estimates the cost of rebuilding damaged physical assets alone at $216 billion, Mr. Cordone noted, calling for sustained international support.
paras.zh: 科尔多内先生指出，世界银行估计仅重建受损实物资产的成本就达 2,160 亿美元，并呼吁国际社会提供持续支持。

paras.en: On security, the envoy said more than 100 Kurdish families trying to return to Tel Abyad in late October reportedly faced violence and intimidation, while Sweida remains in a “tense security and political stalemate”.
paras.zh: 在安全方面，特使表示，据报道，10 月底试图返回特尔艾卜耶德的 100 多个库尔德家庭面临暴力和恐吓，而斯韦达仍处于“紧张的安全和政治僵局”。

paras.en: Israeli military activities have continued “relentlessly in violation of Syria’s sovereignty and territorial integrity”, he said, deploring the killing of a man with a disability during an Israeli operation in Jamla, western Dara’a, on 21 October.
paras.zh: 他说，以色列的军事活动继续“无情地侵犯叙利亚的主权和领土完整”，并对 10 月 21 日以色列在德拉西部贾姆拉的行动中杀害一名残疾人表示遗憾。

paras.en: Jordanian airstrikes in Dara’a on 27 October, which Jordan said targeted Da’esh (or ISIL) militants and a weapons depot, also caused civilian casualties, with three children among those reported killed.
paras.zh: 约旦 10 月 27 日对德拉发动空袭，约旦称空袭目标是达伊沙（或伊斯兰国）武装分子和一个武器库，也造成平民伤亡，据报道其中有 3 名儿童丧生。

paras.en: ‘Stability built on silence is not peace’
paras.zh: “建立在沉默之上的稳定不是和平”

paras.en: Hayma Alyousfi, a Syrian feminist and human rights defender, told the Council that women who speak publicly face online abuse, including sexualised threats and coordinated campaigns to discredit them. She urged the authorities to suspend restrictive Assad-era laws on expression and assembly.
paras.zh: 叙利亚女权主义者和人权捍卫者哈玛·阿尤斯菲 (Hayma Alyousfi) 告诉安理会，公开发言的女性面临网络虐待，包括性威胁和协调一致的抹黑她们的运动。她敦促当局暂停阿萨德时代对言论和集会的限制性法律。

paras.en: “Stability built on silence is not peace,” she said. “And a transition that excludes women cannot deliver the future that Syrians deserve.”
paras.zh: “建立在沉默之上的稳定不是和平，”她说。 “排除女性的过渡无法带来叙利亚人应得的未来。”

paras.en: Closing his briefing, Mr. Yahya urged the Council to sustain humanitarian funding and support mine action and the winter response.
paras.zh: 叶海亚先生在通报结束时敦促安理会维持人道主义资金并支持排雷行动和冬季应对措施。

paras.en: “The progress in Syria is real. The opportunity is real. We must lean in, invest more and act now.”
paras.zh: “叙利亚的进展是真实的。机会也是真实的。我们必须向前迈进，加大投资，并立即采取行动。”

articles.title: AI gets climate science right – until users push back

paras.en: AI gets climate science right – until users push back
paras.zh: 人工智能让气候科学正确——直到用户反对

paras.en: The report, Can We Trust AI on Climate? was presented on Monday at the COP31 climate conference in Antalya, Türkiye, by education and science agency, UNESCO and University College London.
paras.zh: 这份报告《我们可以相信人工智能对气候的影响吗？》教育和科学机构、联合国教科文组织和伦敦大学学院于周一在土耳其安塔利亚举行的 COP31 气候会议上提出了这一建议。

paras.en: Researchers tested up to 33 leading AI models in 13 languages.
paras.zh: 研究人员用 13 种语言测试了多达 33 个领先的人工智能模型。

paras.en: “Many of us interact with these AI models and chatbots on a daily basis seeking information on a wide variety of topics,” said Leona Verdadero, the report’s lead author at UNESCO. “A lot of times these models, when they respond, they sound really authoritative, and they sound very smart. But as we’ve seen with our experiments, they don’t always sound right.”
paras.zh: 该报告的主要作者、联合国教科文组织的 Leona Verdadero 表示：“我们中的许多人每天都与这些人工智能模型和聊天机器人互动，寻求有关各种主题的信息。” “很多时候，这些模型在做出反应时，听起来非常权威，而且非常聪明。但正如我们在实验中看到的那样，它们听起来并不总是正确的。”

paras.en: Researchers found that AI tends towards sycophancy – a built-in inclination to agree with users, even when they present false information.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，人工智能倾向于阿谀奉承——一种与用户达成一致的内在倾向，即使他们提供了虚假信息。

paras.en: In tests on 15 models, researchers challenged answers the models had got right, moving from simple disagreement to claimed expertise and fabricated evidence.
paras.zh: 在对 15 个模型的测试中，研究人员对模型的正确答案提出了质疑，从简单的分歧到声称拥有专业知识和捏造证据。

paras.en: Every model gave way, and some could be pushed into endorsing false claims, such as that carbon dioxide is not the main driver of climate change. Roughly eight in 10 of the answers that changed did so at the very first sign of disagreement.
paras.zh: 每个模型都让位了，有些模型可能被迫支持错误的主张，例如二氧化碳不是气候变化的主要驱动因素。大约十分之八的答案在出现分歧迹象时就发生了变化。

paras.en: “If a user says, ‘I actually don’t think that is right,’ what’s very fascinating is that we found in eight out of 10 of these cases, when a user pushes back, the AI model can actually reverse its answer to be more agreeable with the user,” Ms. Verdadero told UN News in an interview for our daily podcast series from COP, Talk & Action.
paras.zh: “如果用户说，‘我实际上认为这是不对的’，非常有趣的是，我们发现，在十分之八的案例中，当用户拒绝时，人工智能模型实际上可以改变其答案，以更符合用户的要求，”Verdadero 女士在接受《联合国新闻》COP、Talk & Action 每日播客系列采访时告诉《联合国新闻》。

paras.en: “AI could just abandon a scientific fact to be more agreeable to the user.”
paras.zh: “人工智能可能会放弃科学事实，以更容易被用户接受。”

paras.en: On textbook-style climate questions, the best models answered between 88 and 96 per cent correctly. But the more reasoning a task required, the worse they did.
paras.zh: 对于教科书式的气候问题，最好的模型的正确率在 88% 到 96% 之间。但一项任务需要的推理越多，他们的表现就越差。

paras.en: Asked whether a piece of evidence supported or contradicted a scientific claim, even the strongest systems managed only 71 to 77 per cent. Asked whether two climate policies together would achieve more, less or the same as their separate effects, the models averaged just 33.8 per cent – no better than random guessing.
paras.zh: 当被问及一项证据是否支持或反驳科学主张时，即使是最强大的系统也只能做到 71% 到 77%。当被问及两项气候政策一起实施是否会比单独实施带来更多、更少或相同的效果时，模型的平均得分仅为 33.8%——并不比随机猜测更好。

paras.en: “What we’re saying is that the science and the experts should be trusted more,” Ms. Verdadero said. “The AI models aren’t there yet.”
paras.zh: “我们想说的是，应该更加信任科学和专家，”贝尔达德罗女士说。 “人工智能模型还没有出现。”

paras.en: Accuracy also depended on the language used. Models averaged 88.6 per cent in English, with similar results in Spanish, French and Portuguese, but fell to 83.6 per cent in Hindi and Bengali, 81.4 per cent in Urdu and 78.3 per cent in Swahili.
paras.zh: 准确性还取决于所使用的语言。模型的英语平均得分为 88.6%，西班牙语、法语和葡萄牙语的结果相似，但印地语和孟加拉语的平均得分为 83.6%，乌尔都语为 81.4%，斯瓦希里语为 78.3%。

paras.en: “Imagine you and I are using the same model, asking the exact same question, but in a different language,” Ms. Verdadero said. “Based on the language, we can have totally different responses.”
paras.zh: “想象一下，你和我使用相同的模型，提出完全相同的问题，但使用不同的语言，”维达德罗女士说。 “根据语言，我们可能会有完全不同的反应。”

paras.en: “Communities that are speaking these languages are primarily in South Asia and East Africa, and we know these are communities that are very much climate vulnerable,” she noted.
paras.zh: “使用这些语言的社区主要位于南亚和东非，我们知道这些社区非常容易受到气候影响，”她指出。

paras.en: The report calls on technology companies to invest more in local datasets and multilingual development, so that speakers of underrepresented languages are not left behind.
paras.zh: 该报告呼吁科技公司加大对本地数据集和多语言开发的投资，以便不让使用代表性不足的语言的人落后。

paras.en: The report is part of UNESCO’s contribution to the Global Initiative for Information Integrity on Climate Change, which it co-chairs with the UN and Brazil.
paras.zh: 该报告是教科文组织对气候变化信息完整性全球倡议所做贡献的一部分，该倡议由教科文组织与联合国和巴西共同主持。

paras.en: “The fight against climate change needs to be grounded in reliable evidence and scientific evidence,” Ms. Verdadero told us. “A lot of this evidence informs policies today and also feeds into the COP negotiations.”
paras.zh: “应对气候变化的斗争需要建立在可靠的证据和科学证据的基础上，”韦尔达德罗女士告诉我们。 “许多证据为当今的政策提供了信息，也为缔约方会议的谈判提供了信息。”

paras.en: She stressed that AI should be treated as only one source among many.
paras.zh: 她强调，人工智能应该被视为众多来源中的唯一一种。

paras.en: “These AI models should be used as one type of information source, but it should not be your primary one,” she said. “Factchecking, making sure the sources are reliable, is important.
paras.zh: “这些人工智能模型应该用作一种信息源，但它不应该是你的主要来源，”她说。 “事实核查，确保消息来源可靠，这一点很重要。

paras.en: “And, of course, trusting evidence from experts, climate scientists and researchers should not be replaced.”
paras.zh: “当然，来自专家、气候科学家和研究人员的可信证据不应被取代。”

articles.title: Lebanon leading the way in mental health support

paras.en: Lebanon leading the way in mental health support
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩在心理健康支持方面处于领先地位

paras.en: Mental health support must be a core part of the humanitarian response, said the UN Deputy Secretary-General during a visit to Lebanon over the weekend, where efforts to address the psychological toll of years of conflict and instability offer valuable lessons for other crisis-affected countries.
paras.zh: 联合国副秘书长周末访问黎巴嫩时表示，心理健康支持必须成为人道主义应对措施的核心部分，黎巴嫩解决多年冲突和不稳定造成的心理损失的努力为其他受危机影响的国家提供了宝贵的经验教训。

paras.en: “What I heard in Lebanon is a powerful reminder that the impact of conflict does not end with the physical destruction we can see,” said Amina Mohammed.
paras.zh: “我在黎巴嫩听到的消息有力地提醒我们，冲突的影响并不会随着我们所看到的物质破坏而结束，”阿米娜·穆罕默德说。

paras.en: “The effects on people’s mental health, families and communities can endure long after.”
paras.zh: “对人们心理健康、家庭和社区的影响可能会持续很长时间。”

paras.en: Lebanon is facing mass displacement and acute food shortages as Israeli strikes continue, particularly in the south.
paras.zh: 随着以色列继续发动袭击，黎巴嫩正面临大规模流离失所和严重粮食短缺的问题，特别是在南部地区。

paras.en: In the face of growing needs, though, Lebanon has increasingly integrated mental health support into its public healthcare system.
paras.zh: 然而，面对不断增长的需求，黎巴嫩越来越多地将心理健康支持纳入其公共医疗保健系统。

paras.en: The country's National Mental Health Programme has developed a strategy to make mental health and psychosocial support an integral part of healthcare services.
paras.zh: 该国的国家心理健康计划制定了一项战略，使心理健康和社会心理支持成为医疗保健服务的一个组成部分。

paras.en: In Beirut’s primary health centre in Chiyah, for instance, routine health checks include mental health screenings and support.
paras.zh: 例如，在贝鲁特 Chiyah 的初级卫生中心，例行健康检查包括心理健康筛查和支持。

paras.en: Lebanon has also recently made its national suicide prevention and emotional support hotline, Lifeline 1564, toll-free.
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩最近还免费开通了全国自杀预防和情感支持热线 Lifeline 1564。

paras.en: “Lebanon clearly has the expertise, integrated systems and proven models; what it urgently needs is more investment to bring mental health well-being services to more people and communities and ensure its long-term sustainability,” she said.
paras.zh: “黎巴嫩显然拥有专业知识、综合系统和行之有效的模式；它迫切需要的是更多投资，为更多人和社区提供心理健康福祉服务，并确保其长期可持续性，”她说。

paras.en: In the southern city of Tyre, Ms. Mohammed met mental health professionals and patients, hearing how local teams are working to ensure uninterrupted care despite difficult conditions.
paras.zh: 在南部城市提尔，穆罕默德女士会见了心理健康专家和患者，了解当地团队如何在困难的情况下努力确保不间断的护理。

paras.en: “I was deeply moved and inspired by their courage, especially women, and how they lean into each other’s kindness to build strength,” she said.
paras.zh: “她们的勇气，尤其是女性的勇气，以及她们如何依靠彼此的善意来增强力量，让我深受感动和鼓舞，”她说。

paras.en: In Naqoura, also in the South, the Deputy Secretary-General met with personnel of the UN’s peacekeeping mission in Lebanon, UNIFIL, and expressed her thanks for the contributions and sacrifices of its staff as the mission’s mandate comes to an end.
paras.zh: 同样在南部的纳古拉，常务副秘书长会见了联合国驻黎巴嫩维和特派团联黎部队的人员，并对联黎部队工作人员在特派团任务即将结束时做出的贡献和牺牲表示感谢。

paras.en: Lebanon's efforts are part of a broader UN push to make mental health support central to humanitarian responses worldwide.
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩的努力是联合国更广泛努力的一部分，旨在使精神卫生支持成为全球人道主义应对措施的核心。

paras.en: In 2024, more than 300 million people needed humanitarian assistance and protection globally, including an estimated 66 million experiencing adverse mental health conditions.
paras.zh: 到 2024 年，全球有超过 3 亿人需要人道主义援助和保护，其中估计有 6600 万人患有不良心理健康状况。

paras.en: Yet services remain severely underfunded, leaving millions without adequate care.
paras.zh: 然而，服务资金仍然严重不足，导致数百万人得不到足够的护理。

paras.en: To help close this gap, the UN launched the Greentree Acceleration Plan, backed by $13.2 million in initial funding from the independent charitable healthcare foundation, Wellcome.
paras.zh: 为了帮助缩小这一差距，联合国启动了格林特里加速计划，该计划得到了独立慈善医疗保健基金会 Wellcome 提供的 1320 万美元初始资金的支持。

paras.en: The initiative, being rolled out first in Lebanon and Chad, aims to strengthen locally led mental health services, expand access to proven treatments and improve psychological support for humanitarian workers.
paras.zh: 该倡议首先在黎巴嫩和乍得推出，旨在加强当地主导的心理健康服务，扩大获得有效治疗的机会，并改善对人道主义工作者的心理支持。

paras.en: Annemarie Hou, Executive Director of the UN Office for Partnerships, the body responsible for the Greentree Acceleration Plan, said Lebanon offers valuable lessons for humanitarian operations elsewhere.
paras.zh: 负责格林特里加速计划的联合国伙伴关系办公室执行主任安妮玛丽·侯表示，黎巴嫩为其他地方的人道主义行动提供了宝贵的经验教训。

paras.en: “People affected by crisis need more than survival. They need the support and dignity that allow them to recover, reconnect and rebuild their lives,” she stressed.
paras.zh: “受危机影响的人们需要的不仅仅是生存。他们需要支持和尊严，使他们能够恢复、重新联系和重建生活，”她强调。

articles.title: British doubles No 1 criticises ATP bosses at trophy presentation absence

paras.en: Henry Patten: British doubles No 1 takes swipe at ATP chairman and CEO for absence from trophy presentation
paras.zh: 亨利·帕滕：英国双打第一选手因缺席颁奖典礼而批评ATP主席兼首席执行官

paras.en: Henry Patten uses trophy presentation to focus on the absence of ATP bosses, reigniting his opposition to the doubles reform expected for 2028; You can watch the ATP Finals in Turin this week on Sky Sports Tennis
paras.zh: 亨利·帕滕 (Henry Patten) 通过奖杯颁奖来聚焦 ATP 老板的缺席，重新激起了他对 2028 年双打改革的反对；您可以在天空体育网球频道观看本周在都灵举行的 ATP 总决赛

paras.en: British doubles No 1 Henry Patten has taken a swipe at ATP bosses for their absence from a trophy presentation in Turin on Monday.
paras.zh: 英国双打排名第一的亨利·帕滕（Henry Patten）因缺席周一在都灵举行的颁奖典礼而对 ATP 老板进行了猛烈抨击。

paras.en: Upon receiving the year-end doubles No 1 trophy from chief tour officer Andre Silva, alongside his Finnish partner Harri Heliovaara, Patten called out the ATP chairman Andrea Gaudenzi and CEO Eno Polo.
paras.zh: 在从巡回赛首席官安德烈·席尔瓦（Andre Silva）和他的芬兰搭档哈里·赫利奥瓦拉（Harri Heliovaara）手中接过年终双打第一奖杯后，帕滕对ATP主席安德里亚·高登齐（Andrea Gaudenzi）和首席执行官伊诺·波罗（Eno Polo）进行了表彰。

paras.en: "For us, it's a really big deal. It's a real shame that the ATP chairman and CEO don't think the same." Patten said.
paras.zh: “对我们来说，这确实是一件大事。令人遗憾的是 ATP 主席兼首席执行官不这么认为。”彭定康说。

paras.en: "It would have been nice to have them on court with us today, but here we are by ourselves."
paras.zh: “今天如果他们和我们一起在球场上就好了，但我们却孤身一人。”

paras.en: Sky Sports News has contacted the ATP Tour for comment.
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻已联系 ATP 巡回赛寻求评论。

paras.en: Patten and Heliovaara enjoyed a sensational season, winning Wimbledon for the second time in their careers and lifting trophies in Adelaide, Doha, Dubai, and Madrid.
paras.zh: 帕滕和赫利奥瓦拉度过了一个激动人心的赛季，职业生涯第二次赢得温网冠军，并在阿德莱德、多哈、迪拜和马德里举起奖杯。

paras.en: The duo have repeatedly criticised the ATP's approach to doubles, including their proposals that would include smaller draws and reduce prize money for the 2028 season.
paras.zh: 两人多次批评 ATP 对双打的做法，包括他们提出的减少抽签和减少 2028 赛季奖金的提议。

paras.en: Patten and Dutch player Sem Verbeek spearheaded an open letter, signed by over a hundred other players - including former champions Bob and Mike Bryan - calling for the reform project to be scrapped.
paras.zh: 帕滕和荷兰球员塞姆·维贝克带头写了一封公开信，由包括前冠军鲍勃和迈克·布莱恩在内的一百多名其他球员签署，呼吁废除改革项目。

paras.en: Speaking to Sky Sports Tennis, Tim Henman said: "He [Patten] made his thoughts pretty clear about the lack of representation from the chair and the CEO on the tour.
paras.zh: 蒂姆·亨曼在接受天空体育网球采访时表示：“他（帕滕）非常清楚地表达了他对主席和首席执行官在巡回赛中缺乏代表的想法。

paras.en: "There is the conversation around massive reform in the doubles world, potentially cutting the doubles draw in half and that would save prize money that could go into the singles, so those doubles players are feeling like their jobs are in jeopardy.
paras.zh: “人们正在讨论双打世界的大规模改革，可能会将双打抽签数减少一半，这将节省可以投入单打的奖金，所以那些双打球员感觉他们的工作处于危险之中。

paras.en: "This is a great platform as the doubles is getting incredible support."
paras.zh: “这是一个很棒的平台，双打得到了令人难以置信的支持。”

paras.en: Heliovaara also addressed the crowd, thanking Patten and their team, saying: "I'm going to say that Henry is the best partner in the world for doubles. I've been lucky enough to play with him for two and a half years.
paras.zh: 赫利奥瓦拉也向观众致谢，感谢彭定康和他们的团队，他说：“我想说亨利是世界上最好的双打搭档。我很幸运能和他一起打球两年半。

paras.en: "We shared a lot of wins, a lot of losses, but most of all, a lot of time everywhere in the world, really. On the court, off court, it's been a very nice, amazing trip together. But it's not just the two of us, I think it's also our team there in the box, in the spotlight today.
paras.zh: “我们分享了很多胜利，也分享了很多失利，但最重要的是，我们在世界各地度过了很多时间，真的。无论在场上还是场外，这都是一次非常美好、令人惊叹的共同之旅。但这不仅仅是我们两个人的事情，我认为我们的球队也在禁区里，今天成为了聚光灯下的焦点。”

paras.en: "I would like that we also give a big hand to every one of them. It's a lot of sacrifices from us, from the team, and obviously our families at home. Everybody who has helped us to achieve something like this. And to have a trophy like that at home, we will be very proud for a very long time."
paras.zh: “我希望我们也向他们每一个人伸出援手。这是我们、球队、当然还有我们家里的家人做出的巨大牺牲。每个帮助我们取得这样成就的人。在家里拥有这样的奖杯，我们将在很长一段时间内感到非常自豪。”

paras.en: Patten and Heliovaara will now turn their attention to the task at hand in Turin, where they are 1-0 in round-robin play. They defeated Orlando Luz and Rafael Matos in a match tie-break on Sunday.
paras.zh: 帕滕和赫利奥瓦拉现在将把注意力转向都灵的任务，他们在循环赛中以 1-0 获胜。他们在周日的抢七中击败了奥兰多·卢兹和拉斐尔·马托斯。

articles.title: Rice verbally agrees new Arsenal contract

paras.en: Declan Rice contract: Arsenal midfielder verbally agrees new deal with the Premier League champions
paras.zh: 德克兰·赖斯合同：阿森纳中场口头同意与英超冠军的新合同

paras.en: Declan Rice has just over 18 months left on his existing contract, with a further year's option in Arsenal's favour; the Premier League champions want to bring him in line with the club's top earner, Bukayo Saka; Rice admitted on England duty that he is close to a new agreement
paras.zh: 德克兰·赖斯(Declan Rice)现有合同仅剩18个月多一点，阿森纳还可以选择再续约一年；英超冠军希望他能与俱乐部收入最高的球员布卡约·萨卡（Bukayo Saka）保持一致；赖斯在英格兰队任职时承认他即将达成新协议

paras.en: Declan Rice has verbally agreed terms on a new long-term contract at Arsenal, Sky Sports News can reveal.
paras.zh: 据天空体育新闻透露，德克兰·赖斯已口头同意阿森纳新的长期合同条款。

paras.en: Sky Sports News has been told his new deal will bring him in line with Bukayo Saka, who is the highest-paid player at the Emirates.
paras.zh: 天空体育新闻获悉，他的新合同将使他与酋长球场薪水最高的球员布卡约·萨卡保持一致。

paras.en: Rice and his representatives have been in negotiations for several months, with the club keen to tie down one of their most important players, even though he still has 18 months left on his existing contract, with a further year's option in the club's favour.
paras.zh: 莱斯和他的代表已经进行了几个月的谈判，俱乐部渴望留住他们最重要的一名球员，尽管他与俱乐部的现有合同还有18个月的期限，且俱乐部还有一年的续约选择权。
