paras.zh: “远离水面，远离岩石和码头，永远不要背对大海，”国家气象局补充道，并提到了“运动鞋波浪”的风险——强大的水流可以达到海滩上比预期更高的高度，但最终会以潜在的致命力量拉回海洋。

paras.en: Despite the warnings, big-wave watchers gathered at famed lookout points like Mavericks Beach in northern California’s Half Moon Bay.
paras.zh: 尽管有警告，巨浪观察者还是聚集在著名的观景点，例如加州北部半月湾的 Mavericks 海滩。

paras.en: Mavericks is considered one of the premier big-wave surfing spots in North America, with water cresting as high as a five-storey building. Surfers from across the world have descended on the beach in recent days to catch swells reaching approximately 18 metres, or 60 feet.
paras.zh: Mavericks 被认为是北美首屈一指的大浪冲浪点之一，浪高高达五层楼。最近几天，来自世界各地的冲浪者纷纷涌向海滩，捕捉高达 18 米（60 英尺）的海浪。

paras.en: Some of the offshore waves have been so strong that they were detected by the Berkeley Seismology Lab, which wrote about the phenomenon on its blog.
paras.zh: 一些离岸波浪非常强烈，以至于伯克利地震实验室检测到了它们，并在其博客上写下了这一现象。

paras.en: “A few miles offshore, there are no beaches for the waves to hit, but their bottoms bang into the continental shelf, where the shallow coastal waters drop off sharply into deeper ocean regions,” the lab explained.
paras.zh: 该实验室解释说：“在离岸几英里的地方，没有可供海浪撞击的海滩，但它们的底部会撞到大陆架上，那里的浅沿海水域急剧下降到更深的海洋区域。”

paras.en: “This impact is strong enough to make all of California shake. In fact, it makes the entire continent wiggle a little.”
paras.zh: “这种冲击力足以让整个加州都摇晃起来。事实上，它让整个大陆都有点摇晃。”

paras.en: While it is typical for California to experience storms in November and December, this year’s heavy rainfall and powerful surf have been turbocharged by a climate phenomenon known as El Nino.
paras.zh: 虽然加利福尼亚州在 11 月和 12 月经历风暴是很常见的，但今年的强降雨和强大的海浪因厄尔尼诺气候现象而加剧。

paras.en: The El Nino pattern occurs when the recurrent warming of the eastern tropical Pacific Ocean releases heat into the atmosphere. Already, experts say ocean temperatures off of California are reaching record levels for this time of year, making the water feel warmer than normal.
paras.zh: 当东部热带太平洋反复变暖向大气中释放热量时，就会发生厄尔尼诺现象。专家表示，加利福尼亚州附近的海洋温度已经达到一年中这个时候的创纪录水平，使海水感觉比平时温暖。

paras.en: El Nino can also alter weather patterns around the world. Scientists and state officials expect an especially strong El Nino this year to result in heavy rain for California in the coming weeks.
paras.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象还会改变世界各地的天气模式。科学家和州政府官员预计，今年特别强烈的厄尔尼诺现象将在未来几周内给加州带来大雨。

paras.en: “The odds of an unusually wet, and perhaps exceptionally wet, second half of November continue to rise in California,” climate scientist Daniel Swain said in a social media post.
paras.zh: 气候科学家丹尼尔·斯温（Daniel Swain）在社交媒体帖子中表示：“加州 11 月下半月出现异常潮湿，甚至可能异常潮湿的可能性继续上升。”

articles.title: Sudanese army air attack kills 13 in western Sudan: Rights group

paras.en: An air strike launched by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) has killed at least 13 civilians in the Abu Qalb area of West Kordofan state, according to the Emergency Lawyers rights group.
paras.zh: 据紧急律师人权组织称，苏丹武装部队 (SAF) 发动的空袭已造成西科尔多凡州阿布盖尔布地区至少 13 名平民死亡。

paras.en: Warplanes belonging to the military government carried out the attack on the Abu Zabad locality, with the victims including women and children, “according to preliminary monitoring” the legal collective said in a social media post on Monday. Al Jazeera was unable to immediately verify the report.
paras.zh: 该法律团体周一在社交媒体上发帖称，“根据初步监测”，属于军政府的战机对阿布扎巴德地区发动了袭击，受害者包括妇女和儿童。半岛电视台无法立即核实该报道。

paras.en: Several homes were also destroyed in the strike, which took place the previous day, Emergency Lawyers said. The group, which documents human rights violations and crimes in the war between the SAF and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF), cited videos circulating of “horrific scenes” of destruction.
paras.zh: 紧急律师说，前一天发生的罢工还摧毁了几所房屋。该组织记录了苏丹武装部队和准军事快速支援部队（RSF）之间战争中的侵犯人权行为和犯罪行为，并引用了流传的“可怕的破坏场景”视频。

paras.en: “The continued use of indiscriminate airstrikes on residential areas poses a direct threat to civilian lives and constitutes a grave violation of the rules of international humanitarian law,” it said in its statement.
paras.zh: 声明称，“继续对居民区进行不分青红皂白的空袭，对平民生命构成直接威胁，严重违反国际人道法规则。”

paras.en: Mohamed Didan, the official spokesperson for the Special Operations Forces that fight alongside the SAF, said on Facebook that his troops had moved through Abu Zabad and “eliminated” RSF positions in West Kordofan.
paras.zh: 与苏丹武装部队并肩作战的特种作战部队官方发言人穆罕默德·迪丹在脸书上表示，他的部队已穿过阿布扎巴德，并“消灭”了无国界医生组织在西科尔多凡的阵地。

paras.en: The war between the army and the RSF, which began in April 2023, has created one of the world’s worst humanitarian crises, according to several aid organisations.
paras.zh: 据多个援助组织称，军队与无国界医生组织之间于 2023 年 4 月开始的战争造成了世界上最严重的人道主义危机之一。

paras.en: Reports say the war has killed at least 59,000 people, displaced about 13 million and pushed parts of the country into famine.
paras.zh: 报道称，战争已造成至少 59,000 人死亡，约 1,300 万人流离失所，并使该国部分地区陷入饥荒。

paras.en: Much of the fighting is concentrated in Darfur and Kordofan, although it recently shifted towards the Blue Nile province.
paras.zh: 大部分战斗集中在达尔富尔和科尔多凡，尽管最近战事转移到了青尼罗省。

paras.en: Drone warfare has also surged during the war, becoming the deadliest threat to civilians. Both sides are being supplied with drones by countries in the Middle East and beyond, experts have said.
paras.zh: 战争期间无人机战争也激增，成为对平民最致命的威胁。专家表示，中东及其他地区的国家正在向双方提供无人机。

paras.en: The SAF has gained control over several strategically important villages and localities in West Kordofan recently in a push into the western reaches of the country.
paras.zh: 苏丹武装部队最近控制了西科尔多凡州几个具有重要战略意义的村庄和地区，并向该国西部地区挺进。

articles.title: California files lawsuit against OpenAI alleging lack of proper safeguards

paras.en: California has filed a lawsuit against the technology firm OpenAI, alleging that the company endangered the public by developing an artificial intelligence model without the appropriate safeguards.
paras.zh: 加州已对科技公司 OpenAI 提起诉讼，指控该公司在没有适当保障措施的情况下开发人工智能模型，从而危害公众。

paras.en: The lawsuit, announced by Attorney General Rob Bonta on Monday, centres on an incident that unfolded in July, when one of OpenAI’s experimental models gained access to the internet.
paras.zh: 司法部长 Rob Bonta 于周一宣布了这起诉讼，其核心是 7 月份发生的一起事件，当时 OpenAI 的一个实验模型获得了互联网访问权限。

paras.en: It proceeded to launch a days-long cyberattack on the AI hosting platform Hugging Face.
paras.zh: 随后，它对人工智能托管平台 Hugging Face 发起了长达数天的网络攻击。

paras.en: In the California complaint, Bonta argues that the incident indicates that OpenAI pursues growth over guardrails, leading to potentially dangerous errors.
paras.zh: 在加州的投诉中，Bonta 认为该事件表明 OpenAI 追求增长越过护栏，导致潜在的危险错误。

paras.en: “The Hugging Face attack was the predictable result of an internal culture at OpenAI that prioritises growth and rapid model development over safety and accountability — and this was only one of 80 known incidents,” Bonta said in a statement.
paras.zh: Bonta 在一份声明中表示：“拥抱脸攻击是 OpenAI 内部文化的可预见结果，这种文化优先考虑增长和快速模型开发，而不是安全和问责——而这只是 80 起已知事件之一。”

paras.en: The lawsuit is the first brought by a state in response to the July incident. It alleges that OpenAI violated California’s consumer protection laws and created a public nuisance through its actions.
paras.zh: 该诉讼是各州针对 7 月事件提起的首起诉讼。它指控 OpenAI 违反了加州的消费者保护法，并通过其行为造成了公众滋扰。

paras.en: The complaint, filed in a state court in San Francisco, calls for civil penalties against OpenAI and an injunction to bar it from engaging in actions that constitute “unfair competition”.
paras.zh: 该诉状向旧金山州法院提起，要求对 OpenAI 进行民事处罚，并颁布禁令，禁止其从事构成“不公平竞争”的行为。

paras.en: “The simple truth is that the attack was entirely foreseeable in light of OpenAI’s decision to test models it knew to be dangerous in a flawed and exploitable testing environment without proper oversight,” the complaint reads.
paras.zh: 诉状中写道：“简单的事实是，鉴于 OpenAI 决定在有缺陷且可利用的测试环境中测试其已知的危险模型，而没有适当的监督，这次攻击是完全可以预见的。”

paras.en: The Hugging Face incident became a catalyst for anxieties in the US about the explosive growth of the AI industry and the relatively light oversight it receives from the government.
paras.zh: “抱脸”事件引发了美国民众对人工智能行业爆炸性增长以及政府监管相对宽松的担忧。

paras.en: President Donald Trump’s administration has largely opposed blanket regulations on the AI industry, warning that such rules could stifle the industry’s growth.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府在很大程度上反对对人工智能行业进行全面监管，并警告称此类规则可能会抑制该行业的增长。

paras.en: In December 2025, for instance, Trump issued an executive order attempting to limit the ability of individual states to pass laws that might govern AI development.
paras.zh: 例如，2025 年 12 月，特朗普发布了一项行政命令，试图限制各个州通过可能管理人工智能发展的法律的能力。

paras.en: “United States AI companies must be free to innovate without cumbersome regulation. But excessive State regulation thwarts this imperative,” the order reads.
paras.zh: 该命令写道：“美国人工智能公司必须在没有繁琐监管的情况下自由创新。但过度的国家监管阻碍了这一必要性。”

paras.en: “My Administration must act with the Congress to ensure that there is a minimally burdensome national standard — not 50 discordant State ones.”
paras.zh: “我的政府必须与国会合作，确保制定一个最低限度负担的国家标准，而不是 50 个不一致的国家标准。”

paras.en: Polls, however, show that a majority of Americans want to see greater oversight of AI development and are wary that the technology could fuel economic and social disruptions.
paras.zh: 然而，民意调查显示，大多数美国人希望看到对人工智能发展的更严格监督，并担心该技术可能会加剧经济和社会混乱。

paras.en: The Associated Press and the NORC Center for Public Affairs Research, for instance, found in October that 64 percent of US adults believe AI is developing too rapidly. Roughly 81 percent said the technology should be kept under human control, rather than be left to operate independently.
paras.zh: 例如，美联社和 NORC 公共事务研究中心 10 月份发现，64% 的美国成年人认为人工智能发展得太快。大约 81% 的人表示，该技术应该处于人类控制之下，而不是让它独立运行。

paras.en: Several high-profile resignations in the AI sector — notably that of Jacob Coxon in September — have also spurred concerns about the lack of oversight.
paras.zh: 人工智能领域的几位高调辞职——尤其是 9 月份雅各布·考克森 (Jacob Coxon) 的辞职——也引发了人们对缺乏监管的担忧。

paras.en: “They are racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives,” Coxon, formerly a researcher at the AI firm Anthropic, wrote in a social media post about his departure.
paras.zh: “他们正一路狂奔，朝着自我进化的超级智能冲刺，拿我们的生命在豪赌。”人工智能公司Anthropic的前研究员科克森在一条关于他离职的社交媒体帖文中写道。

paras.en: “Do not underestimate the power of this technology. These will soon be superhuman systems that can hack anything, revolutionize any field overnight, and acquire real power and resources.”
paras.zh: “不要低估这项技术的力量。这些很快就会成为超人系统，可以破解任何东西，在一夜之间彻底改变任何领域，并获得真正的力量和资源。”

paras.en: In Monday’s lawsuit, California officials accuse companies like OpenAI of failing to “adequately secure and monitor” their AI tests. It also alleged that the company had obstructed state investigators when they attempted to look into incidents like the Hugging Face hacking.
paras.zh: 在周一的诉讼中，加州官员指责 OpenAI 等公司未能“充分保护和监控”他们的人工智能测试。它还声称，该公司在州调查人员试图调查“拥抱脸”黑客事件等事件时阻碍了他们。

paras.en: “OpenAI thwarted the Attorney General’s efforts to investigate these incidents, including by refusing to provide detailed information about the full universe of incidents known to the company,” the lawsuit said.
paras.zh: 诉讼称：“OpenAI 阻碍了总检察长调查这些事件的努力，包括拒绝提供该公司已知的全部事件的详细信息。”

paras.en: OpenAI has responded to July’s incident by stating that it would reinforce its safety measures and acknowledging the need for greater transparency.
paras.zh: OpenAI 对 7 月份的事件做出了回应，表示将加强其安全措施并承认需要提高透明度。

paras.en: In September, it also published a framework for “tracking, investigating, and disclosing instances of model misalignment” to better inform lawmakers and the public.
paras.zh: 9 月，它还发布了一个“跟踪、调查和披露模型错位实例”的框架，以更好地告知立法者和公众。

articles.title: Chris Van Hollen says he can beat Chuck Schumer. Here's his case
articles.author: Steve Inskeep

paras.en: Chris Van Hollen says he can beat Chuck Schumer. Here's his case
paras.zh: 克里斯·范·霍伦说他可以击败查克·舒默。这是他的案例

paras.en: Sen. Chris Van Hollen of Maryland said Monday that he is gaining momentum in his bid to unseat longtime Democratic leader Chuck Schumer, taking a traditionally private Senate leadership contest into public view.
paras.zh: 马里兰州参议员克里斯·范·霍伦 (Chris Van Hollen) 周一表示，他正在努力推翻长期担任民主党领袖的查克·舒默 (Chuck Schumer)，将传统上不公开的参议院领导权竞争带入公众视野。

paras.en: "Well, I'm the underdog, but we are really moving in the right direction here," Van Hollen told NPR's Steve Inskeep on Morning Edition.
paras.zh: “好吧，我是失败者，但我们确实正在朝着正确的方向前进，”范·霍伦在早间版节目中告诉 NPR 的史蒂夫·英斯基普。

paras.en: Over the weekend, he appeared on CNN, ABC and Fox News to make his case for new Democratic leadership after his party's sweeping midterm victories. Schumer, who has led Senate Democrats for nearly a decade, says he has enough votes to remain leader.
paras.zh: 周末，他出现在美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN)、美国广播公司 (ABC) 和福克斯新闻频道上，为民主党在中期选举中取得压倒性胜利后为新的民主党领导层辩护。领导参议院民主党近十年的舒默表示，他有足够的选票来保持领导地位。

paras.en: Van Hollen is hardly a Washington outsider. The progressive Democrat has spent nearly 25 years on Capitol Hill, served as a deputy to then-House Speaker Nancy Pelosi and led Democratic campaign efforts in both chambers. He has been a vocal opponent of the Trump administration's immigration crackdown and dismantling of the U.S. Agency for International Development, and he has called for investigations into the administration's foreign aid cuts.
paras.zh: 范霍伦并不是华盛顿的局外人。这位进步的民主党人在国会山工作了近 25 年，担任时任众议院议长南希·佩洛西 (Nancy Pelosi) 的副手，并领导了参众两院的民主党竞选活动。他一直强烈反对特朗普政府镇压移民和解散美国国际开发署，并呼吁对政府削减对外援助的行为进行调查。

paras.en: Schumer has continued to support U.S. military assistance to Israel despite his criticism of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Van Hollen, by contrast, has pushed to restrict weapons sales and military aid to the Israeli government over its war in Gaza, while pressing for more humanitarian aid to Palestinians.
paras.zh: 尽管舒默批评总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡，但他继续支持美国对以色列的军事援助。相比之下，范霍伦则因加沙战争而推动限制向以色列政府出售武器和提供军事援助，同时敦促向巴勒斯坦人提供更多人道主义援助。

paras.en: "I certainly oppose the idea of an American taxpayer blank check to the government of Israel, regardless of its actions," Van Hollen said.
paras.zh: 范霍伦说：“我当然反对向以色列政府发放美国纳税人空白支票的想法，无论以色列政府采取什么行动。”

paras.en: Van Hollen also wants Democratic leaders to stay out of contested primaries. He pointed to the victories of incoming Sens. Abdul El-Sayed of Michigan and Peggy Flanagan of Minnesota.
paras.zh: 范霍伦还希望民主党领导人不要参与竞争激烈的初选。他指出了即将上任的密歇根州参议员阿卜杜勒·赛义德和明尼苏达州参议员佩吉·弗拉纳根的胜利。

paras.en: "We have two senators-elect who would not be there if the current majority leader had his way," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果现任多数党领袖按他的方式行事，我们有两名当选参议员，他们就不会出席。”

paras.en: He described the midterm victories as a populist rejection of President Trump, rather than an election orchestrated by Washington Democrats.
paras.zh: 他将中期选举的胜利描述为民粹主义对特朗普总统的拒绝，而不是华盛顿民主党精心策划的选举。

paras.en: Van Hollen also cited legislation to strengthen labor unions, which never received a vote on the Senate floor. On the war in Iran, he called for an end to further funding.
paras.zh: 范霍伦还引用了加强工会的立法，该立法从未在参议院获得投票。关于伊朗战争，他呼吁停止进一步提供资金。

paras.en: "We should not be voting for one penny in mid-December to continue this war," he said.
paras.zh: “我们不应该在 12 月中旬投票一分钱来继续这场战争，”他说。

paras.en: Van Hollen will need close to 30 votes, a simple majority of the Senate Democratic caucus, to win. The election will be decided by secret ballot behind closed doors, making it difficult to know how many votes either candidate secured.
paras.zh: 范霍伦需要获得近 30 票，即参议院民主党核心小组的简单多数票才能获胜。选举将通过闭门无记名投票方式决定，因此很难知道两位候选人获得了多少票。

paras.en: Listen to the full interview by clicking the blue button above.
paras.zh: 单击上面的蓝色按钮即可收听完整采访。

paras.en: The digital version of this live interview was edited by Suzanne Nuyen.
paras.zh: 本次现场采访的数字版本由 Suzanne Nuyen 编辑。

articles.title: FAA ground stop still affecting thousands of flights. And, Trump meets Xi, Putin in Asia
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: FAA ground stop still affecting thousands of flights. And, Trump meets Xi, Putin in Asia
paras.zh: 美国联邦航空局 (FAA) 地面停止仍然影响数千个航班。而且，特朗普在亚洲会见习近平和普京

paras.en: Travelers are expected to face continued disruptions at airports as airlines recover from Friday's nationwide ground stop. As of Sunday evening, more than 2,300 flights have been canceled, and more than 8,000 flights within, into or out of the U.S. have been delayed, according to FlightAware.com. Dallas-Fort Worth and Atlanta airports saw the most disruptions, with over 250 delayed flights each. U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said L3Harris Technologies Inc., a federal contractor, was doing routine maintenance in at least one remote location, changing copper wire to fiber optics.
paras.zh: 随着航空公司从周五的全国地面停靠中恢复过来，预计旅客在机场将面临持续的干扰。据 FlightAware.com 统计，截至周日晚间，已有 2,300 多个航班被取消，8,000 多个进出美国的航班被延误。达拉斯-沃斯堡和亚特兰大机场受到的干扰最为严重，各有超过 250 个航班延误。美国交通部长肖恩·达菲 (Sean Duffy) 表示，联邦承包商 L3Harris Technologies Inc. 正在至少一个偏远地点进行日常维护，将铜线更换为光纤。

paras.en: - 🎧 The U.S. air traffic system remains safe, and this recent incident is considered an unusual meltdown, NPR's Joel Rose tells Up First. The Federal Aviation Administration believes it has identified the issue, and airlines will be ready for the holiday travel rush. Rose says the nation's air traffic system has suffered from decades of underinvestment by Congress and administrations from both parties. Before the ground stop, Duffy had requested $30 billion to upgrade the air traffic control system. Now he seems to be asking for $50 billion by the end of the year, on top of the $12.5 billion for air traffic equipment that the Trump administration secured from Congress last year. Democrats, who will control Congress in January, are not responding positively to Duffy's latest request. Rose expects Democrats to seek more clarity on the administration's spending and the causes of the ground stop.
paras.zh: - 🎧 美国空中交通系统仍然安全，最近发生的这起事件被认为是一次不寻常的崩溃，NPR 的乔尔·罗斯 (Joel Rose) 告诉 Up First。美国联邦航空管理局相信已经发现了这个问题，航空公司将为假期旅行高峰做好准备。罗斯表示，美国的空中交通系统因国会和两党政府数十年来投资不足而受到影响。在地面停留之前，达菲要求花费 300 亿美元来升级空​​中交通管制系统。现在，除了特朗普政府去年从国会获得的 125 亿美元空中交通设备资金外，他似乎还要求在今年年底前再拨款 500 亿美元。将于一月份控制国会的民主党人没有对达菲的最新要求作出积极回应。罗斯预计民主党将进一步澄清政府的支出和停工的原因。

paras.en: As Democrats gear up for substantial majorities in Congress, one question looms: who will take the helm? So far, no one has challenged Rep. Hakeem Jeffries for the House speaker role. Meanwhile, Sen. Chris Van Hollen of Maryland is setting his sights on unseating longtime leader Chuck Schumer in the Senate.
paras.zh: 随着民主党准备在国会获得绝大多数席位，一个问题迫在眉睫：谁将掌舵？到目前为止，还没有人挑战众议员哈基姆·杰弗里斯（Hakeem Jeffries）担任众议院议长一职。与此同时，马里兰州参议员克里斯·范·霍伦(Chris Van Hollen)的目标是推翻参议院长期领导人查克·舒默(Chuck Schumer)。

paras.en: - 🎧 A wave of incoming senators has spent months hearing voters demand change in Washington. NPR's Eric McDaniel says this presents a real opportunity for Van Hollen and a potential risk for Schumer, especially after the recent election results. Van Hollen needs 30 Democrats to secure a simple majority. He has support he needs from popular progressives like Bernie Sanders, and incoming members like Abdul El-Sayed and Peggy Flanagan, McDaniel says. Since votes are cast by secret ballot, it's uncertain how many will back each leader when they convene in a few weeks, and McDaniel says anything could happen.
paras.zh: - 🎧 一波即将上任的参议员花了几个月的时间听取选民对华盛顿变革的要求。 NPR 的埃里克·麦克丹尼尔表示，这对范·霍伦来说是一个真正的机会，但对舒默来说却是一个潜在的风险，特别是在最近的选举结果公布之后。范霍伦需要 30 名民主党人才能获得简单多数。麦克丹尼尔说，他需要伯尼·桑德斯等受欢迎的进步人士以及阿卜杜勒·赛义德和佩吉·弗拉纳根等新成员的支持。由于投票是通过无记名投票进行的，因此不确定在几周后召开的会议上有多少人会支持每位领导人，麦克丹尼尔说任何事情都有可能发生。

paras.en: President Trump is traveling to the Philippines and China this morning for a high-profile trip, which includes a trilateral summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. This marks Trump's second visit to China this year. The trip to Asia comes as the administration faces scrutiny following Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation. Huang admitted to an extramarital affair with a woman linked to China's top spy agency, according to The New York Times. He traveled to China with Trump earlier this year; this time, tech billionaire Elon Musk is accompanying Trump to Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统今天上午将前往菲律宾和中国进行一次备受瞩目的访问，其中包括与中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统普京举行三边峰会。这是特朗普今年第二次访华。这次亚洲之行正值英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋辞职后政府面临审查之际。据《纽约时报》报道，黄承认与一名与中国最高间谍机构有联系的女性有婚外情。今年早些时候，他与特朗普一起访问了中国。此次，科技亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克陪同特朗普前往深圳。

paras.en: - 🎧 It's not unusual for presidents who face midterm election defeats to shift their focus to foreign policy, NPR's Mara Liasson says. But Trump's recent foreign policy efforts, including tariffs and the war in Iran, have been widely unpopular and seen as reasons why his party lost in the midterms, Liasson says. The White House said that Trump isn't expected to address pressing issues like the war in Ukraine or tensions with China during this trip. Instead, he plans to discuss the war in Iran and nuclear weapons. Trump will also skip mentioning Huang's affair. Bringing up the Nvidia situation could serve as a reminder that many in Congress believe the U.S. should restrict access to advanced chips in China. Trump disagrees with Congress on the matter, likely due to his ties with Huang, who committed millions of dollars for Trump's ballroom, Liasson says.
paras.zh: - NPR 的玛拉·利亚森 (Mara Liasson) 表示，对于面临中期选举失败的总统来说，将注意力转向外交政策并不罕见。但利亚森表示，特朗普最近的外交政策努力，包括关税和伊朗战争，普遍不受欢迎，并被视为他的政党在中期选举中失败的原因。白宫表示，预计特朗普此行不会解决乌克兰战争或与中国的紧张局势等紧迫问题。相反，他计划讨论伊朗战争和核武器。特朗普也将跳过提及黄的事件。提起英伟达的情况可能会提醒人们，国会中的许多人认为美国应该限制中国获得先进芯片。利亚森说，特朗普在此事上与国会意见不一，这可能是因为他与黄的​​关系，黄为特朗普的舞厅投入了数百万美元。

paras.en: Living Better is a special series about what it takes to stay healthy in America.
paras.zh: 《生活得更好》是一个关于如何在美国保持健康的特别系列。

paras.en: Sleep plays a crucial role in weight management. Studies have found that poor sleep can increase appetite and lead to overeating, making it harder to shed pounds. On the flip side, quality sleep might actually enhance your weight-loss efforts. One study found that participants in a year-long weight-loss program who enjoyed better sleep lost more weight and fat. So, prioritizing sleep could be your secret weapon in the journey to a healthy weight. Here's what researchers say:
paras.zh: 睡眠在体重管理中起着至关重要的作用。研究发现，睡眠不足会增加食欲并导致暴饮暴食，从而使减肥变得更加困难。另一方面，优质睡眠实际上可能会增强您的减肥效果。一项研究发现，参加为期一年的减肥计划的参与者如果睡眠质量更好，体重和脂肪会减少更多。因此，优先考虑睡眠可能是您实现健康体重的秘密武器。研究人员是这样说的：

paras.en: - 😴 While evidence linking more sleep to weight loss is limited, there is consistent science connecting insufficient sleep to weight gain.
paras.zh: - 😴 虽然将更多睡眠与减肥联系起来的证据有限，但有一致的科学证据表明睡眠不足与体重增加有关。

paras.en: - 😴 Lack of sleep increases activity in brain regions associated with pleasure and reward, making it harder to make good food choices.
paras.zh: - 😴 睡眠不足会增加与快乐和奖励相关的大脑区域的活动，使人们更难做出良好的食物选择。

paras.en: - 😴 Not having enough sleep can disrupt circadian rhythms and reduce insulin sensitivity, encouraging fat storage and weight gain.
paras.zh: - 😴睡眠不足会扰乱昼夜节律并降低胰岛素敏感性，从而促进脂肪储存和体重增加。

paras.en: - 😴 The relationship between sleep and food goes both ways. Eating added sugars and saturated fats disrupts sleep and reduces deep sleep, while consuming fruits, vegetables and fiber improves sleep quality and decreases nighttime awakenings.
paras.zh: - 😴 睡眠和食物之间的关系是双向的。吃添加糖和饱和脂肪会扰乱睡眠并减少深度睡眠，而吃水果、蔬菜和纤维则可以改善睡眠质量并减少夜间醒来。

paras.en: Route 66 is celebrating an incredible century as America's most iconic highway. Stretching across eight states — from the vibrant streets of Chicago to the sun-soaked shores of Santa Monica, Calif. — this legendary route invites you to embrace the spirit of adventure on the open road. Imagine cruising through vast plains, rolling prairies, stunning canyons and shimmering deserts. Along the way, you'll discover a mix of big cities, charming cow towns and ghost towns. Over the decades, Route 66 has inspired countless songs, been captured in books, been seen in artwork and been celebrated in Pixar's 2006 animated movie Cars. So hop in, buckle up and experience the magic of Route 66 through these photos.
paras.zh: 66 号公路作为美国最具标志性的高速公路正在庆祝一个令人难以置信的世纪。这条传奇路线横跨八个州——从芝加哥充满活力的街道到加利福尼亚州圣莫尼卡阳光普照的海岸——邀请您在开阔的道路上拥抱冒险精神。想象一下，巡航穿过广阔的平原、连绵起伏的大草原、令人惊叹的峡谷和闪闪发光的沙漠。一路上，您会发现大城市、迷人的牛镇和鬼城。几十年来，66 号公路激发了无数歌曲的灵感，被记录在书籍中、出现在艺术作品中，并在皮克斯 2006 年的动画电影《赛车总动员》中受到赞扬。因此，跳上车，系好安全带，通过这些照片体验 66 号公路的魔力。

paras.en: - NASA's Voyager 1 has traveled farther than any human-launched object and is about to reach a new milestone: reaching a distance that's one light-day away from Earth.
paras.zh: - NASA 航海者 1 号的飞行距离比任何人类发射的物体都要远，并且即将达到一个新的里程碑：到达距地球一光日的距离。

paras.en: - New Orleans port officials have filed a lawsuit against the owner and operator of the Atlantic Asphalt tanker that crashed into a docked cruise ship in the Mississippi River. They are seeking at least $1 million in damages.
paras.zh: - 新奥尔良港口官员对大西洋沥青油轮的所有者和运营商提起诉讼，这艘油轮在密西西比河上撞上了一艘停靠的游轮。他们正在寻求至少 100 万美元的损失赔偿。

paras.en: - Mauricio Pochettino, who guided the U.S. men's national soccer team to a Round of 16 finish in the 2026 FIFA World Cup, is leaving to become the head coach of Manchester United in the English Premier League.
paras.zh: - 带领美国国家男子足球队在 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯上闯入 16 强的毛里西奥·波切蒂诺 (Mauricio Pochettino) 将出任英超曼联队主教练。

articles.title: U.N. talks seek to rein in 'killer robots' as fears over AI weapons grow
articles.author: Imogen Foulkes

paras.en: U.N. talks seek to rein in 'killer robots' as fears over AI weapons grow
paras.zh: 随着对人工智能武器的担忧加剧，联合国会谈寻求遏制“杀手机器人”

paras.en: GENEVA — Negotiations on possible rules for the use of lethal autonomous weapons, also known as 'killer robots' are underway at the United Nations in Geneva.
paras.zh: 日内瓦——位于日内瓦的联合国正在就使用致命自主武器（也称为“杀手机器人”）的可能规则进行谈判。

paras.en: Supporters of controls on autonomous weapons say this week's U.N. conference on Certain Conventional Weapons (or CCW), which meets just once every five years, is the last best chance to agree rules before it is too late.
paras.zh: 自主武器管制的支持者表示，本周召开的联合国特定常规武器会议每五年举行一次，是在为时已晚之前达成规则的最后最佳机会。

paras.en: Warfare technology has advanced rapidly in the last few years, with some experts warning that the world is just months away from having weapons that can choose targets and make the decision to kill autonomously.
paras.zh: 战争技术在过去几年中迅速发展，一些专家警告说，世界距离拥有能够选择目标并自主做出杀伤决定的武器只有几个月的时间。

paras.en: In Ukraine and Gaza, AI-assisted weapons have already been used to take out targets, with Ukrainian civilians reporting being 'hunted' by drones as they shop or go to school. But these are still controlled remotely by humans.
paras.zh: 在乌克兰和加沙，人工智能辅助武器已经被用来消灭目标，乌克兰平民报告说，他们在购物或上学时遭到无人机“追捕”。但这些仍然是由人类远程控制的。

paras.en: Humanitarian organizations say the decision to kill – and responsibility for that choice – must stay in human hands. Ahead of this week's meeting, the United Nations, the International Committee of the Red Cross and the Pope have all called for legally binding rules. U.N. Secretary-General Antonio Guterres warned that allowing fully autonomous weapons to kill would be 'crossing a moral red line'.
paras.zh: 人道主义组织表示，杀戮的决定以及这一选择的责任必须掌握在人类手中。在本周的会议之前，联合国、红十字国际委员会和教皇都呼吁制定具有法律约束力的规则。联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯警告说，允许完全自主的武器杀人将“跨越道德红线”。

paras.en: The Red Cross is especially worried that existing rules of war – the Geneva Conventions – cannot be fully respected by autonomous weapons. War is often chaotic and confusing, and the situation can change rapidly. Under the Conventions, soldiers who are wounded or in the process of surrendering can no longer be targeted.
paras.zh: 红十字会尤其担心自主武器无法充分遵守现有的战争规则——《日内瓦公约》。战争往往是混乱无序、局势瞬息万变的。根据公约，受伤或正在投降的士兵不能再成为攻击目标。

paras.en: Georgia Haines, a legal adviser with the Red Cross, worries that autonomous weapons will not be able to distinguish between a soldier who is still fighting, one who is wounded and one who wants to surrender.
paras.zh: 红十字会法律顾问乔治亚·海恩斯担心，自主武器将无法区分仍在战斗的​​士兵、受伤的士兵和想要投降的士兵。

paras.en: 'The risk is that, based on the technology we are seeing, they are not able to understand in the same way that a human is the contextual signals. And so the risks are incredibly high that there will be a misidentification of a target.'
paras.zh: “风险在于，根据我们所看到的技术，它们无法像人类那样理解上下文信号。因此，错误识别目标的风险非常高。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, human rights groups warn that the technology behind AI-assisted weapons is becoming increasingly cheap and easy to use. The more it is adopted by the military, the greater the danger of proliferation and its use by terrorist groups or law enforcement agencies in repressive regimes. In theory, a swarm of autonomous drones could be programmed to kill everyone wearing a red sweater, everyone carrying a poster or even everyone speaking a certain language.
paras.zh: 与此同时，人权组织警告说，人工智能辅助武器背后的技术正变得越来越便宜且易于使用。军队采用的越多，扩散以及被恐怖组织或专制政权的执法机构使用的危险就越大。理论上，一群自主无人机可以被编程杀死每个穿红色毛衣的人、每个拿着海报的人，甚至每个人说某种语言的人。

paras.en: Many of the countries now meeting in Geneva take such concerns very seriously. At least 50, including Ireland, Italy, Brazil, Mexico, France and Germany, are calling for a strict timetable to agree on binding rules governing autonomous weapons.
paras.zh: 目前在日内瓦召开会议的许多国家都非常重视此类关切。包括爱尔兰、意大利、巴西、墨西哥、法国和德国在内的至少 50 个国家呼吁制定严格的时间表，以就管理自主武器的约束性规则达成一致。

paras.en: But among states that are already developing and using semi-autonomous weapons, there is pushback. The United States, Russia and Israel have indicated they are set to oppose legally binding rules, with Washington proposing a five-year timetable to draft non-binding guidelines instead.
paras.zh: 但在已经开发和使用半自主武器的国家中，却出现了阻力。美国、俄罗斯和以色列已表示他们将反对具有法律约束力的规则，而华盛顿则提出了一个五年时间表来起草不具约束力的指导方针。

paras.en: The U.S. is traditionally a late adopter of international treaties. It did not ratify the Ottawa Convention on landmines, for example, although it did, over time, stop deploying them and reduce its stockpiles.
paras.zh: 传统上，美国是国际条约的较晚采用者。例如，它没有批准《渥太华地雷公约》，尽管随着时间的推移，它确实停止部署地雷并减少库存。

paras.en: Under President Trump, doubts about international law have grown. Washington has imposed sweeping sanctions on the International Criminal Court, and just this weekend, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, in a keynote speech to the Federalist Society, warned against "quoting laws to men with swords."
paras.zh: 在特朗普总统的领导下，人们对国际法的怀疑有所增加。华盛顿对国际刑事法院实施了全面制裁，就在本周末，国务卿马可·卢比奥在联邦党人协会的主题演讲中警告不要“向持剑之人引用法律”。

paras.en: The problem for states meeting in Geneva is that U.N. negotiations on limiting specific weapons are supposed to be conducted by consensus. This was achieved in 1995, when countries agreed to a ban on blinding lasers, but other agreements have proved elusive. With landmines, countries frustrated by the delay finally took negotiations outside the U.N. process to create the Ottawa Convention.
paras.zh: 各国在日内瓦举行会议的问题是，联合国关于限制特定武器的谈判应该以协商一致方式进行。这一目标于 1995 年实现，当时各国同意禁止致盲激光，但事实证明其他协议难以达成。由于地雷问题，因拖延而感到沮丧的国家最终在联合国制定《渥太华公约》的进程之外进行了谈判。

paras.en: This week, there may be a compromise: a longer or even open-ended negotiating period to come up with rules that individual states can adopt as binding or non-binding. For diplomats supporting such a solution, it is a way to ensure at least some progress. For campaigners, it is less than ideal, with one likening it to kicking a very dangerous can down the road.
paras.zh: 本周，可能会达成妥协：更长甚至不限成员名额的谈判期，以制定各国可以采用的有约束力或无约束力的规则。对于支持这种解决方案的外交官来说，这是确保至少取得一些进展的一种方式。对于活动人士来说，这并不理想，有人将其比作将一个非常危险的罐子踢到路上。

articles.title: Devin Hester says chasing rabbits through Florida sugarcane fields helped build NFL speed

paras.en: Devin Hester made a Hall of Fame career out of being faster than just about everyone else on the football field. And apparently, growing up in South Florida came with some pretty unconventional speed training.
paras.zh: 德文·赫斯特 (Devin Hester) 因比足球场上的其他人都快而进入了名人堂。显然，在南佛罗里达长大的过程中伴随着一些非常规的速度训练。

paras.en: In a recent interview with Whistle, the legendary Chicago Bears return specialist was asked what makes football players from Florida different. His answer? Year-round football, plenty of time playing outside and, believe it or not, chasing rabbits.
paras.zh: 在最近接受 Whistle 采访时，这位传奇的芝加哥熊队回归专家被问到是什么让佛罗里达州的橄榄球运动员与众不同。他的答案是什么？全年都可以踢足球，有充足的时间在户外玩耍，不管你信不信，还可以追兔子。

paras.en: "I'm from West Palm, and so West Palm out in the Glades area, they ran in the Muck where they chase the rabbits," Hester said. "They get paid for catching rabbits."
paras.zh: “我来自西棕榈岛，所以西棕榈岛在空地地区，他们在淤泥中奔跑，追逐兔子，”海丝特说。 “他们通过抓兔子获得报酬。”

paras.en: Yes, actual rabbits. And it wasn't just a game.
paras.zh: 是的，真正的兔子。这不仅仅是一场游戏。

paras.en: "You had family members that ate rabbits. So like, you catch a rabbit, kill them. You catch about three rabbits. That's about $60," Hester explained.
paras.zh: “你有家庭成员吃兔子。就像，你抓住一只兔子，杀死它们。你抓住大约三只兔子。这大约是 60 美元，”海丝特解释道。

paras.en: When the interviewer asked what he meant by running in the Muck, Hester clarified that he was talking about sugarcane fields.
paras.zh: 当采访者问他“在泥地里跑”是什么意思时，Hester解释说，他指的是甘蔗田。

paras.en: "That's how you made your money on the weekends," he said.
paras.zh: “这就是你周末赚钱的方式，”他说。

paras.en: Hester added that while he never ate the rabbits himself, he had aunts, uncles and grandfathers who did.
paras.zh: 海丝特补充说，虽然他自己从未吃过兔子，但他的阿姨、叔叔和祖父却吃过。

paras.en: And if this all sounds a little strange, there's actually quite a bit of history behind it.
paras.zh: 如果这一切听起来有点奇怪，其实背后有相当多的历史。

paras.en: In the agricultural communities surrounding Lake Okeechobee — particularly Belle Glade and Pahokee — chasing rabbits through sugarcane fields has been a tradition for generations. The region is nicknamed "the Muck" for its dark, fertile soil.
paras.zh: 在奥基乔比湖周围的农业社区，尤其是贝尔格莱德和帕霍基，在甘蔗田里追兔子已经成为几代人的传统。该地区因其深色肥沃的土壤而被昵称为“淤泥”。

paras.en: During sugarcane harvests, farmers traditionally burned the fields to clear away excess vegetation, sending rabbits running out of the cane. Locals would chase them down, sometimes catching them by hand. Some rabbits were eaten, while others were sold for extra money.
paras.zh: 在甘蔗收获期间，农民传统上会焚烧田地以清除多余的植被，让兔子从甘蔗中跑出来。当地人会追赶它们，有时甚至用手抓住它们。有些兔子被吃掉了，有些则被卖掉换取额外的钱。

paras.en: A 2013 Washington Post story about former Maryland cornerback Will Likely detailed the practice, describing rabbit chasing as a way of life in the Muck rather than simply a childhood pastime.
paras.zh: 2013 年《华盛顿邮报》一篇关于前马里兰州角卫威尔·莱利 (Will Likely) 的报道详细介绍了这种做法，将追逐兔子描述为沼泽地的一种生活方式，而不仅仅是一种童年消遣。

paras.en: The tradition was also featured in the 2023 PBS documentary "Outta the Muck," which explores the history, culture and football legacy of Pahokee.
paras.zh: 这一传统还出现在 2023 年 PBS 纪录片《Outta the Muck》中，该片探讨了帕霍基的历史、文化和足球遗产。

paras.en: And Hester certainly isn't the only NFL player with a connection to rabbit chasing.
paras.zh: 海丝特当然不是唯一一个与追兔子有联系的 NFL 球员。

paras.en: Former Cleveland Browns wide receiver and return specialist Travis Benjamin, who grew up in Belle Glade, once credited the activity for his agility.
paras.zh: 在贝尔格莱德长大的前克利夫兰布朗队外接手和回攻专家特拉维斯·本杰明（Travis Benjamin）曾将他的敏捷性归功于这项活动。

paras.en: "I really do think chasing rabbits helped me develop agility," Benjamin told the Browns' official website in 2014. "Sometimes when I watch my punt returns on film, it reminds me of being a kid with the rabbits."
paras.zh: “我确实认为追兔子帮助我提高了敏捷性，”本杰明在 2014 年告诉布朗队的官方网站。“有时，当我在电影中看到我的弃踢回攻时，这让我想起了小时候和兔子在一起的时光。”

paras.en: Benjamin said he caught hundreds of rabbits growing up, including 15 during his first outing when he was just 12 years old. His speed eventually earned him the nickname "The Rabbit" from his Browns teammates.
paras.zh: 本杰明说，他在成长过程中捕获了数百只兔子，其中 15 只是在他 12 岁时第一次郊游时捕获的。他的速度最终为他赢得了布朗队队友的绰号“兔子”。

paras.en: And Hester, of course, went on to become one of the most dangerous return men in NFL history. The four-time Pro Bowler and three-time first-team All-Pro retired with an NFL-record 20 combined return touchdowns and became the first player inducted into the Pro Football Hall of Fame primarily as a return specialist.
paras.zh: 当然，海丝特后来成为 NFL 历史上最危险的回归者之一。这位四届职业投球手和三届全职业队第一阵容的球员以创造 NFL 纪录的 20 次接球达阵退役，并成为第一位主要作为接球专家入选职业橄榄球名人堂的球员。

paras.en: Love all things wildlife and outdoors? Follow OutKick OutDoors on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube!
paras.zh: 喜欢野生动物和户外活动吗？在 Instagram、TikTok 和 YouTube 上关注 OutKick OutDoors！

articles.title: JD Vance says he and Trump still 'don't know' whether Alice Huang was a Chinese spy

paras.en: Vice President JD Vance said he and President Donald Trump are still unsure about whether Alice Huang, the Chinese businesswoman at the center of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's extramarital affairs, was working as a Chinese spy, even after reviewing intelligence.
paras.zh: 副总裁 JD 万斯表示，即使在审查了情报之后，他和唐纳德·特朗普总统仍不确定英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋婚外情的中心人物爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 是否担任中国间谍。

paras.en: "I think what the president is just pointing at is there is a lack of clarity about it. I don't know. And he doesn't know whether this woman was a spy or not," Vance told host Laura Ingraham.
paras.zh: 万斯告诉主持人劳拉·英格拉汉姆：“我认为总统的意思是，这件事不够明确。我不知道。而且他也不知道这个女人是否是间谍。”

paras.en: The vice president discussed the controversy surrounding Nvidia, as well as Friday’s nationwide ground stop, during an interview on "The Ingraham Angle" set to air Monday at 7 p.m. ET.
paras.zh: 这位副总统在周一晚上 7 点播出的“The Ingraham Angle”节目中讨论了围绕 Nvidia 的争议以及周五的全国停飞事件。等。

paras.en: U.S. officials suspect Alice Huang was recruited by China to influence Nvidia to make its advanced chips more available to Beijing, according to the New York Times. The Chinese businesswoman became a regular presence in Jensen Huang’s professional circle, frequently accompanying him to corporate events and dinners.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，美国官员怀疑黄爱丽是被中国招募来影响英伟达，让其先进芯片更容易为北京所用。这位中国女商人成为黄仁勋职业圈子里的常客，经常陪同他参加公司活动和晚宴。

paras.en: Vance told Fox News that the intelligence he viewed on the investigation was not sufficient enough for him and the president to conclude that Alice Huang was spying on behalf of China, arguing that intel can sometimes be conflicting.
paras.zh: 万斯告诉福克斯新闻，他在调查中看到的情报不足以让他和总统得出爱丽丝黄正在代表中国进行间谍活动的结论，并认为情报有时可能是相互矛盾的。

paras.en: "The reason is because this intelligence always points in different directions," Vance said. "The thing I've learned about intelligence, Laura, I think Henry Kissinger once said that you think you're really smart by reading all the intelligence, and then you realize that because the intelligence disagrees with itself."
paras.zh: “原因是这种情报总是指向不同的方向，”万斯说。 “劳拉，我对情报的了解，我想亨利·基辛格曾经说过，通过阅读所有情报，你会认为自己真的很聪明，然后你就会意识到这一点，因为情报本身并不相符。”

paras.en: The espionage allegations, as well as Jensen Huang’s admission to engaging in extramarital affairs, rocked the stock market and raised national security concerns.
paras.zh: 间谍指控以及黄仁勋承认婚外情震动了股市并引发了国家安全担忧。

paras.en: Many believe the Chinese businesswoman could have been gathering intelligence on one of America’s most highly valued technology companies for China.
paras.zh: 许多人认为，这名中国女商人可能正在为中国收集有关美国估值最高的科技公司之一的情报。

paras.en: Nvidia has said, however, Huang’s meetings with Alice Huang were not unusual, adding that he meets with thousands of executives each year.
paras.zh: 不过，英伟达表示，黄与 Alice Huang 的会面并不罕见，并补充说他每年都会与数千名高管会面。

paras.en: Vance said the fact of whether Alice Huang was spying for China or not is largely insignificant in the broader scandal. The vice president said strengthening America's domestic industrial base and safeguarding critical technology takes precedence.
paras.zh: 万斯表示，爱丽丝·黄是否为中国从事间谍活动这一事实在更广泛的丑闻中基本上无关紧要。副总统表示，加强美国国内工业基础和保护关键技术是当务之急。

paras.en: "That actually is not the main issue. The main issue is we need to industrialize the country and protect our critical technology and our critical infrastructure," he said. "And the only way to do that is to build more of it in the United States of America and prevent it from falling into the wrong hands."
paras.zh: “这实际上不是主要问题。主要问题是我们需要实现国家工业化并保护我们的关键技术和关键基础设施，”他说。 “做到这一点的唯一方法就是在美国建造更多这样的设施，并防止它落入坏人之手。”

paras.en: China has rejected allegations of Alice Huang being a spy and the Justice Department has not determined whether she was providing Beijing with intelligence.
paras.zh: 中国否认了黄爱丽是间谍的指控，司法部尚未确定她是否向北京提供情报。

articles.title: United Airlines experiences ‘widespread system outage’ days after nationwide FAA ground stop

paras.en: United Airlines acknowledged a widespread system outage Monday as passengers reported planes unable to take off, days after a nationwide FAA ground stop disrupted travel across the country.
paras.zh: 联合航空周一承认出现大范围系统中断，乘客报告飞机无法起飞，几天前美国联邦航空局在全国范围内进行地面停靠，扰乱了全国各地的旅行。

paras.en: "We're aware of the widespread system outage, and our teams are working hard to get things back up and running as soon as possible," United’s official X account wrote in response to a passenger.
paras.zh: 美联航官方 X 账户在回复一位乘客时写道：“我们意识到系统出现大范围中断，我们的团队正在努力尽快恢复正常运行。”

paras.en: The airline apologized and urged travelers to monitor their flight status through the United app or its website. Its response did not identify the cause or provide an estimated restoration time.
paras.zh: 该航空公司道歉并敦促旅客通过美联航应用程序或其网站监控航班状态。它的回应没有查明原因或提供估计的恢复时间。

paras.en: One passenger reported being stuck on the tarmac, saying crews could not clear planes for takeoff because they could not connect to a weight system.
paras.zh: 一名乘客报告被困在停机坪上，称机组人员无法让飞机起飞，因为他们无法连接到重量系统。

paras.en: Another social media user said their flight was returning to the gate after the pilot announced a company wide IT issue that left the crew "unable to get performance data for takeoff."
paras.zh: 另一位社交媒体用户表示，飞行员宣布公司范围内的 IT 问题导致机组人员“无法获取起飞性能数据”后，他们的航班正在返回登机口。

paras.en: "Pilot just announced ALL of United Airlines has a company wide IT issue," the user wrote. "We’re going back to the gate."
paras.zh: 该用户写道：“Pilot 刚刚宣布，联合航空所有公司都出现了全公司范围内的 IT 问题。” “我们要回门口了。”

paras.en: Another passenger reported a similar announcement while waiting for departure.
paras.zh: 另一位乘客在等待出发时也报告了类似的消息。

paras.en: "Waiting to take off, on the runway, and the pilot just said we can’t take off because United is experiencing a system-wide computer outage," the user wrote.
paras.zh: 该用户写道：“在跑道上等待起飞，飞行员只是说我们无法起飞，因为美联航正在经历全系统计算机故障。”

paras.en: The X account @theATCapp also posted that it was receiving reports of a systemwide IT outage affecting the airline.
paras.zh: X 帐户 @theATCapp 还发布消息称，它收到了影响航空公司的系统范围 IT 中断的报告。

paras.en: United’s response acknowledged a widespread outage but did not confirm the passengers’ descriptions of the affected systems. The number of flights and airports affected was not immediately clear.
paras.zh: 美联航的回应承认发生了大范围的停电，但没有证实乘客对受影响系统的描述。目前尚不清楚受影响的航班和机场数量。

paras.en: The outage comes after a telecommunications failure prompted the Federal Aviation Administration to issue a nationwide ground stop Friday, Nov. 13. The restriction was later lifted, but airlines faced lingering delays and cancellations as they worked to restore their schedules.
paras.zh: 此次停电是在 11 月 13 日星期五，由于电信故障促使美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 发布了全国范围内的地面停飞令后发生的。该限制后来被取消，但航空公司在努力恢复航班时刻表的过程中面临着挥之不去的延误和取消。

paras.en: Following Friday’s ground stop, United CEO Scott Kirby praised the FAA’s decision to halt flights and thanked employees and customers for their patience. He also called for better technology and full staffing to help prevent future outages.
paras.zh: 周五的地面停留后，美联航首席执行官斯科特·柯比赞扬了美国联邦航空局暂停航班的决定，并感谢员工和乘客的耐心。他还呼吁采用更好的技术和充分的人员配备，以帮助防止未来的停电。

paras.en: Kirby said he had spoken directly with Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy, FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford and aviation leaders from both parties in Congress about the impact on United’s passengers and employees.
paras.zh: 柯比表示，他已直接与交通部长肖恩·达菲、美国联邦航空局局长布莱恩·贝德福德以及国会两党航空业领导人讨论了此次事件对美联航乘客和员工的影响。

paras.en: "This moment must be a call to action," Kirby said in a statement shared with Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 柯比在与福克斯新闻数字频道分享的一份声明中表示：“这一刻必须呼吁采取行动。”

paras.en: "It is critical for safety, our passengers, and our economy that we fix our nation’s Air Traffic Control system now."
paras.zh: “我们现在修复国家的空中交通管制系统对于安全、乘客和经济都至关重要。”

paras.en: Kirby said lawmakers from both parties were committed to modernizing the system while holding the FAA accountable.
paras.zh: 柯比表示，两党立法者都致力于使该系统现代化，同时追究联邦航空局的责任。

paras.en: There was no immediate confirmation that United’s outage Monday was connected to Friday’s FAA disruption.
paras.zh: 目前还没有立即证实美联航周一的停电与周五美国联邦航空管理局 (FAA) 的停电有关。

paras.en: Fox News Digital reached out to United Airlines for additional comment.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字媒体联系了美国联合航空公司以征求更多评论。

paras.en: This is a developing story. Please check back for updates.
paras.zh: 这是一个发展的故事。请回来查看更新。

articles.title: Saudi Arabia strategy challenged by anti-Houthi forces in Yemen
articles.author: Patrick Wintour Diplomatic editor

paras.en: Saudi Arabia has been accused by anti-Houthi forces over its military strategy after its Yemeni allies withdrew troops from the strategic Bab al-Mandab strait and pulled back forces from parts of Marib in the central part of the country.
paras.zh: 在也门盟友从战略性的曼德海峡撤军并从该国中部马里卜部分地区撤军后，沙特阿拉伯因其军事战略而受到反胡塞武装的指责。

paras.en: The Saudi-backed government explained the repositioning by saying the strategic priority was to break the attritional siege on Taiz, Yemen’s third city, and to protect Aden, the southern port city in which the Saudi-backed and UN-recognised government is now based.
paras.zh: 沙特支持的政府解释了这一重新定位，称战略重点是打破对也门第三城市塔伊兹的消耗性围困，并保护南部港口城市亚丁，沙特支持且得到联合国承认的政府目前驻扎在亚丁。

paras.en: Many blame the Houthi advance on the absence of a consolidated military command and control among the disparate forces backing the Aden-based government. Saudi Arabia responded to the setback by sidelining the commander of its Yemen coalition, Lt Gen Fahd bin Abdulaziz al-Salman, and replacing him with the chief of staff, Gen Fayyad bin Hamed bin Ruqad al-Ruwaili.
paras.zh: 许多人将胡塞武装的进展归咎于支持亚丁政府的不同部队之间缺乏统一的军事指挥和控制。沙特阿拉伯为应对这一挫折，将也门联军指挥官法赫德·本·阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·萨勒曼中将排除在外，并由参谋长法耶德·本·哈米德·本·鲁卡德·鲁瓦利将军取而代之。

paras.en: The Houthis’ steady advance towards the areas surrounding Bab al-Mandab, the narrow strait linking the Red Sea with the Indian Ocean on Yemen’s west coast, culminated on Sunday with a formal withdrawal of Yemen government forces, including some in the Southern Giants Brigades that had always been reluctant to defend territory outside the old southern Yemen. In 1990 Yemen had been divided in two, and many in the south want to return to a separated state.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装向曼德海峡（也门西海岸连接红海和印度洋的狭窄海峡）周围地区稳步推进，周日，也门政府军正式撤出，其中包括一些一直不愿保卫也门南部以外领土的南方巨人旅。 1990 年，也门被一分为二，南部的许多人希望回到一个分离的国家。

paras.en: The Saudi-backed government launched a fresh military campaign 42 days ago to drive the Houthis from Yemen but so far it has backfired.
paras.zh: 42天前，沙特支持的政府发起了新的军事行动，将胡塞武装赶出也门，但迄今为止却适得其反。

paras.en: The forces redeployed on Sunday have moved along the coast to al-Suqyah, 95 miles west of Aden, and inside the old Southern Yemen.
paras.zh: 周日重新部署的部队已沿着海岸转移到亚丁以西 95 英里处的苏基亚 (al-Suqyah)，位于旧也门南部境内。

paras.en: The retreat seems to be acknowledgment of Houthi resilience and is all the more remarkable given the Saudi air superiority. More than 300,000 Yemeni civilians have been displaced.
paras.zh: 这次撤退似乎是对胡塞武装韧性的认可，考虑到沙特的空中优势，这一撤退就显得更加引人注目。超过30万也门平民流离失所。

paras.en: Amr al-Bidh, special representative of the exiled Southern Transitional Council (STC) leader, Aidarous al-Zubaidi, a separatist anti-Houthi force that is opposed by Saudi Arabia, accused the Saudis of incompetence – and in effect warned Riyadh that unless it became more open to a southern state it would lack the cohesive forces required to prevent the Houthis becoming a permanent security threat.
paras.zh: 流亡的南方过渡委员会（STC）领导人艾达鲁斯·祖拜迪（Aidarous al-Zubaidi）是沙特阿拉伯反对的反胡塞分离主义势力的特别代表阿姆鲁·比德（Amr al-Bidh），他指责沙特无能，实际上警告利雅得，除非它对南方国家更加开放，否则它将缺乏防止胡塞武装成为永久安全威胁所需的凝聚力。

paras.en: He said: “When there is no strategy and no plan, it is inevitable the Houthis would take advantage. The STC will defend the south to the last man but we are fighting with one hand behind our backs since January after Saudi Arabia attacks on the STC.
paras.zh: 他说：“当没有战略和计划时，胡塞武装不可避免地会乘虚而入。STC将保卫南部直至最后一人，但自一月份沙特阿拉伯袭击STC以来，我们一直在背后进行单手作战。”

paras.en: “The STC forces retain a credible capability on the ground. But we need practical and political support from the region to counter the Houthis and create the basis for a negotiated settlement, one in which the pathway towards southern independence is fully recognised. We cannot continue like this or else the Houthis will keep expanding.”
paras.zh: “南方过渡委员会部队在当地保留了可靠的能力。但我们需要该地区的实际和政治支持来对抗胡塞武装，并为谈判解决方案奠定基础，使南方独立的道路得到充分认可。我们不能继续这样下去，否则胡塞武装将继续扩张。”

paras.en: The breadth of support for the STC, backed by the United Arab Emirates, however, remains disputed. The movement suffered a near fatal setback in January and since then some of the Giants Brigades have switched to backing Riyadh.
paras.zh: 然而，阿拉伯联合酋长国支持的 STC 的支持范围仍存在争议。该运动在一月份遭受了近乎致命的挫折，从那时起，一些巨人旅转而支持利雅得。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia continues in effect to keep as many as 10 STC leaders hostage in Riyadh, and has refused to let al-Zubaidi to return from exile in Abu Dhabi. Al-Bidh argued the priority should be defensive, avoiding counteroffensives that backfire, improving command and control, and widening the coalition.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯实际上继续将多达 10 名 STC 领导人扣留在利雅得作为人质，并拒绝让流亡在阿布扎比的祖拜迪返回。比德认为，首要任务应该是防御，避免适得其反的反攻，改善指挥和控制，并扩大联盟范围。

paras.en: Al-Bidh said reconciliation would require Riyadh to acknowledge the political declaration al-Zubaidi made about a timetable for a southern state in January, and that al-Zubaidi’s return would boost morale and help unify chaotic southern military factions.
paras.zh: 比德表示，和解需要利雅得承认祖拜迪一月份就南方国家时间表发表的政治声明，祖拜迪的回归将提振士气，有助于统一混乱的南方军事派别。

paras.en: He said a recent Yemeni government cabinet reshuffle, including a new information minister, was designed primarily to try draw southerners into fighting the Houthis and not to change policy toward the south.
paras.zh: 他说，最近也门政府内阁改组，包括任命新的信息部长，主要是为了吸引南方人参与打击胡塞武装，而不是改变对南方的政策。

paras.en: He also urged the UK to use its diplomacy to bring in other actors rather than simply backing Riyadh. A group of southern Yemenis have written to the foreign secretary, Ed Miliband, seeking a review of UK policy. “We recognise that the longstanding advice from your office is to continue following the Saudi line while calling for unity among the anti-Houthi forces,” the letter said. “But you must surely recognise that every time Britain calls for ‘the unity and territorial integrity of Yemen’, it is asking the southern people and their armed forces to fight for a political outcome in which they do not believe”.
paras.zh: 他还敦促英国利用外交手段吸引其他参与者，而不是简单地支持利雅得。也门南部的一群人已写信给外交大臣埃德·米利班德，寻求对英国政策进行审查。信中说：“我们认识到，你的办公室长期以来的建议是继续遵循沙特路线，同时呼吁反胡塞武装团结一致。” “但你必须认识到，每次英国呼吁‘也门的统一和领土完整’时，它都是在要求南部人民及其武装部队为他们不相信的政治结果而战”。

paras.en: The former US special envoy to Yemen Tim Lenderking said the US administration was treating Yemen like a sideshow adding “world powers do not understand the gravity of what it is at stake here”. He warned “the problem is only going to get bigger through apathy and lack of attention”.
paras.zh: 美国前也门特使蒂姆·伦德金表示，美国政府将也门视为一场余兴节目，并补充说“世界大国不了解这里利害攸关的严重性”。他警告说，“由于冷漠和缺乏关注，问题只会变得更大”。

articles.title: Albanese signs on to Trump’s AI supply chain pact before leaders’ meeting at Quad summit
articles.author: Tom McIlroy in Manila

paras.en: Anthony Albanese will attempt to walk a tightrope in his relationship with Donald Trump when the two leaders meet on Tuesday, as Australia signed on to a US-led pact to secure the technologies and critical infrastructure for artificial intelligence supply chains.
paras.zh: 周二，两位领导人会面时，安东尼·阿尔博内塞将试图在与唐纳德·特朗普的关系中走钢丝，因为澳大利亚签署了一项以美国为首的协议，以确保人工智能供应链的技术和关键基础设施的安全。

paras.en: The Quad leaders’ summit in the Philippines’ capital of Manila will be Trump’s first, in either of his presidencies. The US president, fresh from a crushing midterms result, will take centre stage in gatherings of Asian leaders and prepare for historic three-way talks with Xi Jinping of China and Russia’s Vladimir Putin this week.
paras.zh: 在菲律宾首都马尼拉举行的四方领导人峰会将是特朗普在其任内的首次峰会。刚刚获得压倒性中期选举结果的美国总统将成为亚洲领导人聚会的中心舞台，并为本周与中国习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京进行历史性的三方会谈做准备。

paras.en: Underlying the diplomatic swing are efforts by the federal government to avoid angering China as the Quad leaders gather for the first time since 2024 – and after Australia joined countries, including the US and Japan, in an agreement for new protections around key AI technologies.
paras.zh: 外交摇摆的背后是联邦政府努力避免激怒中国，因为四方领导人自 2024 年以来首次齐聚，澳大利亚与美国和日本等国就关键人工智能技术达成了新的保护协议。

paras.en: Designed to firm up supply chains for chips and critical minerals components, the San Francisco Declaration was crafted to promote cooperation in the face of China’s efforts to control areas of AI development.
paras.zh: 《旧金山宣言》旨在巩固芯片和关键矿物部件的供应链，旨在促进合作，应对中国控制人工智能发展领域的努力。

paras.en: Part of the Pax Silica international accord, officials said the agreement would help ensure Trump worked with partners to set standards in AI, rather than relying on others for leadership.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，作为 Pax Silica 国际协议的一部分，该协议将有助于确保特朗普与合作伙伴合作制定人工智能标准，而不是依赖其他人的领导。

paras.en: The declaration vows to protect sensitive technologies – “including goods, software, materials, knowledge, components and inputs used to produce them, and their means of production essential to [AI] supply chains”.
paras.zh: 该宣言誓言保护敏感技术——“包括用于生产这些技术的商品、软件、材料、知识、组件和投入，以及对[人工智能]供应链至关重要的生产资料”。

paras.en: It also cites critical infrastructure – “the ports, terminals, transport, communications, and logistics networks, the ICT and energy infrastructure that their operations depend on, as well as the digital platforms that facilitate their coordination and management”.
paras.zh: 它还引用了关键基础设施——“港口、码头、运输、通信和物流网络、其运营所依赖的信息通信技术和能源基础设施，以及促进其协调和管理的数字平台”。

paras.en: Signatories include the UK, India, Israel, South Korea and Singapore.
paras.zh: 签署国包括英国、印度、以色列、韩国和新加坡。

paras.en: Albanese told the Asean-Australia summit on Monday that the region needed friendship, mutual trust and optimism to prosper.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯周一在东盟-澳大利亚峰会上表示，该地区需要友谊、互信和乐观才能繁荣。

paras.en: “At a time of global instability, the cooperation we demonstrate here will help us to confront the challenges we share at home and in our region,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在全球不稳定的时期，我们在这里展示的合作将有助于我们应对我们在国内和本地区共同面临的挑战。”

paras.en: Federal government sources told Guardian Australia the intense international efforts, including Albanese’s attendance at the Apec leaders’ meeting in Shenzhen, China, at the end of the week, was about maintaining engagement with Trump in the final two years of his presidency and stopping the US from withdrawing from global leadership.
paras.zh: 联邦政府消息人士告诉《澳大利亚卫报》，国际社会做出的巨大努力，包括阿尔巴内斯参加本周末在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织领导人会议，都是为了在特朗普总统任期的最后两年内保持与特朗普的接触，并阻止美国退出全球领导地位。

paras.en: Asia Society senior fellow Premesha Saha said the Quad talks would focus on critical minerals, maritime security and energy security.
paras.zh: 亚洲协会高级研究员普雷梅沙·萨哈表示，四方会谈将重点讨论关键矿产、海事安全和能源安全。

paras.en: “For Australia, keeping the United States engaged in the Indo-Pacific is a core strategic interest, and the Quad is one of the few settings where the president is tied into a regional agenda alongside three close partners,” Saha said.
paras.zh: 萨哈说：“对于澳大利亚来说，让美国参与印太地区是一项核心战略利益，而四方会谈是总统与三个密切伙伴一起参与地区议程的少数几个场合之一。”

paras.en: “After a year in which Washington has been engaged elsewhere and has opened its own channel with Beijing, getting Trump to a Quad leaders’ meeting in the region matters to Australia.”
paras.zh: “一年来，华盛顿一直在其他地方进行接触，并与北京打开了自己的渠道，让特朗普参加该地区的四方领导人会议对澳大利亚来说很重要。”

paras.en: Saha said Albanese’s objectives included keeping Washington engaged in the region and building a Quad capable of delivering results, even during shifts in US policy and interest.
paras.zh: 萨哈表示，阿尔巴内塞的目标包括让华盛顿继续参与该地区事务，并建立一个即使在美国政策和利益发生变化时也能取得成果的四方机制。

paras.en: “Beijing will criticise it, as it always does, and will cast it as bloc politics. But I will be cautious about overstating how much this will anger China,” she said.
paras.zh: “北京将一如既往地批评它，并将其视为集团政治。但我会谨慎地夸大这将激怒中国的程度，”她说。

paras.en: “The Quad isn’t a military alliance and Washington has gone out of its way to say it isn’t an anti-China coalition.”
paras.zh: “四方不是一个军事联盟，华盛顿也特意表示它不是一个反华联盟。”

paras.en: Jennifer Parker, a non-resident fellow at the Lowy Institute, said criticism of Albanese’s involvement in the annual international summit season was shortsighted.
paras.zh: 洛伊研究所的非常驻研究员詹妮弗·帕克表示，对阿尔巴尼斯参与年度国际峰会季的批评是短视的。

paras.en: “Our relationships in the region are essential to our security in an increasingly chaotic world, and our security is the backbone of our national prosperity,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“在日益混乱的世界中，我们在该地区的关系对于我们的安全至关重要，我们的安全是我们国家繁荣的支柱。”

paras.en: “It is important for Australia to be seen on the international stage and advocate for our national interests.”
paras.zh: “对于澳大利亚来说，在国际舞台上出现并倡导我们的国家利益非常重要。”

paras.en: Parker disagreed that Australia was working to keep the US engaged in the Asia Pacific region.
paras.zh: 帕克不同意澳大利亚正在努力让美国继续参与亚太地区的说法。

paras.en: “The US has enduring interests here, both economically and strategically. But sometimes it pays for Australia to remind them of that,” she said.
paras.zh: “美国在这里拥有持久的利益，无论是经济上还是战略上。但有时澳大利亚提醒他们这一点是值得的，”她说。

paras.en: Albanese announced a new Asean-Australia digital economy program on Monday to support AI safety and intelligence standards and digital trade standards.
paras.zh: Albanese 周一宣布了一项新的东盟-澳大利亚数字经济计划，以支持人工智能安全和情报标准以及数字贸易标准。

paras.en: He said humans must remain in control of AI, shaping the technology “rather than let it shape us”.
paras.zh: 他表示，人类必须保持对人工智能的控制，塑造技术“而不是让它塑造我们”。

paras.en: Albanese also held one-on-one talks with the Philippines president, Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内塞还与菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯进行了一对一会谈。

paras.en: He told his Laos counterpart, Saleumxay Kommasith, that Australia remained very concerned about the deaths of backpackers Bianca Jones and Holly Morton-Bowles, who died after drinking methanol-laced alcohol at a hostel in Vientiane in 2024.
paras.zh: 他告诉老挝外长 Saleumxay Kommasith，澳大利亚仍然非常关注背包客 Bianca Jones 和 Holly Morton-Bowles 的死亡事件，他们于 2024 年在万象一家旅馆饮用含有甲醇的酒精后死亡。

paras.en: Albanese said Australia remained concerned about the seriousness of charges over the deaths. Investigators said they did not have enough evidence to do more because autopsies were not carried out.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯表示，澳大利亚仍然对死亡指控的严重性感到担忧。调查人员表示，由于没有进行尸检，他们没有足够的证据来采取更多行动。

paras.en: Albanese called the case a “tragedy” and said it remained a serious issue in Australia.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯称此案为“悲剧”，并表示这在澳大利亚仍然是一个严重问题。

paras.en: Kommasith said the Laos government had attached importance to the case and officials were “trying our best to put an end to this by bringing those perpetrators into justice”.
paras.zh: 科马西斯表示，老挝政府高度重视此案，官员们正在“尽最大努力结束这一事件，将肇事者绳之以法”。

articles.title: Third US aircraft carrier brings thousands more troops to Middle East
articles.author: Associated Press

paras.en: A third US aircraft carrier has arrived in the Middle East, US Central Command said in a social media post on Monday, making a dramatic show of military might as Donald Trump keeps his options open for next steps in the Iran war.
paras.zh: 美国中央司令部周一在社交媒体帖子中表示，美国第三艘航空母舰已抵达中东，这戏剧性地展示了军事实力，而唐纳德·特朗普则为伊朗战争的下一步行动保留了选择余地。

paras.en: The USS Theodore Roosevelt brings thousands of additional troops to the Middle East as Trump has oscillated between threatening additional large-scale strikes on Iran and insisting that the more than eight-month-old war “militarily is effectively over”.
paras.zh: 西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰向中东增派了数千名士兵，特朗普在威胁对伊朗进行进一步大规模打击和坚称这场持续八个多月的战争“在军事上实际上已经结束”之间摇摆不定。

paras.en: The Roosevelt, along with its accompanying strike force, left San Diego in September. It joins the USS George HW Bush and the USS George Washington aircraft carriers, as well as smaller navy ships, which are in the region to maintain a naval blockade of Iranian shipping.
paras.zh: 罗斯福号及其随行打击部队于九月离开圣地亚哥。它与乔治·H·W·布什号航空母舰和乔治·华盛顿号航空母舰以及小型海军舰艇一起在该地区维持对伊朗航运的海上封锁。

paras.en: The George HW Bush arrived in the region in April, while the George Washington arrived in August. The navy previously had three carrier strike groups in the Middle East in April, for the first time since 2003.
paras.zh: 乔治·H·W·布什号于四月抵达该地区，而乔治·华盛顿号则于八月抵达该地区。此前，海军于4月份在中东部署了三个航母战斗群，这是自2003年以来的首次。

paras.en: In addition to the three aircraft carriers, the flotilla in the Arabian Sea now includes 13 destroyers, two cruisers and a littoral combat ship, according to the navy. Two more destroyers are in the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 据海军称，除了三艘航空母舰外，阿​​拉伯海的舰队目前还包括 13 艘驱逐舰、两艘巡洋舰和一艘濒海战斗舰。还有两艘驱逐舰正在红海。

paras.en: The Roosevelt had deployed along with the USS Makin Island amphibious readiness group, which includes the USS John P Murtha and USS Anchorage amphibious landing ships and around 2,000 marines. Those ships have yet to make it to the region.
paras.zh: 罗斯福号与马金岛号两栖战备大队一起部署，该大队包括约翰·P·穆萨号和安克雷奇号两栖登陆舰以及大约 2,000 名海军陆战队员。这些船只尚未抵达该地区。

paras.en: The third carrier arrived nearly two weeks after midterm elections that saw voters deliver major losses to Trump’s Republican party, driven in part by the unpopularity of the Iran war and its economic effects. The results led JD Vance to publicly break with Trump over the conflict, posting on social media that “the reason we lost is the war”.
paras.zh: 第三艘航母在中期选举近两周后抵达，选民们给特朗普领导的共和党带来了重大损失，部分原因是伊朗战争不受欢迎及其经济影响。结果导致JD万斯在冲突问题上公开与特朗普决裂，并在社交媒体上发帖称“我们失败的原因是战争”。

paras.en: Trump has insisted it was the right thing to do and has not ruled out restarting the conflict, which has been locked in a stalemate for months.
paras.zh: 特朗普坚称这是正确的做法，并且不排除重新启动冲突的可能性，冲突已陷入僵局数月。

paras.en: Last week, Trump warned Iran that the US military is “locked and loaded” and that the US was keeping an eye on Pickaxe Mountain, a facility linked to Iran’s nuclear program, for signs of activity.
paras.zh: 上周，特朗普警告伊朗，美军已“上膛并上膛”，并且美国正在密切关注与伊朗核计划有关的镐山设施，寻找活动迹象。

paras.en: “If something does not work out, I would not hesitate” to act, Trump told conservative broadcaster Hugh Hewitt on Thursday.
paras.zh: 特朗普周四对保守派广播公司休·休伊特表示，“如果事情没有解决，我会毫不犹豫地”采取行动。

paras.en: Yet, Trump also told reporters last week that he believed it was highly unlikely he would need to order new major strikes on Iran, declaring that the war “militarily is effectively over” after meeting with Qatar’s prime minister.
paras.zh: 然而，特朗普上周还告诉记者，他认为他不太可能下令对伊朗进行新的大规模打击，并在与卡塔尔总理会面后宣布战争“在军事上实际上已经结束”。

paras.en: Trump also declared that the US no longer needs a deal with Tehran and told Vance – who was a chief negotiator in earlier ceasefire talks – instead to focus on the administration’s domestic anti-fraud campaign targeting Democratic-controlled cities and states.
paras.zh: 特朗普还宣布美国不再需要与德黑兰达成协议，并告诉万斯 — — 他是早期停火谈判的首席谈判代表 — — 而是将重点放在政府针对民主党控制的城市和州的国内反欺诈运动上。

paras.en: Negotiations have stalled due to differences over Iran’s nuclear program, an issue that Trump insists be part of any deal meant to end the war. Iran wants the US first to agree to several core conditions, including lifting the naval blockade that is stopping its oil from getting to world markets.
paras.zh: 由于对伊朗核计划的分歧，谈判陷入僵局，特朗普坚称这一问题是任何旨在结束战争的协议的一部分。伊朗希望美国首先同意几个核心条件，包括解除阻止其石油进入世界市场的海上封锁。

paras.en: In the meantime, a focal point of the simmering conflict remains the strait of Hormuz, a critical waterway where a fifth of the world’s oil passed before the war.
paras.zh: 与此同时，日益激烈的冲突的焦点仍然是霍尔木兹海峡，这是一条重要的水道，战前世界上五分之一的石油都经过这里。

paras.en: Commercial ships are still coming under attack or facing other risks, while the US has carried out limited strikes on Iranian targets near the strait and is helping guide vessels through the contested waters.
paras.zh: 商船仍然受到攻击或面临其他风险，而美国对海峡附近的伊朗目标进行了有限的打击，并正在帮助引导船只通过有争议的水域。

paras.en: Iranian state TV, quoting the naval arm of Iran’s revolutionary guard and the army, warned shipping companies Monday that a US-supported route through the waterway is dangerous because of mines.
paras.zh: 伊朗国家电视台周一援引伊朗革命卫队海军部队和陆军的消息警告航运公司，美国支持的这条水道航线因地雷而存在危险。

paras.en: Mines have damaged six oil tankers since Sunday, polluting the strait’s coastlines, according to the revolutionary guard’s navy.
paras.zh: 据革命卫队海军称，自周日以来，地雷已损坏了六艘油轮，污染了海峡的海岸线。

paras.en: Separately, a projectile struck a tanker trying to transit through the strait, starting an engine room fire, but no casualties were reported, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Organization said.
paras.zh: 英国海事贸易组织表示，另外一枚炮弹击中了一艘试图通过该海峡的油轮，引发机舱火灾，但没有人员伤亡报告。

paras.en: US Central Command, which oversees military operations in the Middle East, said it has redirected 150 merchant vessels and disabled five since June under the blockade.
paras.zh: 负责监督中东军事行动的美国中央司令部表示，自 6 月以来，在封锁下，已调整了 150 艘商船的航线，并使 5 艘商船瘫痪。

paras.en: Independent assessments from Lloyd’s List, a maritime tracking and analysis firm, show that traffic through the strait remains at less than a third of prewar levels.
paras.zh: 海上追踪和分析公司劳合社的独立评估显示，通过该海峡的交通量仍不到战前水平的三分之一。

articles.title: Forensic expert says his analysis of autopsy photos suggests Epstein was killed

paras.en: This article contains distressing details and references to suicide
paras.zh: 这篇文章包含令人痛苦的细节和自杀的参考

paras.en: A forensic expert has said he believes that convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein's death in prison was the result of a homicide, not suicide.
paras.zh: 一名法医专家表示，他认为被定罪的性犯罪者杰弗里·爱泼斯坦在监狱中死亡是他杀而非自杀。

paras.en: Speaking to BBC Newsnight, Professor Michael Freeman said that after reviewing the New York City medical examiner's file he believes Epstein was strangled, most likely from behind.
paras.zh: 迈克尔·弗里曼教授在接受英国广播公司新闻之夜采访时表示，在审查了纽约市法医的档案后，他认为爱泼斯坦是被勒死的，很可能是从后面勒死的。

paras.en: The medical examiner who carried out the autopsy concluded in 2019 that Epstein's injuries were consistent with suicide and there was no evidence of the defensive wounds expected if his death had been a homicide.
paras.zh: 进行尸检的法医在 2019 年得出结论，爱泼斯坦的伤势符合自杀，并且没有证据表明他的死亡是他杀所预期的防御性伤口。

paras.en: Epstein was found dead in prison on 10 August 2019 in New York as he awaited trial on sex trafficking charges.
paras.zh: 2019 年 8 月 10 日，爱泼斯坦在纽约监狱中被发现死亡，当时他正在等待性交易指控的审判。

paras.en: Dr Barbara Sampson, chief medical examiner at the time of Epstein's autopsy, who ruled that Epstein's death was a suicide, has previously said: "I stand firmly behind our determination of the cause and manner of death for Mr. Epstein." The BBC has approached Sampson for further comment.
paras.zh: 爱泼斯坦尸检时的首席法医芭芭拉·桑普森博士裁定爱泼斯坦的死亡为自杀，她此前曾表示：“我坚决支持我们对爱泼斯坦先生死因和死亡方式的确定。” BBC 已联系桑普森寻求进一步评论。

paras.en: Freeman has served as a cause-of-death expert to attorneys-general in the US for death in police custody cases, including George Floyd in Minnesota.
paras.zh: 弗里曼曾担任美国总检察长的死因专家，负责处理警察拘留案件中的死亡案件，其中包括明尼苏达州的乔治·弗洛伊德案件。

paras.en: He published his research and the New York City medical examiner's files after presenting his findings in London on Monday evening.
paras.zh: 周一晚上，他在伦敦介绍了他的研究结果后，公布了他的研究结果和纽约市法医的档案。

paras.en: Freeman, who did not see the body, based his conclusions on the files and photographs from the examiner's report provided to him by Epstein's brother, Mark Epstein, who has always maintained that his brother was murdered.
paras.zh: 弗里曼没有看到尸体，他的结论是根据爱泼斯坦的兄弟马克·爱泼斯坦向他提供的检查员报告中的文件和照片得出的，马克·爱泼斯坦一直坚称他的兄弟是被谋杀的。

paras.en: Freeman said his analysis is independent and that he was not paid by Mark Epstein. His research has not been peer reviewed.
paras.zh: 弗里曼表示，他的分析是独立的，并且马克·爱泼斯坦没有向他支付报酬。他的研究尚未经过同行评审。

paras.en: He told the BBC that he believed there are signs indicating an assault on Epstein, including a deep haemorrhage to his left shoulder and injuries that appear to be consistent to being struck in the face.
paras.zh: 他告诉英国广播公司，他相信有迹象表明爱泼斯坦遭到袭击，包括他的左肩严重出血，面部受伤似乎与被击中一致。

paras.en: Freeman said he believed the evidence was most consistent with strangulation using a ligature and then that same ligature was probably used to suspend the body from the bunk bed.
paras.zh: 弗里曼说，他认为证据与使用结扎线勒死最为一致，然后可能使用相同的结扎线将尸体悬挂在双层床上。

paras.en: He said there appeared to be fingernail marks above the ligature mark on Epstein's neck, which "would be consistent with strangulation, particularly from behind. And the attempt by the victim to try to remove the ligature from the neck".
paras.zh: 他说，爱泼斯坦脖子上的结扎痕迹上方似乎有指甲痕迹，这“与勒死相一致，特别是从后面勒死。以及受害者试图从脖子上取下结扎的行为”。

paras.en: He said "the injuries and the way the body was found don't match up. There's only one remaining explanation then, and that is that the death was as a result of a homicide."
paras.zh: 他说，“伤势和尸体被发现的方式不符。那么只剩下一个解释，那就是他杀所致。”

paras.en: The medical examiner who performed the autopsy at the time told the Department of Justice (DoJ) Office of the Inspector General , externalthat Epstein's injuries were more consistent with, and indicative of, a suicide by hanging rather than homicide by strangulation, adding there was no evidence of defensive wounds consistent with what is seen in victims of strangulation.
paras.zh: 当时进行尸检的法医告诉司法部监察长办公室，爱泼斯坦的伤势更符合并表明是上吊自杀，而不是勒死他杀，并补充说没有证据表明防御性伤口与勒死受害者身上所见的情况一致。

paras.en: Freeman said he would have expected in an investigation of a death by hanging in custody for there to be a photograph before the body was taken down.
paras.zh: 弗里曼说，他本来希望在对羁押中上吊死亡事件进行调查时，在尸体被取下之前会有一张照片。

paras.en: According to a DoJ investigation into Epstein's time in prison, the guard who found Epstein immediately called for a second colleague to help, lowered Epstein's body to the floor and began attempts to resuscitate him.
paras.zh: 根据司法部对爱泼斯坦入狱时间的调查，发现爱泼斯坦的警卫立即呼叫另一位同事帮忙，将爱泼斯坦的尸体放倒在地板上，并开始尝试对他进行复苏。

paras.en: Epstein's death came a month after he was briefly placed on suicide watch, the DoJ report said.
paras.zh: 美国司法部的报告称，爱泼斯坦在被短暂置于自杀观察一个月后去世。

paras.en: When asked who might have killed Epstein if his interpretation of the evidence was correct, Freeman said he had "no idea".
paras.zh: 当被问及如果爱泼斯坦对证据的解释正确的话谁可能杀死了爱泼斯坦时，弗里曼说他“不知道”。

paras.en: "That is not something I have an opinion about. That isn't any part of any investigation that I've done," he said.
paras.zh: “我对此没有意见。这不是我所做的任何调查的一部分，”他说。

paras.en: Challenged on whether his views veered into conspiracy theory, Freeman said: "I have the luxury of being able to say, don't take my word for it, let everybody look at it."
paras.zh: 当被问到他的观点是否转向阴谋论时，弗里曼说：“我有幸能够说，不要相信我的话，让每个人都看看吧。”

paras.en: "If you think I'm still a conspiracy theorist because I'm looking at something that looks like a strangulation and say, I think it is a strangulation and I don't think it could be a hanging, show me where I got it wrong."
paras.zh: “如果你认为我仍然是一个阴谋论者，因为我正在看一些看起来像勒死的东西，然后说，我认为这是勒死，而且我不认为这可能是绞刑，请告诉我我哪里错了。”

paras.en: "I'm wide open to that. I'm an academic. I'm quite happy to hear people's theories on things that are informed," he said.
paras.zh: “我对此持开放态度。我是一名学者。我很高兴听到人们对知情事物的理论，”他说。

paras.en: Epstein was convicted in 2008 of soliciting prostitution from a minor, for which he was registered as a sex offender. He escaped a heavy jail sentence as a result of a plea deal.
paras.zh: 2008年，爱泼斯坦因招揽未成年人卖淫而被定罪，并因此被登记为性犯罪者。由于认罪协议，他逃脱了重刑。

paras.en: Eleven years later, Epstein was charged with running a network of underage girls for sex. He was awaiting trial in 2019 when he was found dead at the Metropolitan Correctional Center in New York City.
paras.zh: 十一年后，爱泼斯坦被指控经营一个以未成年女孩为性对象的网络。 2019 年，他在纽约市大都会惩教中心等待审判时被发现死亡。

articles.title: Houthi rebel advance in Yemen may further destabilise global economy

paras.en: The Iran-backed Houthi rebels who seized much of Yemen in 2014 have now forced the army of the internationally recognised government to withdraw from the Red Sea coast in order to defend their interim capital, Aden.
paras.zh: 2014年，伊朗支持的胡塞叛军占领了也门大部分地区，现在迫使国际公认政府的军队从红海沿岸撤军，以保卫其临时首都亚丁。

paras.en: Their advance bodes ill for Yemen's legitimate, internationally recognised government, its Saudi backers and, by extension, much of the rest of the world.
paras.zh: 他们的进展对也门合法的、国际公认的政府、其沙特支持者乃至世界其他许多国家来说都是一个坏兆头。

paras.en: Yemen, a mountainous, heavily armed, intensely tribal and largely impoverished nation, sits at the far south-west corner of the Arabian Peninsula.
paras.zh: 也门位于阿拉伯半岛的西南角，是一个多山、全副武装、部落人口密集且基本贫困的国家。

paras.en: The country has two coasts: One faces the Indian Ocean on which sits the once-prosperous trading port of Aden, the other faces the Red Sea and, most importantly, the narrow chokepoint at the southern exit of that waterway - the so-called Bab al-Mandab Strait or, in English, The Gate of Tears.
paras.zh: 该国有两个海岸：一个面向印度洋，那里坐落着曾经繁荣的贸易港口亚丁；另一个面向红海，最重要的是，该国面临着该水道南出口的狭窄阻塞点——所谓的曼德海峡，或者英语中的“泪水之门”。

paras.en: Whoever controls that strait can threaten any or all maritime traffic passing through from both the Mediterranean and the Red Sea to the Indian Ocean.
paras.zh: 无论谁控制了该海峡，都可以威胁从地中海和红海到印度洋的任何或所有海上交通。

paras.en: In normal times, it accounts for around 12% of global trade, with anywhere between 70 to 150 ships a day making the transit.
paras.zh: 正常情况下，它约占全球贸易的 12%，每天有 70 至 150 艘船舶在此过境。

paras.en: But not any more. Although the Houthis say they are no threat to maritime traffic, they are currently at war with Saudi Arabia, making it extremely hazardous for the Saudis to send their oil tankers past the now rebel-controlled coast.
paras.zh: 但不再是了。尽管胡塞武装声称他们对海上交通没有威胁，但他们目前正与沙特阿拉伯交战，这使得沙特将油轮驶过目前由叛军控制的海岸极为危险。

paras.en: When the US and Israel started a war with Iran in February, Tehran responded by choking off much of the oil trade flowing out of the Gulf through another narrow chokepoint - the Strait of Hormuz. This sent oil prices soaring, boosted inflation and hurt economies everywhere.
paras.zh: 当美国和以色列二月份与伊朗开战时，德黑兰的回应是切断了通过另一个狭窄的咽喉要道——霍尔木兹海峡流出海湾的大部分石油贸易。这导致油价飙升，加剧通货膨胀，损害各地经济。

paras.en: The Saudis had a Plan B. Instead of exporting their oil past the dangerous coast of Iran, where their tankers risked being droned or mined by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps, they started pumping it overland through their East-West Pipeline to an export terminal on the Red Sea at Yanbu. This worked for a while.
paras.zh: 沙特有一个B计划。他们没有通过危险的伊朗海岸出口石油，因为他们的油轮在那里有被伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队无人机或布雷的风险，而是开始通过东西向管道将石油从陆上泵送到红海延布的一个出口码头。这工作了一段时间。

paras.en: But then in July a cold truce between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis broke down, that pipeline got hit by drones and the rebels started firing missiles and drones at targets all over Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 但随后在 7 月，沙特阿拉伯和胡塞武装之间的冷休战破裂，该管道遭到无人机袭击，叛军开始向沙特阿拉伯各地的目标发射导弹和无人机。

paras.en: On land, the Houthis seized the initiative and made a lightning dash down the Red Sea coast, sending the Yemeni army into headlong retreat. A brief counter-offensive appears to have failed and the Houthis are now reported to be in full control of the Bab al-Mandab Strait and the nearby offshore islands.
paras.zh: 陆地上，胡塞武装抢占先机，闪电般冲过红海沿岸，将也门军队打得节节败退。短暂的反攻似乎已经失败，据报道胡塞武装现在完全控制了曼德海峡和附近的近海岛屿。

paras.en: Nicholas Hopton, a former British Ambassador to both Yemen and Iran and now director-general of the UK-based Middle East Association, says: "The decision by the legitimate government of Yemen to prioritise the military defence of Aden at the expense of withdrawing from other areas suggests that the war is not going well for the Saudi-backed [Yemeni] government. And the rest of the world should be worried."
paras.zh: 前英国驻也门和伊朗大使、现任英国中东协会总干事尼古拉斯·霍普顿表示：“也门合法政府决定优先考虑亚丁的军事防御，而不是从其他地区撤军，这表明沙特支持的（也门）政府的战争进展并不顺利。世界其他国家应该感到担忧。”

paras.en: He warns that if the port of Aden â a city of roughly 1.25 million inhabitants â was to fall to the Houthis, it "would undoubtedly precipitate a further escalation in the regional crisis and further fragility in the global economy, catalysed by the US-Iran war".
paras.zh: 他警告说，如果亚丁港——一座拥有约125万居民的城市——落入胡塞武装之手，“毫无疑问将导致地区危机进一步升级，并在美伊战争的推动下导致全球经济进一步脆弱”。

paras.en: But Mohammed al-Basha, the Yemeni founder of the US-based risk advisory firm Basha Report, believes the Houthis would struggle to capture the heavily fortified city of Aden.
paras.zh: 但总部位于美国的风险咨询公司巴沙报告的也门创始人穆罕默德·巴沙认为，胡塞武装将难以占领戒备森严的亚丁市。

paras.en: "Any attempt to seize a densely populated city like Aden would come at a significant human cost," Basha said. "Advancing across the flat coastal plains would also expose Houthi forces to air power."
paras.zh: 巴沙说：“任何夺取亚丁这样人口稠密城市的企图都会付出巨大的人员代价。” “穿越平坦的沿海平原也会让胡塞武装暴露在空中力量之下。”

paras.en: "For now, the Houthis appear to be seeking a negotiated surrender, hoping to exploit infighting and divisions among southern factions to achieve their objectives without a costly urban offensive."
paras.zh: “目前，胡塞武装似乎正在寻求谈判投降，希望利用南部各派之间的内斗和分歧来实现其目标，而无需进行代价高昂的城市攻势。”

paras.en: It is conceivable that the Yemen war will settle into a less dramatic but deeply unsatisfactory stasis - a situation where casualty figures subside yet the country remains split between areas controlled by the Houthis - Iran's Shia allies - and the disparate and often poorly motivated forces of the Saudi-backed Yemeni army.
paras.zh: 可以想象，也门战争将陷入一种不那么戏剧性但非常令人不满意的停滞状态——伤亡数字有所下降，但该国仍然分裂在胡塞武装（伊朗的什叶派盟友）控制的地区和沙特支持的也门军队的不同且往往缺乏动力的部队之间。

paras.en: The former British defence attachÃ© to Yemen, Col Iain Smailes, warned that the recent Houthi advance could trigger a spike in oil prices, as it did when they seized the Bab al-Mandab Strait in September.
paras.zh: 英国前驻也门国防武官伊恩·斯迈尔斯上校警告说，胡塞武装最近的进展可能会引发油价飙升，就像他们9月份占领曼德海峡时那样。

paras.en: He also warns this could have a knock-on effect to security well beyond Yemen's borders.
paras.zh: 他还警告说，这可能会对也门境外的安全产生连锁反应。

paras.en: "By extending their control over the western coastline, the Houthis will increase their ability to smuggle weapons and ammunition from Iran, the Horn of Africa and elsewhere, posing additional threats to the region," Col Smailes said.
paras.zh: 斯迈尔斯上校说：“通过扩大对西海岸线的控制，胡塞武装将增强从伊朗、非洲之角和其他地方走私武器和弹药的能力，从而对该地区构成额外的威胁。”

paras.en: "This control will enable both Iran and the Houthis to extend their influence in East Africa and beyond."
paras.zh: “这种控制将使伊朗和胡塞武装能够扩大其在东非及其他地区的影响力。”

articles.title: Nvidia dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign as Trump backs effort to reinstate ex CEO

paras.en: Nvidia has dismissed a campaign calling for Jensen Huang to be handed back his job as allies, including US President Donald Trump, backed the effort.
paras.zh: 英伟达驳回了一项要求黄仁勋交回职位的活动，因为包括美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在内的盟友支持这一努力。

paras.en: Trump said on Monday that he "would certainly not mind" if Huang was reinstated, adding to a list of supporters who are backing a "Bring Jensen Back" campaign.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一表示，如果黄仁勋复职，他“当然不会介意”，这又增加了支持“让詹森回来”运动的支持者名单。

paras.en: Fellow tech bosses, including SpaceX's Elon Musk and Tim Sweeney, chief executive of Fortnite-maker Epic Games, have also supported Huang's return.
paras.zh: 包括 SpaceX 的埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和《堡垒之夜》制造商 Epic Games 首席执行官蒂姆·斯威尼 (Tim Sweeney) 在内的其他科技巨头也支持黄仁勋的回归。

paras.en: But the BBC has been told the board of the AI chip giant is not interested in bringing him back after he resigned last week following revelations he had two affairs, including one that involved a suspected Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 但英国广播公司获悉，这家人工智能芯片巨头的董事会无意让他回归，因为他上周辞职，因为他有两起婚外情，其中一桩涉及一名疑似中国间谍。

paras.en: Meanwhile on Monday, the Trump administration said it will further restrict China's âaccess to AI chips from companies like Nvidia.
paras.zh: 与此同时，特朗普政府周一表示，将进一步限制中国“获取英伟达等公司的人工智能芯片”。

paras.en: The reported affairs created a crisis for one of the world's most valuable firms - a central company in AI and the US battle against China for dominance. Since his departure, supporters have launched an online petition demanding his return.
paras.zh: 所报道的事件给世界上最有价值的公司之一——一家人工智能领域的核心公司以及美国与中国争夺主导地位的斗争——造成了一场危机。自从他离开后，支持者发起了在线请愿活动，要求他返回。

paras.en: Musk and Sweeny are among the more than 175,000 who have signed the open letter calling for the board to reinstate Huang while an ongoing internal probe is conducted.
paras.zh: 马斯克和斯威尼是超过 175,000 人签署公开信的人之一，呼吁董事会在正在进行的内部调查期间恢复黄的职位。

paras.en: The "Stand with Jensen" campaign claims to have been launched by a make up of current and former Nvidia employees, partners, shareholders and supporters, all demanding the return of the former chief executive.
paras.zh: “与詹森站在一起”活动声称是由英伟达现任和前任员工、合作伙伴、股东和支持者发起的，他们都要求这位前首席执行官回归。

paras.en: They expressed concerns the ex-Nvidia boss "was removed without meaningful due process".
paras.zh: 他们对这位前英伟达老板“在没有经过有意义的正当程序的情况下被解雇”表示担忧。

paras.en: President Trump gave his views on Huang's future on Monday, saying he "would certainly not mind" seeing the former boss given his job back.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统周一对黄的未来发表了看法，称他“当然不介意”看到这位前老板重新获得职位。

paras.en: "I guess maybe one lesson is more important than another, but I would certainly not mind seeing that," he told reporters as he left the White House.
paras.zh: “我想也许一个教训比另一个更重要，但我当然不介意看到这一点，”他在离开白宫时告诉记者。

paras.en: The Trump administration on Monday also issued new restrictions on chip exports to overseas data centres, which allow Chinese companies to access advanced AI chips to train AI models.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府周一还发布了对向海外数据中心出口芯片的新限制，允许中国公司获得先进的人工智能芯片来训练人工智能模型。

paras.en: The move came ahead of Trump's meeting with Chinese President Xi Jingping this week.
paras.zh: 此举是在特朗普本周与中国国家主席习近平会晤之前做出的。
